sum: This study analyzes the ML 5.6 Reno earthquake sequence, Canada's largest induced seismic event, using seismological data from local arrays deployed after the mainshock. The seismicity is mapped to a single fault plane within the crystalline basement. Reflection seismic data reveal a fault structure extending from the sedimentary section down to the basement, potentially acting as a conduit for pressure transfer from wastewater disposal wells. Temporal correlation analysis suggests a stronger link between seismicity and operations in a nearby Belloy Formation well compared to a Leduc Formation well. The findings highlight the role of subsurface structures in induced seismicity and the importance of well-specific operational impacts.
本文利用主震后部署的局部地震台网观测数据，分析了加拿大最大的诱发地震事件——ML 5.6雷诺地震序列。地震活动被映射到结晶基底内的单一断层面上。反射地震数据揭示了一个从沉积层向下延伸至基底的断层构造，可能作为废水处置井压力传递的通道。时间相关性分析表明，地震活动与附近Belloy组油井的作业有更强的……

t: The study uses seismological observations from local arrays and integrates reflection seismic datasets to map seismicity and identify fault structures.
研究利用局部台网的地震观测和反射地震数据来绘制地震活动和识别断层构造。
Data includes seismological observations from local arrays deployed post-mainshock and reflection seismic datasets.
数据包括主震后部署的局部台网地震观测和反射地震数据集。
Seismicity maps to a basement fault, potentially connected to a Belloy Formation well via a sedimentary structure.
地震活动映射到基底断层，可能通过沉积构造连接到Belloy组油井。
The analysis relies on post-mainshock data and infers connections between structures and pressure transfer.
分析基于主震后数据，并推断构造与压力传递的联系。
Detailed seismological mapping of a large induced event and its link to specific wastewater disposal well operations.
详细地震学绘制了大型诱发事件及其与特定废水处置井作业的联系。

kc: Detailed seismological mapping of the Reno induced earthquake sequence within the crystalline basement.
Identification of a potential fault conduit connecting sedimentary formations to the basement fault plane.
Correlation of seismicity with wastewater disposal well operations, particularly in the Belloy Formation.
详细地震学地绘制了结晶基底内的雷诺诱发地震序列。
识别出连接沉积层与基底断层面的潜在断层通道。
将地震活动与废水处置井作业相关联，特别是在Belloy组。

Integration of reflection seismic datasets.
Temporal correlation analysis between seismicity and well operations.
来自局部监测阵列的地震学数据分析。
反射地震数据集的整合。
地震活动与油井作业之间的时间相关性分析。

Reflection seismic datasets.
Wastewater disposal well operational data.

tm.why: The paper investigates the ML 5.6 Reno earthquake sequence, identified as the largest induced seismic event in Canada, and its relationship with nearby wastewater disposal wells.

The study maps seismicity within the crystalline basement and uses reflection seismic datasets to identify fault structures in the sedimentary section, contributing to understanding subsurface structure.
The paper aims to develop a detailed understanding of the processes that drove the seismicity, which relates to earthquake source processes.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the provided abstract and metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the seismogenic structures of three moderate-magnitude (Ms 5.4) earthquakes in 2021 and 2022 in the western Kunlun Range foreland thrust system (WKFTS) and their relationship with the 2015 Ms 6.5 Pishan event. Using waveform data from the Xinjiang regional seismic network, the authors relocated mainshocks and aftershocks via Hyposat and HypoDD, inverted focal mechanisms using the Cut and Paste (CAP) method, integrated petroleum seismic reflection profiles, and calculated Coulomb failure stress changes using PSGRN/PSCMP. Unlike the 2015 Pishan event on the Slik ramp (~8.8 km depth), the three recent earthquakes occurred at 16.7–20.3 km depth on the gently S-dipping (20°–25°) frontal blind Kuoshi fault ramp, within positive Coulomb stress loading zones (up to 0.0494 MPa). The results reveal simple outward thrust propagation where rear ramps cease slipping and the unruptured frontal ramp poses a minimum Mw 6.5 seismic hazard.
本研究探讨了2021和2022年西昆仑山前冲断带三次Ms 5.4地震的发震构造及其与2015年皮山Ms 6.5地震的关系。利用新疆区域台网波形数据，采用Hyposat和HypoDD方法对主余震进行重定位，利用CAP方法反演震源机制，结合石油地震反射剖面，并通过PSGRN/PSCMP计算了同震与震后库……

t: The authors relocated earthquake sequences using Hyposat and HypoDD with a local 1D velocity model, inverted focal mechanisms via the CAP method with bootstrap resampling, and calculated viscoelastic Coulomb stress changes using PSGRN/PSCMP.
采用Hyposat与HypoDD重定位、CAP方法反演震源机制解，并用PSGRN/PSCMP计算粘弹性库仑应力变化。

The study used 1,146 wave files from the Xinjiang regional digital seismic network (2021–2023), broadband waveforms from 14 regional stations within 350 km, and two 2D petroleum seismic reflection profiles.
使用新疆台网1146个波形文件、14个区域宽频带台站波形数据及两条二维石油地震反射剖面。

The three 2021–2022 Ms 5.4 mainshocks relocated to 16.7–20.3 km depth with thrust focal mechanisms (dip 19°–31°) on the frontal Kuoshi ramp, experiencing up to 0.0494 MPa combined coseismic and postseismic Coulomb stress loading.
三次Ms 5.4地震重定位深度为16.7–20.3 km，位于前锋阔什断坡上，受到最高0.0494 MPa的正库仑应力加…
No published effective friction coefficient exists for the Kuoshi fault ramp, requiring an assumed conservative estimate of 0.4 and sensitivity testing across values of 0.2 and 0.6.
阔什断坡缺乏实测摩擦系数，只能假设0.4的保守估计值并进行敏感性测试。
Contrary to prior studies attributing the 2021–2022 events to the 2015 Pishan fault or basement structures, this work identifies the newly recognized frontal blind Kuoshi ramp as their common source.
推翻了前人认为发震于2015年皮山断层或基底构造的观点，首次确定前锋盲断坡阔什断坡为发震构造。

kc: Identified the gently S-dipping (20°–25°) blind Kuoshi fault ramp as the seismogenic structure for the three 2021–2022 Ms 5.4 earthquakes at depths of 16.7–20.3 km.

Demonstrated that coseismic and postseismic slips of the 2015 Ms 6.5 Pishan earthquake produced positive Coulomb stress changes (up to 0.0494 MPa) on the Kuoshi ramp, promoting the 2021–2022 ruptures.

Revealed a simple outward thrusting deformation pattern in the WKFTS where rear thrust ramps become inactive and active strain concentrates on the frontal blind ramp, which holds an unruptured segment capable of an Mw ≥ 6.5 earthquake.
查明向南缓倾（20°–25°）的盲断坡——阔什断坡是2021–2022年三次Ms 5.4地震（深度16.7–20.3 km）的发震构造。
证实2015年皮山Ms 6.5地震的同震和震后滑动在阔什断坡上产生了正库仑应力加载（最大达0.0494 MPa），促进了2021–2022年地震的发生。
揭示了西昆仑山前冲断带的前展式逆冲变形模式，后排断坡停止活动而前锋盲断坡集中积累应变，其未破裂段具备发生Mw ≥ 6.5地震的潜能。
me: Earthquake relocation combining Hyposat for initial absolute locations and double-difference (HypoDD) for high-precision relative locations using a custom local 1D velocity model.
Focal mechanism inversion using the Cut and Paste (CAP) waveform inversion method with F-K synthetic Green's functions and 100-iteration bootstrap uncertainty analysis.
Structural interpretation integrating relocated seismicity and focal mechanisms with 2D petroleum seismic reflection profiles across the Guman and Slik anticlines.
Coseismic and postseismic Coulomb failure stress change modeling using elastic/viscoelastic dislocation theory (PSGRN/PSCMP) with friction coefficient sensitivity analysis (0.2, 0.4, 0.6).
结合Hyposat绝对定位和双差定位法（HypoDD），利用定制的区域一维速度模型对主震和余震序列进行高精度重定位。
采用截断粘贴法（CAP）和F-K合成格林函数反演震源机制解，并通过100次Bootstrap重采样评估结果的稳定性。
将重定位震源位置和震源机制解投影至横跨固满和Slik背斜的石油地震反射剖面，综合约束深部发震断层几何形态。
利用弹性/粘弹性位错理论程序包（PSGRN/PSCMP）计算同震和震后库仑破裂应力变化，并对有效摩擦系数（0.2、0.4、0.6）进行敏感性分析。
de: 1,146 waveform files and phase-picking data from 713 selected earthquakes recorded by fixed and mobile stations of the Xinjiang regional digital seismic network within 400 km.
Broadband waveforms from 14 regional stations within 350 km epicentral distance for CAP focal mechanism inversion of the three Ms 5.4 mainshocks.
Two 2D petroleum seismic reflection profiles across the Pixina and Wuxiabashi areas in the western Kunlun piedmont.
Published coseismic and postseismic slip models of the 2015 Ms 6.5 Pishan earthquake derived from InSAR, GPS, and teleseismic data.
收集新疆区域数字地震台网400 km范围内固定台和流动台记录的1146个波形文件，筛选出713个地震事件进行重定位。
选取震中距350 km以内14个区域宽频带台站的波形数据，用于三次Ms 5.4主震的CAP震源机制反演。
西昆仑山前Pixina和Wuxiabashi地区的两条二维石油地震反射剖面。
已发表的基于InSAR、GPS和远震数据反演的2015年皮山Ms 6.5地震同震及震后滑动模型。
li: No published effective friction coefficient is available specifically for the Kuoshi fault ramp, requiring an assumed conservative estimate of 0.4 and sensitivity testing.
Earthquake locations and Green's functions rely on 1D layered crustal velocity models rather than a 3D velocity model across the complex Kunlun-Tarim transition.
The calculated Coulomb stress increment for the 2021 Yecheng earthquake (0.004–0.008 MPa) is slightly below the conventional 0.01 MPa triggering threshold.
阔什断坡缺乏已发表的实际摩擦系数测量值，只能采用0.4的保守估计值并进行敏感性测试。
地震重定位和格林函数计算依赖于一维分层地壳速度模型，未考虑昆仑-塔里木盆山结合带复杂的三维速度结构。
计算得到的2021年叶城地震处的库仑应力增量（0.004–0.008 MPa）略低于传统的0.01 MPa触发阈值。

tm.why: The paper relocates the 2015 Pishan earthquake and three 2021–2022 moderate earthquakes along with their aftershocks using Hyposat and HypoDD.
The study inverts focal mechanism solutions using the CAP method and calculates coseismic and postseismic Coulomb stress changes to evaluate earthquake triggering.
The authors integrate seismicity with seismic reflection profiles to delineate the subsurface fault-fold geometry and deformation propagation of the western Kunlun Range foreland thrust system.

ev.notes: Full 30-page unedited manuscript PDF from Geophysical Journal International used for all metadata, methods, quantitative results, source anchors, and figure analyses.

sum: Simultaneously estimating earthquake fault geometry and slip distribution from geodetic observations typically assumes a homogeneous half-space because numerical forward modeling in heterogeneous structures requires costly remeshing for every candidate geometry. This study overcomes this barrier for 2-D inplane problems by combining two key concepts. First, the principle of fault geometry invariance is generalized to heterogeneous linear elastic media to define a dislocation potential (DP), reducing an infinite-dimensional fault geometry problem to finite dimensions via line integration. Second, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to yield continuous, differentiable ensemble solutions for the DP, enabling efficient gradient-based Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) Bayesian sampling. Synthetic tests on a 2-D curved reverse fault with topography and elastic heterogeneity show that incorporating true heterogeneous structure accurately recovers the two-peak slip distribution, fault shape, and noise level (1.04 cm vs. 1 cm ground truth), whereas a homogeneous assumption yields severely biased estimates.
本研究提出了一种在非均匀地壳结构中同时反演断层几何形状和滑动分布的贝叶斯方法。首先，基于二维平面应变下的断层几何不变性引入位错势（DP），通过线积分将无限维断层几何问题降为有限维。其次，利用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解位错势的可微集合解，从而支持基于自动微分的高效哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）采样。……

t: Combines a 2-D inplane dislocation potential (DP) integral formulation with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to obtain differentiable forward displacement solutions, enabling Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) Bayesian sampling of fault geometry and slip.
结合二维面内位错势积分公式与物理信息神经网络获得可微位移解，利用HMC进行断层几何与滑动的贝叶斯反演。

2-D synthetic surface displacements generated via FEM at 100 equally spaced points with 1 cm Gaussian noise for a 16-km curved reverse fault (two slip peaks, max 1.6 m) in a heterogeneous medium with topography.
含地形和非均匀介质中16公里弯曲逆断层（双峰滑动，最大1.6米）的100个地表点FEM合成位移（含1厘米噪声）。

The heterogeneous (HET) model accurately recovers fault shape, two slip peaks, and noise (1.04 ± 0.05 cm vs. 1 cm truth), whereas the homogeneous (HOM) model yields unstable geometry, biased slip, and doubled noise (1.95 ± 0.12 cm).
非均匀模型准确恢复断层形态、双峰滑动及噪声（1.04厘米），而均匀模型结果严重失真且噪声被高估至1.95厘米。
The method is restricted to 2-D problems because defining and solving the dislocation potential in 3-D requires parameterizing a boundary curve with infinite degrees of freedom.
受限于二维问题，三维位错势依赖于无限自由度的边界曲线，难以直接用PINNs数值求解。
First simultaneous Bayesian inversion of fault geometry and slip in heterogeneous crustal structures by integrating inplane dislocation potential theory with differentiable PINN ensemble modeling.
首次将面内位错势理论与PINN可微集合建模相结合，实现非均匀地壳中断层几何与滑动的同时反演。

kc: Extended the principle of fault geometry invariance and dislocation potential (DP) to 2-D inplane dislocations in arbitrary heterogeneous linear elastic media.
Trained physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to obtain continuous, differentiable ensemble solutions of the inplane DP tensor, avoiding repetitive FEM remeshing.
Implemented Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) Bayesian inversion using automatic differentiation of PINN-based DP line integrals to jointly infer fault geometry, slip, and data noise.
Demonstrated via 2-D synthetic experiments that accounting for crustal heterogeneity and topography removes severe slip and depth biases caused by homogeneous half-space assumptions.
将断层几何不变性原理和位错势（DP）理论扩展到任意非均匀线弹性介质中的二维面内位错问题。
训练物理信息神经网络（PINNs）获取面内位错势张量的连续可微集合解，避免了传统有限元法繁琐的重复网格划分。
结合PINN位错势线积分的自动微分与哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）方法，实现了断层几何、滑动分布和观测噪声的高效贝叶斯联合反演。
通过二维合成数值实验证明，引入真实非均匀地壳结构和地形能显著消除均匀半空间假设带来的断层深度和滑动量反演偏差。
me: Theoretical formulation of 2-D inplane and 3-component dislocation potential (DP) tensors based on fault geometry invariance and linear superposition.
Line integral representation of surface displacements for arbitrary curved fault geometries and slip distributions using the spatial gradient of the DP tensor.
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) trained to solve partial differential equations for the two DP vector components across heterogeneous media.
Bayesian inference via Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS), leveraging automatic differentiation through the trained PINNs.
基于断层几何不变性和线性叠加原理，建立二维面内及三分量位错势（DP）张量的理论公式。
利用位错势张量的空间梯度线积分，表征任意弯曲断层几何和滑动分布引起的地表位移。
训练两个独立的物理信息神经网络（PINNs），求解非均匀介质中面内位错势两个矢量分量的偏微分方程。
利用训练好的PINNs进行自动微分计算后验梯度，采用带No-U-Turn采样器（NUTS）的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）方法进行贝叶斯推断。
de: 2-D synthetic forward validation of fault geometry invariance across four curved fault geometries sharing a common tip in a heterogeneous medium.
2-D synthetic inversion on a 16-km curved reverse fault (depth 10 km, 8 segments) with a two-peak slip distribution (max 1.6 m) in a heterogeneous structure with surface topography.
Synthetic surface displacement data generated at 100 equally spaced stations using FEM with added 1 cm Gaussian noise.
Comparative Bayesian inversions using homogeneous half-space (HOM) vs. true heterogeneous (HET) models, both with and without slip positivity constraints.
二维合成正演验证：在非均匀介质中对比共用同一端点的四条不同弯曲断层，验证面内位错的几何不变性条件。
二维合成反演设置：在含地表起伏和非均匀弹性结构的介质中，设置一条长16公里（分8段，深10公里）、具有双峰滑动分布（最大1.6米）的弯曲逆断层。
合成观测数据：在100个等间距地表台站上，利用有限元法（FEM）生成合成位移数据并加入标准差为1厘米的高斯噪声。
对比反演实验：分别在施加和不施加滑动正值约束条件下，对比均匀半空间模型（HOM）与真实非均匀模型（HET）的贝叶斯反演结果。
li: The proposed dislocation potential inversion framework is currently restricted to 2-D space; extending DP to 3-D is difficult because the 3-D DP tensor depends on a boundary curve with infinite degrees of freedom.
PINNs are trained for a fixed heterogeneous structure and cannot directly represent ensemble uncertainty over variable elastic structures (which have infinite degrees of freedom).
Only synthetic 2-D data with spatially uncorrelated Gaussian noise were tested; real spatially dense geodetic data require full data covariance matrices.
当前位错势反演框架仅限于二维问题；将其推广到三维很困难，因为三维位错势张量依赖于具有无限自由度的边界曲线。
PINNs针对固定的非均匀结构进行训练，无法直接表征具有无限自由度的可变弹性结构不确定性。
仅测试了含空间不相关高斯噪声的二维合成数据，实际高密度大地测量数据反演还需引入完整的数据协方差矩阵。

tm.why: The paper develops an inversion method to simultaneously estimate earthquake fault geometry and coseismic slip distributions from surface deformation.
It uses Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) sampling to estimate posterior probability distributions and uncertainties of fault geometry, slip, and observational noise.
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to provide continuous, differentiable ensemble solutions of the dislocation potential in heterogeneous structures.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF read and analyzed, including equations, synthetic experiment setups, HMC inversion results, and all 6 figures.

sum: This study performs ultrasonic wave-speed measurements on exhumed metasedimentary rock samples from the Lakes of the Gods fault zone (Olympic Subduction Complex), serving as an analog for the modern Cascadia megathrust. The laboratory results reveal strong seismic anisotropy (up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs) controlled by lithology and structural fabric. By weighting these laboratory measurements based on mapped fault-zone unit abundances, the authors construct composite larger-scale velocities that match in-situ geophysical observations of the low-velocity zone. The findings suggest that the observed low-velocity zone is primarily an intrinsic feature of accreted metasediments and their fabric, rather than solely fluid overpressure. Additionally, the derived shear moduli (20.0–30.1 GPa) indicate that fabric development acts as a critical weakening mechanism at seismogenic depths.
本研究对奥林匹克俯冲杂岩带（卡斯卡迪亚巨型逆冲断层陆上类比）的样品进行了超声波速测量。结果表明，岩性和结构面理发育对地震波速起首要控制作用，产生高达25.6%的Vp各向异性和31.6%的Vs各向异性。通过对实验室测量值进行地质丰度加权估算的大尺度速度，与实际观测到的俯冲带低速带高度吻合。这表明低速带……

t: Ultrasonic wave-speed measurements on exhumed fault-zone rock samples combined with volumetric upscaling based on geological mapping.
对出露断裂带岩石样品进行超声波速测量，并结合地质填图进行体积比例尺度上推。
Exhumed metasedimentary rock samples from the Lakes of the Gods fault zone in the Olympic Subduction Complex, representing a Cascadia megathrust analog.
采集自奥林匹克俯冲杂岩带Lakes of the Gods断裂带的变质沉积岩样品。
Measured seismic anisotropy up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs, with derived shear moduli (20.0-30.1 GPa) lower than geophysical estimates.
测得Vp各向异性达25.6%，Vs达31.6%，剪切模量（20.0-30.1 GPa）低于地球物理估算值。
The study relies on exhumed analog samples to infer deep in-situ properties, which may have undergone alteration or stress relief.
利用地表出露的类比样品来推断深部原位性质，可能存在后期改造或应力释放影响。
Demonstrating that the subduction low-velocity zone can be explained by intrinsic rock fabric and lithology rather than solely high fluid pressures.
证明俯冲带低速带可由岩石固有面理和岩性解释，而非完全依赖于高流体压力。

kc: Measured ultrasonic wave-speeds and anisotropy on exhumed Cascadia megathrust analog samples.
Demonstrated that lithology and structural fabric produce high seismic anisotropy (up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs).
Showed that the subduction low-velocity zone can be explained by the intrinsic elastic properties of accreted metasediments.
Identified fabric development as a critical weakening mechanism that lowers shear moduli at seismogenic depths.
对卡斯卡迪亚巨型逆冲断层类比带的露头样品进行了超声波速和各向异性测量。
证明了岩性和结构面理会产生极高的地震各向异性（Vp达25.6%，Vs达31.6%）。
表明俯冲带低速层可由增生变质沉积物的固有弹性性质和面理结构来解释。
指出面理发育是降低发震深度剪切模量的关键弱化机制。
me: Ultrasonic wave-speed measurements (Vp and Vs) on rock core samples under laboratory conditions.
Fabric and lithological characterization of exhumed fault zone samples.
Upscaling laboratory measurements to regional scale using volumetric weighting based on geological mapping.
在实验室条件下对岩心样品进行超声波速（Vp和Vs）测量。
对出露断裂带样品的面理和岩性特征进行表征。
基于地质填图的体积加权方法，将实验室测量结果外推至区域大尺度。
de: Rock samples collected from the Lakes of the Gods fault zone in the Olympic Subduction Complex.
Laboratory-derived directional elastic wave velocities and calculated shear moduli (20.0–30.1 GPa).
采集自奥林匹克俯冲杂岩带Lakes of the Gods断裂带的岩石样品。
实验室测得的方向弹性波速及计算得到的剪切模量（20.0–30.1 GPa）。
li: Laboratory measurements on exhumed samples may not fully capture in-situ fluid pressure conditions and transient stress states.
The upscaling model assumes simplified volumetric proportions of lithologies.
对出露地表样品的实验室测量可能无法完全模拟原位的真实流体压力条件和瞬态应力状态。
尺度上推模型假设了简化的岩性体积比例。

tm.why: The paper measures ultrasonic wave-speeds on exhumed fault zone samples, reporting high seismic anisotropy of up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs.
The study links laboratory-derived elastic properties and fabric development to weakening mechanisms and earthquake source physics in the Cascadia megathrust.
It investigates the origin of the low-velocity zone at the subduction plate interface using exhumed metasedimentary rocks.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the complete metadata and abstract provided via OpenAlex, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the stability and water exchange of dense hydrous magnesium silicates (DHMSs) coexisting with nominally anhydrous minerals (NAMs) under water-undersaturated subducting slab conditions (~2 wt% H2O). Using multi-anvil high-pressure (8–28 GPa) and high-temperature (800–1500 °C) experiments on MgO–SiO2–H2O systems with varying Mg/Si ratios (2.0 and 1.3), the authors construct internally consistent phase diagrams and quantify mineral water contents via EPMA and FTIR. They demonstrate that DHMSs progressively dehydrate in the mantle transition zone, transferring water into wadsleyite and ringwoodite without generating free fluid, while leaving the cold slab core (<900 °C) nearly dry. Consequently, transformational faulting from dry metastable olivine, rather than dehydration embrittlement, likely triggers most deep-focus earthquakes above 660 km, whereas rapid dehydration of phase D/superhydrous phase B near 700 km triggers the deepest earthquakes. Furthermore, higher Mg/Si ratios stabilize DHMSs, making harzburgite a more efficient deep-water carrier than peridotite.
本研究通过多顶砧高温高压实验（8–28 GPa，800–1500 °C），探究了水不饱和俯冲板片条件下（~2 wt% H2O）不同Mg/Si比值（2.0和1.3）的MgO–SiO2–H2O体系中含水镁硅酸盐（DHMSs）与名义上无水矿物（NAMs）的相态关系及水交换过程。结合电子探针和红外光谱分析，……

t: High-pressure (8–28 GPa) and high-temperature (800–1500 °C) multi-anvil press experiments on hydrous MgO-SiO2 mixtures (~2 wt% H2O) with Mg/Si ratios of 2 and 1.3, analyzed via XRD, FE-SEM, EPMA, and FTIR.
对含2 wt%水的不同Mg/Si比值（2和1.3）MgO-SiO2混合物开展8–28 GPa、800–1500 °C多顶…

Recovered experimental run products from reagent mixtures (Mg2SiO4 + 2 wt% H2O and Mg1.3SiO3.3 + 2 wt% H2O) and pre-synthesized hydrous wadsleyite/ringwoodite, including XRD patterns, BSE images, EPMA compositions, and FTIR spectra.
两组试剂混合物及预合成含水瓦兹利石/林伍德石的高温高压实验回收样品，包含XRD图谱、BSE图像、EPMA成分和FTIR光…
DHMS volume fractions decrease with temperature in the MTZ (e.g., sPhB drops from ~35% at 1000 °C to ~4% at 1200 °C at 18 GPa), while wadsleyite water content reaches ~1.8 wt% before sPhB disappears.
转换带中DHMS体积分数随升温显著下降（18 GPa下sPhB从1000 °C的35%降至1200 °C的4%），瓦兹利…
The experiments omit minor natural components like CaO, FeO, and Al2O3, and low-temperature NAM grain sizes (<15–20 μm) are too small for direct FTIR water quantification.
实验未包含CaO、FeO和Al2O3等天然次要组分，且低温实验样品晶粒过小（<15–20 μm）无法直接进行FTIR测水…

First internally consistent phase diagrams at 2 wt% bulk water up to 28 GPa providing direct experimental proof of temperature-dependent partial DHMS dehydration and progressive NAM hydration in varying Mg/Si slabs.
首次建立2 wt%含水量下直达下地幔顶部的内部一致相图，直接证实了转换带含水矿物渐进脱水与名义无水矿物连续水化的耦合机制…

kc: Constructed internally consistent phase diagrams for water-undersaturated (~2 wt% H2O) MgO-SiO2-H2O systems across 8–28 GPa and 800–1500 °C for Mg/Si = 2 and 1.3.
Provided direct experimental evidence for progressive solid-state dehydration of DHMSs coupled with continuous hydration of wadsleyite and ringwoodite in the mantle transition zone.

Demonstrated that dry olivine transformational faulting likely drives most deep earthquakes above 660 km, whereas rapid DHMS dehydration near 700 km generates fluids triggering the deepest earthquakes.
Showed that higher bulk Mg/Si ratios expand the thermal stability of DHMSs in the upper transition zone, making the harzburgite layer a more effective water carrier than peridotite.
构建了水不饱和（~2 wt% H2O）MgO-SiO2-H2O体系（Mg/Si = 2和1.3）在8–28 GPa和800–1500 °C下的内部一致相图。
提供了地幔转换带中DHMSs渐进固态脱水并与瓦兹利石和林伍德石连续水化耦合的直接实验证据。
阐明660 km以上的深源地震主要由干橄榄石相变断层作用驱动，而700 km附近的快速脱水产生流体并触发最深源地震。
揭示较高的全岩Mg/Si比值扩大了上转换带中DHMSs的热稳定性，表明方辉橄榄岩层比二辉橄榄岩层是更有效的水载体。
me: High-pressure and high-temperature phase-equilibrium experiments using 6-axis and Kawai-type multi-anvil presses (8–28 GPa, 800–1500 °C).
Decomposition reversal experiments using pre-synthesized hydrous wadsleyite (~2 wt% H2O) and ringwoodite (~1.6 wt% H2O).
Phase identification and textural analysis via microfocus X-ray diffraction (XRD), field-emission SEM back-scattered electron (BSE) imaging, and ImageJ volume fraction estimation.
Chemical composition and water content quantification in NAMs using Electron Probe Microanalysis (EPMA Mg/Si ratio proxy) and Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy.
利用六轴和Kawai型多顶砧压机开展高温高压相平衡实验（8–28 GPa，800–1500 °C）。
使用预合成的含水瓦兹利石（~2 wt% H2O）和林伍德石（~1.6 wt% H2O）进行分解验证实验。
通过微区X射线衍射（XRD）、场发射扫描电镜背散射电子（BSE）成像及ImageJ软件估算进行物相鉴定与体积分数分析。
利用电子探针（EPMA Mg/Si比值代理指标）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）定量分析名义上无水矿物的化学成分与含水量。
de: High P-T runs on synthetic reagent mixtures of Mg2SiO4 + 2 wt% H2O (Mg/Si = 2) and Mg1.3SiO3.3 + 2 wt% H2O (Mg/Si = 1.3) sealed in welded Au capsules.
Secondary high P-T experiments on pre-synthesized hydrous wadsleyite and ringwoodite between 10–22 GPa and 900–1300 °C.
XRD patterns, BSE images, EPMA compositional datasets, and unpolarized FTIR absorption spectra (1600–4800 cm^-1) archived in Mendeley Data.
密封于焊接金胶囊中的Mg2SiO4 + 2 wt% H2O（Mg/Si = 2）和Mg1.3SiO3.3 + 2 wt% H2O（Mg/Si = 1.3）合成试剂混合物的高温高压实验。
在10–22 GPa和900–1300 °C条件下对预合成含水瓦兹利石和林伍德石开展的二阶段高温高压实验。
存储在Mendeley Data中的XRD图谱、BSE图像、EPMA成分数据集以及非偏振FTIR吸收光谱（1600–4800 cm^-1）。
li: Experiments were conducted in simplified iron-, calcium-, and aluminum-free MgO-SiO2-H2O systems, omitting multi-component effects present in natural ultramafic rocks.
Small grain sizes (<15–20 μm) of NAMs at low temperatures prevented direct FTIR measurement, requiring water contents to be estimated via EPMA Mg/Si ratios.
实验在简化的不含铁、钙、铝的MgO-SiO2-H2O体系中进行，未涵盖天然超镁铁质岩石中多组分的影响。
低温下合成的名义上无水矿物晶粒较小（<15–20 μm），低于FTIR测量孔径限制，需依赖EPMA的Mg/Si比值估算水含量。

tm.why: The paper investigates deep mantle mineral phase relations, water exchange between hydrous and nominally anhydrous minerals, and their controls on slab deformation and stagnation.
The study evaluates the triggering mechanisms of intermediate-depth and deep-focus earthquakes, comparing dry olivine transformational faulting against dehydration embrittlement.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 10-page Nature Communications PDF, including main text, figures, and Methods section.

sum: Following the 7 January 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri normal-faulting earthquake in southern Tibet, multi-track InSAR (Sentinel-1, LT-1, ALOS-2) revealed a ~30 cm circular deformation anomaly west of the main rupture that was absent from seismic catalogs (maximum reported aftershock Ms 4.3). Integrating InSAR and high-rate GNSS slip inversions, deep-learning strong-motion aftershock detection (USTC-Picker), static Coulomb stress modeling, and 3D SeisSol dynamic rupture simulations, the authors show the anomaly corresponds to an Mw 5.9 slip event on a branch fault (F3). While static Coulomb stress change unloaded F3, 3D dynamic simulations demonstrate that transient dynamic stresses from the cascading rupture along the main (F1) and conjugate (F2) faults unclamped F3 and triggered rupture within ~15–20 s, burying its seismic signals in the mainshock coda. This combined geodetic-dynamic workflow effectively resolves near-field catalog blind spots.
2025年1月7日西藏定日Mw 7.1正断层地震后，多轨InSAR（Sentinel-1、LT-1、ALOS-2）在主破裂西侧发现一处约30厘米的圆形形变异常，但常规地震目录最大余震仅为Ms 4.3。本研究结合InSAR与高频GNSS静态滑动反演、基于深度学习（USTC-Picker）的近场强震早期……

t: Combines two-step InSAR/GNSS static slip inversion, deep-learning strong-motion phase picking (USTC-Picker), Coulomb stress modeling, and 3D SeisSol dynamic rupture simulations with linear slip-weakening friction and off-fault plasticity.
结合两步法InSAR/GNSS静态反演、强震深度学习拾取、库仑应力计算及SeisSol三维动力学模拟。

Multi-track L-band (LT-1, ALOS-2) and C-band (Sentinel-1) SAR imagery, 1 Hz three-component GNSS coseismic displacements from three near-field stations, and vertical strong-motion records within 6 minutes of the mainshock.
多轨L/C波段SAR影像（LT-1、ALOS-2、Sentinel-1）、近场1 Hz GNSS位移及主震后6分钟强震波…
Inversion reveals up to 3.7 m slip on F1, 4.1 m on conjugate F2, and 0.7 m (Mw 5.9) on branch F3. Dynamic modeling shows F1-F2 rupture dynamically unclamped and triggered F3 at ~15–20 s.
F1、F2和F3最大滑动分别为3.7、4.1和0.7米（Mw 5.9）；动态应力在约15–20秒解耦并触发F3。

Simplified planar fault geometry and unresolved local rock properties lead to underestimated waveform amplitudes at station D0004 and overestimated near-epicenter east-west surface displacements; parameter space exploration was limited to 13 models.
平面断层假设导致低估D0004台站振幅并高估震中东西向位移，且仅开展了13组参数敏感性测试。

Couples multi-track InSAR with 3D dynamic rupture modeling and strong-motion deep-learning detection to uncover a hidden Mw 5.9 branch rupture dynamically triggered within the mainshock coda inside a static stress shadow.
联合高分辨率InSAR与三维动力学模拟，揭示静态应力影区内被主震尾波掩盖的近瞬时动态触发Mw 5.9破裂。

kc: Identified an uncataloged Mw 5.9 earthquake on branch fault F3 from a ~30 cm circular InSAR deformation anomaly west of the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri mainshock.

Performed two-step static geodetic inversion combining L/C-band InSAR and high-rate GNSS to resolve slip across main fault F1 (up to 3.7 m), conjugate fault F2 (up to 4.1 m), and branch fault F3 (up to 0.7 m).

Showed through 3D dynamic rupture simulations (SeisSol) that static stress unloaded F3, whereas transient dynamic shear loading and normal-stress unclamping triggered F3 at ~15–20 s during the mainshock.
Demonstrated how combining early coseismic InSAR with strong-motion deep-learning picking overcomes near-field seismic catalog blind spots caused by mainshock coda masking.
利用2025年定日Mw 7.1主震西侧约30厘米的InSAR圆形形变异常，识别出分支断层F3上未被目录收录的Mw 5.9地震。
结合L/C波段InSAR与高频GNSS开展分步静态反演，约束了主断层F1（最大滑动3.7米）、共轭断层F2（4.1米）和分支断层F3（0.7米）的三维滑动分布。
通过SeisSol三维动力学破裂模拟证实静态库仑应力对F3起卸载作用，而瞬态动态剪应力加载与正应力解耦在主震发震约15-20秒时动态触发了F3破裂。
展示了结合早期同震InSAR与强震深度学习震相拾取克服主震尾波掩盖导致的近场地震目录盲区的有效性。
me: Multi-track InSAR processing (GMTSAR, split-spectrum ionospheric correction, SNAPHU phase unwrapping, pixel offset tracking) and 2D displacement decomposition.
Two-step static coseismic slip inversion of quadtree-downsampled InSAR and 3-component GNSS offsets using residual deformation to isolate smaller branch fault F3.
Early aftershock detection within 6 minutes of the mainshock using deep-learning picker USTC-Picker, PyOcto phase association, and NonLinLoc relocation in a 1D average of USTC-Litho2.0.
Static Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling using Coulomb 3.3 with effective friction sensitivity tests (μ' = 0.1 to 0.8).
3D dynamic rupture simulations using SeisSol (1.65M tetrahedral elements, linear slip-weakening friction, Drucker-Prager off-fault visco-plasticity).
多轨InSAR数据处理（GMTSAR、分谱法电离层校正、SNAPHU相位解缠、像素偏移量追踪POT）及二维形变场分解。
基于四叉树降采样InSAR和三分量GNSS数据的两步法静态同震滑动反演，利用F1和F2的残差形变场单独反演较小规模的分支断层F3。
基于深度学习拾取器USTC-Picker、PyOcto震相关联及NonLinLoc（采用USTC-Litho2.0一维平均速度模型）的主震后6分钟内近场强震早期余震检测。
使用Coulomb 3.3计算静态库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS），并对有效摩擦系数（μ' = 0.1至0.8）进行敏感性测试。
基于SeisSol的三维动力学破裂模拟（165万四面体网格、线性滑移弱化摩擦准则、Drucker-Prager断层外粘塑性耗散）。
de: Ascending and descending L-band (LuTan-1, ALOS-2) and C-band (Sentinel-1) SAR images, plus pre-event COMET-LiCS interferograms.
1 Hz three-component high-rate GNSS coseismic displacements from CMONOC stations (specifically XZB2, XZRK, XZAR).
Vertical-component waveforms from near-field strong-motion stations (D0004, D0007, DS002) and 4 broadband stations (36–88 km epicentral distance) from China Earthquake Administration.
Regional relocated aftershock catalogs (Yao et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2025) and 13 dynamic rupture parameter sensitivity models varying prestress ratio R, Dc, and friction.
升轨和降轨L波段（陆探一号LT-1、ALOS-2）与C波段（Sentinel-1）SAR影像，以及震前COMET-LiCS干涉图。
中国大陆构造环境监测网络（CMONOC）1 Hz高频GNSS台站（XZB2、XZRK、XZAR）三分量同震位移数据。
中国地震局近场强震动台站（D0004、D0007、DS002）垂直分量波形及震中距36–88公里处4个宽频带台站记录。
区域重定位余震目录（Yao et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2025）以及改变预应力比R、临界滑移距离Dc和摩擦系数的13组动力学敏感性试验模型。
li: Planar fault geometry simplifications cause the dynamic model to overestimate the east-west displacement component near the epicenter and underestimate waveform amplitudes at station D0004.
High computational cost restricted the 3D dynamic rupture parameter exploration to thirteen representative trial-and-error sensitivity models with uniform friction parameters.
InSAR has limited sensitivity to north-south displacements and suffers from temporal resolution limits imposed by satellite revisit cycles.
简化的平面断层几何模型导致动力学模拟高估了震中附近的东西向地表位移，并低估了D0004台站的波形振幅。
高昂的计算成本限制了对参数空间的全面搜索，仅针对均匀摩擦参数开展了13组代表性动力学敏感性测试。
InSAR对南北向形变敏感度有限，且受卫星重访周期带来的时间分辨率限制。

tm.why: The paper investigates a 3-segment normal fault rupture cascade and performs 3D dynamic rupture simulations using SeisSol to study dynamic stress triggering during the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake.
The authors apply deep-learning phase picking (USTC-Picker), PyOcto, and NonLinLoc to near-field strong-motion records to detect early aftershocks and expose catalog blind spots.
The study analyzes static Coulomb failure stress versus transient dynamic clamping/unclamping and rules out a slow-slip origin for a ~30 cm geodetic deformation anomaly.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the EPSL article (including abstract, text, figures 1-5, and references) was analyzed directly.

sum: This study presents a seismic imaging workflow to delineate a subsurface salt-dissolution void in McPherson County, Kansas, caused by a brine wastewater disposal well casing breach. The authors acquired high-frequency seismic reflection data and applied a 2D elastic multiscale full-waveform inversion (FWI) using body waves (20-50 Hz). First-arrival travel-time tomography, aided by a custom-trained convolutional neural network for automated picking, refined the initial velocity model. The FWI velocity updates successfully resolved the salt cavity, estimating it to be approximately 100 m wide and over 50 m tall, matching historical borehole measurements. This demonstrates FWI's capability for high-resolution hazard monitoring of shallow salt-related anomalies.
本研究针对堪萨斯州麦克弗森县因盐水处置井套管破裂导致的地下盐溶空洞，提出了一种高分辨率地震成像工作流。研究采集了高频地震反射数据，并应用20-50 Hz体波的二维弹性多尺度全波形反演（FWI）。利用定制训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）进行自动初至拾取，并通过初至走时断层成像优化了初始速度模型。FWI速度……

t: A 2D elastic multiscale full-waveform inversion (FWI) using 20-50 Hz body waves, combined with CNN-based first-arrival picking and travel-time tomography.
采用20-50 Hz体波的二维弹性多尺度全波形反演，结合基于CNN的初至拾取和走时断层成像。
High-frequency seismic reflection data with a maximum source offset of 1050 m, targeting a 150-m-deep Permian salt layer in Kansas.
针对堪萨斯州150米深二叠纪盐层的高频地震反射数据，最大震源偏移距为1050米。
The FWI velocity updates successfully resolved the salt cavity, estimating it to be approximately 100 m wide and over 50 m tall.
FWI速度更新成功圈定了盐腔，估算其宽度约为100米，高度超过50米。
The shallow depth and lack of high-pressure containment make this specific salt interval unsuitable for energy or CO2 storage.
该特定盐层由于埋深较浅且缺乏高压密封性，不适合用于能源或二氧化碳封存。
Integration of CNN-based automated picking, travel-time tomography, and high-frequency elastic FWI to successfully map a shallow, hazardous salt-dissolution void.
将CNN自动拾取、走时断层成像与高频弹性FWI相结合，成功实现了浅层危险盐溶空洞的精细成像。

kc: Developed an integrated seismic workflow combining CNN-based picking, travel-time tomography, and 2D elastic multiscale FWI.
Successfully imaged and delineated a shallow (150 m deep) salt-dissolution void, determining its horizontal and vertical dimensions.
Demonstrated the feasibility of using high-frequency FWI for environmental hazard assessment and infrastructure stability monitoring.
开发了结合CNN自动拾取、走时断层成像和二维弹性多尺度FWI的综合地震成像工作流。
成功对150米深的浅层盐溶空洞进行了成像与圈定，确定了其水平和垂直尺度。
展示了利用高频FWI进行环境灾害评估和基础设施稳定性监测的可行性。
me: 2D elastic multiscale Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI) using 20-50 Hz body waves.
First-arrival travel-time tomography for initial velocity model building.
Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for automated first-arrival picking from shot gathers.
利用20-50 Hz体波的二维弹性多尺度全波形反演（FWI）。
用于建立初始速度模型的初至走时断层成像。
用于从炮集记录中自动拾取初至的卷积神经网络（CNN）。
de: High-frequency seismic reflection data acquired over a known salt-dissolution void in McPherson County, Kansas, with a maximum source offset of 1050 m.
在堪萨斯州麦克弗森县已知盐溶空洞上方采集的高频地震反射数据，最大震源偏移距为1050米。
li: The shallow depth and lack of high-pressure fluid containment make this specific salt interval unsuitable for energy or CO2 storage.
由于该特定盐层埋深较浅且缺乏高压流体密封能力，因此不适合用于能源或二氧化碳封存。

tm.why: The paper uses a 2D elastic multiscale full-waveform inversion (FWI) technique to image a salt-dissolution void.
First-arrival travel-time tomography is used to refine the initial velocity model above the salt layer.
A custom-trained convolutional neural network is used for automated first-arrival picking from seismic shot gathers.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from OpenAlex, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: Linking physical source parameters to empirical magnitudes across scales is challenging for microearthquakes due to attenuation, scattering, and bandwidth limits. This study bridges the microseismic observational gap down to ML ≈ -1.8 by integrating near-source induced microearthquakes from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment (ToC2ME) in Canada, dense nodal recordings from Ridgecrest, regional broadband data from San Jacinto, and a western US potency catalog. After empirically calibrating borehole geophone gains using colocated broadband sensors, the authors apply Bayesian source-spectral inversion to P-wave displacement spectra to estimate scalar potency, corner frequency, and spectral falloff. Across nine local-magnitude units (-1.8 ≤ ML ≤ 7.5), the combined datasets follow a continuous quadratic scaling relation: MP = 0.040 ML^2 + 0.556 ML + 1.133. Synthetic forward modeling demonstrates that self-similar source scaling combined with anelastic attenuation and the finite Wood-Anderson passband can explain much of this observed nonlinearity.
本研究整合加拿大ToC2ME水力压裂诱发微震、Ridgecrest密集节点台阵、圣哈辛托宽频带数据及美国西部目录，将势震级（MP）与地方震级（ML）标度关系扩展至ML≈-1.8。通过共址宽频带地震仪经验标定检波器增益，并利用P波位移谱贝叶斯反演获取标量地震势，建立了跨越9个ML单位的统一二次关系：M……

t: Three-component P-wave displacement spectra are estimated via multitaper, corrected for path and site attenuation, median-stacked across stations, and inverted for scalar potency, corner frequency, and spectral falloff using a Metropolis-Hastings Bayesian generalized Brune model.
利用多窗谱估计P波位移谱并校正衰减，经台站中位数叠加后采用贝叶斯广义Brune模型反演地震势。

The study integrates 4,230 induced microearthquakes from ToC2ME (Canada), 501 nodal recordings from Ridgecrest, and 2,337 broadband recordings from San Jacinto with the western North America potency catalog of Trugman and Ben-Zion (2024).
整合ToC2ME的4,230个微震、Ridgecrest的501个事件、圣哈辛托2,337个事件及北美西部区域目录。

Across -1.8 ≤ ML ≤ 7.5, binned median regression yields the continuous quadratic relation MP = (0.040 ± 0.003)ML^2 + (0.556 ± 0.018)ML + (1.133 ± 0.027), alongside a calibrated ToC2ME geophone median gain of 40,433.5 counts/(m/s).
在-1.8≤ML≤7.5范围内建立二次关系MP=0.040ML^2+0.556ML+1.133，并标定检波器增益为40,…

Poorly resolved low-frequency plateaus near the noise floor cause quality-control selection bias at the smallest magnitudes, and the empirical curve cannot uniquely separate propagation effects from rupture-scaling differences.
极小震级低频谱受噪底限制存在质控选择偏差，且无法唯一区分传播效应与破裂标度差异。

Bridges the microseismic observational gap down to ML ≈ -1.8, unifying induced microearthquakes and regional tectonic earthquakes under a single empirical potency-magnitude scaling curve across nine magnitude units.
将ML-MP标度延伸至ML≈-1.8，在9个震级单位上统一了诱发微震与区域构造地震。

kc: Extended the empirical local-to-potency magnitude (ML-MP) scaling relation down to ML ≈ -1.8, spanning ~9 ML units and ~7 MP units.
Established a unified continuous quadratic scaling relation: MP = (0.040 ± 0.003)ML^2 + (0.556 ± 0.018)ML + (1.133 ± 0.027).
Empirically calibrated ToC2ME borehole geophone gain (40,433.5 counts/(m/s)), correcting a five-order-of-magnitude discrepancy in nominal IRIS metadata.
Demonstrated via synthetic modeling that self-similar sources, frequency-dependent attenuation, and Wood-Anderson filtering jointly produce the observed MP-ML curvature.
将地方震级与势震级（ML-MP）的经验标度关系下延至ML ≈ -1.8，跨越约9个ML单位和7个MP单位。

通过合成波形正演证明自相似震源标度、频率相关衰减和Wood-Anderson有限滤波通带可共同产生观测到的MP-ML非线性曲率。
me: Empirical instrument gain calibration by minimizing P-wave amplitude differences between colocated borehole geophones and surface broadband stations.
Multitaper three-component vector-sum P-wave displacement spectrum estimation with geometrical spreading, path/near-surface attenuation, and radiation pattern corrections.
Bayesian source-spectral inversion in the logarithmic spectral domain using a generalized Brune model (varying high-frequency falloff n) sampled via Metropolis-Hastings.
Binned median quadratic least-squares regression across 50 equally spaced ML bins with outlier filtering.
Time-domain synthetic source forward modeling with self-similar scaling, frequency-dependent attenuation, and Wood-Anderson filtering.
通过最小化共址井下检波器与地表宽频带台站的P波振幅差异，进行经验仪器增益标定。
采用多窗谱法估计三分量矢量和P波位移谱，并进行几何扩散、路径与近地表衰减及辐射花样校正。

在50个等间距ML分箱中进行异常值剔除与中位数二次最小二乘回归拟合。
结合自相似震源标度、频率相关衰减和Wood-Anderson滤波进行时域合成震源正演模拟。
de: ToC2ME dataset (Alberta, Canada): 7,886 candidate hydraulic-fracturing-induced events recorded on 69 shallow-borehole geophones (500 Hz) and 6 broadband stations, yielding 4,230 reliable potency estimates.
Ridgecrest dataset (California): 1,970 candidate aftershocks (0 ≤ ML ≤ 1.5) recorded at 500 Hz by temporary 3J nodal array, yielding 501 reliable potency estimates.
San Jacinto dataset (California): 4,405 candidate events (0.5 ≤ ML ≤ 3.5) from the QTM catalog recorded at 100 Hz on regional broadband stations, yielding 2,337 reliable potency estimates.
Western North America regional potency catalog from Trugman and Ben-Zion (2024) covering moderate-to-large tectonic earthquakes up to ML ≈ 7.5.

Trugman和Ben-Zion (2024) 的北美西部区域地震势目录，涵盖最高达ML ≈ 7.5的中大型构造地震。

The empirical MP-ML relation cannot uniquely distinguish between propagation/finite-bandwidth effects and genuine non-self-similar rupture scaling differences.
Fitted regression coefficients are empirical and may vary across regions due to velocity/attenuation structures, network geometry, and instrumental bandwidth.
极小震级事件信噪比受限导致低频谱平台难以分辨，质量控制剔除标准在震级下限附近可能引入选择偏差。
观测到的经验MP-ML关系无法唯一区分传播与有限带宽效应和真实的非自相似破裂标度差异。

tm.why: The paper estimates scalar seismic potency, corner frequency, and spectral falloff to establish a unified potency-magnitude scaling relation across nine local-magnitude units.
The authors apply Bayesian spectral inversion using a Metropolis-Hastings algorithm in the logarithmic spectral domain along with detailed data- and model-induced uncertainty quantification.
The study relies heavily on 4,230 hydraulic-fracturing-induced microearthquakes from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment (ToC2ME) to extend scaling down to ML ≈ -1.8.

sum: This study applies seismic interferometry to very-low-frequency (0.01–0.1 Hz) tiltmeter data recorded at Mt. Aso Volcano to monitor temporal subsurface variations. Despite wavelengths greatly exceeding inter-station distances, stable cross-correlations were constructed. The authors identified and corrected for a Parallel Time Shift (PTS)—a non-stretching temporal shift—to extract stretching-type velocity-change proxies. The resulting velocity changes varied by frequency and component (RR vs. TT), reflecting distinct depth sensitivities. Notably, the 2015 and 2016 eruptions showed contrasting temporal patterns, highlighting differences in the volcanic system's state. This demonstrates the utility of near-field seismic interferometry using tiltmeters for deep volcanic monitoring.
本研究将地震干涉测量法应用于阿苏火山记录的极低频（0.01-0.1 Hz）倾斜仪数据，以监测地下介质的随时间变化。尽管分析频段的波长远大于台站间距，研究仍构建出了稳定的互相关波形。作者识别并校正了“平行时间偏移（PTS）”（一种非拉伸型的波形整体移动），从而成功提取出拉伸型的速度变化指标。所获得的速……

t: Seismic interferometry applied to very-low-frequency (0.01–0.1 Hz) tiltmeter data, incorporating a correction for Parallel Time Shift (PTS) to isolate stretching-type velocity-change proxies.
对极低频（0.01-0.1 Hz）倾斜仪数据进行地震干涉测量，并引入平行时间偏移（PTS）校正以提取拉伸型速度变化。
Continuous very-low-frequency tiltmeter data recorded at Mt. Aso Volcano, covering the periods of the 2015 and 2016 eruptive episodes.
阿苏火山记录的连续极低频倾斜仪数据，覆盖了2015年和2016年喷发时期。

Successful extraction of velocity-change proxies showing distinct temporal behaviors between RR and TT components in the 0.04–0.07 Hz band, correlating with different eruption states in 2015 and 2016.
成功提取出速度变化指标，在0.04-0.07 Hz频段内RR和TT分量表现出不同的时间行为，对应不同的喷发状态。
The interpretation of the velocity-change proxy relies on complex Green's function responses that may include poorly constrained near-field terms.
速度变化指标的解释依赖于复杂的格林函数响应，其中可能包含难以约束的近场项。
Demonstrating near-field seismic interferometry using tiltmeters in a frequency range where wavelengths are much longer than inter-station distances, and identifying the PTS phenomenon.
在波长远大于台站间距的频段内，首次利用倾斜仪实现了近场地震干涉测量，并发现了PTS现象。

kc: Successfully applied seismic interferometry to very-low-frequency (0.01–0.1 Hz) tiltmeter data where wavelengths exceed station spacing.
Identified and corrected for Parallel Time Shift (PTS) to isolate true stretching-type velocity variations.
Revealed distinct temporal velocity-change patterns associated with the 2015 and 2016 eruptive episodes of Mt. Aso.
成功将地震干涉测量法应用于波长远大于台站间距的极低频（0.01-0.1 Hz）倾斜仪数据。
识别并校正了平行时间偏移（PTS），从而孤立出真实的拉伸型速度变化。
揭示了与阿苏火山2015年和2016年喷发事件相关的不同时间速度变化特征。
me: Seismic interferometry and cross-correlation of continuous tiltmeter data.
Parallel Time Shift (PTS) correction to separate non-stretching shifts from stretching-type variations.
Stretching method to estimate velocity-change proxies from cross-correlation functions.
Depth-sensitivity kernel analysis to interpret depth-dependent variations.
连续倾斜仪数据的地震干涉测量与互相关分析。
平行时间偏移（PTS）校正，用以分离非拉伸型偏移与拉伸型变化。
拉伸法（Stretching method），用于从互相关函数中估算波速变化指标。
深度敏感核分析，用于解释随深度变化的速度特征。

阿苏火山在2015年和2016年喷发期间记录的连续极低频（0.01-0.1 Hz）倾斜仪数据。
li: The physical mechanism of the Parallel Time Shift (PTS) and the exact contribution of near-field terms require further theoretical validation.
平行时间偏移（PTS）的物理机制以及近场项的具体贡献仍需要进一步的理论验证。

tm.why: The paper applies seismic interferometry to very-low-frequency tiltmeter data to estimate temporal variations in subsurface structures.
The study focuses on monitoring the deep volcanic system and eruptive episodes of Mt. Aso Volcano.
It measures velocity-change proxies and waveform stretching/shifts from cross-correlation functions.

sum: Whether and how the subducted Indian slab tears beneath the Indo-Myanmar subduction zone (IMSZ) has remained poorly constrained. This study integrates teleseismic P-wave data from the newly deployed CMGSMO I and II arrays with surrounding networks (797 stations total) to perform 3-D finite-frequency travel-time tomography in two frequency bands (0.5–2 Hz and 0.1–0.5 Hz). The resulting upper-mantle velocity model reveals two N-S-trending high-velocity anomalies with opposing dips beneath the Indo-Burma Ranges: an east-dipping subducting Indian slab (HV1) and a west-dipping detached slab fragment (HV3). From north to south, the intersection angle between HV1 and HV3 decreases while their along-dip lengths vary inversely (HV1 shortens from ~700 to ~450 km; HV3 lengthens from ~200 to ~450 km). This novel geometric constraint documents southward-shallowing slab tearing likely driven by oblique subduction, while shallow slab blockage explains the sporadic regional volcanism since the Mid-Miocene.
本研究利用缅甸新布设的CMGSMO I和II台阵及周边台网（共797个台站）记录的2788次远震事件，在0.5–2 Hz和0.1–0.5 Hz双频段提取逾14万条P波走时数据，开展三维有限频层析成像。结果显示印缅山脉下方上地幔存在两个南北走向、倾向相反的高速异常体：东倾的俯冲印度板片（HV1）和西倾……

t: 3-D finite-frequency teleseismic P-wave travel-time tomography using linear Born single-scattering sensitivity kernels, damped least-squares (LSQR) inversion on a 33x33x33 grid, and frequency-dependent crustal corrections.
采用基于Born单次散射核的三维有限频远震P波走时层析成像、LSQR阻尼最小二乘反演及频率相关地壳校正。

71,868 high-frequency (0.5–2 Hz) and 68,360 low-frequency (0.1–0.5 Hz) P-wave differential arrival times from 2,788 teleseismic events (M > 5.5) recorded by 797 stations including CMGSMO I and II arrays.
整合CMGSMO I/II等797个台站记录的2788次远震，提取71,868条高频和68,360条低频P波相对走时差。

Imaged east-dipping HV1 (~50°–60°, shortening southward from ~700 to ~450 km) and west-dipping HV3 (~40° to ~60°, lengthening southward from ~200 to ~450 km), achieving ~76% travel-time variance reduction.
揭示东倾HV1（向南由700减至450 km）和西倾HV3（由200增至450 km）两个反向倾斜高速体，方差缩减约76…

Uneven earthquake distribution reduces amplitude recovery for HV3 (~54% vs ~77% for HV1), and alternative detached-fragment interpretations require further geological, geochemical, and geodynamical constraints.
西侧远震较少导致HV3振幅恢复率偏低（约54%），且南部边界分辨率下降，尚需更多动力学约束。

Resolves previous ambiguities by clearly separating opposing-dip slab anomalies (HV1 and HV3) in central-southern Myanmar, providing the first 3-D geometric evidence for southward-shallowing slab tearing.
首次清晰分辨出缅甸中南部HV1与HV3之间的空间间隙及南北几何变化，证实向南变浅的板片撕裂。

kc: Obtained a high-resolution 3-D P-wave velocity model of the upper mantle beneath central and southern Myanmar using new wide-aperture CMGSMO I and II array data.
Identified two opposing-dip high-velocity anomalies (east-dipping HV1 and west-dipping HV3) with a southward-decreasing intersection angle and inversely varying along-dip lengths.
Proposed a geodynamic model of southward-shallowing slab tearing driven by oblique subduction, explaining the sporadic Mid-Miocene to Quaternary volcanism in Myanmar.
利用新布设的CMGSMO I和II宽孔径台阵数据，获得了缅甸中南部上地幔高分辨率三维P波速度模型。
识别出两个倾向相反的高速异常体（东倾HV1与西倾HV3），发现其交角向南减小且倾向长度呈反向变化。
提出了由斜向俯冲驱动的向南变浅板片撕裂动力学模型，解释了缅甸中中新世以来零星的火山活动。
me: Measured differential P-wave arrival times in two frequency bands (0.5–2 Hz and 0.1–0.5 Hz) using waveform cross-correlation (AIMBAT) referenced to permanent station LSA.
Applied 3-D finite-frequency teleseismic travel-time tomography based on linear Born single-scattering Fréchet sensitivity kernels and damped LSQR inversion.
Performed frequency-dependent crustal and elevation corrections, checkerboard tests, custom structural recovery tests, and bootstrap uncertainty quantification.
以永久台站LSA为参考，利用AIMBAT波形互相关方法在0.5–2 Hz和0.1–0.5 Hz两个频段测量P波相对走时差。
采用基于线性Born单次散射理论三维Fréchet灵敏度核的有限频远震走时层析成像与阻尼LSQR反演。
实施了频率相关的地壳与高程校正，并开展了检测板测试、特定结构恢复测试及Bootstrap不确定性评估。
de: Combined broadband seismic dataset from 797 stations (~35 km average spacing) across CMGSMO I (70 stations), CMGSMO II (75 stations), CSN, ChinArray, TSAR, and IRIS.
71,868 high-frequency (0.5–2 Hz) and 68,360 low-frequency (0.1–0.5 Hz) teleseismic P-wave arrivals from 2,788 earthquakes (epicentral distance 30°–90°, M > 5.5).
整合了CMGSMO I（70台）、CMGSMO II（75台）、CSN、ChinArray、TSAR和IRIS共797个宽频带台站数据（平均台间距约35 km）。
li: Uneven azimuthal distribution of teleseismic events (fewer earthquakes from the west) leads to lower amplitude recovery (~54%) for the western anomaly HV3.
Tomographic resolution decreases in the southernmost study area, blurring the along-dip length of HV3 south of ~21.6°N.
Isotropic velocity inversion neglects seismic anisotropy, and a fully detached slab fragment model cannot be definitively ruled out without further geodynamic constraints.
远震事件方位分布不均（西侧地震较少）导致西侧高速异常体HV3的振幅恢复率较低（约54%）。
研究区最南端层析成像分辨率下降，导致约21.6°N以南HV3的倾向延伸长度变得模糊。
各向同性反演忽略了地震各向异性，且在缺乏进一步地球动力学约束下无法完全排除全断离板片模型。

tm.why: The paper applies finite-frequency teleseismic P-wave travel-time tomography to image the upper mantle velocity structure beneath Myanmar.
The primary focus is imaging the geometry of the subducting Indian slab and interpreting southward-shallowing slab tearing and its geodynamic implications.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 10-page PDF text and figures of Yang et al. (2026) in Geophysical Research Letters.

sum: Direct numerical simulations (DNS) on large, high-resolution 3D micro-CT rock scans are computationally prohibitive in digital rock physics. This paper combines a lightweight 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) with hierarchical homogenization (HHM) to rapidly estimate effective elastic moduli. Large 900^3 voxel sandstone scans are partitioned into 75^3 subcubes, where the CNN replaces costly FFT-based DNS, and HHM upscales predictions to the full volume. Using a shared CNN backbone across five sandstone datasets, the authors systematically compare three training targets: (1) full 6x6 anisotropic stiffness tensors, (2) isotropic bulk and shear moduli (K, G), and (3) Hashin-Shtrikman (HS)-normalized factors. All three models achieve high accuracy (R^2 > 0.99 at the subcube level) and accelerate large-rock evaluation by 5 to 6 orders of magnitude over full-rock DNS. Direct (K, G) prediction yields the highest accuracy, whereas HS-normalized targets offer the fastest convergence and guaranteed physical consistency.
针对高分辨率三维微CT数字岩石直接数值模拟（DNS）计算成本过高的问题，本文结合轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）与分层均匀化方法（HHM）快速预测有效弹性模量。该方法将900^3体素砂岩图像划分为75^3子立方体，用CNN替代子尺度DNS，再通过HHM粗化求解全岩模量。基于五种砂岩数据，作者系统对比……

t: A lightweight 3D CNN predicts subcube elastic properties from 75x75x75 voxel scans under three alternative targets (stiffness tensor, direct K/G, or HS-normalized factors), embedded within hierarchical homogenization (HHM) to upscale elasticity to large rock volumes.
利用轻量级3D CNN在三种目标下预测75^3子立方体弹性参数，并嵌入分层均匀化（HHM）升级求解大岩石等效模量。

Segmented binary 900x900x900 micro-CT scans of five sandstones: Berea (B1, B2), Castlegate (CG), and Fontainebleau (FB1, FB2), partitioned into 75^3 subcubes and validated on 300^3 and 600^3 cropped subregions against FFT-based GeoDict DNS.
五种砂岩（B1、B2、CG、FB1、FB2）的900^3体素二值微CT图像，划分为75^3子块并在300^3和600^3…

All three models achieve subcube R^2 > 0.99 on B1 and reduce training time to 170-528 seconds (vs. 9511-14307s for benchmarks). On 300^3 crops, total GPU inference + HHM runtime is 0.23-2.85s, providing 10^5-10^6x speedup over full DNS.
三种模型在B1子块上R^2>0.99，训练仅需170–528秒；300^3区域GPU总耗时0.23–2.85秒，比直接D…
The unavoidable HHM upscaling error (~1.5-2.0 GPa MAE) dominates over the small CNN surrogate error, and 600^3 crop evaluation on FB2 suffers from limited test sample size.
HHM尺度升级固有误差主导总误差；600^3尺寸FB2样本因测试集数量不足导致R^2偏低。

Systematic evaluation of anisotropic stiffness, isotropic moduli, and HS-normalized targets within a lightweight CNN-HHM architecture that trains fast enough from scratch to eliminate the need for transfer learning.
在轻量级CNN-HHM框架中系统对比三种物理与各向异性目标，从头训练极快从而无需迁移学习。

kc: Developed a lightweight 3D CNN surrogate integrated with hierarchical homogenization (HHM) that accelerates large-volume digital rock elastic moduli estimation by 10^5-10^6 times compared to direct numerical simulation.
Systematically evaluated three CNN output targets: full 6x6 stiffness tensor, direct isotropic moduli (K, G), and Hashin-Shtrikman (HS)-normalized factors across five sandstone rock types.
Demonstrated that surrogate error at the subcube scale is much smaller than HHM upscaling error, validating the isotropic subcube approximation for macroscopically isotropic rocks.
Showed that ad hoc training from scratch on each rock type converges in minutes (170-528 seconds), rendering pretraining and transfer learning unnecessary in practice.
开发了结合分层均匀化（HHM）的轻量级3D CNN代理工作流，相比直接数值模拟将大体积数字岩石弹性模量评估速度提升了10^5至10^6倍。
在五种砂岩类型上系统评估了三种CNN输出目标：完整6×6刚度张量、直接各向同性模量(K, G)以及Hashin-Shtrikman (HS)归一化因子。
证明了子立方体尺度的CNN代理误差远小于HHM尺度升级误差，验证了宏观各向同性岩石在子立方体尺度采用各向同性假设的合理性。
表明针对每种岩石从头训练仅需数分钟（170–528秒）即可收敛，在实际应用中无需预训练和迁移学习。
me: Hierarchical homogenization (HHM) partitioning N^3 rock volumes into (N/n)^3 non-overlapping subcubes (n=75) followed by coarse-grained global elasticity assembly.
Lightweight 3D CNN backbone consisting of three Conv3D+MaxPool3D blocks (1.18x10^5 convolutional parameters) and fully connected output heads.
Training target comparison across Voigt 6x6 stiffness matrix (Model 1), Voigt-averaged (K, G) (Model 2), and [0, 1] bounded Hashin-Shtrikman factors (Model 3).
FFT-based elasticity solver (GeoDict) for generating subcube and large-crop ground-truth DNS reference labels.
分层均匀化（HHM）：将N^3岩石体积划分为(N/n)^3个不重叠子立方体（n=75），随后组装为粗粒度弹性体积并求解全局弹性问题。
轻量级3D CNN骨干网络：包含三个Conv3D+MaxPool3D模块（卷积参数仅1.18×10^5个）和全连接输出头。
训练目标对比：对比Voigt 6×6刚度矩阵（模型1）、Voigt平均(K, G)（模型2）以及限制在[0, 1]区间内的Hashin-Shtrikman归一化因子（模型3）。
基于FFT的弹性求解器（GeoDict）：用于生成子立方体和大尺寸裁剪区域的DNS基准参考标签。
de: High-resolution segmented binary 3D micro-CT scans (900x900x900 voxels) of five sandstones: Berea (B1, B2), Castlegate (CG), and Fontainebleau (FB1, FB2).
Subcube-level training and validation on 75x75x75 voxel subvolumes with an 80%/20% train-test split, Adam optimizer, and validation-plateau early stopping.
Large-volume HHM validation on 300x300x300 and 600x600x600 cropped subregions against full DNS references.
Wall-clock runtime benchmarking across CPU and GPU hardware and error analysis against subcube porosity.
五种砂岩的高分辨率二值化分割3D微CT扫描图像（900×900×900体素）：Berea（B1、B2）、Castlegate（CG）和Fontainebleau（FB1、FB2）。
在75×75×75体素子体积上进行训练与验证（80%/20%训练测试划分），采用Adam优化器和验证集损失平台早停策略。
在300×300×300和600×600×600裁剪子区域上进行大体积HHM验证，并与完整DNS参考结果对比。
在CPU和GPU硬件上进行运行时间基准测试，并分析子立方体孔隙度对预测误差的影响。
li: The isotropic subcube approximation (Models 2 and 3) is designed for macroscopically isotropic rocks and may not hold for rocks that are strongly anisotropic across length scales.
HHM upscaling itself introduces an unavoidable baseline discrepancy relative to full DNS (~1.5-2.0 GPa MAE on B1), which dominates the total pipeline error.
Lower R^2 performance observed on the 600x600x600 FB2 dataset is attributed to an insufficient number of testing samples at that scale.
各向同性子立方体假设（模型2和模型3）针对宏观各向同性岩石设计，对于跨尺度具有强各向异性的岩石可能不再适用。
HHM尺度升级本身相对于完整DNS会引入不可避免的基准误差（B1岩石上MAE约为1.5–2.0 GPa），主导了整个流程的总误差。
在600×600×600尺寸的FB2数据集上观察到的R^2下降归因于该尺度下测试数据样本数量不足。

tm.why: The paper develops a lightweight 3D convolutional neural network surrogate to predict subcube elastic moduli from micro-CT images in digital rock physics.
The study uses FFT-based direct numerical simulations and hierarchical homogenization to solve 3D elasticity and compute effective rock elastic moduli.
The authors explicitly evaluate predicting the full 6x6 anisotropic stiffness tensor versus isotropic bulk and shear moduli at the subcube scale.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF including appendices A, B, and C, 11 figures, and 7 tables was analyzed.

sum: This study evaluates the operational feasibility and processing workflows of ultra-high-density 'carpet shooting' geometry using a dual acquisition pilot survey. The survey compares conventional geophone arrays with single-sensor nodes. The authors process both datasets through a standard land time-processing sequence to analyze the data volume and quality. The results demonstrate that carpet shooting significantly improves pre-processing and inversion workflows. Specifically, single-sensor data preserves crucial low-frequency information, which is highly beneficial for velocity model building via full-waveform inversion (FWI) compared to legacy geophone array configurations.
本研究评估了双接收系统（检波器组合与单点传感器）下超高密度“地毯式”采集几何的施工可行性与数据处理流程。作者通过标准陆上时间处理序列对两套数据进行对比。结果表明，地毯式采集显著提升了预处理与反演效果。相较于传统检波器组合，单点传感器数据保留了更丰富的低频成分，能为全波形反演（FWI）速度建模与成像提……

t: Comparison of geophone-array and single-sensor data acquired via ultra-high-density carpet shooting geometry, processed through a standard land time-processing sequence.
对比超高密度地毯式采集下的检波器组合与单点传感器数据，并采用标准陆上时间序列进行处理。
Seismic data from a pilot land survey using dual receiver types (geophone arrays and single sensors) with a carpet shooting geometry.
采用地毯式采集几何、包含双接收器类型（检波器组合与单点传感器）的陆上地震试验性测线数据。
Single-sensor data provides superior low-frequency content compared to geophone arrays, which is highly beneficial for full-waveform inversion and velocity model building.
单点传感器数据比检波器组合具有更优的低频成分，有利于全波形反演和速度模型构建。
Processing the massive volume of data produced by ultra-high-density carpet surveys requires highly compute-intensive processing steps.
超高密度地毯式采集产生的大量数据需要极高计算强度的处理步骤。
First evaluation of dual acquisition (geophone array vs. single sensor) specifically under an ultra-high-density carpet shooting geometry for FWI applications.
首次针对超高密度地毯式采集几何评估双接收系统在全波形反演应用中的表现。

kc: Evaluated the operational feasibility of ultra-high-density carpet shooting geometry in land seismic acquisition.
Compared the processing workflows and data quality of geophone arrays versus single-sensor dual acquisitions.
Demonstrated the advantages of single-sensor low-frequency content for full-waveform inversion (FWI) and velocity model building.
评估了陆上地震采集超高密度地毯式采集几何的施工可行性。
对比了检波器组合与单点传感器双接收采集的处理流程与数据质量。
证明了单点传感器低频信号在全波形反演（FWI）和速度建模中的优势。
me: Dual acquisition seismic survey design (geophone arrays vs. single sensors).
Ultra-high-density carpet shooting geometry.
Land seismic data time-processing sequence.
Low-frequency analysis for full-waveform inversion (FWI).
双接收地震采集设计（检波器组合对比单点传感器）。
超高密度地毯式采集几何。
陆上地震数据时间处理序列。
用于全波形反演（FWI）的低频信号分析。

在地毯式采集几何下，利用双接收器类型（检波器组合和单点传感器节点）采集的陆上地震试验性测线数据。
li: The massive data volume produced by ultra-high-density carpet surveys poses significant computational and storage challenges during processing.
超高密度地毯式采集产生海量数据，给数据处理带来了极大的计算与存储挑战。

tm.why: The paper evaluates carpet shooting geometry and single-sensor data for providing low frequencies crucial for full waveform inversion and velocity model building.
The study compares dual acquisition receiver types, specifically geophone arrays versus single-sensor nodes, in a high-density carpet geometry.
