sum: This study utilizes high-resolution microseismicity data to investigate the active tectonics, wedge-confined deformation, and strain partitioning within the northern Sistan suture zone in Eastern Iran. By analyzing local earthquake locations and focal mechanisms, the authors characterize the complex fault geometry and kinematic behavior of the region. The results provide critical insights into how oblique convergence is accommodated by partitioned strike-slip and thrusting motion within a confined tectonic wedge, improving our understanding of suture zone geodynamics.
本研究利用高分辨率微震数据，调查了伊朗东部北锡斯坦缝合带的活动构造、楔形限制变形和应变分配特征。通过分析地方震源定位和震源机制解，作者阐明了该地区复杂的断裂几何形态和运动学行为。研究结果揭示了斜向汇聚如何通过受限构造楔内的走滑和逆冲分量进行分配，深化了对缝合带地质动力学过程的认识。

t: High-precision relocation of microearthquakes and determination of focal mechanism solutions to characterize active faulting.
利用微震高精度重新定位和震源机制解确定来表征活动断层特征。
Seismic waveform data recorded by a local network monitoring microseismicity in the northern Sistan suture zone, Eastern Iran.
伊朗东部北锡斯坦缝合带地方台网记录的微震波形数据。
Identification of wedge-confined deformation and clear strain partitioning between strike-slip and thrust faulting in the suture zone.
识别出缝合带内楔形限制的变形以及走滑和逆冲断层作用之间清晰的应变分配。
Limited spatial and temporal coverage of the local seismic array used to capture the microseismicity.
用于捕获微震的地方地震台网在空间和时间覆盖范围上存在局限性。
First detailed microseismicity-based characterization of wedge-confined deformation and strain partitioning in this specific part of the Sistan suture zone.
首次基于微震详细刻画了锡斯坦缝合带该特定区域的楔形限制变形和应变分配。

kc: Delineated active fault geometries in the northern Sistan suture zone using high-resolution microseismicity.
Demonstrated strain partitioning between strike-slip and thrust faulting within a wedge-confined tectonic setting.
Provided new seismotectonic constraints on the deformation of Eastern Iran.
利用高分辨率微震数据描绘了北锡斯坦缝合带的活动断裂几何形态。
展示了楔形限制构造背景下走滑和逆冲断层作用之间的应变分配。
为伊朗东部的变形机制提供了新的地震构造学约束。
me: Microearthquake detection and high-precision relocation.
Focal mechanism solution determination to infer local stress and fault kinematics.
微震检测与高精度重新定位。
确定震源机制解以推断局部应力和断层运动学。
de: Local seismic network recordings of microseismicity in the northern Sistan suture zone, Eastern Iran.
伊朗东部北锡斯坦缝合带地方地震台网记录的微震数据。
li: The study is limited by the temporal coverage of the temporary local seismic network and the detection threshold for smaller events.
该研究受限于临时地方地震台网的观测时间跨度以及较小地震事件的检测能力。

tm.why: The paper uses microseismicity to reveal wedge-confined deformation and strain partitioning in Eastern Iran.
The study investigates tectonic deformation, strain partitioning, and suture zone structures in the northern Sistan suture zone.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, metadata, and regional seismotectonic context of the Sistan suture zone in Eastern Iran.

sum: This study presents high-precision potassium (K) isotope data for Archean komatiites from ten localities to investigate the onset of volatile cycling between Earth's surface and interior. Komatiites from three localities exhibit heavy K isotope compositions significantly higher than typical mantle values. This heavy signature is interpreted as evidence of mantle metasomatism by K-rich fluids derived from subducted, water-altered oceanic lithosphere. The findings demonstrate that surface-derived water was transported into deep mantle reservoirs by at least 3.6 billion years ago, providing key evidence for the early operation of subduction-style volatile recycling and its role in maintaining Earth's long-term habitability.
本研究提供了来自10个地点的太古代科马提岩的高精度钾（K）同位素数据，以探讨地球表层与内部挥发分循环的开始时间。其中3个地点的科马提岩记录了显著偏重的钾同位素组成，远高于典型地幔值。该重同位素信号被解释为受俯冲、水化洋壳释放的富钾流体交代的地幔源区特征。研究结果表明，地表水至少在36亿年前就已通过俯……

t: High-precision potassium (K) stable isotope geochemistry applied to ancient ultramafic volcanic rocks (komatiites).
对古老超镁铁质火山岩（科马提岩）进行高精度钾（K）稳定同位素地球化学分析。
Komatiite rock samples collected from ten different Archean localities globally.
收集自全球十个不同太古代地点的科马提岩岩石样品。
Three komatiite localities record heavy K isotope compositions well above typical mantle values, indicating water-altered subducted material in their source.
三个地点的科马提岩记录了远高于地幔平均值的重钾同位素组成，指示源区存在水化俯冲物质。
Potential overprinting by secondary alteration and the limited number of localities showing the heavy signature.
后期次生蚀变可能造成的干扰，以及仅在部分地点观测到重同位素信号。
Using K isotopes in komatiites to provide direct evidence of subduction-style water transport into the mantle by 3.6 Ga.
首次利用科马提岩钾同位素为36亿年前地表水通过俯冲带进入地幔提供了直接证据。

kc: Presented high-precision potassium (K) isotope data for Archean komatiites from ten global localities.
Identified heavy K isotope signatures in three ancient komatiite localities, indicating mantle metasomatism by surface-derived fluids.
Established that subduction-style volatile recycling and transport of surface water into the mantle occurred by at least 3.6 Ga.
提供了全球10个地点的太古代科马提岩的高精度钾（K）同位素数据。
在3个古老科马提岩地点发现了偏重的钾同位素特征，指示了地表流体对地幔的交代作用。
证实了至少在36亿年前就已存在俯冲型挥发分循环以及地表水向地幔的输送。
me: High-precision potassium (K) stable isotope analysis of ultramafic komatiite samples.
Geochemical tracing of mantle source compositions and metasomatic processes.
超镁铁质科马提岩样品的超高精度钾（K）稳定同位素分析。
地幔源区成分及交代作用过程的地球化学示踪。
de: Analyzed komatiite samples collected from ten different Archean localities globally.
对全球10个不同太古代地点采集的科马提岩样品进行了分析。
li: The heavy potassium isotope signature is only preserved in three out of the ten studied localities, requiring careful evaluation of alteration and preservation factors.
偏重的钾同位素特征仅在10个研究地点中的3个中保留，需要仔细评估后期蚀变与保存因素。

tm.why: The paper investigates the cycling of surface volatiles into the mantle and early subduction-style recycling using komatiite geochemistry.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Nature Communications and Semantic Scholar.

sum: This study investigates how oxygen-fugacity-dependent melting curves influence the thermal structure, melt fraction, and rheological evolution of rocky exoplanet interiors, specifically applying the coupled interior-atmosphere framework PROTEUS to the super-Earth GJ 1132 b. The authors find that in volatile-poor systems, reduced melting curves promote earlier deep-mantle crystallization and sustain late-stage surface magma oceans, while oxidized melting curves maintain higher melt fractions. Reduced mantles produce massive H2-CO-rich atmospheres, whereas oxidized mantles favor thinner H2O-CO2 envelopes. In volatile-rich systems, volatile inventory dominates, and melting curve variations provide only secondary modulation. This reveals a hierarchical control on planetary evolution and offers testable spectral predictions for JWST.
本研究探讨了氧逸度相关的熔融曲线如何影响岩石系外行星内部的热结构、熔融体积分数和流变学演化。研究利用耦合内部-大气的PROTEUS框架，模拟了超级地球GJ 1132 b。结果表明，在贫挥发分系统中，还原态熔融曲线促进深部地幔更早结晶，并维持后期表面岩浆洋，而氧化态熔融曲线则保持较高的熔融比例。还原性……

t: Coupled interior-atmosphere numerical modeling using the PROTEUS framework, incorporating experimentally derived, oxygen-fugacity-dependent melting curves.
使用PROTEUS框架进行内部-大气耦合数值模拟，并引入与氧逸度相关的实验熔融曲线。
Synthetic planetary parameters and atmospheric/interior scenarios modeled for the short-period super-Earth GJ 1132 b.
针对短周期超级地球GJ 1132 b设计的合成行星参数、大气和内部演化模拟场景。
Reduced mantles promote earlier deep crystallization and massive H2-CO atmospheres, while oxidized mantles maintain higher melt fractions and thinner H2O-CO2 envelopes.
还原性地幔促进深部更早结晶并产生富H2-CO大气；氧化性地幔维持高熔融比例和较薄H2O-CO2大气。
The influence of melting curve variations is secondary to volatile inventory, which acts as the primary regulator of the thermal state.
熔融曲线变化的影响次于挥发分总量，后者是决定行星热状态的主要控制因素。
First systematic quantification of how oxygen-fugacity-dependent melting curves propagate through coupled interior-atmosphere models to alter magma ocean solidification.
首次系统定量评估了氧逸度相关的熔融曲线如何通过耦合模型改变岩浆洋的固化过程。

kc: Quantified the impact of oxygen-fugacity-dependent melting curves on the coupled interior-atmosphere evolution of rocky exoplanets.
Demonstrated that reduced mantles promote earlier deep-mantle crystallization and sustain late-stage surface magma oceans in volatile-poor systems.
Identified a hierarchical control where volatile inventory acts as the primary regulator of thermal state, and melting relations provide secondary modulation.
定量评估了氧逸度相关的熔融曲线对岩石系外行星内部-大气耦合演化的影响。
证明了在贫挥发分系统中，还原性地幔促进深部地幔更早结晶，并维持后期表面岩浆洋。
确定了行星演化的分级控制机制：挥发分总量是热状态的主要调节器，而熔融关系提供次要调制。
me: Coupled interior-atmosphere numerical modeling using the PROTEUS framework.
Implementation of experimentally derived, oxygen-fugacity-dependent melting curves.
使用PROTEUS框架进行内部-大气耦合数值模拟。
应用实验获取的、与氧逸度相关的熔融曲线。
de: Numerical simulations applied to the short-period super-Earth GJ 1132 b under varying volatile inventories and redox states.
在不同挥发分总量和氧化还原状态下，对短周期超级地球GJ 1132 b进行的数值模拟。
li: The study relies on simplified 1D coupled interior-atmosphere models and parameterized rheology.
该研究依赖于简化的一维内部-大气耦合模型和参数化的流变学。

tm.why: The paper models the coupled interior-atmosphere evolution, mantle crystallization, and thermal structure of rocky exoplanets.
The paper focuses on planetary geophysics, specifically magma oceans and atmospheric evolution of the super-Earth GJ 1132 b.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract as no PDF was available.

sum: The authors develop a ground-motion model for 5% damped pseudospectral accelerations (0.01 to 0.5 s) in Pohang, South Korea, incorporating topographic effects. Using 487 ground motions from 119 stations, they introduce a new parameter, alpha (the azimuth angle from the station to the epicenter relative to the slope aspect). They find that ground motions are deamplified when relative elevation is below -18 m and alpha is under 90 degrees (slope faces epicenter). Conversely, amplification occurs when relative elevation exceeds 14 m and alpha is over 90 degrees (slope faces away). This model significantly improves ground-motion prediction by coupling topography with wave propagation direction.
本文针对韩国浦项地区开发了一种考虑地形效应的5%阻尼伪反应谱加速度（周期0.01至0.5秒）地震动预测模型。研究利用了119个地震台站记录的487条地震动数据，首次引入了震中至台站方位角与坡向之间的夹角（alpha）作为地形参数。结果表明，当相对高程低于-18米且alpha小于90度（坡向朝向震中）……

t: Empirical ground-motion modeling of 5% damped pseudospectral accelerations incorporating relative elevation and the azimuth angle from the station to the epicenter relative to slope aspect (alpha).
结合相对高程与台站至震中方位角相对坡向夹角（alpha）的经验地震动预测建模方法。
487 ground-motion records obtained from a dense network of 118 temporary stations and one permanent station in Pohang, South Korea.
利用韩国浦项密集观测网中119个台站记录到的487条强震动波形数据。
Ground motions are deamplified when relative elevation < -18 m and alpha < 90 degrees, and amplified when relative elevation > 14 m and alpha > 90 degrees.
高程<-18m且alpha<90°时地震动减幅；高程>14m且alpha>90°时地震动放大。
The predictive model is restricted to short-period ground motions ranging from 0.01 to 0.5 s.
该地形相关地震动预测模型目前仅适用于0.01至0.5秒的短周期范围。
Introduction of the azimuth angle from the station to the epicenter relative to slope aspect (alpha) as a key parameter in ground-motion prediction.
首次引入震中方位角与坡向的夹角（alpha）作为表征地形效应的关键地震动预测参数。

kc: Developed a new ground-motion prediction model incorporating both relative elevation and wave propagation direction relative to slope aspect (alpha).
Quantified specific thresholds for topographic amplification and deamplification based on relative elevation and the angle alpha.
Demonstrated that slope direction relative to the epicenter significantly influences high-frequency ground-motion amplification.
开发了一种结合相对高程和波传播方向与坡向夹角（alpha）的新型地震动预测模型。
定量给出了基于相对高程和夹角alpha的地震动放大与缩减的具体阈值。
证明了坡向与震中的相对方位对高频地震动放大具有显著影响。
me: Empirical ground-motion modeling for 5% damped pseudospectral accelerations (PSA) at short periods (0.01–0.5 s).
Introduction of a novel topographic parameter, alpha, representing the azimuth angle from the station to the epicenter relative to the slope aspect.
针对短周期（0.01-0.5秒）5%阻尼伪反应谱加速度（PSA）进行经验地震动建模。
引入新型地形参数alpha，表示台站至震中方位角与坡向之间的夹角。
de: Utilized 487 ground-motion records from a dense seismic network consisting of 118 temporary stations and one permanent station in Pohang, South Korea.
利用了韩国浦项地区由118个临时台站和1个常规台站组成的密集地震观测网记录到的487条地震动记录。
li: The model is parameterized for short periods (0.01 to 0.5 s) and its applicability to longer periods or different geological settings remains to be tested.
该模型仅针对短周期（0.01至0.5秒）进行了参数化，其在更长周期或其他地质背景下的适用性仍需验证。

tm.why: The paper develops a ground-motion model to predict the amplification of ground motion considering topography and wave propagation direction.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Crossref and Semantic Scholar.

sum: This study presents eleven new in situ 10Be exposure ages from high fluvial terraces and four from a lower terrace, combined with geomorphic analyses across eight adjacent catchments (29.5–32.5°S) in the Central Andes forearc. The high terrace was abandoned between ~1 and 2 Ma (Early Pleistocene), while the lower terrace records incision at ~0.4–0.8 Ma. Morphometric analysis reveals a systematic upstream-decreasing pediplain relief pattern terminating within the surface projection of the 50–55 km slab-depth contour. This long-wavelength signal is overprinted by localized underplating in peninsular settings. Integrating these findings regionally, the authors identify a continuous Early Pleistocene uplift phase spanning 16° to 42°S, implying a subtle but widespread change in subduction dynamics during the last ~2 Myr.
本研究通过安第斯中前弧（29.5–32.5°S）8个相邻流域的11个新原位10Be暴露年龄及地形地貌分析，重新评估了剥蚀面（山麓剥蚀平原）的年代学与构造意义。高阶地在~1-2 Ma（早更新世）被废弃，而低阶地记录了~0.4-0.8 Ma的下切。地貌分析显示，山麓剥蚀平原起伏向源头系统性减小，并终止于……

t: In situ 10Be cosmogenic radionuclide exposure dating combined with morphometric analysis of river catchments.
原位10Be宇宙成因核素暴露测年与河流流域地貌形态分析相结合。
Eleven 10Be exposure ages from high terraces, four from a lower terrace, and geomorphic data from eight catchments (29.5–32.5°S).
来自高阶地的11个10Be暴露年龄、低阶地的4个年龄以及8个流域的地貌数据。
High terrace abandonment occurred at ~1-2 Ma, followed by incision at ~0.4-0.8 Ma, with relief terminating near the 50-55 km slab-depth projection.
高阶地在~1-2 Ma废弃，随后在~0.4-0.8 Ma发生下切，起伏终止于50-55 km板块深度投影附近。
The study relies on geomorphic proxies and exposure ages which can have localized overprints (e.g., underplating) that complicate regional signals.
研究依赖于地貌指标和暴露年龄，局部叠加（如底侵）会使区域信号复杂化。
Demonstrates a continuous, margin-wide (16° to 42°S) Early Pleistocene uplift phase linked to a widespread change in subduction dynamics.
展示了横跨整个边缘（16°至42°S）的连续早更新世抬升阶段，并将其与俯冲动力学变化联系起来。

kc: Determined the abandonment age of high fluvial terraces in the Andean forearc to be between ~1 and 2 Ma using in situ 10Be exposure dating.
Identified a systematic upstream-decreasing pediplain relief pattern terminating within the surface projection of the 50-55 km slab-depth contour.
Proposed a continuous, margin-wide Early Pleistocene uplift phase (16° to 42°S) linked to a widespread change in subduction dynamics.
利用原位10Be暴露测年确定了安第斯前弧高河流阶地的废弃年龄在~1至2 Ma之间。
发现山麓剥蚀平原起伏向源头系统性减小，并终止于50-55 km板块深度等深线的地表投影区域内。
提出了一个横跨整个边缘（16°至42°S）的连续早更新世抬升阶段，并将其与俯冲动力学的广泛变化联系起来。
me: In situ 10Be cosmogenic radionuclide exposure dating of fluvial terraces.
Morphometric and geomorphic analysis of eight adjacent catchments across the Andean forearc (29.5–32.5°S).
河流阶地的原位10Be宇宙成因核素暴露测年。
对安第斯前弧（29.5–32.5°S）8个相邻流域进行地形测量和地貌分析。
de: Eleven new in situ 10Be exposure ages from high fluvial terraces and four ages from a lower terrace.
Topographic and morphometric data from eight catchments in the Central Andes forearc.
来自高河流阶地的11个全新原位10Be暴露年龄以及来自低阶地的4个年龄。
安第斯中部前弧8个流域的地形和地貌测量数据。
li: The exact physical mechanism driving the widespread change in subduction dynamics remains to be fully quantified.
导致俯冲动力学广泛变化的具体物理机制仍有待完全量化。

tm.why: The paper investigates the geomorphic imprint of Andean forearc uplift and links it to subduction dynamics and slab-depth contours.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata provided, as no PDF was available.

sum: Earthquake phase association is increasingly bottlenecked by massive pick volumes from dense networks and deep-learning pickers. This study introduces VORA (Voronoi tessellation- and Origin-time-based Rapid Associator), which formulates phase association as an unsupervised spatio-temporal clustering problem. By pairing P and S picks at individual stations over a prescribed Vp/Vs ratio range, VORA estimates hypothetical origin-time intervals without needing an absolute velocity model or hypocentral search. It uses Voronoi tessellation to adaptively define station neighbor graphs across non-uniform networks, clustering overlapping origin-time intervals via a modified DBSCAN algorithm, followed by an optional Expectation-Maximization (EM) sub-clustering step for dense sequences. Benchmarks on synthetic stress tests and the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence (local and global scales) show VORA is ~10x faster than GaMMA and PyOcto while maintaining high recall (>0.8) and precision (>0.9). Its training-free, scale-invariant design enables unified local-to-global seismic monitoring.
针对密集台网与深度学习拾取带来的海量震相数据，本文提出了基于Voronoi剖分与发震时刻的快速震相关联方法（VORA）。该方法利用单台P、S波走时差与波速比估算发震时刻区间，利用Voronoi图自适应构建台站空间近邻关系，结合改进DBSCAN与可选EM子聚类算法实现无监督时空聚类。在合成压力测试及2……

t: VORA estimates origin-time intervals from station P-S pairs using a Vp/Vs range, builds adaptive station graphs via Voronoi tessellation, and clusters overlapping intervals across neighbors using modified DBSCAN and optional EM sub-clustering.
由单台P-S对估算发震时刻区间，通过Voronoi图构建自适应台站图，并用改进DBSCAN和EM进行时空聚类。

Evaluated on 8 synthetic sequences (5,000 events each, 121 Geysers stations), a 6-day local PhaseNet dataset for the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence, and a 2-week global PhaseNet dataset (>10M picks, 4,461 stations).
包含8组Geysers合成序列、2019年Ridgecrest序列6天局地拾取集，及两周全球超1000万拾取集。

In the most dense synthetic test (5 s average separation), VORA maintains >0.8 recall and >0.9 precision in <2.5 minutes (~10x faster than GaMMA/PyOcto), achieves 0.86 recall on Ridgecrest, and detects ~37,800 global events.
5秒间隔测试保持>0.8召回率与>0.9精确率，耗时<2.5分钟（快约10倍）；全球检出约37800个地震。
VORA requires both P and S picks at each station, causing larger epicentral errors and missed events when S picks are missing (e.g., the Ridgecrest mainshock).
要求单台同时具有P和S震相，导致定位台站减少、震中误差偏大，且在S波缺失时漏检主震。

Decouples phase association from velocity models and hypocentral grid searches by combining Wadati origin-time intervals with multi-order Voronoi station graphs, scaling from local to global networks without retraining.
结合Wadati发震时刻与多阶Voronoi近邻图，无需速度模型或训练即可从局地无缝扩展至全球。

kc: Formulates earthquake phase association as an unsupervised spatio-temporal clustering of single-station hypothetical origin-time intervals.
Introduces multi-order Voronoi tessellation on planes or spheres to define adaptive, physically meaningful station neighborhoods across non-uniform networks.
Develops an optional Expectation-Maximization (EM) sub-clustering step using S-P interval local minima as seed stations to separate overlapping events.
Demonstrates ~10x faster runtime than GaMMA and PyOcto with robust recall and precision from local to global scales without hyperparameter retuning.
将地震震相关联构建为单台假设发震时刻区间的无监督时空聚类问题。
引入平面或球面多阶Voronoi剖分，在非均匀台网中自适应定义具有物理意义的台站近邻关系。
开发了以S-P走时差局部极小值台站为种子的可选EM子聚类步骤，有效分离时空重叠地震。
无需重调超参数即可扩展至全球尺度，保持高召回率与精确率的同时比GaMMA和PyOcto快约10倍。
me: Single-station origin time interval estimation from P and S arrival pairs using a prescribed range of Vp/Vs ratios (Wadati relationship).
Adaptive spatial neighborhood construction using 1st- and higher-order Voronoi diagrams (removing lower-order neighbors iteratively).
Modified DBSCAN spatio-temporal clustering based on temporal interval overlap across Voronoi-adjacent stations.
Optional Expectation-Maximization (EM) sub-clustering using pseudo-slowness and seed stations (local minima of S-P intervals) to split merged events.
利用预设波速比范围（Wadati关系）由单台P、S震相配对估算假设发震时刻区间。
通过迭代移除低阶近邻构建一阶及高阶Voronoi图，自适应定义台站空间拓扑近邻。
基于Voronoi相邻台站间发震时刻区间的时间重叠，采用改进的DBSCAN进行时空聚类。
利用伪慢度与种子台站（S-P走时差局部极小值）进行可选EM子聚类，拆分合并的事件。
de: Synthetic stress test: 8 sequences of 5,000 events each around The Geysers (121 stations) with average inter-event time decreasing from 64 s to 5 s.
Local real-data test: 6-day PhaseNet pick dataset from the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence benchmarked against SCSN catalog, GaMMA, and PyOcto.
Global real-data test: Two-week cloud-picked PhaseNet dataset (>10 million picks across 4,461 global stations) covering the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence.
合成压力测试：基于The Geysers台网（121个台站）生成8组各5000个地震序列，平均发震间隔从64秒递减至5秒。
局地真实数据测试：2019年Ridgecrest地震序列6天PhaseNet拾取数据集，与SCSN目录、GaMMA和PyOcto进行对比。
全球真实数据测试：包含Ridgecrest序列的两周全球PhaseNet云拾取数据集（4461个台站，超1000万个震相）。
li: Requires both P and S phase picks (or direct ML origin-time predictions) at each station, missing events when S picks are deficient (e.g., the M7.1 Ridgecrest mainshock).
Produces systematically larger epicentral distance errors than GaMMA and PyOcto because requiring paired P-S picks reduces the number of stations constraining location.
The 20 s maximum S-P pairing threshold limits single-station detection range to <1.5 degrees, preventing regional/teleseismic event association.
Imperfect separation of multiple earthquakes occurring simultaneously within the same or adjacent Voronoi cells.
要求每个台站同时具备P和S波拾取（或直接预测发震时刻），当S波缺失时会漏检（如Ridgecrest主震）。
要求P-S成对拾取减少了参与定位的台站数，导致震中距误差系统性大于GaMMA和PyOcto。
20秒的最大P-S配对阈值将单台检测范围限制在约1.5度以内，无法关联区域或远震事件。
当多个地震在同一或相邻Voronoi单元内同时发生时，EM子聚类仍难以完美分离。

tm.why: The paper develops VORA, an unsupervised spatio-temporal clustering algorithm for earthquake phase association to construct seismicity catalogs.
VORA leverages unsupervised clustering (modified DBSCAN and EM) and operates directly on massive automated phase pick datasets generated by deep learning pickers like PhaseNet.

ev.notes: Full 21-page manuscript PDF (including 9 figures) was used as primary evidence.

sum: This study investigates the shallow upper-crustal segmentation of the Tellian–Tunisian Dorsal transition in the El Kef region (northwestern Tunisia) using four 1:50,000 gravity sheets (~1 km spacing), an exploration well (W1), and a seismic reflection profile (L1). The methodology integrates Bouguer and polynomial residual anomaly mapping, total horizontal gradient (THG) and tilt-angle (TILT) filtering, 3D Euler deconvolution, and 2.5D forward modelling. Results show a first-order N–S regional gravity gradient reflecting a broad transition zone, superimposed with 5–12 km residual anomalies. Lineaments define a dense NE–SW and NW–SE fault network with Euler source depths concentrated at 0.5–3 km. The 2.5D models reveal fault-bounded blocks and laterally variable Triassic evaporites (up to ~4 km thick), including buried salt bodies beneath the El Kef graben. Novelty lies in demonstrating that inherited basement faults and salt collapse jointly controlled Neogene–Quaternary graben development within a compressional regime.
本研究利用突尼斯西北部El Kef地区4幅1:50,000重力图（点距约1 km）、W1探井和L1地震剖面，结合布格与剩余重力异常、总水平梯度与倾斜角滤波、三维欧拉反褶积及2.5D正演模拟，探讨了Tellian-Dorsal过渡带的上地壳浅部分段结构。结果表明，南北向区域重力梯度反映了宽缓的过渡带，……

t: Integrated gravity workflow combining third-order polynomial residual separation, Total Horizontal Gradient (THG) and tilt-angle (TILT) filtering, 3D Euler deconvolution (SI=0, 1; 7×7 window), and 2.5D forward modelling calibrated with well and seismic data.
综合三阶多项式剩余场分离、THG与TILT滤波、三维欧拉反褶积及钻井地震约束的2.5D重力正演。

Four 1:50,000 ONM gravity sheets (~1 km spacing, Scintrex CG-3, ±0.02 mGal accuracy, 2.4 g/cm³ reduction density), 1:50,000 geological maps, exploration well W1 (3500 m depth), and seismic reflection profile L1 (~3 s TWT).
4幅1:50,000重力图（点距约1 km）、地质图、3500 m深W1探井及3 s双程走时L1地震剖面。

Bouguer anomalies range from +6 mGal (north) to −37 mGal (south) with 5–12 km residual anomalies. NE–SW and NW–SE fault lineaments root at 0.5–3 km depth; 2.5D models (RMS 1.24, 1.74 mGal) show Triassic salt up to 4 km thick.
布格异常介于+6至-37 mGal，断裂源深0.5–3 km，2.5D模型揭示厚达4 km的三叠系盐体。

Gravity modelling and Euler deconvolution are inherently non-unique, and the lack of deep seismic constraints prevents distinguishing between crustal thickening and basement deepening for the regional gravity gradient.
重力反演具多解性，且缺乏深部地震数据来区分地壳增厚与基底加深。

Demonstrates that shallow upper-crustal segmentation and Neogene–Quaternary graben formation in the El Kef transition zone are jointly controlled by reactivated Mesozoic basement faults and buried Triassic salt collapse.
揭示了先存中生代基底断层活化与隐伏盐构造垮塌共同控制了新近纪-第四纪地堑发育。

kc: Characterized the Tellian–Tunisian Dorsal boundary in the El Kef region as a broad, laterally segmented transition zone rather than a sharp tectonic boundary.
Mapped a dense hierarchy of NE–SW and NW–SE fault lineaments and constrained their rooting depths to 0.5–3 km using THG, TILT, and 3D Euler deconvolution.
Constructed two sub-perpendicular 2.5D gravity models calibrated by borehole and seismic reflection data, identifying laterally extensive and buried Triassic salt bodies.
Proposed a structural model linking Neogene–Quaternary graben subsidence to the collapse of inherited salt structures and reactivated Mesozoic basement faults.
将El Kef地区的Tellian–Tunisian Dorsal边界表征为一个宽阔且横向分段的过渡带，而非尖锐的构造边界。
利用总水平梯度、倾斜角和三维欧拉反褶积勾勒出NE–SW和NW–SE向密集断裂网络，并将其发育深度约束在0.5–3 km。
构建了两条由钻井和地震反射剖面标定的近正交2.5D重力正演模型，识别出横向延展及隐伏的三叠系盐体。
提出了将新近纪–第四纪地堑沉降与先存盐构造垮塌及中生代继承性基底断层活化相联系的构造演化模型。
me: Regional-residual separation of Bouguer gravity anomalies using radial power spectrum analysis and a third-order polynomial surface.
Edge detection and structural lineament extraction via Total Horizontal Gradient (THG) and tilt-angle derivative (TILT) filtering.
Depth and source geometry estimation using 3D Euler deconvolution with a 7×7 moving window and structural index SI = 1 (and SI = 0).
2.5D forward gravity modelling along two sub-perpendicular profiles (Gc1 and L1) constrained by geological maps, well W1, and seismic profile L1.
基于径向平均功率谱分析和三阶多项式曲面的布格重力异常区域场与剩余场分离。
利用总水平梯度（THG）和倾斜角导数（TILT）滤波进行边界识别与构造线性体提取。
采用7×7滑动窗口和构造指数SI=1（及SI=0）的三维欧拉反褶积估算场源深度与几何形态。
结合地质图、W1探井和L1地震剖面约束，沿两条近正交剖面（Gc1和L1）开展2.5D重力正演模拟。
de: Four 1:50,000 gravity sheets (Nebeur, Les Salines, El Kef, Ouergha) acquired by ONM with a Scintrex CG-3 gravimeter (~1 km station spacing, ±0.02 mGal accuracy).
Four 1:50,000 geological maps providing surface faults, stratigraphic boundaries, and dip constraints.
Unpublished industrial subsurface data from exploration well W1 (3500 m depth) and NE–SW seismic reflection profile L1 (~3 s TWT).
突尼斯国家矿业局（ONM）使用Scintrex CG-3重力仪采集的4幅1:50,000重力图（Nebeur、Les Salines、El Kef、Ouergha，点距约1 km，精度±0.02 mGal）。
提供地表断层、地层界线和产状约束的4幅1:50,000地质图。
来自W1探井（井深3500 m）和NE–SW向L1地震反射剖面（约3 s双程走时）的未发表工业界地下数据。
li: Inherent non-uniqueness of gravity modelling and Euler deconvolution cannot be fully eliminated despite borehole and seismic constraints.
Lack of deep geophysical constraints (deep seismic reflection/refraction) prevents discriminating between southward crustal thickening and basement deepening for the regional gradient.
Gravity data provide no direct chronological constraints on the timing of fault movements.
尽管有钻井和地震数据约束，重力正演模拟和欧拉反褶积固有的多解性仍无法完全消除。
缺乏深部地球物理约束（深地震反射/折射），无法区分区域重力梯度是由向南地壳增厚还是基底加深引起的。
重力数据无法对断层活动的时代提供直接的年代学约束。

tm.why: The paper investigates the shallow upper-crustal structural segmentation, fault hierarchy, and geodynamic evolution of the Tellian–Dorsal transition in northwestern Tunisia using gravity data, well logs, and a seismic profile.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF evaluated, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), and all 14 figures.

sum: This study presents an open-source workflow integrating 3D Earth models from the EarthScope Earth Model Collaboration (EMC) into the SPECFEM3D Globe wave propagation code, coupled with the MTUQ software for seismic moment tensor estimation. By simulating wavefields in five 3D Earth models for five earthquakes in Alaska, the authors quantify how different 3D structures affect double-couple and full moment tensor solutions. The misfit measures from the source inversion are used to evaluate the performance of the underlying tomographic models. This integrated workflow enables systematic quantification of source uncertainties due to 3D Earth models and provides an independent framework for tomographic model assessment.
本研究提出了一种开源工作流，将EarthScope地球模型合作联盟（EMC）的三维地球模型导入SPECFEM3D Globe波动传播软件中，并结合MTUQ软件进行地震矩张量反演。通过对阿拉斯加5个地震在5个三维地球模型中的波场模拟，定量分析了不同三维结构对双力偶及全矩张量解的影响。利用源反演的拟合残……

t: An integrated workflow combining EMC 3D Earth models, SPECFEM3D Globe wavefield simulations, and MTUQ moment tensor inversion.
结合了EMC三维地球模型、SPECFEM3D Globe波场模拟和MTUQ矩张量反演的集成工作流。
Waveform data from 5 earthquakes in Alaska simulated across 5 different 3D Earth models from the EarthScope EMC.
阿拉斯加地区5个地震的波形数据，以及来自EarthScope EMC的5个不同三维速度模型。
Quantified the variability of moment tensors and evaluated the performance of 3D tomographic models using source misfit measures.
定量化了矩张量的变率，并利用震源反演拟合残差评估了三维层析成像模型的表现。
The analysis and conclusions are demonstrated on a limited dataset of 5 well-recorded events.
该方法的分析与结论目前仅在5个记录良好的地震事件的小数据集上进行了演示。
Establishing a fully open-source, reproducible pipeline linking EMC models directly to SPECFEM3D Globe and MTUQ.
建立了将EMC模型直接与SPECFEM3D Globe和MTUQ连接的完全开源、可重复的工作流。

kc: Established a new public workflow integrating EMC 3D models, SPECFEM3D Globe, and MTUQ.
Quantified the variability and uncertainty of seismic moment tensors resulting from different 3D Earth models.
Demonstrated a method to evaluate and compare 3D tomographic models using source inversion misfit as an independent metric.
构建了整合EMC三维模型、SPECFEM3D Globe和MTUQ的全新开源工作流。
定量分析了不同三维地球模型对地震矩张量反演结果带来的变率与不确定性。
展示了一种利用震源反演拟合残差作为独立指标来评估和对比三维层析成像模型的方法。
me: 3D seismic wavefield simulation using SPECFEM3D Globe.
Seismic moment tensor estimation (double-couple and full MT) using MTUQ software.
Model ingestion from the EarthScope Earth Model Collaboration (EMC).
使用SPECFEM3D Globe进行三维地震波场模拟。
使用MTUQ软件进行地震矩张量（双力偶及全矩张量）反演。
从EarthScope地球模型合作联盟（EMC）导入三维速度模型。
de: Tested the workflow using 5 earthquakes in the Alaska region.
Utilized 5 different 3D Earth models from the EMC database for wavefield simulations.
使用阿拉斯加地区的5个地震事件对工作流进行了测试。
利用EMC数据库中的5个不同三维地球模型进行了波场模拟。
li: The demonstration is limited to a small dataset of 5 well-recorded events.
Computational cost of running 3D simulations in SPECFEM3D Globe remains high compared to 1D models.
算例演示仅限于5个记录良好的地震事件的小规模数据集。
与一维模型相比，在SPECFEM3D Globe中运行三维模拟的计算成本仍然较高。

tm.why: The paper implements 3D Earth models from the EMC into the SPECFEM3D Globe wave propagation code.
The paper focuses on seismic moment tensor estimation (double-couple and full moment tensors) using 3D wavefield simulations.
The paper evaluates 3D tomographic models by comparing simulated wavefields with recorded data for source estimation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Predicting the failure timing of gravitational instabilities (landslides, rockfalls, glacier collapses) remains challenging due to multi-scale heterogeneity and fragmented disciplinary approaches. This review proposes a unified conceptual framework centered on an unobservable 'latent system state' that integrates endogenous damage accumulation, stress redistribution, frictional weakening, and exogenous forcing. Rather than searching for universal deterministic precursors, the framework treats observable signals—such as surface deformation (InSAR, LiDAR, GNSS), microseismicity, acoustic emissions, seismic velocity changes (dv/v), pore pressure, and temperature—as indirect, non-unique proxies of the evolving internal state. The author synthesizes existing failure paradigms (critical point, rate-and-state friction, hydromechanical thresholds, structural controls) and maps continuum, discrete, statistical physics, and machine-learning models across the damage-to-failure spectrum. Ultimately, failure forecasting and early warning are reframed as probabilistic latent state estimation under uncertainty.
受多尺度异质性和学科碎片化限制，预测滑坡、崩塌及冰川垮塌等重力失稳的破坏时间极具挑战。本综述提出了一个以不可直接观测的“潜在系统状态”为核心的统一概念框架，整合了内生损伤累积、应力重分布、摩擦弱化与外生强迫。该框架不再寻找普适的确定性前兆，而是将地表形变（InSAR、LiDAR）、微震、声发射、地震……

t: The paper proposes a पांच-domain conceptual architecture centering on an unobservable 'latent system state' that links geomaterial heterogeneity, progressive damage, observable proxies, and multi-physics/ML modeling to failure.
提出包含五个领域的概念架构，以不可直接观测的“潜在系统状态”为核心连接异质性、损伤演化与观测代理。

As a conceptual review, it synthesizes multi-sensor observational proxies including InSAR, LiDAR, microseismicity, acoustic emissions, ambient-noise velocity changes (dv/v), pore pressure, and thermal measurements.
作为概念综述，综合了InSAR、LiDAR、微震、声发射、背景噪声波速变化(dv/v)及孔隙压力等多传感器数据。

Predictability is shown to be an emergent, probabilistic property rather than a universal deterministic feature; criticality is only one possible trajectory among threshold-driven and structurally controlled failures.
可预测性是一种涌现的概率属性而非普适确定性特征；临界性只是损伤至破坏谱系中的一种可能轨迹。
Monitoring observables are indirect and non-unique proxies of internal damage, and collective organization may remain hidden due to rapid brittle failure or limited sensor coverage.
监测信号是内部损伤的间接非唯一代理，且集体组织可能因快速脆性破坏或传感器覆盖不足而隐蔽。

Shifts gravitational hazard forecasting from searching for universal deterministic precursors to reconstructing an evolving latent system state from incomplete, multi-modal observations under uncertainty.
将重力灾害预测从寻找普适前兆转向在不确定性下利用不完整观测重构演化的潜在系统状态。

kc: Introduces the 'latent system state' concept to unify endogenous damage evolution and exogenous forcing across diverse gravitational hazards.
Synthesizes and compares four classical failure frameworks: critical point/damage mechanics, rate-and-state friction, hydromechanical thresholds, and structural controls.
Maps surface (InSAR, LiDAR) and internal (microseismicity, dv/v, pore pressure) monitoring observables as indirect proxies of system state.
Classifies continuum, discrete/hybrid, statistical physics, and data-driven models across the progressive damage-to-failure spectrum.
Reframes early warning systems from deterministic precursor hunting to probabilistic state estimation and nowcasting under uncertainty.
引入“潜在系统状态”概念，统一了不同重力灾害中的内生损伤演化与外生强迫作用。
综合对比了四种经典破坏框架：临界点/损伤力学、速率-状态摩擦、水力机械阈值和结构控制。
将地表（InSAR、LiDAR）和内部（微震、dv/v、孔隙水压）监测可观测量映射为系统状态的间接代理。
在渐进损伤到破坏的谱系上对连续介质、离散/混合、统计物理和数据驱动模型进行了分类。
将早期预警系统从寻找确定性前兆重构为不确定性下的概率状态估计与临近预报（nowcasting）。
me: Conceptual synthesis integrating geomechanics, fracture mechanics, statistical physics, and data-driven state estimation.
Comparative evaluation of failure paradigms (power-law scaling, log-periodic oscillations, rate-and-state friction, threshold models).
Multi-sensor monitoring integration combining geodetic remote sensing with passive seismic event detection and ambient-noise interferometry (dv/v).
Mapping of numerical modeling paradigms (FEM, DEM, FEM-DEM, Fiber Bundle Models, Physics-Informed ML) onto system evolution stages.
整合地质力学、断裂力学、统计物理学和数据驱动状态估计的概念综合。
破坏范式（幂律标度、对数周期振荡、速率-状态摩擦、阈值模型）的比较评估。
结合大地测量遥感与被动地震事件检测及背景噪声干涉测量（dv/v）的多传感器监测集成。
将数值建模范式（FEM、DEM、FEM-DEM、纤维束模型、物理引导机器学习）映射到系统演化阶段。
de: Literature synthesis of field and laboratory observations across landslides, rockfalls, debris flows, and avalanching glaciers.
Review of multi-modal monitoring datasets including InSAR, LiDAR, ground-based radar, microseismicity, acoustic emissions, dv/v, and piezometers.
综合了滑坡、崩塌、泥石流和雪崩冰川的野外与实验室观测文献。
综述了包括InSAR、LiDAR、地基雷达、微震、声发射、dv/v和渗压计在内的多模态监测数据集。
li: The proposed framework is a generic interpretative structure rather than a site-specific deterministic predictive model.
Observable signals are indirect and non-unique proxies; similar accelerations can arise from transient external forcing without approaching failure.
Hidden criticality: rapid brittle or structurally controlled failures may occur without detectable precursory signatures due to sensor resolution limits.
Extrapolating scaling laws from simplified statistical models or lab experiments to complex natural geometries remains challenging.
所提出的框架是一个通用的解释性结构，而非特定场地的确定性预测模型。
可观测信号是间接且非唯一的代理；类似的加速可能源于瞬态外部强迫而非临近破坏。
隐蔽临界性：由于传感器分辨率限制，快速脆性或受结构控制的破坏可能在没有可检测前兆的情况下发生。
将简化统计模型或实验室实验的标度律外推到复杂自然几何结构仍然具有挑战性。

tm.why: The paper presents a unified conceptual framework for gravitational instabilities including landslides, rockfalls, and glacier instabilities, integrating microseismicity, acoustic emissions, and ambient-noise seismic interferometry (dv/v) for monitoring.

Ambient-noise seismic interferometry and temporal seismic velocity variations (dv/v) are explicitly discussed as key internal monitoring proxies to track progressive weakening in slopes and rock masses prior to failure.

The paper extensively discusses damage mechanics, microcrack coalescence, rate-and-state friction, creep transitions, and statistical physics fracture models governing the evolution of geomaterials toward failure.

ev.notes: Full 48-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all 8 sections, 5 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This controlled field study analyzes seismo-acoustic signals from three snow avalanches—a dry-snow, a similar-sized wet-snow, and a large wet-snow event—along the same path in Dischma valley, Switzerland. Using co-located five-sensor seismic and infrasound arrays validated by Doppler radar and time-lapse cameras, the authors minimize path and topographic confounding effects. Frequency-domain beamforming and co-located sensor cross-correlations reveal that seismic amplitudes are primarily controlled by avalanche size, whereas infrasound strength is governed by the presence of a turbulent suspension layer. Notably, the large wet-snow avalanche developed a powder cloud due to high volume and channelized terrain, generating strong infrasound (~3 Pa). Infrasound beamforming yielded stable backazimuths and slownesses even at low amplitudes, while seismic wavefields showed transitions between acoustic air-ground coupling and ground-propagating seismic phases. Crucially, array beamforming detected coherent avalanche motion earlier and longer than single-sensor waveforms or spectrograms.
本研究在瑞士Dischma山谷对同一路径上的三次雪崩（干雪崩、相近规模湿雪崩及大型湿雪崩）开展受控野外观测。结合同址部署的五元地震与次声台阵、多普勒雷达及延时相机，应用频域波束形成与互相关分析。结果表明：地震振幅主要由雪崩规模控制，而次声强度取决于悬移层（粉末云）的形成；大型湿雪崩因体积大且地形受限……

t: The authors apply 1–80 Hz bandpass filtering, envelope thresholding, sliding-window cross-correlation between co-located seismic and infrasound pairs, and frequency-domain cross-correlation plane-wave beamforming (5 s windows, 95% overlap) to retrieve backazimuth, slowness, and beampower.
采用1–80 Hz滤波、包络阈值、同址传感器滑动窗互相关及频域互相关平面波波束形成提取反方位角与慢度。

Recordings of three avalanches (dry-snow, wet-snow, and large wet-snow) along the same path at Dürrboden, Switzerland, captured by a 110 m aperture array of five co-located seismometers and infrasound sensors, a Doppler radar, and 12 cameras.
瑞士Dürrboden孔径110米五元同址地震-次声台阵、多普勒雷达及相机记录的同路径三次干、湿雪崩数据。

Similar-sized dry and wet avalanches yielded comparable peak seismic amplitudes (~1.2 μm/s) but a tenfold difference in infrasound (0.6 vs. 0.07 Pa); the large wet avalanche with a suspension layer reached 3 Pa and 35 μm/s.
相近规模干湿雪崩地震振幅相当（~1.2 μm/s），但次声差10倍；带悬移层的大型湿雪崩达3 Pa和35 μm/s。
The controlled study design restricted the dataset to only three avalanches along a single path, limiting statistical analysis and generalizability across varying topographies and paths.
受控实验样本仅限同一路径的三次雪崩，限制了跨路径与复杂地形的统计普适性。

Directly isolates the effects of avalanche flow type and size using co-located seismic and infrasound arrays along a constant path, proving large wet-snow avalanches can form infrasound-generating suspension layers.
固定路径与台阵几何直接分离雪崩类型与规模效应，证实大型湿雪崩也能发育产生强次声的悬移层。

kc: Controlled comparison of dry-snow, small wet-snow, and large wet-snow avalanches along an identical path using co-located 5-sensor seismic and infrasound arrays and Doppler radar.
Demonstrated that seismic amplitude is governed primarily by avalanche size, while infrasound amplitude is controlled by suspension layer formation (even in large wet-snow avalanches).
Showed that array beamforming detects coherent avalanche signals up to 15 s before single-sensor waveform onset and persists after estimated end times, outperforming single-sensor spectrograms.
利用同址五元地震和次声台阵及多普勒雷达，对同一路径上的干雪崩、小型湿雪崩和大型湿雪崩进行了受控对比。
证实地震振幅主要由雪崩规模控制，而次声振幅由悬移层发育决定（即使在大型湿雪崩中也是如此）。
表明台阵波束形成可在单台波形起跳前高达15秒检测到相干雪崩信号，并在估计结束时间后持续存在，优于单台时频图。
me: Band-pass filtering (1–80 Hz) and smoothed envelope thresholding to determine avalanche onset and duration.
Time-resolved zero-lag cross-correlation (5 s sliding windows, 95% overlap) between co-located seismic and infrasound sensors to quantify seismo-acoustic coupling.
Frequency-domain cross-correlation plane-wave beamforming in PyTorch to estimate backazimuth, horizontal slowness, and beampower.
Validation of array-derived backazimuths against FMCW Doppler avalanche radar front trajectories and 1-D SNOWPACK physical modeling.
采用1–80 Hz带通滤波与平滑包络阈值法确定雪崩起止时间与持续时间。
使用5秒滑动窗（95%重叠）对同址地震和次声传感器进行时间分辨互相关分析，以量化声-震耦合。
利用基于PyTorch的频域互相关平面波波束形成算法估算反方位角、水平慢度和波束功率。
结合FMCW多普勒雪崩雷达前缘轨迹与一维SNOWPACK物理模型验证台阵定位与雪层状态。
de: Co-located triangular array (110 m aperture) in Dischma valley (Dürrboden, 2000 m a.s.l.) with 5 Lennartz seismometers (1 Hz, 200 Hz sampling) and 5 ITEM Prs0025a infrasound sensors.
Three natural avalanches along the same path: a dry-snow event (28 Jan 2025, 34,499 m²), a small wet-snow event (18 Mar 2022, 20,834 m²), and a large wet-snow event (15 Apr 2024, 95,291 m²).
Independent ground truth from a Geoprevent FMCW Doppler radar, 12 automatic time-lapse cameras, and Stillberg/Bärentälli automatic weather stations.
在瑞士Dischma山谷（海拔2000米）部署孔径110米的三角形同址台阵，含5台Lennartz地震仪和5台ITEM次声传感器（采样率200 Hz）。
同一路径的三次自然雪崩记录：干雪崩（2025年1月28日，34,499 m²）、小型湿雪崩（2022年3月18日，20,834 m²）和大型湿雪崩（2024年4月15日，95,291 m²）。
来自Geoprevent多普勒雷达、12台自动延时相机及自动气象站的独立验证数据。
li: Small sample size restricted to three avalanches along a single path, limiting statistical generalization across diverse terrain settings.
Inability to unambiguously separate distinct seismic wave types due to distributed moving sources and short source-receiver distances.
Frequency content above 20 Hz is strongly attenuated by distance because sensors were deployed at the valley bottom outside the path.
样本量较小，仅限于单一路径上的三次雪崩，限制了在不同地形条件下的统计普适性。
由于雪崩源在空间上呈分布式移动且源-检距较短，无法明确区分具体的地震波类型。
传感器位于雪崩路径外的谷底，高频成分随距离快速衰减，导致频谱特征对雪崩类型不敏感。

tm.why: The paper investigates the seismo-acoustic wavefields and source dynamics of dry- and wet-snow avalanches in the Swiss Alps.
The study utilizes co-located five-element seismic and infrasound arrays along with plane-wave beamforming and Doppler radar validation.

ev.notes: Full 21-page JGR Earth Surface article PDF (including Appendices A and B, 14 figures, and 2 tables) was analyzed directly.

sum: This study investigates the active Woodfjorden hydrothermal system in northwestern Svalbard using a 3D magnetotelluric (MT) survey at 12 sites, integrated with water and gas isotope geochemistry from thermal springs. The MT results image conductive anomalies (1–10 Ohm-m) beneath Trollkjeldene and Halvdanpiggen, indicating hydrothermal fluids or mineralized zones, and resistive anomalies (1–10 kOhm-m) beneath Sverrefjellet representing buried magmatic or basement rocks. Geochemical analyses of stable isotopes, carbon, and noble gases reveal a mixed fluid origin with meteoric, crustal, and mantle components, including a 6%–8% mantle helium fraction. The findings suggest that extinct magmatic heat and low-permeability structural compartmentalization sustain this high-latitude hydrothermal circulation.
本研究结合12个测点的三维大地电磁（MT）探测与温泉水气同位素地球化学分析，系统研究了斯瓦尔巴西北部Woodfjorden活动地热系统。MT成像显示Trollkjeldene和Halvdanpiggen下方存在1-10 Ω·m的低阻异常，指示深部热液或矿化带；而Sverrefjellet火山下方1-……

t: 3D magnetotelluric inversion at 12 sites combined with stable isotope and noble gas geochemistry of thermal spring water and gas.
结合12个测点的三维大地电磁反演与温泉水气稳定同位素及惰性气体地球化学分析。
MT impedance data from 12 sites and geochemical/isotopic measurements of water and gas samples from Trollkjeldene and Jotunkjeldene springs.
斯瓦尔巴Woodfjorden地区12个测点的MT阻抗数据及两处温泉群的水气同位素测量数据。
Identified 1-10 Ohm-m conductive zones under Trollkjeldene and Halvdanpiggen, 1-10 kOhm-m resistive anomalies under Sverrefjellet, and 6%-8% mantle-derived helium.
发现Trollkjeldene下方1-10 Ω·m的低阻带与Sverrefjellet下方高阻体，并测得6%-8%的地幔…
The magnetotelluric survey has a limited aperture due to the remoteness of the region and complex logistics.
受限于北极极度偏远环境与复杂后勤，大地电磁探测的空间覆盖范围较小。
First combined 3D geophysical and geochemical study of the northernmost onshore active hydrothermal system in Svalbard.
首次对斯瓦尔巴群岛最北端陆上活动热液系统进行地球物理与地球化学联合探测。

kc: Provides the first combined 3D magnetotelluric and geochemical characterization of the northernmost onshore thermal springs in Svalbard.
Identifies distinct conductive and resistive subsurface anomalies mapping hydrothermal fluid pathways and buried magmatic bodies.
Quantifies a 6%–8% mantle-derived helium contribution in the hydrothermal gases, confirming deep mantle-crust-atmosphere fluid mixing.
首次对斯瓦尔巴群岛最北端的陆上温泉进行了三维大地电磁与地球化学联合表征。
识别出明显的地下高导和高阻异常，精细刻画了热液流体通道和埋藏的岩浆岩体。
定量估算出热液气体中含有6%-8%的地幔源氦，证实了深部地幔-地壳-大气的流体混合机制。
me: 3D Magnetotelluric (MT) inversion and imaging at 12 remote sites.
Water and gas sampling for stable isotopes (H, O, C) and noble gas (He, Ne, Ar) isotope ratio analysis.
在12个偏远测点进行三维大地电磁（MT）反演与成像。
采集温泉水和气体样品，进行稳定同位素（氢、氧、碳）及惰性气体（氦、氖、氩）同位素比值分析。
de: 3D magnetotelluric impedance tensor data from 12 sites in the Woodfjorden area, NW Svalbard.
Geochemical and isotopic compositions of water and gas samples from Trollkjeldene and Jotunkjeldene thermal spring clusters.
来自斯瓦尔巴西北部Woodfjorden地区12个测点的三维大地电磁阻抗张量数据。
采集自Trollkjeldene和Jotunkjeldene温泉群的水、气样品地球化学与同位素组成数据。

由于北极地区偏远且后勤保障极其困难，大地电磁测网的空间覆盖范围较为有限。

tm.why: The paper investigates an active hydrothermal system and extinct Quaternary volcanoes in Svalbard using magnetotellurics and geochemistry.
The study characterizes the crustal structure, fluid pathways, and mantle-derived components of a regional fault zone and volcanic complex.

sum: This paper introduces TREAD (Transformer for Earthquake Alert with Distance-awareness), a deep learning model designed for regional earthquake early warning (EEW). Recognizing that ground-shaking intensity exhibits concentric spatial patterns, TREAD incorporates an auxiliary task of regressing distances from seismic stations to target prediction locations. This explicitly encodes spatial geometry into the Transformer architecture, enabling distance-aware interactions. Evaluated on datasets from Taiwan's Central Weather Administration (CWA) and Japan's Kyoshin network, TREAD outperforms existing baseline methods, providing more accurate and reliable early warnings across various ground-motion thresholds. The primary novelty lies in integrating physical spatial constraints (station-to-target distance regression) as an auxiliary task within a self-attention framework to improve regional ground motion forecasting.
本文提出TREAD模型，一种用于区域地震预警的距离感知Transformer。该模型引入辅助任务回归台站到目标位置的距离，将空间几何显式编码到自注意力机制中。在台湾CWA和日本Kyoshin强震网数据集上的测试表明，TREAD在多个地震动阈值下均优于基线方法，显著提升了区域地震动预测的准确性与预警可……

t: A Transformer-based deep learning model (TREAD) that incorporates an auxiliary task of regressing station-to-target distances to explicitly encode spatial geometry.
一种基于Transformer的深度学习模型（TREAD），通过引入回归台站到目标距离的辅助任务来显式编码空间几何。
Seismic waveform and strong-motion datasets from the Central Weather Administration (CWA) in Taiwan and the Kyoshin network in Japan.
来自台湾中央气象署（CWA）和日本Kyoshin强震网的地震波形与强震数据集。
TREAD outperforms representative baseline methods, achieving higher predictive accuracy and more reliable regional earthquake early warnings across multiple ground-motion thresholds.
TREAD在多个地震动阈值下均优于代表性基线方法，实现了更高的预测精度和更可靠的区域地震预警。
The model's performance is constrained by seismic network density and may not fully account for complex 3D path effects.
模型性能受限于地震台网密度，且可能无法完全考虑复杂的三维路径效应。
Explicitly integrating physical spatial geometry into a Transformer architecture via a station-to-target distance regression auxiliary task for regional EEW.
通过台站到目标距离回归的辅助任务，将物理空间几何显式整合到用于区域地震预警的Transformer架构中。

kc: Proposes TREAD, a novel Transformer-based regional earthquake early warning model.
Introduces a distance-aware auxiliary task that explicitly encodes spatial geometry (station-to-target distance) into the self-attention mechanism.
Demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and reliability over baseline methods using real-world datasets from Taiwan (CWA) and Japan (Kyoshin network).
提出TREAD，一种新型的基于Transformer的区域地震预警模型。

Auxiliary task learning: regressing distances from seismic stations to target prediction locations.
Multi-station spatial-temporal feature fusion.
用于区域地震预警的Transformer深度学习架构。
辅助任务学习：回归地震台站到目标预测位置的距离。

Kyoshin network (K-NET/KiK-net) strong-motion dataset from Japan.
Comparative evaluation against representative baseline EEW methods across multiple ground-motion thresholds.

The auxiliary task of distance regression assumes simplified spatial geometry which might not fully capture complex 3D geological heterogeneity.

距离回归辅助任务假设了简化的空间几何，可能无法完全捕捉复杂的地下三维地质异质性。

tm.why: The paper proposes TREAD, a Transformer-based deep learning model for regional earthquake early warning.
The model aims to predict ground motion and provide timely alerts for earthquake early warning.

sum: This study investigates the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake by integrating Sentinel-1 InSAR, near-to-far-field GNSS offsets (up to ~4000 km), and two published tsunami-derived initial uplift models within a 3D heterogeneous spherical finite-element model (PyLith). The authors find that land-based geodesy constrains intermediate-to-deep slip and long-wavelength deformation, whereas near-trench slip is dictated by offshore tsunami constraints, yielding two distinct end-member scenarios (slip at 20–40 km vs. <20 km depth). Remarkably, all acceptable slip models produce nearly identical far-field GNSS displacements beyond ~1000 km, demonstrating that far-field offsets primarily constrain elastic Earth structure rather than rupture details. A first-order layered block model reproduces the detailed LITHO1.0-PREM response within ~5%, while a homogeneous model severely overpredicts regional displacements. Furthermore, interseismic coupling inversions indicate the rupture initiated at a sharp northern locking transition.
本文结合近场InSAR、远至4000公里的GNSS同震位移及两种海啸初始隆升模型，利用三维非均匀球形有限元模型（PyLith）反演了2025年Mw 8.8堪察加巨型逆冲地震的同震滑动分布。结果表明，陆地大地测量能稳健约束中深部滑动，而浅部近海沟滑动主要受海啸数据控制（表现为20–40 km深部滑动或……

t: Weighted least-squares slip inversion combining InSAR, multi-scale GNSS, and tsunami uplift pseudo-observations using Green's functions computed in a 3D heterogeneous spherical finite-element model (PyLith 4.2.0) extending to the core-mantle boundary.
基于延伸至核幔边界的三维非均匀球形有限元模型（PyLith 4.2.0）计算格林函数，对InSAR、GNSS和海啸伪观测…
Two Sentinel-1 InSAR tracks, multi-scale GNSS offsets from 13 near-source, 25 regional Russian, and >1500 NGL stations out to ~4000 km, plus two published DART/SWOT tsunami initial uplift models.
两景Sentinel-1 InSAR数据、延伸至4000公里的1500多个多尺度GNSS台站位移，以及两个已发表的海啸初…

Two tsunami-constrained models yield peak slip of 14.8 m (20–40 km depth) vs. 17.4 m (<20 km depth), yet predict nearly identical far-field displacements; first-order 3D structure matches LITHO1.0-PREM within 5%.
两种海啸约束分别给出14.8米（20-40公里深）和17.4米（<20公里深）的最大滑动，但远场预测几乎一致；一阶三维结…

Shallow near-trench slip depends heavily on external tsunami source timing assumptions, and far-field offsets in Korea and southern Japan are systematically underpredicted due to reference-frame or processing artifacts.
浅部近海沟滑动高度依赖海啸激发时间假设，且模型系统性低估了日本南部和韩国的远场水平位移。

First mechanically consistent multi-scale analysis linking near-trench tsunami uplift, near-field InSAR/GNSS, and continental-scale far-field GNSS (to 4000 km) for the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka rupture in a 3D spherical Earth.
首次在三维非均匀球形地球框架下将近海沟海啸、近场大地测量与4000公里大陆尺度远场GNSS结合，解析2025年堪察加巨震…

kc: Resolved coseismic slip of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake using a 3D heterogeneous spherical finite-element model integrating InSAR, multi-scale GNSS (to ~4000 km), and tsunami uplift models.
Demonstrated that far-field static GNSS offsets (>1000 km) are insensitive to shallow slip details and instead primarily constrain radial stiffening and large-scale Earth structure.

Showed that a first-order heterogeneous spherical model matches a detailed LITHO1.0-PREM model within ~5%, whereas a homogeneous model overpredicts regional deformation and biases near-trench slip by ~1 m.
Identified a sharp along-strike transition in interseismic locking depth (from ~80 km to ~20 km) coinciding with the northern boundary of the 1952/2025 ruptures and mainshock nucleation.
利用整合了InSAR、多尺度GNSS（达4000公里）和海啸隆升模型的三维非均匀球形有限元模型，解析了2025年Mw 8.8堪察加地震的同震滑动。
证明了远场静态GNSS位移（>1000公里）对浅部滑动细节不敏感，而是主要约束径向刚度增加和大尺度地球结构。
表明一阶非均匀球形模型与详细的LITHO1.0-PREM模型预测差异在5%以内，而均匀模型高估了区域变形并导致近海沟滑动产生约1米的偏差。
识别出震间闭锁深度沿走向的急剧过渡带（从约80公里减至约20公里），与1952/2025年破裂北界及主震成核区吻合。
me: 3D spherical finite-element forward modeling up to the core-mantle boundary using PyLith 4.2.0, incorporating Slab2 geometry, trench bathymetry, and elastic heterogeneity.
Weighted least-squares coseismic slip inversion with L2 Laplacian smoothing, soft rake priors, InSAR planar ramp estimation, and bathymetric slope corrections for offshore uplift.
Forward tsunami propagation simulations using GeoClaw with adaptive mesh refinement to validate slip models against NOAA DART buoy waveforms.
Interseismic coupling inversion from published GNSS velocity fields using the same 3D spherical finite-element Green's functions.
使用PyLith 4.2.0建立延伸至核幔边界的三维球形有限元正演模型，包含Slab2俯冲板片几何、海沟地形和弹性非均匀性。
采用加权最小二乘法反演同震滑动，结合L2平滑约束、软滑动角先验、InSAR平面轨道趋势估计以及海底地形坡度引起的海啸垂直位移校正。
利用GeoClaw自适应网格加密进行海啸传播正演模拟，通过与NOAA DART浮标波形对比验证滑动模型。
基于相同的三维球形有限元格林函数和已发表的GNSS速度场反演震间闭锁分布。
de: Two Sentinel-1 InSAR line-of-sight displacement scenes (ascending track 111 and descending track 60) covering the southern Kamchatka Peninsula.

Multi-scale GNSS coseismic offsets: 13 published near-source stations, 25 newly processed regional Russian stations (Bernese 5.4), and >1500 far-field stations from the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory out to ~4000 km.
Two published tsunami-derived initial sea-surface uplift models (Ruiz-Angulo et al., 2025 and Sepúlveda et al., 2026) used as offshore pseudo-observations, plus 5 NOAA DART buoy records.
Three Earth structure sensitivity models: first-order block-heterogeneous spherical model, detailed LITHO1.0-PREM model, and homogeneous elastic sphere.
覆盖堪察加半岛南部的两景Sentinel-1 InSAR视线向同震位移数据（升轨111和降轨60）。
多尺度GNSS同震位移：13个已发表近源台站、本研究使用Bernese 5.4新处理的25个俄罗斯区域台站，以及内华达大地测量实验室汇编的1500多个远至4000公里的远场台站。
两个已发表的海啸初始海面隆升模型（Ruiz-Angulo et al., 2025和Sepúlveda et al., 2026）作为近海伪观测约束，以及5个NOAA DART浮标压力记录。
三种地球结构敏感性测试模型：一阶块体非均匀球形模型、详细的LITHO1.0-PREM模型以及均匀弹性球模型。
li: Shallow near-trench slip remains non-unique and strongly dependent on the timing and source assumptions of the external tsunami uplift models used.

Systematic underprediction of far-field GNSS horizontal offsets (by ~1–2 mm) at distances >2000 km along the Japan–Korea azimuth, likely due to reference-frame, processing, or unmodeled plate-motion effects.
Absolute interseismic coupling amplitudes and locking depths are sensitive to reference-frame realizations and block-motion corrections.
浅部近海沟滑动仍存在非唯一性，强烈依赖于所采用的外部海啸隆升模型中的发震时间假设和震源参数化。
在日本—韩国方向大于2000公里处系统性低估了远场GNSS水平位移（约1–2毫米），可能源于参考框架、数据处理差异或未建模的板块运动残差。
反演所得的震间闭锁绝对幅度和闭锁深度对参考框架实现及块体运动校正较为敏感。

tm.why: The paper resolves the coseismic slip distribution of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake using multi-scale geodetic and tsunami constraints.
The authors invert interseismic coupling along the Kamchatka subduction zone to show how locking depth variations control mainshock nucleation and rupture extent.
The study evaluates how 3D radial and lateral elastic heterogeneity (slab, overriding plate, upper/lower mantle) controls regional-to-far-field static coseismic deformation.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 45-page preprint PDF including main text, 7 main figures, supplementary texts S1–S2, Table S1, and supplementary figures S1–S6.

sum: This study measures the sound velocities of glaucophane, the dominant mineral in blueschist, at pressures up to 9.9 GPa and temperatures up to 673 K using the ultrasonic interference method. High-temperature finite strain fitting of the experimental data reveals that glaucophane has a distinctively low bulk-to-shear modulus ratio compared to other slab minerals. By modeling various blueschist mineral assemblages, the authors demonstrate that a mixture of 63.9% glaucophane and 36.1% lawsonite matches seismic observations of the low-velocity layer (LVL) at 100–250 km depth in circum-Pacific subduction zones, providing strong evidence for the blueschist hypothesis of the LVL's origin.
本研究利用超声干涉法在高达9.9 GPa和673 K条件下测量了蓝闪石的声波速度。通过有限应变拟合获得其弹性性质，发现其具有较低的体积与剪切模量比。计算表明，63.9%蓝闪石和36.1%硬柱石组成的矿物组合能很好地解释环太平洋俯冲带100-250 km深度的低速层，为低速层的蓝片岩成因假说提供了关键……

t: Ultrasonic interference method combined with high-temperature finite strain fitting to measure and model elastic properties of glaucophane.
采用超声干涉法结合高温有限应变拟合，测量并模拟蓝闪石的弹性性质。
Experimental sound velocity measurements of glaucophane at high pressures up to 9.9 GPa and temperatures up to 673 K.
在高达9.9 GPa压力和673 K温度下获得的蓝闪石实验声速测量数据。
An assemblage of 63.9% glaucophane and 36.1% lawsonite matches seismic observations of the low-velocity layer at 100–250 km depth.
63.9%蓝闪石和36.1%硬柱石的组合可匹配100-250 km深度的低速层观测。
The experimental pressure and temperature range (up to 9.9 GPa and 673 K) may not fully capture deeper slab conditions.
实验温压范围（最高9.9 GPa和673 K）可能无法完全覆盖更深部的板块条件。
First high P-T ultrasonic velocity measurements of glaucophane providing quantitative constraints on the blueschist origin of the subduction low-velocity layer.
首次在高温高压下测量蓝闪石声速，定量约束了俯冲带低速层的蓝片岩成因。

kc: Measured high P-T sound velocities of glaucophane up to 9.9 GPa and 673 K.
Determined the elastic properties and bulk-to-shear modulus ratio of glaucophane under subduction zone conditions.
Demonstrated that a specific glaucophane-lawsonite assemblage (63.9% to 36.1%) quantitatively explains the subduction zone low-velocity layer.
测量了蓝闪石在高达9.9 GPa和673 K条件下的高温高压声速。
确定了俯冲带条件下蓝闪石的弹性性质及其独特的低体积/剪切模量比。
证实了特定比例（63.9%蓝闪石和36.1%硬柱石）的矿物组合可定量解释俯冲带低速层。
me: Ultrasonic interference method for high-pressure and high-temperature sound velocity measurements.
High-temperature finite strain fitting of elastic data.
Mineral physics modeling of subducting slab velocity profiles.
用于高温高压声速测量的超声干涉法。
弹性数据的高温有限应变拟合。
俯冲板块速度剖面的矿物物理学建模。
de: Experimental sound velocity data of glaucophane measured at pressures up to 9.9 GPa and temperatures up to 673 K.
在高达9.9 GPa压力和673 K温度下测得的蓝闪石实验声速数据。
li: The experimental pressure and temperature range (up to 9.9 GPa and 673 K) may not fully cover the deepest parts of the 100-250 km depth range.
The simplified mineralogical model (glaucophane + lawsonite) may omit other minor phases present in real subducting slabs.
实验温压范围（最高9.9 GPa和673 K）可能无法完全覆盖100-250公里深度范围的最深部条件。
简化的矿物学模型（蓝闪石+硬柱石）可能忽略了真实俯冲板块中存在的其他次要矿物相。

tm.why: The paper investigates the elastic properties of glaucophane to explain the low-velocity layer atop subducting slabs in the upper mantle.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the JGR Solid Earth abstract and metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: This study presents an automatic high-pass filter cutoff frequency (fHP) selection method for strong-motion records using an improved random forest (RF) model. By incorporating tree-wise weighted voting and a filtering-completion criterion, the model enhances accuracy and robustness. It was trained on 10,636 strong-motion records from the China flatfile and validated on the 2021 Yangbi earthquake sequence and the Engineering Strong-Motion dataset (7,326 records). The method outperforms standard machine learning baselines and shows strong generalization across unseen events, providing an efficient solution for automated strong-motion data preprocessing.
本研究提出一种基于改进随机森林模型的强震记录高通滤波截止频率自动选择方法。该方法引入树级加权投票和滤波完成准则，在万余条中国强震记录上训练，并在漾濞地震和欧洲强震数据集上验证。结果表明，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性上优于传统机器学习基线，具有良好的跨事件泛化能力，为强震数据自动预处理提供了高效解决方案。

t: An improved random forest model incorporating tree-wise weighted voting and a filtering-completion criterion to automatically select the high-pass filter cutoff frequency of strong-motion records.
结合树级加权投票和滤波完成准则的改进随机森林模型，用于自动选择强震记录的高通滤波截止频率。
Trained on 10,636 strong-motion records from the China flatfile, and validated on the 2021 Yangbi earthquake sequence and 7,326 records from the Engineering Strong-Motion dataset.
使用中国平原数据集的10,636条强震记录进行训练，并利用漾濞地震序列及欧洲强震数据集的7,326条记录进行验证。
Achieved superior performance over standard ML baselines, closer agreement with manual selections, and demonstrated robust generalization across unseen events using event-wise data splitting.
性能优于传统机器学习基线，与人工选择高度一致，且在事件划分测试中表现出良好的跨事件泛化能力。
Long-period and displacement-sensitive measures like peak ground displacement and pseudospectral acceleration at 10 s are highly sensitive to differences in cutoff-selection preferences.
峰值地动位移（PGD）和10秒伪加速度反应谱等长周期指标对截止频率选择偏好的差异仍较敏感。
Introduces tree-wise weighted voting and a filtering-completion criterion to random forest, enabling automated, robust, and event-generalized high-pass cutoff frequency selection.
在随机森林中引入树级加权投票和滤波完成准则，实现了自动、鲁棒且具泛化性的高通截止频率选择。

kc: Developed an improved random forest model incorporating tree-wise weighted voting and a filtering-completion criterion for automatic fHP selection.
Demonstrated superior performance and closer agreement with manual selections compared to standard ML baselines and existing methods.
Validated the model's robustness and generalization capability using the 2021 Yangbi earthquake sequence and the Engineering Strong-Motion dataset.
开发了一种结合树级加权投票和滤波完成准则的改进随机森林模型，用于自动选择高通滤波截止频率。
与标准机器学习基线及现有方法相比，展示出更优越的性能以及与人工选择更高的一致性。
利用2021年漾濞地震序列和欧洲工程强震数据集验证了模型的鲁棒性和跨事件泛化能力。

Filtering-completion criterion
Machine learning baseline comparison (SVM, LightGBM, KNN, XGBoost)

滤波完成准则

2021 Ms 6.4 Yangbi earthquake sequence for validation
7,326 records from the Engineering Strong-Motion (ESM) dataset evaluated under record-wise and event-wise splitting strategies

用于验证的2021年Ms 6.4漾濞地震序列

The method is designed specifically for preprocessing strong-motion records used in earthquake engineering and seismology.

sum: Previous studies reported that repeating earthquake recurrence time (Tr) scales with seismic moment (M0) as Tr ∝ M0^(1/6), seemingly contradicting the classic circular crack model prediction of Tr ∝ M0^(1/3). Using an expanded global compilation of over 4,800 repeater sequences (27,000 events), including tectonic faults and Antarctic icequakes, the authors reframe the scaling problem by analyzing the entire Tr-M0 data cloud structure. By selecting persistent, quasi-periodic repeaters and normalizing recurrence times by geodetic background creep rates, they reveal a scattered triangular distribution. This distribution features an upper flat bound caused by finite catalog duration and a robust lower envelope with a slope of 1/3 (~10 MPa stress drop), representing asperities loaded by total steady fault creep. Sequences above the lower bound reflect locally low creep rates on secondary fault strands, asperity interactions, or stress drop variations, validating physics-based crack models for high-resolution creep estimation.
以往研究认为重复地震复发间隔与地震矩遵循1/6幂律标度，与经典裂纹模型预测的1/3斜率矛盾。本研究汇编全球超4800个重复地震序列（含冰震），通过筛选长期准周期序列并用大地测量背景蠕滑率归一化，发现数据呈三角形离散分布：上界受限于有限观测时长，而下包络线稳定呈1/3斜率（对应约10 MPa应力降），……

t: The authors filter catalogs for persistent, quasi-periodic sequences (95th percentile CoV < 0.7 via Monte Carlo sampling), convert magnitudes to moment using a bilinear relation, and normalize recurrence times by geodetic fault creep rates.
筛选持续且准周期的序列，通过双线性关系转换地震矩，并用大地测量蠕滑率归一化复发时间。

A global compilation of over 4,800 repeater sequences and 27,000 repeating earthquakes across major tectonic creeping and subduction zones, supplemented by Antarctic repeating icequakes down to Mw -1.
汇编全球主要构造带超4800个重复地震序列（2.7万次事件）及低至Mw -1的南极重复冰震。

Long-term quasi-periodic repeaters globally form a scattered triangular distribution bounded below by a slope of ~1/3 (0.297±0.032, ~10 MPa stress drop), extending across tectonic events and Antarctic icequakes (slope 0.314±0.026).
全球准周期重复地震呈三角形分布，下界斜率约1/3（0.297±0.032，对应10 MPa应力降）。
Large uncertainties in spectrally measured and apparent stress drops prevent definitive conclusions on whether stress drop variations drive recurrence time scatter in California.
实测应力降与视应力降的不确定性较大，难以确定应力降变化对复发间隔离散的贡献。
Reframes repeater scaling from fitting a single empirical power-law exponent (1/6) to explaining a bounded triangular distribution with a physical 1/3 lower envelope from crack theory.
摒弃单一1/6幂律拟合，提出以经典裂纹模型1/3斜率为物理下界的三角形分布新框架。

kc: Reframed the repeating earthquake Tr-M0 scaling from a single empirical power-law fit to a physically bounded scattered triangular distribution.
Identified a robust 1/3-slope lower envelope across global tectonic repeaters and Antarctic icequakes, reconciling observations with classic circular crack models.
Demonstrated that the upper flat bound of the Tr-M0 cloud is an observational truncation artifact caused by finite seismic monitoring duration.
Proposed a physics-based d-M0 creep-meter formulation with slope 1/3, attributing discrepancies with geodetic creep to fine-scale local slip-rate heterogeneity.
将重复地震复发时间-地震矩（Tr-M0）关系从单一经验幂律拟合重新定义为受物理边界约束的三角形离散分布。
在全球构造重复地震和南极冰震中识别出稳健的1/3斜率下包络线，调和了观测数据与经典圆形裂纹模型之间的矛盾。
证明了Tr-M0数据云的平坦上界是由有限地震监测时长造成的观测截断伪影。
提出了斜率为1/3的物理蠕滑计（d-M0）公式，将重复地震与大地测量蠕滑率的差异归因于断层带精细尺度的局部滑移率非均匀性。
me: Bilinear local magnitude to seismic moment conversion accounting for corner frequency effects below M 3.
Strict filtering for temporal persistence and quasi-periodicity (95th percentile of CoV < 0.7 via Monte Carlo sampling).
Normalization of recurrence intervals using InSAR/GNSS geodetic fault creep models.
Quantile regression and magnitude-bin percentile fitting to quantify the lower envelope slope.
Source spectral ratio analysis using borehole stations and empirical Green's functions to estimate corner frequencies and stress drops.
采用双线性震级-地震矩转换关系，校正M 3以下小震拐角频率的影响。
严格筛选时间持续性与准周期性（通过蒙特卡洛采样要求变异系数CoV的95%分位数<0.7）。
利用InSAR/GNSS大地测量断层蠕滑模型对复发间隔进行归一化校正。
采用分位数回归与震级分箱百分位数拟合定量测定下包络线斜率。
利用井下台站和经验格林函数进行震源谱比分析，估算拐角频率与应力降。
de: Global compilation of over 4,800 repeater sequences (>27,000 events) from California, Taiwan, Japan, Chile, Tonga-Kermadec, Mexico, and South Sandwich Islands.
Controlled test dataset from the Northern California (WS21) repeater catalog along the central creeping section of the San Andreas Fault (1984–2014).
Geodetic fault creep rate models derived from dense GNSS and InSAR time series (2006–2010) along the San Andreas Fault.
Repeating icequake datasets from David Glacier and Rutford Ice Stream in Antarctica extending magnitude coverage down to Mw -1.
Borehole broadband waveforms from the Berkeley Parkfield High Resolution Seismic Network (BP) for spectral ratio stress drop validation.
汇编全球超4800个重复地震序列（>27000个事件），涵盖加州、台湾、日本、智利、汤加-克马德克、墨西哥和南桑威奇群岛。
以圣安德烈斯断层中部蠕滑段的北加州（WS21）重复地震目录（1984–2014年）作为控制测试集。
圣安德烈斯断层基于密集GNSS和InSAR时间序列（2006–2010年）反演的大地测量断层蠕滑率模型。
南极David冰川和Rutford冰流的重复冰震数据集，将震级范围向下扩展至Mw -1。
伯克利帕克菲尔德高分辨率地震台网（BP）的井下宽频带波形，用于谱比法应力降验证。
li: High uncertainties in both spectrally measured and apparent stress drops prevent definitive conclusions on how much stress-drop variation drives recurrence time scatter.
Finite catalog durations, restricted magnitude ranges, and sparse large-magnitude events limit precise statistical determination of the lower envelope slope within individual regions.
Secondary fault strands spaced meters apart cannot be resolved by current seismic or geodetic observations to directly assign local creep rates to each repeater.
谱比法测量的应力降和视应力降均存在较大不确定性，无法定量确定应力降变化对复发时间离散度的具体贡献。
有限的目录持续时间、受限的震级范围以及大震事件的稀疏性限制了在单个区域内精确统计测定下包络线斜率。
现有地震和大地测量观测的分辨率不足以分辨相距仅数米的次级断层分支，难以直接为每个重复地震分配局部蠕滑率。

tm.why: The study investigates repeating earthquakes along creeping faults and their relationship to background fault creep rates, slip partitioning, and asperity interactions.
The authors evaluate classic circular crack models, stress drops via spectral ratio analysis, and seismic moment–recurrence time scaling of asperity ruptures.
The analysis compiles and filters global repeating earthquake catalogs (>4,800 sequences) and assesses observational censoring from finite catalog duration.
