sum: This study investigates a rift-related lacustrine carbonate slope system within the Pre-salt Barra Velha Formation of the Santos Basin, Brazil. The authors integrate a 125 km² post-stack depth-migrated 3D seismic volume with multi-attribute blending (Dip, Dip Azimuth, Maximum Curvature, and Thinning) using Relative Geological Time (RGT) modeling, calibrated by 336 thin sections from seven wells. Results show that a NE-SW striking Major Fault with up to 2,000 m vertical throw established a 1,550 m paleo-bathymetric relief. Stratigraphically, the system evolved from a syn-rift bypass margin (Piçarras and Itapema formations) to a late post-rift accretionary margin (Barra Velha Formation) featuring an in situ shrubstone platform, arcuate marginal mounds, steep gullied slopes (25°–45°), head-alcoves, aprons, and point-sourced fans. The novelty lies in demonstrating how high-resolution 3D seismic geomorphology and petrography reveal striking architectural similarities between alkaline lacustrine rift slopes and classic marine carbonate platforms.
本研究利用125平方公里的叠后深度偏移3D地震数据、相对地质年代（RGT）建模及多属性融合（倾角、倾向、最大曲率），结合7口井的336个岩石薄片，重构了巴西桑托斯盆地盐下Barra Velha组湖相碳酸盐岩斜坡系统。结果表明，走向NE-SW、垂直断距达2000米的主断层控制了高达1550米的古水深地……

t: Five-stage workflow integrating Relative Geological Time (RGT) horizon modeling, Automatic Fault Extraction (AFE), stratigraphic thinning attributes, multi-attribute blending (Dip, Azimuth, Curvature), and 3D geobody extraction calibrated with thin-section petrography.
结合RGT层位建模、自动断层提取、减薄属性、多属性融合及薄片标定的3D地质体提取五步工作流。
A 125 km² post-stack depth-migrated 3D seismic volume (12.5 m bin spacing, 25–30 Hz dominant frequency) integrated with 43 regional wells and 336 thin sections from 7 key wells.
125 km²叠后深度偏移3D地震数据（12.5 m面元，主频25–30 Hz），结合43口井及7口井的336个薄片。

The NE-SW Major Fault has up to 2,000 m throw, creating a 1,550 m platform-to-basin relief with 25°–45° slopes, arcuate mounds, gullies, fans, and up to 75.6% reworked grain-supported facies at the margin.
NE-SW向主断层落差达2000米，形成1550米台盆高差、25°–45°陡坡、弧形丘、扇体及边缘75.6%的再搬运颗粒…

Seismic vertical resolution (~25 m) cannot resolve thin microbialite beds or individual gravity flows, and lateral facies heterogeneity makes inter-well interpolations across the seven wells predictive.
约25米的垂向地震分辨率无法识别单层微生物岩或重力流，且相变快使井间插值仅具预测性。

Provides the first high-resolution 3D geobody and petrographic reconstruction of an alkaline lacustrine rift slope in the Santos Basin, demonstrating strong morphological convergence with marine carbonate platforms.
首次在桑托斯盆地实现碱性湖相裂谷斜坡的高分辨率3D地质体与岩石学重构，揭示其与海相台地的形态趋同。

kc: Reconstructed the 3D structural and stratigraphic architecture of a Pre-salt lacustrine slope system in the Santos Basin using RGT modeling and multi-attribute seismic analysis.
Documented the tectonic-driven transition from an early syn-rift bypass margin to a late post-rift rimmed accretionary carbonate platform with 1,550 m relief and 25°–45° slope dips.

Calibrated 3D seismic geobodies (linear/arcuate mounds, head-alcoves, gullies, fans, and aprons) with 336 petrographic thin sections, linking high-energy reworked grainstones (up to 75.6%) to exposed platform margins.
利用相对地质年代（RGT）建模和多属性地震分析，重构了桑托斯盆地盐下湖相斜坡系统的三维构造和地层格架。
记录了受构造控制的从早期同裂谷旁路型边缘向晚期后裂谷镶边加积型碳酸盐岩台地的转变，古地形落差达1550米，斜坡倾角为25°–45°。
利用336个岩石薄片对3D地震地质体（线性和弧形丘、源头凹槽、沟谷、扇体和裙带）进行了标定，将高达75.6%的高能再搬运颗粒灰岩与暴露的台地边缘联系起来。
me: Semi-automated 3D seismic horizon tracking and Relative Geological Time (RGT) modeling in PaleoScan (30% correlation threshold).
Automatic Fault Extraction (AFE) using variance and thinning attributes to extract the structural fault skeleton.
Multi-attribute blending (Dip, Dip Azimuth, Maximum Curvature, and Thinning) for 3D geobody extraction and inflection line mapping.
Petrographic analysis of 336 core and sidewall-core thin sections impregnated with blue epoxy and stained with alizarin red-S.
在PaleoScan软件中采用30%相关阈值进行半自动三维地震层位追踪和相对地质年代（RGT）建模。
利用方差和减薄属性进行自动断层提取（AFE），以提取构造变形骨架。
结合倾角、倾向、最大曲率和减薄等多属性融合技术，进行三维地质体提取和拐点线绘图。
对336个注入蓝色环氧树脂并用茜素红-S染色的岩心和井壁取心薄片进行岩石学分析。
de: 125 km² (25 km x 5 km) post-stack depth-migrated (PSDM) 3D seismic volume in the Santos Basin with 12.5 m x 12.5 m bin spacing and 20–40 Hz bandwidth (~25 m vertical resolution).
Stratigraphic markers from 43 regional wells and 336 petrographic thin sections from 7 key wells across the Barra Velha Formation.
桑托斯盆地125平方公里（25 km x 5 km）叠后深度偏移（PSDM）三维地震数据体，面元间距12.5 m x 12.5 m，频带20–40 Hz（垂向分辨率约25米）。
来自43口区域井的地层标志层以及横跨Barra Velha组的7口关键井的336个岩石学薄片。
li: Vertical seismic resolution of ~25 m prevents resolving thin microbialite beds or individual gravity-flow deposits, requiring them to be grouped as seismic facies associations.
Accuracy of geometric attributes (Thinning and Dip) depends on the quality of the RGT model and reflector continuity in heavily faulted zones.
High lateral variability of lacustrine carbonate facies makes inter-well lithological interpolations across the 7 ground-truth wells predictive rather than deterministic.
约25米的地震垂向分辨率无法分辨薄层微生物岩或单个重力流沉积，只能将其表征为地震相组合。
减薄和倾角等几何属性的精度取决于RGT模型的质量以及复杂断裂带中反射层的连续性。
湖相碳酸盐岩相强烈的横向变异性使得7口标定井之间的井间岩性插值仅具预测性。

tm.why: The study reconstructs the 3D structural fault architecture and tectono-stratigraphic evolution of a continental rift basin (Santos Basin) during the breakup of Western Gondwana using 3D reflection seismic data.

ev.notes: Full 19-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, methods, structural/stratigraphic/geomorphological/lithological results, discussion, and all 9 figures.

sum: This study presents a unified analytical-numerical framework to evaluate the seismic response, damage behavior, and post-earthquake functionality of tunnels across four regions in Asia (Oman, South Korea, Himalayas, and Sichuan). By integrating analytical solutions with finite element simulations (MIDAS GTS NX), the authors capture soil-structure interaction effects under varying seismic conditions. Tunnel performance is assessed using deformation parameters, damage indices, fragility curves, and functionality indicators. The results reveal a transition from deformation-controlled behavior in low seismic regions to brittle and fault-driven responses in high seismic zones, with numerical models predicting higher deformation demands than analytical solutions. This framework supports performance-based tunnel design and resilient infrastructure development.
本研究提出了一种统一的解析-数值框架，用于评估阿曼、韩国、喜马拉雅和四川四个地区隧道的地震响应、损伤行为及震后功能性。方法结合了解析解与MIDAS GTS NX有限元模拟，以捕获不同地震条件下的土-结构相互作用。评估指标包括变形参数、损伤指数、易损性曲线和功能性指标。结果表明，隧道行为从低震区的变形……

t: Integration of analytical solutions with finite element simulations (MIDAS GTS NX) to model soil-structure interaction under seismic loading.
结合解析解与有限元模拟（MIDAS GTS NX），对地震荷载下的土-结构相互作用进行建模。
Synthetic deformation parameters, damage indices, and fragility curves simulated for tunnels in Oman, South Korea, Himalayas, and Sichuan.
针对阿曼、韩国、喜马拉雅和四川隧道模拟的合成变形参数、损伤指数和易损性曲线。
Numerical models predict higher deformation demands than analytical solutions, showing a transition from deformation-controlled to brittle/fault-driven responses in high seismic zones.
数值模型预测的变形需求高于解析解，且高震区表现出从变形控制向脆性/断层驱动响应的转变。
The framework's accuracy depends on the assumptions of the analytical solutions and the specific soil-structure interaction parameters used in the FEM software.
该框架的准确性取决于解析解的假设以及有限元软件中使用的特定土-结构相互作用参数。
A unified analytical-numerical framework that evaluates both physical damage and post-earthquake functional performance across diverse seismic regions.
提出一个统一的解析-数值框架，可同时评估不同地震区域隧道的物理损伤与震后功能性能。

kc: Developed a unified analytical-numerical framework for tunnel seismic performance assessment.
Evaluated and compared tunnel seismic vulnerability across four distinct Asian regions.
Demonstrated that numerical models predict higher deformation demands than analytical solutions.
开发了用于隧道地震性能评估的统一解析-数值框架。
评估并对比了亚洲四个不同区域的隧道地震易损性。
表明数值模型预测的变形需求高于解析解。
me: Finite element modeling (MIDAS GTS NX) for soil-structure interaction.
Analytical solutions for seismic deformation of tunnels.
Fragility curve and damage index calculation.
用于土-结构相互作用的有限元模拟（MIDAS GTS NX）。
隧道地震变形的解析解方法。
易损性曲线和损伤指数计算。
de: Numerical simulations of tunnels under varying seismic conditions in Oman, South Korea, Himalayas, and Sichuan.
Comparative analysis between analytical solutions and finite element results.
阿曼、韩国、喜马拉雅和四川不同地震条件下隧道的数值模拟。
解析解与有限元结果之间的对比分析。
li: The study relies heavily on simplified analytical assumptions and specific numerical software configurations.
Lack of real-world observational damage data to validate the simulated fragility curves.
该研究在很大程度上依赖于简化的解析假设和特定的数值软件配置。
缺乏实际观测到的破坏数据来验证模拟的易损性曲线。

tm.why: The paper presents a framework to evaluate the seismic response, damage behavior, and post-earthquake functionality of tunnels under varying seismic conditions.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the abstract and metadata.

sum: The Antarctic–South American subduction zone in southern Patagonia lacks documented large interplate earthquakes and has poorly known deep slab geometry. Analyzing 2 years of continuous 3-component broadband seismic data from the temporary 1P network via modified envelope correlation and feature-based clustering, the authors detect and locate 1,540 deep tectonic tremor events at 30–40 km depth. The tremors occur in three major episodic bursts separated by ~9 months, migrating laterally over ~50 km at velocities of 5–20 km/day. Furthermore, non-homogeneous Poisson modeling confirms significant exponential modulation by tidal shear stress (sensitivity α = 0.51 kPa⁻¹). These observations provide the first direct seismic evidence of active aseismic deformation along the Antarctic–South American plate interface, constraining its downdip extent and demonstrating that tectonic tremor can illuminate megathrust geometry and mechanics in remote margins lacking conventional interplate seismicity.
巴塔哥尼亚南部的南极-南美俯冲带缺乏大地震记录，深部板块界面几何形态未知。本研究利用1P临时宽频带地震台网两年的连续三分量波形数据，结合包络互相关与特征聚类方法，首次在该区域30–40 km深处识别并定位了1,540个深部构造颤动事件。颤动表现为三次主要爆发（重现期约9个月），沿走向迁移达50 km……

t: Tremor is detected and located in 2–8 Hz continuous waveforms using modified envelope correlation and maximum-likelihood optimization, separated from earthquakes via feature clustering, and modeled against tidal stress using a non-homogeneous Poisson process.
对2–8 Hz连续波形采用改进包络互相关与最大似然法检测定位颤动，经特征聚类分离地震，并用非齐次泊松过程拟合潮汐调制。

Two years of continuous 3-component broadband seismic waveforms from the temporary 1P network deployed in southern Patagonia (48°–52°S), supplemented by local seismicity catalogs and GCMT focal mechanisms.
巴塔哥尼亚南部（48°–52°S）1P临时宽频带台网2年的连续三分量波形数据，结合区域地震目录与GCMT震源机制。

Detected 1,540 tremors at 30–40 km depth occurring in three major bursts (~9-month recurrence) migrating at 5–20 km/day over ~50 km, with exponential tidal shear stress sensitivity α = 0.51 ± 0.06 kPa⁻¹.
在30–40 km深处检出1,540个颤动，呈三次主要爆发（间隔约9个月），迁移速度5–20 km/天，潮汐敏感度α=0…

Tidal stress calculations rely on an assumed fault geometry and simplified structure near a complex coastline, and tremor observations are restricted by sparse station coverage and a 2-year recording window.
潮汐应力计算依赖假设的断层几何，且观测受限于稀疏台站覆盖和仅两年的临时布设周期。

First discovery of tectonic tremor along the Antarctic–South American subduction zone, providing the first direct seismic evidence of active slow deformation and downdip interface geometry at this margin.
首次在南极-南美俯冲带发现构造颤动，提供了该板块界面活跃慢变形及下倾几何形态的首个直接地震学证据。

kc: Reported the first discovery of deep tectonic tremor (1,540 events at 30–40 km depth) along the Antarctic–South American subduction zone.
Identified three major episodic tremor bursts migrating at 5–20 km/day over ~50 km with an approximate recurrence interval of 9 months.
Demonstrated statistically significant exponential correlation between tremor occurrence rates and tidal shear stress (α = 0.51 ± 0.06 kPa⁻¹).
Provided the first direct observational constraints on the depth, existence, and downdip termination of the megathrust interface in southern Patagonia.
首次在南极-南美俯冲带发现并定位了深部构造颤动（30–40 km深处共1,540个事件）。
识别出三次主要的幕式颤动爆发，迁移速度为5–20 km/天，展布约50 km，重现期约9个月。
证实了颤动发生率与潮汐剪应力之间存在统计显著的指数相关性（α = 0.51 ± 0.06 kPa⁻¹）。
为巴塔哥尼亚南部大型逆冲断层界面的存在、深度和下倾边界提供了首个直接观测约束。
me: Modified envelope correlation and maximum-likelihood source location (Mizuno & Ide, 2019) applied to 2–8 Hz bandpass-filtered continuous waveforms.
Feature-based clustering analysis using minimum energy duration, depth, and high-to-low frequency amplitude ratios (AH/AL) to separate tremor from fast earthquakes.
Bootstrap resampling of station/component pairs to estimate location uncertainties (retaining events with ≤5 km uncertainty).
Non-homogeneous Poisson process modeling with maximum likelihood estimation to quantify exponential tidal stress sensitivity.
对2–8 Hz带通滤波的连续波形应用改进的包络互相关和最大似然震源定位方法（Mizuno & Ide, 2019）。
利用最小能量持续时间、深度和高低频振幅比（AH/AL）进行特征聚类，将构造颤动与普通快地震分离。
对台站/分量对进行自举重采样（bootstrap）以估计定位不确定性（仅保留误差≤5 km的事件）。
采用非齐次泊松过程模型和最大似然估计量化指数型潮汐应力敏感性参数。
de: Two years (2019–2020) of continuous 3-component broadband seismic records from the temporary 1P network deployed in southern Patagonia.
Tidal shear and normal stress time series evaluated at 40 km depth assuming a reverse fault mechanism (strike 350°, dip 20°, rake 90°).
Comparison with regional earthquake catalogs (Riedel-Hornig et al., 2026) and GCMT focal mechanisms.
巴塔哥尼亚南部部署的1P临时宽频带地震台网两年（2019–2020年）的连续三分量地震记录。
假设逆冲断层机制（走向350°、倾角20°、滑动角90°）在40 km深度处计算的潮汐剪应力和正应力时间序列。
与区域地震目录（Riedel-Hornig et al., 2026）及GCMT震源机制解进行对比。
li: Spatial distribution and detection completeness are limited by sparse station coverage and the 2-year duration of the temporary seismic experiment.
Resolved tidal stress magnitudes and the exact numerical value of α carry uncertainties due to assumed fault geometry, complex coastline, and unknown slab configuration.
颤动的空间分布和检测完备性受限于稀疏的台站覆盖以及临时地震观测仅两年的时间窗口。
由于假设的断层几何形态、复杂海岸线和未知板块形态，解析的潮汐应力幅值及敏感度α的具体数值存在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper reports the discovery of deep tectonic tremor, tremor migration, and tidal modulation indicating slow deformation processes along a subduction plate interface.
The authors build a catalog of 1,540 deep tectonic tremor events from continuous broadband data using modified envelope correlation, maximum-likelihood location, and feature-based clustering.
The detected deep tremor distribution at 30–40 km depth provides the first observational constraints on the geometry and downdip termination of the Antarctic–South American plate interface.

ev.notes: All metadata, methods, quantitative results (1,540 events, 30–40 km depth, 5–20 km/day migration, ~9-month recurrence, λ0 = 0.08 h⁻¹, α = 0.51 kPa⁻¹), figure descriptions, and verbatim quotes were extracted directly from the 9-page GRL PDF.

sum: The critical slip distance Dc spans from micrometers in laboratory experiments to meters in natural earthquakes, a discrepancy unexplained by standard scale-free friction frameworks. This study presents a first-principles derivation showing that Dc is a structural property governed by self-affine fault roughness in the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class (Hurst exponent ζ = 2/3). The unified expression Dc = max(δfrac, (C/2μ)leff^ζ) bridges scales from the microscopic cohesive fracture process zone δfrac to macroscopic geometric asperity unlocking, saturating at the pulse width controlled by seismogenic depth. Validated against compilation data and the 2025 Mw 7.8 Myanmar earthquake (predicting Dc ≈ 3.5 m vs. ~3 m observed), the theory further demonstrates that rate-and-state friction laws emerge as the mean-field limit of fractal contact dynamics. Finally, the authors introduce 'fault retentivity'—the multiscale probabilistic capacity of roughness barriers to arrest ruptures—redefining how fault stability and seismic potential are assessed.
针对实验室微米级与天然地震米级临界滑移距离（Dc）的巨大尺度差异，本文基于Kardar-Parisi-Zhang普适类自仿射断层粗糙度（Hurst指数ζ=2/3）提出了第一性原理推导。研究表明Dc并非材料常数，而是由微观内聚断裂过程区与宏观几何凹凸体解锁共同决定的断层结构属性，并在大震脉冲宽度处饱和……

t: Derives a unified critical slip distance formula combining microscopic cohesive fracture and macroscopic dilatant unlocking of KPZ self-affine asperities (ζ = 2/3), and uses McKendrick-von Foerster contact age statistics to derive rate-and-state friction.
结合微观内聚断裂与宏观KPZ自仿射凹凸体扩容解锁推导统一Dc公式，并由接触年龄分布导出速率-状态摩擦。

Validates the scaling relation against compiled laboratory and seismological Dc estimates across eight decades of source size, plus the 2025 Mw 7.7-7.8 Myanmar earthquake (~450 km rupture on the Sagaing Fault).
利用跨越8个数量级震源尺度的实验室与地震学Dc汇编数据，以及2025年缅甸Mw 7.8地震数据进行验证。
The self-affine saturation model fits compiled Dc vs. L data with R^2 = 0.92 (RMSE = 0.64) and predicts Dc = 3.5 m for the 2025 Myanmar earthquake, matching the observed ~3 m.
饱和自仿射模型拟合跨尺度数据的R^2达0.92，预测2025年缅甸地震Dc为3.5米，与观测值约3米吻合。

Relies on 1D Gaussian roughness profiles, quasi-static failure cascades without dynamic barrier jumping or fault lubrication, a single traveling slip pulse for large events, and static roughness over the seismic cycle.
假设一维高斯粗糙剖面、准静态级联破坏、单一滑移脉冲及静态粗糙度，忽略了二维各向异性与动态润滑。

First-principles derivation showing Dc and rate-and-state friction parameters are scale-dependent emergent structural properties of KPZ fault roughness rather than material constants, plus the new concept of fault retentivity.
首次从第一性原理证明Dc和速率-状态摩擦源于KPZ断层粗糙度的涌现结构属性，并提出断层滞留度概念。

kc: Derives a unified, parameter-free scaling law for critical slip distance Dc across laboratory to tectonic scales based on KPZ self-affine fault roughness (ζ = 2/3).
Demonstrates that rate-and-state friction and the Dieterich aging law emerge as the mean-field statistical limit of fractal asperity contact dynamics.
Validates the theoretical prediction against multi-scale compilation data and the 2025 Mw 7.8 Myanmar earthquake (predicting Dc ≈ 3.5 m vs. ~3 m observed).
Introduces 'fault retentivity' R(L), an extreme-value statistical measure of a fault's multiscale structural capacity to arrest propagating ruptures.
基于KPZ自仿射断层粗糙度（ζ = 2/3），推导了统一实验室到构造尺度的临界滑移距离Dc无参数标度律。
证明了速率-状态摩擦定律和Dieterich老化定律是分形凹凸体接触动力学的平均场统计极限。
利用跨尺度汇编数据及2025年缅甸Mw 7.8地震（预测Dc ≈ 3.5 m，观测约3 m）验证了理论预测。
提出了“断层滞留度”R(L)新概念，利用极值统计量化断层多尺度结构屏障阻断破裂扩展的能力。
me: Self-affine surface formalism and Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) stochastic interface growth theory fixing the slip-parallel Hurst exponent at ζ = 2/3.
Mechanical scaling analysis combining mode II cohesive brittle fracture, fractal contact friction, and dilatant geometric unlocking of sawtooth asperities.
Extreme value statistics (Gumbel/Weibull survival process in scale space) to model hierarchical asperity cascades and rupture arrest probability.
Mean-field ensemble averaging over contact age distributions governed by the McKendrick–von Foerster equation to derive macroscopic rate-and-state parameters.
应用自仿射表面形式体系与Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ)随机界面生长理论，确定滑移平行方向Hurst指数ζ = 2/3。
结合II型内聚脆性断裂、分形接触摩擦与锯齿状凹凸体扩容几何解锁的力学标度分析。
利用尺度空间中的极值统计（Gumbel/Weibull生存过程）建立层级凹凸体级联与破裂阻断概率模型。
基于McKendrick–von Foerster方程控制的接触年龄分布进行平均场系综平均，推导宏观速率-状态摩擦参数。
de: Published compilation of laboratory friction experiments and seismological/geodetic source inversions spanning source dimensions from 10^-2 m to 10^6 m.
Case study of the 28 March 2025 Mw 7.7–7.8 central Myanmar earthquake on the Sagaing Fault with direct surface visual inversion of Dc ≈ 3 m.
涵盖震源尺度从10^-2米到10^6米的已发表实验室摩擦实验与地震学/大地测量震源反演汇编数据。
2025年3月28日实皆断层缅甸中部Mw 7.7–7.8地震案例研究（其地表直接视觉反演得到Dc ≈ 3 m）。
li: Treats the fault as a 1D profile with Gaussian height statistics rather than a 2D surface with anisotropic, potentially non-Gaussian roughness.
Assumes quasi-static failure across scales in the cascade model, neglecting dynamic rupture effects, barrier jumping, and coseismic fault lubrication.
Assumes large earthquakes propagate as a single steady traveling slip pulse and that fault roughness remains static over the seismic cycle.
将断层简化为具有高斯高度统计的一维剖面，而非具有各向异性和潜在非高斯粗糙度的二维表面。
级联模型假设跨尺度准静态破坏，忽略了动态破裂效应、跨屏障跳跃以及同震断层润滑作用。
假设大地震以单一稳定传播的滑移脉冲形式扩展，且断层粗糙度在地震周期内保持静态不变。

tm.why: The paper derives a first-principles physical model for the critical slip distance Dc, which controls earthquake rupture nucleation, propagation, and arrest.
It reinterprets rate-and-state fault friction as an emergent statistical property of self-affine fault roughness and introduces fault retentivity to characterize multiscale fault stability.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF (including main text and Supplementary Appendices A, B, and C) was read and analyzed.

sum: Deep learning seismic phase pickers typically process raw or minimally filtered waveforms. While effective at local distances (<100 km), this approach degrades severely at regional distances (1°–20°) due to attenuation, scattering, and dispersion. This study introduces two architectures to incorporate multiband-filtered waveforms into P-arrival picking: a stacking approach that concatenates filtered traces along the channel dimension, and a branching approach that processes each frequency band through dedicated residual blocks before feature fusion. Evaluated on local Northern California data and regional CREW and IMS datasets across three filter banks, baseline raw/1-Hz models fail regionally (~10–12% accuracy), whereas stacking and branching models using a seven-band one-octave filter bank (0.25–32 Hz) exceed 80% accuracy. Grad-CAM analysis reveals that band importance varies across samples with a slight preference for 0.25–0.5 Hz, proving that explicit spectral feature engineering and filter-bank optimization remain critical for regional deep learning pickers.
深度学习震相拾取模型通常直接使用原始或简单滤波波形，在地方震表现优异，但在区域距离（1°–20°）性能大幅下降。本文提出“堆叠”和“分支”两种策略将多频带滤波波形融入P波到时拾取网络。基于北加州地方震数据以及CREW和IMS区域地震数据集的测试表明，使用0.25–32 Hz七频带倍频程滤波器组时，两……

t: A 7-block residual CNN predicts a probability mass function of P-arrival time inside a 3-s window, incorporating multiband-filtered waveforms via either input channel concatenation (stacking) or separate 4-block convolutional branches fused before 3 shared blocks (branching).
基于7残差块CNN预测3秒窗内P波到时概率分布，通过通道堆叠或多分支网络融合多频带滤波波形。

Evaluated on 100-Hz 3-component BH/HH P-waveforms: local NCEDC data (175,595 train; 27,438 validation, geographically split) and regional 1°–20° data (1,243,566 CREW training traces; 28,548 independent 2024 IMS validation traces).
使用100 Hz三分量P波数据：地方震NCEDC数据集与区域1°–20°数据集（CREW训练，IMS验证）。

All models achieve ~98% accuracy locally (offset <0.25 s, IQR <0.5 s). Regionally, raw and 1-Hz baselines drop to 10.33% and 12.35%, whereas stacking, branching, and fair-branching with Filter Bank 1 achieve 80.86%, 89.10%, and 86.29%.
地方震各模型准确率均约98%；区域距离基线仅10%–12%，采用滤波器组1的堆叠和分支模型达80.86%–89.10%。
Restricted to offline zero-phase filtering and first-arriving P-phase refinement within pre-windowed 3-s clips, separating arrival-time picking from continuous phase detection.
仅针对预设3秒窗内初至P波做离线零相位滤波拾取，未耦合连续波形检测。

Demonstrates that explicit multiband filtering is critical for regional-distance deep learning phase pickers and introduces channel-stacking and multi-branch architectures with Grad-CAM band attribution.
揭示多频带滤波对区域深度学习震相拾取的关键作用，提出堆叠与多分支架构并量化频带贡献。

kc: Demonstrated that standard deep learning phase pickers trained on raw or 1 Hz high-pass filtered waveforms suffer severe performance degradation at regional distances (1°–20°).
Proposed two neural network architectures—channel stacking and multi-branch feature fusion—to explicitly ingest multiband-filtered waveforms.
Showed that filter-bank design strongly controls regional picking performance, with a 7-band one-octave filter bank (0.25–32 Hz) boosting accuracy from ~10% to >80%.
Applied Grad-CAM to show that frequency band importance varies by sample and training realization, with a slight overall preference for 0.25–0.5 Hz.
证实了基于原始或1 Hz高通滤波波形训练的常规深度学习震相拾取模型在区域距离（1°–20°）性能严重退化。
提出了通道堆叠（stacking）与多分支特征融合（branching）两种神经网络架构，显式引入多频带滤波波形。
揭示了滤波器组设计对区域震相拾取性能的决定性影响，0.25–32 Hz七频带倍频程滤波器组可将准确率从约10%提升至80%以上。
利用Grad-CAM分析证明不同波形样本和训练实例对频带的依赖度不同，整体上0.25–0.5 Hz频带权重略高。
me: Fully convolutional neural network with seven residual blocks and antialiasing layers formulated as a multiclass arrival-time classification (PMF output over a 3-s window).
Stacking architecture concatenating 3-component waveforms across K filter bands into a (B, 3×K, L) input tensor with minimal parameter overhead.
Branching architecture assigning dedicated 4-block residual branches per frequency band before convolutional fusion and 3 shared residual blocks, plus a parameter-matched 'branching (fair)' variant.
Zero-phase 4th-order Butterworth filtering across three distinct filter banks, paired with Grad-CAM attribution on branch activations.
构建包含7个残差块和抗混叠层的全卷积神经网络，将3秒窗内的到时拾取构建为输出概率质量函数（PMF）的多分类问题。
堆叠架构：将K个频带的三分量滤波波形沿通道维度拼接为(B, 3×K, L)张量，仅轻微增加参数量。
分支架构：为每个频带分配含4个残差块的独立分支，经卷积融合层后再通过3个共享残差块，并设计了参数量对齐的公平分支模型。
使用零相位四阶巴特沃斯滤波器测试三种滤波器组配置，并结合Grad-CAM评估各频带分支的特征重要性。
de: Local dataset: Northern California Earthquake Data Center (NCEDC, 2000–2023) BH/HH traces at 100 Hz, split geographically at 36.8°N/36.6°N (175,595 train; 27,438 validation).
Regional dataset: Curated Regional Earthquake Waveforms (CREW, 1°–20°) with 1,243,566 training traces, validated on 28,548 independent International Monitoring System (IMS) waveforms from 2024.
External baseline comparison against pretrained SKYNET model on the 2024 IMS validation dataset.
地方震数据集：北加州地震数据中心（NCEDC，2000–2023年）100 Hz采样的BH/HH通道波形，按纬度36.8°N/36.6°N做空间划分（训练集175,595条，验证集27,438条）。
区域地震数据集：使用CREW数据集（1°–20°）的1,243,566条波形进行训练，使用2024年国际监测系统（IMS）的28,548条独立波形进行验证。
外部基线对比：在2024年IMS验证集上评估了预训练SKYNET模型的拾取表现。
li: Experiments are restricted exclusively to first-arriving P phases within pre-windowed 3-s segments, isolating arrival-time refinement from phase detection.
Uses zero-phase (forward-reverse) Butterworth filtering, which is designed for offline processing rather than causal real-time earthquake early warning.
No hyperparameter tuning was performed for the neural network architectures.
实验仅限于3秒预设时间窗内的初至P波拾取，将到时精细拾取与震相检测任务进行了剥离。
采用零相位（正反向）巴特沃斯滤波，适用于离线处理，未针对实时地震预警的因果滤波进行测试。
未对神经网络架构进行超参数调优。

tm.why: The paper develops and evaluates convolutional neural network architectures incorporating multiband waveform filtering for seismic phase picking.
The core objective is improving automated P-wave arrival-time picking across local and regional epicentral distances (0°–20°).

ev.notes: Full 10-page accepted manuscript / published article PDF from The Seismic Record (Vol. 6, Issue 3, pp. 320-328) was analyzed in detail, including all methods, dataset numbers, equations/tensors, and 4 figures + 1 table.

sum: This study applies multiple-frequency seismic tomography to image the lithospheric structure of the São Francisco Paleocontinental block (SFPB) and adjacent regions in Brazil at depths of 68–587 km. Using 97,150 P and PKIKP traveltime delays from broadband stations, the authors resolve a high-velocity anomaly extending from the Paranapanema block through the São Francisco craton to the Borborema province. Key findings include two major segmentations in this anomaly (at the southern Brasília belt and the Paramirim aulacogen) and a SE-dipping high-velocity anomaly beneath the Araçuaí belt. The study successfully delineates the subcrustal boundaries of the SFPB, demonstrating that while surface expressions of these paleocontinents are reworked, their lithospheric roots remain relatively intact.
本研究利用97,150条P和PKIKP波走时延迟，通过多频地震断层成像重建了巴西圣弗朗西斯科古陆块（SFPB）68-587km深度的岩石圈结构。结果显示一条NE-SW向高速异常带，并在巴西利亚带和帕拉米林拗拉槽处存在分割；同时发现阿拉苏阿伊带下方存在向SE倾斜的高速异常。该研究圈定了SFPB的深部界……

t: Multiple-frequency seismic tomography using P and PKIKP traveltime delays to image upper mantle velocity structures.
利用P波和PKIKP波走时延迟的多频地震断层成像方法，重建上地幔速度结构。
97,150 traveltime delays compiled from newly processed broadband data (2023-2024) and a previous regional database.
结合2023-2024年新处理数据与已有数据库，共包含97,150个走时延迟数据。
Imaged a NE-SW high-velocity anomaly beneath the SFPB with segmentations at the Brasília belt and Paramirim aulacogen, and a SE-dipping anomaly beneath the Araçuaí belt.
成像出SFPB下方NE-SW向高速异常及阿拉苏阿伊带下方SE倾斜的高速异常。
Poor vertical resolution and recovery of sharp transitions at depths of 316–384 km, and uneven horizontal resolution.
在316-384公里深度处的垂直分辨率和急剧过渡恢复较差，且水平分辨率分布不均。
First high-resolution multi-frequency tomographic imaging of the SFPB's deep lithospheric boundaries and the subcrustal structure of the Araçuaí belt.
首次利用高分辨率多频断层成像揭示了SFPB的深部岩石圈边界及邻区深部结构。

kc: Delineated the subcrustal lithospheric boundaries of the São Francisco Paleocontinental block (SFPB) between 68 and 587 km depth.
Identified a continuous NE-SW trending high-velocity lithospheric anomaly with major segmentations at the southern Brasília belt and the Paramirim aulacogen.
Imaged a SE-dipping high-velocity anomaly beneath the Araçuaí belt, shedding light on its deep tectonic evolution.
圈定了圣弗朗西斯科古陆块（SFPB）在68至587公里深度范围内的深部岩石圈边界。
识别出一条呈东北-西南走向的连续岩石圈高速异常带，并在巴西利亚带南部和帕拉米林拗拉槽处发现主要分割。
成像了阿拉苏阿伊带下方呈东南向倾斜的高速异常，为理解其深部构造演化提供了新证据。
me: Multiple-frequency seismic tomography using P and PKIKP traveltime residuals.
Checkerboard resolution tests (390x390 km and 312x312 km patterns) to assess model reliability at different depths.
利用P波和PKIKP波走时残差的多频地震断层成像方法。
采用棋盘分辨率测试（390x390公里和312x312公里网格）评估不同深度下的模型可靠性。
de: Broadband seismograms recorded between August 11, 2023, and July 31, 2024.
9,254 newly processed traveltime residuals combined with a previous regional database, totaling 97,150 traveltime delays.
2023年8月11日至2024年7月31日期间记录的宽频带地震图。
新增处理了9,254个走时残差，并与已有区域数据库合并，共获得97,150个走时延迟数据。
li: Sharp vertical transitions between checkerboard layers are not fully recovered at deeper levels (316 to 384 km).
Resolution is unevenly distributed, with the best recovery concentrated in the southern/eastern São Francisco craton and Borborema province.
在较深部（316至384公里）无法完全恢复棋盘格层之间的急剧垂直过渡。
分辨率分布不均，最佳恢复区域集中在圣弗朗西斯科克拉通南部/东部及博博雷马省。

tm.why: The paper uses multiple-frequency seismic tomography of P and PKIKP phases to image the lithospheric structure.
The primary objective is to delimit the lithospheric boundaries of the São Francisco Paleocontinental block at mantle depths.

ev.notes: No PDF available; analyzed based on the detailed abstract and GJI metadata.

sum: This metadata paper describes the temporary seismic network deployment (network code ZB, 2007-2009) in Sumatra, Indonesia. The deployment consisted of two phases: the first focused on recording aftershocks of the 2007 Mw 8.4 Bengkulu earthquakes using stations on the southern Mentawai islands, Enggano, and the mainland; the second phase aimed to characterize interseismic seismicity and seismic velocity structure in the unruptured Padang segment using stations on Siberut, Batu, Nias, and Sumatra mainland. The network comprised various broadband and short-period land instruments, complemented by 10 ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) deployed during the Sonne SO198 cruise. This dataset provides critical high-resolution seismic waveforms for studying subduction zone segmentation, earthquake rupture processes, and postseismic stress diffusion.
本文介绍了2007至2009年间在印尼苏门答腊部署的临时地震台网（台网代码ZB）。该台网部署分为两阶段：第一阶段在南部门塔外群岛、恩加诺岛及陆地部署台站，以记录2007年Mw 8.4明古鲁地震的余震；第二阶段在西伯鲁特、巴图、尼亚斯及陆地部署台站，以表征未破裂巴东段的震间地震活动性和速度结构。台网结……

t: Temporary seismic network deployment combining land broadband/short-period stations and ocean-bottom seismometers.
结合陆地宽频带/短周期台站与海底地震仪的临时地震台网部署。
Seismic waveform data from land stations and 10 ocean-bottom seismometers in Sumatra (2007-2009).
2007-2009年苏门答腊陆地台站和10台海底地震仪的地震波形数据。
Successful acquisition of aftershock and interseismic waveforms to study the Bengkulu rupture and Padang segment.
成功获取余震和震间波形，用于研究明古鲁破裂和巴东段。
Limited spatial and temporal coverage due to the temporary nature of the 2-year deployment.
由于两年临时部署的性质，空间和时间覆盖范围有限。
First comprehensive joint land-sea temporary seismic deployment capturing the 2007 Bengkulu aftershock sequence and Padang segment.
首次捕获2007年明古鲁余震序列和巴东段的陆海联合临时地震部署。

kc: Provides a comprehensive seismic dataset (ZB, 2007-2009) covering the Sumatra subduction zone.
Captured high-quality aftershocks of the 2007 Mw 8.4 Bengkulu earthquake.
Acquired passive seismic data to image the unruptured Padang segment.
提供了覆盖苏门答腊俯冲带的完整地震数据集（ZB台网，2007-2009年）。
捕获了2007年Mw 8.4明古鲁地震的高质量余震数据。
获取了用于成像未破裂巴东段的被动源地震数据。
me: Temporary seismic network deployment on land and ocean bottom.
Integration of broadband (Trillium 120P, CMG-3T) and short-period (CMG-6T) instruments.
陆地与海底临时地震台网联合部署。
整合宽频带（Trillium 120P、CMG-3T）与短周期（CMG-6T）地震仪。
de: Seismic waveform data from land stations in Sumatra, Mentawai islands, Enggano, Siberut, Batu, and Nias.
Ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data from 10 instruments deployed during Sonne cruise SO198 and recovered during SO200.
来自苏门答腊陆地、门塔外群岛、恩加诺岛、西伯鲁特岛、巴图群岛和尼亚斯岛的地震波形数据。
在Sonne航次SO198中部署并于SO200中回收的10台海底地震仪（OBS）数据。
li: The deployment was temporary (2007-2009), limiting long-term monitoring.
Mix of different instrument types with varying sensitivity ranges.
台网为临时部署（2007-2009年），限制了长期连续监测能力。
混合使用了具有不同灵敏度范围的多种仪器类型。

tm.why: The paper describes a temporary seismic network deployment involving both land stations and ocean-bottom seismometers.
The network was specifically deployed to record aftershocks of the 2007 Bengkulu earthquake and characterize interseismic seismicity.

ev.notes: Analyzed the dataset metadata and abstract from OpenAlex.

sum: This study proposes a hybrid friction law that incorporates a slip-rate strengthening mechanism below a characteristic slip rate (Vc) into the standard slip-weakening law, specifically designed for the shallow fault layer above the seismogenic zone. Using 3D dynamic rupture simulations, the authors demonstrate that this formulation suppresses shallow slip rates and reduces peak ground velocity within 1 km of the surface fault, without altering the overall rupture propagation or seismic moment. Sensitivity analyses show that the rate-strengthening parameter delta controls the peak slip rate, while Vc governs rupture duration. This simple, computationally efficient friction law successfully reproduces the gradual onset and prolonged duration of shallow slip observed in earthquakes like the 2016 Kumamoto event, making it highly valuable for near-fault ground-motion prediction.
本研究提出一种结合滑移弱化与速率强化的新型断层摩擦律，用于模拟地震发生带上方的浅部介质。三维动力学破裂模拟表明，该摩擦律在不改变整体破裂和地震矩的前提下，能有效抑制浅部滑移率并降低近断层峰值地动速度。该模型成功再现了浅部滑移的缓慢启动与长上升时间，为近断层强地面运动预测提供了高效工具。

t: A hybrid friction law combining standard slip-weakening with a slip-rate strengthening branch operating below a characteristic slip rate Vc on the shallow fault portion.
一种在浅部断层上将标准滑移弱化与特征滑移率 Vc 以下的滑移速率强化相结合的混合摩擦律。
Synthetic 3D elastic dynamic rupture simulations of a fault with a shallow layer characterized by a 0 MPa stress drop.
浅部应力降为0 MPa的断层三维弹性动力学破裂数值模拟合成数据。
The rate-strengthening model suppresses shallow slip rates and reduces peak ground velocity within 1 km of the fault, reproducing gradual slip onset and long rise times.
速率强化模型抑制了浅部滑移率并降低了断层1公里内的峰值地动速度，再现了滑移缓慢启动和长上升时间。
The friction law is tested within a simplified 3D elastic medium, neglecting potential off-fault inelastic deformation in the shallow crust.
该摩擦律在简化的三维弹性介质中测试，忽略了浅部地壳潜在的断层外非弹性变形。
Introduces a simple, computationally efficient rate-strengthening branch below Vc to physically represent shallow slip suppression without requiring artificially long Dc or negative stress drops.
引入了在 Vc 以下起作用的简单且计算高效的速率强化分支，无需人工设置超长 Dc 或负应力降即可物理刻画浅部滑移抑制。

kc: Proposed a novel, computationally efficient friction law combining slip-weakening and rate-strengthening for shallow fault layers.
Demonstrated through 3D dynamic rupture simulations that the law suppresses shallow slip rates and reduces near-fault peak ground velocities.
Identified the distinct roles of the rate-strengthening parameter delta (controlling peak slip rate) and characteristic velocity Vc (controlling rupture duration).
提出了一种新型、计算高效的结合滑移弱化与速率强化的摩擦律，适用于浅部断层。
通过三维动力学破裂模拟，证明该摩擦律能有效抑制浅部滑移率并降低近断层峰值地动速度。
明确了速率强化参数 delta（控制峰值滑移率）与特征速度 Vc（控制破裂持续时间）的不同物理作用。
me: Formulation of a hybrid slip-weakening and rate-strengthening friction law.
3D elastic dynamic rupture modeling with a shallow stress drop of 0 MPa.
Sensitivity analysis of friction parameters (delta and Vc).
构建结合滑移弱化与速率强化的混合摩擦律公式。
开展浅部应力降为0 MPa的三维弹性动力学破裂数值模拟。
对摩擦律参数（delta 和 Vc）进行敏感性分析。
de: Synthetic 3D dynamic rupture simulations modeling a fault with a shallow rate-strengthening layer.
Comparison of ground motion and slip-rate profiles against purely slip-weakening models.
模拟具有浅部速率强化层断层的三维动力学破裂合成数据集。
将地动和滑移率剖面与纯滑移弱化模型进行对比。
li: The model assumes a simplified 3D elastic medium and a flat fault geometry.
Real-world shallow layers may involve complex inelastic deformation (plasticity) not fully captured by the elastic assumption.
模型假设了简化的三维弹性介质和几何平直的断层。
真实的浅部地层可能包含复杂的非弹性变形（如塑性），这在弹性假设中未被完全刻画。

tm.why: The paper proposes a new friction law and performs 3D dynamic rupture simulations to model shallow fault slip.
The study focuses on the friction law governing the shallow fault portion above the seismogenic zone.
The proposed friction law aims to improve near-fault ground-motion prediction by modeling shallow slip-rate suppression.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from BSSA and Semantic Scholar, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: This study presents a data-driven machine learning framework using the random forest (RF) algorithm to predict 3D in situ stress. By combining high-accuracy but sparse well-log stress labels (calculated via a combined spring model) with spatially continuous pre-stack seismic attributes (Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and curvature), the RF model overcomes the limitations of conventional methods. Optimized through grid search and cross-validation, the method was applied to a field dataset from the Daji coal mining area in Shanxi Province, China. The model successfully generated a continuous 3D in situ stress volume that aligns with regional tectonic features, demonstrating its ability to capture complex non-linear relationships and characterize inter-well stress heterogeneity.
本文提出一种基于随机森林算法的数据驱动地应力预测方法。该方法结合高精度测井应力标签与空间连续的地震反演属性（杨氏模量、泊松比及曲率），利用交叉验证优化模型。应用于山西大吉地区实际数据，成功构建了连续三维地应力体。结果与区域构造特征高度一致，有效表征了井间地应力异质性，为储层地应力预测提供了新方案。

t: Random forest regression model optimized via grid search and cross-validation, using geomechanical and geometric seismic attributes as inputs and well-log-derived stress as training labels.
基于网格搜索和交叉验证优化的随机森林回归模型。
Field dataset from the Daji area in Shanxi Province, North China, including pre-stack seismic inversion attributes and well-log data.
山西大吉地区叠前地震反演属性与测井地应力数据。
Successful generation of a continuous 3D in situ stress volume showing strong spatial consistency with regional tectonic features and high predictive accuracy.
成功构建了与区域构造特征高度一致的连续三维地应力体。
The model's accuracy depends heavily on the quality of pre-stack seismic inversion attributes and the availability of representative well-log calibration data.
预测精度受限于叠前反演质量及测井数据的空间分布。
Integrating machine learning (random forest) with pre-stack geomechanical and geometric attributes to bridge the gap between sparse high-accuracy well logs and continuous seismic data.
融合机器学习与叠前地震属性，填补了稀疏测井与连续地震间的空白。

kc: Developed a machine learning framework based on Random Forest to predict 3D in situ stress.
Successfully integrated high-resolution well-log data with spatially continuous seismic attributes.
Validated the approach on a field dataset from the Daji coal-bearing area in Shanxi, China.
开发了基于随机森林的机器学习框架用于预测三维地应力。
成功将高分辨率测井数据与空间连续的地震属性相结合。
在中国山西大吉含煤区野外数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
me: Random Forest (RF) regression algorithm.
Grid search and cross-validation for hyperparameter optimization.
Combined spring model for calculating reference stress from well logs.
Pre-stack seismic inversion to derive Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and curvature.
随机森林（RF）回归算法。
用于超参数优化的网格搜索和交叉验证。
用于从测井数据计算参考应力的组合弹簧模型。
用于获取杨氏模量、泊松比和曲率的叠前地震反演。
de: Field seismic and well-log dataset from the Daji area, Shanxi Province, North China.
Input features: Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and curvature.
Training labels: High-resolution stress values from well logs.
来自华北山西省大吉地区的野外地震和测井数据集。
输入特征：杨氏模量、泊松比和曲率。
训练标签：来自测井的高分辨率地应力值。

Requires sufficient well-log data for training and validation to avoid overfitting.

性能高度依赖于叠前地震反演的质量。
需要足够的测井数据进行训练和验证以避免过拟合。

sum: This study investigates tectonic and climatic controls on erosion and topography in the Three Rivers Region (Salween, Mekong, Yangtze) of the southeastern Tibetan Plateau. The authors analyze 72 new detrital 10Be basin-averaged erosion rates from tributary catchments alongside standard and precipitation-modified channel steepness metrics (ksn and ksnQ) and horizontal GPS velocities. Erosion rates and channel steepness show consistent spatial patterns only after accounting for monsoonal precipitation gradients. Most tributary rates are low (0.1–0.3 mm/yr), except for a localized high (>0.4 mm/yr) in the Meili Mountains driven by a restraining stepover between the Parlung and Zhongdian strike-slip faults. Regionally, erosion rates and ksnQ exhibit a north-south low-high-low arch and a west-to-east decrease. Kinematic modeling links the north-south pattern to southward crustal motion over a Moho ramp, while the west-east decline reflects crustal shortening and uplift from shallow underthrusting and indentation of the Indian Plate.
本研究探讨了藏东南三江地区（怒江、澜沧江、金沙江）构造与气候对侵蚀和地形的控制。作者分析了72个新的支流流域碎屑10Be平均侵蚀率，结合标准与降水修正河道陡度指标（ksn和ksnQ）及GPS水平速度场。结果表明，仅在考虑季风降水梯度后，侵蚀率与河道陡度才呈现一致的空间格局。除梅里雪山因帕隆与中甸走滑……

t: Combines tributary-basin cosmogenic 10Be erosion rates with precipitation-modified channel steepness (ksnQ) and GPS kinematic models (horizontal-flux, Moho-gradient, and surface dilatation) to isolate local and regional tectonic uplift controls.
结合支流10Be侵蚀率、降水修正河道陡度（ksnQ）和GPS运动学模型，分离局部与区域构造隆升控制。

72 modern river sand samples from tributary basins (mostly 20–100 km2) across the Salween, Mekong, Yangtze, and Yuqu rivers, paired with Copernicus 90 m DEM, CHELSA precipitation, GPS velocities, and Moho depths.
怒江、澜沧江、金沙江和玉曲72个支流河沙样品，配合90m DEM、降水、GPS速度与莫霍面数据。

Erosion rates peak >0.4 mm/yr around the Meili Mountains (28–29°N) and decline north and south; excluding Meili, mean tributary rates decrease eastward from 0.27 (Salween) to 0.17 (Mekong) and 0.13 mm/yr (Yangtze).
梅里雪山侵蚀率峰值>0.4 mm/yr；剔除该区后，怒江、澜沧江、金沙江平均侵蚀率自西向东为0.27、0.17、0.13…
Published Moho geometry and present-day GPS velocities overpredict uplift at ~27°N (~0.7 mm/yr vs. 0.1–0.3 mm/yr observed) and simplify complex 3D crustal deformation and temporal velocity changes.
莫霍面梯度模型在27°N附近高估了隆升率，且简化了复杂的三维地壳变形与长期速度变化。

Resolves fine-scale north-south and west-east erosion patterns using tributary rather than trunk basins, reconciling channel steepness with 10Be rates via precipitation corrections and linking them to 3D tectonic kinematics.
利用支流而非干流高分辨率解析侵蚀格局，通过降水校正统一陡度与侵蚀率并关联三维构造运动学。

kc: Provides a high-resolution dataset of 72 new tributary-basin 10Be erosion rates across the Salween, Mekong, and Yangtze rivers.
Demonstrates that channel steepness matches 10Be erosion patterns only when corrected for spatial precipitation gradients (ksnQ).
Identifies a localized erosion hotspot (>0.4 mm/yr) in the Meili Mountains linked to a compressive fault stepover between the Parlung and Zhongdian faults.
Links regional north-south and west-east erosion gradients to crustal motion over a Moho ramp and shallow underthrusting/indentation of the Indian Plate using GPS kinematics.
提供了横跨怒江、澜沧江和金沙江的72个新支流流域10Be侵蚀率高分辨率数据集。
证明了只有在校正空间降水梯度（ksnQ）后，河道陡度才能与10Be侵蚀空间格局相匹配。
识别出梅里雪山局部侵蚀热点（>0.4 mm/yr），并将其归因于帕隆与中甸断层之间的挤压阶区。
利用GPS运动学将区域南北向和东西向侵蚀梯度分别与跨越莫霍面斜坡的地壳运动及印度板片浅部俯冲/楔入联系起来。
me: In situ cosmogenic 10Be analysis of modern river sands from tributary catchments to determine short-term basin-wide erosion rates.
Stream power law geomorphic analysis calculating normalized channel steepness (ksn) and modern-precipitation-modified steepness (ksnQ).
Kinematic modeling of horizontal GPS velocities using Euler pole transformations, surface dilatation (StrainTool), horizontal-flux, and Moho-gradient vertical uplift models.
对支流流域现代河沙进行原位宇宙成因核素10Be分析，以确定短期流域平均侵蚀率。
基于河流水力侵蚀定律进行地貌分析，计算归一化河道陡度（ksn）和现代降水修正河道陡度（ksnQ）。
利用欧拉极转换、地表膨胀率（StrainTool）、水平通量及莫霍面梯度垂向隆升模型对GPS水平速度场进行运动学建模。
de: 72 modern river sand samples collected between 2015 and 2023 from tributaries (mostly 20–100 km2) of the Salween, Mekong, Yangtze, and Yuqu rivers.
Copernicus 90 m DEM and CHELSA (1981–2010) annual precipitation climatology.
Regional GPS velocity field (Wang and Shen, 2020) and published Moho depth model from joint gravity-seismic inversion (Zhao et al., 2020).
2015至2023年间采集自怒江、澜沧江、金沙江及玉曲支流（面积多为20–100 km2）的72个现代河沙样品。
Copernicus 90米数字高程模型（DEM）和CHELSA（1981–2010年）年降水量气候数据。
区域GPS速度场（Wang and Shen, 2020）以及基于重力-地震联合反演的已发表莫霍面深度模型（Zhao et al., 2020）。
li: Low-resolution lithology maps limit the ability to fully resolve local rock strength and fault-damage controls on erodibility.
Translating horizontal GPS velocities into vertical motion via smoothed Moho geometry simplifies complex 3D crustal deformation and potential lower-crustal flow.
Glacial processes in a few high-elevation catchments around the Meili Mountains may bias 10Be assumptions and decouple erosion rates from fluvial channel steepness.
低分辨率岩性图限制了全面解析局部岩石强度和断层破碎对可蚀性控制作用的能力。
通过平滑莫霍面几何形态将GPS水平速度转换为垂向运动，简化了复杂的三维地壳变形和潜在的下地壳流。
梅里雪山周边少数高海拔流域的冰川过程可能使10Be假设产生偏差，并导致侵蚀率与河流河道陡度解耦。

tm.why: The paper investigates crustal deformation, Moho ramp geometry, and Indian Plate indentation kinematics using GPS velocities, erosion rates, and geomorphic metrics in the southeastern Tibetan Plateau.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), equations, references, and all 10 figures.

sum: This software report presents the CRESCENT code verification web platform for comparing numerical simulations of earthquake dynamic rupture, seismic cycles (SEAS), and tsunami generation. Built on a serverless and containerized Amazon Web Services (AWS) backend, it features a React-based uploader with Cognito authentication and an open-access Plotly Dash visualization dashboard hosted on AWS Fargate. Uploaded simulation files are automatically validated, interpolated onto a standardized grid via k-nearest-neighbor inverse-distance weighting, and converted to Parquet format by AWS Lambda and Step Functions. Benchmark specifications are externalized into modular JSON descriptor files, enabling new benchmarks to be added without altering core software logic. The platform currently hosts "The Tsunami Problem Versions" (TTPV1 and TTPV2), comparing 3D coupled solid Earth-ocean dynamic rupture and tsunami simulations across codes like MAFE, SeisSol, and drdg3d. This extensible resource enhances transparency, reproducibility, and community trust in physics-based hazard modeling.
本文介绍了CRESCENT开发的开源代码验证网页平台，用于地震动态破裂、地震周期及海啸模拟软件的对比验证。平台基于AWS无服务器和容器架构，包含React安全上传界面和无需登录的Plotly Dash交互式可视化面板。系统利用AWS Lambda和Step Functions自动解析上传结果，通过k……

t: A modular AWS platform combining a React uploader and a containerized Plotly Dash viewer. Uploaded ZIP outputs are validated, interpolated onto standard grids via k-nearest-neighbor inverse-distance weighting, and converted to Parquet via Lambda functions guided by benchmark JSON descriptors.
结合React上传器和Plotly Dash容器的AWS平台，按JSON描述文件校验数据并经k近邻反距离加权插值存为Pa…

Hosts 3D coupled solid Earth-ocean dynamic rupture and tsunami benchmarks TTPV1 (1 km uniform ocean) and TTPV2 (3 km to 50 m sloping bathymetry) on a 15°-dipping thrust fault, comparing time-series and 2D surface grids from MAFE, SeisSol, and drdg3d.
部署15°倾角逆冲断层三维固-液耦合动态破裂与海啸基准TTPV1（均匀水深）和TTPV2（斜坡水深）模拟数据。

The platform successfully processes, regrids, and interactively visualizes multi-code comparisons of 2D sea surface vertical displacement (eta) at 30 s for TTPV2 and 3-component seafloor velocities and displacements for TTPV1 across MAFE, SeisSol, and drdg3d.
实现了MAFE、SeisSol和drdg3d在TTPV2海面垂直位移二维场与剖面及TTPV1海底三分量波形的交互对比。

Quantitative comparison metrics among simulation results and specific plotting features for earthquake cycle (SEAS) benchmarks are not yet implemented; temporary unauthenticated single-file uploads also do not support 2D surface files.
尚未实现模拟结果的定量对比指标计算，且未登录的临时单文件预览功能不支持二维表面数据。

Externalizes benchmark specifications into JSON files on a scalable serverless AWS infrastructure, enabling new 2D surface and time-series benchmarks to be added without modifying underlying uploader or viewer code.
将基准定义外部化为JSON文件并结合AWS无服务器架构，无需修改底层代码即可扩展支持新基准与二维表面数据。

kc: Developed an open-access, cloud-native web platform on AWS for verifying earthquake dynamic rupture, seismic cycle, and tsunami numerical codes.
Designed a benchmark-agnostic architecture driven by structured JSON descriptor files, allowing new benchmarks to be added without changing platform code.
Implemented automated cloud preprocessing using AWS Lambda and Step Functions to validate outputs, regrid 2D surfaces via k-NN inverse-distance weighting, and store data as Parquet files.
Hosted and demonstrated the platform on 3D coupled earthquake-tsunami benchmarks TTPV1 and TTPV2, comparing outputs from MAFE, SeisSol, and drdg3d.
基于AWS开发了用于验证地震动态破裂、地震周期和海啸数值模拟代码的开源云平台。
设计了由结构化JSON描述文件驱动的模块化架构，无需修改底层代码即可添加新的基准测试。
利用AWS Lambda和Step Functions实现自动化云端预处理，完成格式验证、k近邻反距离加权网格插值及Parquet格式存储。
部署并展示了三维耦合地震动态破裂与海啸基准测试TTPV1和TTPV2，对比了MAFE、SeisSol和drdg3d等代码的模拟结果。
me: Modular cloud architecture on AWS utilizing S3, Cognito, CloudFront, Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, ECR, and ECS Fargate.
JSON-based parametric benchmark definition describing expected time-series and 2D surface outputs, variables, units, and target grids.
Automated spatial interpolation/regridding of unstructured model meshes onto standardized comparison grids using k-nearest-neighbor inverse-distance weighting.
Interactive browser-based data visualization built with Plotly Dash, reading Parquet files directly from S3 and supporting temporary local file previews.
采用基于AWS的模块化云架构，集成S3、Cognito、CloudFront、Lambda、Step Functions、DynamoDB、ECR和ECS Fargate等服务。
使用基于JSON的参数化基准定义文件，描述预期的时间序列和二维表面输出、变量、单位及目标网格。
采用k近邻反距离加权方法，将不同模型的网格输出自动空间插值/重网格化到标准化对比网格上。
利用Plotly Dash构建基于浏览器的交互式数据可视化，直接从S3读取Parquet文件并支持本地单文件临时预览对比。
de: TTPV1 (The Tsunami Problem Version 1): 3D spontaneous dynamic rupture on a 15-degree-dipping thrust fault coupled with a uniform 1 km water layer.
TTPV2 (The Tsunami Problem Version 2): Same 3D dynamic rupture setup as TTPV1, but coupled with a variable-depth water layer sloping from 3 km seaward to ~50 m landward.
Cross-code comparisons of receiver time series (3-component displacements, velocities, pressure) and 2D surface grids (seafloor deformation, sea surface height eta) from MAFE, SeisSol, and drdg3d.
TTPV1基准测试：15度倾角逆冲断层上的三维自发动态破裂，耦合1公里均匀厚度的水层。
TTPV2基准测试：与TTPV1相同的三维动态破裂设置，但耦合水深从海侧3公里向陆侧变浅至约50米的变化水层。
对比了MAFE、SeisSol和drdg3d三个数值代码在接收点的时间序列（三分量位移、速度、压力）和二维表面网格（海底变形、海面高度）。
li: Single local file preview uploads without authentication are not supported for 2D surface files and are not permanently stored.
Quantitative comparison metrics among simulation results are not yet implemented on the platform.
The React frontend application is currently excluded from the automated AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) deployment pipeline.
未登录状态下的本地单文件临时上传预览功能目前不支持二维表面文件，且不会永久保存。
平台尚未实现不同模拟结果之间的定量对比指标计算。
React前端应用目前未包含在AWS云开发工具包（CDK）的自动化部署流程中。

tm.why: The platform is specifically developed to verify numerical codes for 3D earthquake dynamic rupture and coupled tsunami generation.
The platform explicitly supports verification frameworks for Sequences of Earthquakes and Aseismic Slip (SEAS) and earthquake cycle models.
The platform facilitates community code verification of 3D numerical solvers (e.g., SeisSol, MAFE, drdg3d) solving coupled elastodynamic and acoustic/tsunami wave equations.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including architecture descriptions, JSON Listing 1, and Figures 1-5.

sum: Unburied Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) deployments are essential for rapid terrestrial response and lunar missions, yet suffer from poor signal quality. This study identifies and quantifies bending stress relief as the primary mechanism: cable segments suspended between discrete ground contacts accommodate ground motion by bending rather than stretching axially. Combining analytical Euler-Bernoulli beam theory, 1D Timoshenko finite-element modeling in FEniCS, and 3D laser Doppler vibrometer experiments across 56 configurations of seven fiber-optic cables, the authors show that quasi-static strain transfer efficiency depends solely on a dimensionless parameter Theta, determined by the ratio of segment sag to cable radius. Keeping strain loss below 3% requires sag below a quarter (clamped) or eighth (pinned) of the radius. Crucially, initial sag is dominated by curvature retained from spooling rather than gravity, meaning the same coupling criteria apply on the Moon, where frictional slip is also shown to be unlikely for natural moonquakes.
未掩埋分布式声学传感（DAS）在应急响应和月球探测中至关重要，但面临耦合差的问题。本研究提出并量化了“弯曲应力释放”机制：离散接地点间的悬空光缆段通过弯曲而非轴向拉伸来吸收地面应变。结合欧拉-伯努利梁解析理论、FEniCS一维铁木辛柯梁有限元数值模拟以及7种光缆56种配置的激光多普勒测振实验，证明准……

t: Models suspended cable segments between ground contacts as geometrically nonlinear Euler-Bernoulli beams analytically and 1D Timoshenko beams in FEniCS, partitioning applied endpoint strain into axial elongation and flexural bending via energy minimization.
将接地点间的悬空光缆段建模为非线性欧拉-伯努利梁和FEniCS铁木辛柯梁，通过能量最小化将端点应变分配为轴向伸长和弯曲。

Evaluates 1296 FEniCS finite-element parameter combinations and validates against 56 laboratory shaker configurations across seven diverse fiber-optic cables at spans of 5–20 cm measured with a 3-component scanning laser Doppler vibrometer.
计算了1296组有限元参数组合，并利用三分量扫描激光多普勒测振仪对7种光缆在5–20 cm跨距下的56种实验室激振配置进…

Quasi-static strain transfer efficiency is governed by eta = 1/(1+Theta) where Theta = 0.5*(q_f0/r)^2. Keeping loss below 3% requires sag below r/4 (clamped) or r/8 (pinned), with sag dominated by retained spool curvature.
准静态应变传递效率为 η = 1/(1+Θ)，Θ = 0.5*(q_f0/r)^2。损耗低于3%需下垂小于r/4（固支）…

Assumes symmetric single-lobed bends, tension-free segments, ideal non-deforming ground contacts, and perfect internal cable-to-fiber transfer, providing only an upper bound on total recorded fiber strain.
假设单瓣对称弯曲、零初张力、刚性地面接触及完美缆-纤传递，因此仅提供光纤实测应变传递效率的上限。
Provides the first quantitative analytical and experimental framework for unburied DAS ground-to-cable coupling, proving retained curvature rather than gravity sets cable sag on Earth and the Moon.
建立了首个未掩埋DAS地-缆耦合定量理论与实验框架，证明地球和月球上光缆下垂均由残余曲率而非重力决定。

kc: Identifies and analytically quantifies bending stress relief in suspended cable segments as a key mechanism degrading unburied DAS ground-to-cable coupling.
Derives a single dimensionless parameter Theta = 0.5*(q_f0/r)^2 (for clamped ends) that governs quasi-static axial strain transfer efficiency solely from the sag-to-radius ratio.
Validates the theoretical and FEniCS finite-element models using 3D scanning laser Doppler vibrometer measurements across 56 laboratory configurations of seven cables.
Demonstrates that initial cable sag is orders of magnitude larger than gravitational predictions because it is dominated by retained curvature from spooling and handling.

Establishes practical cable design and deployment guidelines for Earth and the Moon, showing that lunar gravity neither alters the bending criterion nor induces frictional slip for natural moonquakes.
识别并解析量化了悬空光缆段中的“弯曲应力释放”是导致未掩埋DAS地-缆耦合退化的关键物理机制。
推导出单一无量纲参数 Θ = 0.5*(q_f0/r)^2（固支边界），证明准静态轴向应变传递效率完全由下垂与光缆半径之比决定。
利用三维扫描激光多普勒测振仪对7种光缆的56种实验室配置进行测量，验证了解析理论和FEniCS有限元模型。
证明实际光缆初始下垂比重力预测大几个数量级，主要由光缆卷轴存储和搬运留下的残余曲率主导。
制定了地球和月球未掩埋DAS光缆设计与布设指南，证明月球低重力不会改变弯曲耦合准则，且自然月震不会引发摩擦滑动。
me: Analytical Euler-Bernoulli beam modeling with geometric nonlinearity, modal reduction (axial elongation and first symmetric flexural mode), and energy minimization.
1D Timoshenko beam finite-element modeling in FEniCS using a nonlinear Newton solver for static equilibrium and linearized steady-state frequency response for dynamics.
Laboratory shaker experiments with non-contact 3-component scanning laser Doppler vibrometry (LDV) and Welch transfer function estimation across 1–500 Hz.
采用几何非线性欧拉-伯努利梁理论、模态简化（轴向伸长和一阶对称弯曲模态）及能量最小化进行解析建模。
在FEniCS中建立一维铁木辛柯梁有限元模型，使用非线性牛顿求解器计算静态平衡，并通过线性化稳态频响分析动态特性。
开展激振器实验室测试，结合非接触式三分量扫描激光多普勒测振仪（LDV）和Welch传递函数估计（1–500 Hz）。
de: 1296 parametric finite-element simulation combinations varying cable radius, segment length, Young's modulus, density, gravity, and retained curvature radius.
56 laboratory configurations across 7 commercial fiber-optic cables (diameters 0.9 to 5.5 mm) at 4 spans (5, 10, 15, 20 cm) in taut and intended-sag states.
Tensile testing on a Zwick Roell Z010 machine (three tests per cable) to measure experimental Young's moduli ranging from 2.1 to 28.6 GPa.
1296组参数化有限元数值模拟，系统改变光缆半径、悬空段长度、杨氏模量、密度、重力加速度和残余曲率半径。
7种商用光缆（外径0.9至5.5 mm）在4种跨距（5、10、15、20 cm）及拉紧与预留松弛两种状态下的56种实验室配置测试。

Experimental shaker setup exhibits transverse head resonances around 137 Hz and clamp compliance, preventing exact quantitative matching of high-frequency dynamic resonance peaks.

The study explicitly evaluates the implications of unburied DAS cable coupling and frictional slip for extraterrestrial seismic deployments on the Moon.
The paper investigates the mechanical coupling physics of seismic instrumentation (surface-draped fiber-optic cables) and provides cable design and deployment guidelines.

sum: The Statewide California Earthquake Center has extended its 3D simulation-based probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) platform, CyberShake, to Northern California (Study 24.8). By simulating hundreds of thousands of seismograms for 315 sites in the greater San Francisco Bay area, the study completes physics-based hazard mapping for the entire San Andreas fault system. The workflow integrates 3D/1D velocity models, the AWP-ODC wave propagation code, and Graves-Pitarka kinematic rupture generator. Compared to empirical NGA-West2 ground-motion models, CyberShake yields slightly lower hazard near the San Francisco Bay and near-fault regions, but higher hazard near sedimentary basins. It also reveals stronger directivity effects in Northern California than in Southern California due to more uniform fault characteristics. Validation against the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake demonstrates reduced bias compared to empirical and 1D models.
本研究将3D模拟概率地震危险性分析平台CyberShake扩展至北加州，模拟了旧金山湾区315个站点的地震动。该工作整合了速度模型、波动传播算法与破裂生成器。相比经验模型，CyberShake在近断层区预测的危险性较低，但在盆地附近长周期危险性更高，且方向性效应更显著。利用Loma Prieta地震……

使用CyberShake平台进行基于3D模拟的概率地震危险性分析，结合了AWP-ODC波动传播和Graves-Pitar…

CyberShake Study 24.8显示的危险性比NGA-West2经验模型略低，其中近断层危险性较低，而沉积盆地…
The simulation is limited by a minimum shear-wave velocity (VS) of 400 m/s, potentially underestimating very shallow site amplification.

First implementation of the physics-based CyberShake workflow in Northern California, completing hazard estimates for the entire San Andreas fault system.

Constructed a unified velocity model by tiling three 3D and 1D models with a near-surface VS30-based taper.

sum: This study investigates how olivine rheological formulations control lithospheric-scale strain localization during upper-mantle extension using 2-D thermo-mechanical simulations in Fluidity. Testing diffusion creep, high-temperature, and unified low- to high-temperature (LT-HT) dislocation creep with and without a yield-stress cap, the authors introduce novel diagnostics that partition local viscosity reduction into mechanical (strain-rate driven) and thermal (temperature driven) weakening. Results show that without a shallow yield-stress cap, deformation remains distributed. When localization occurs, it follows a robust two-stage pathway: Stage 1 lateral narrowing dominated by mechanical weakening, followed by Stage 2 rapid plate thinning driven by asthenospheric upwelling and thermal weakening. Including dislocation creep lowers the yield-to-creep transition temperature (down to 800 K for LT-HT creep), doubling localization speed compared to diffusion-plus-yield rheologies. Furthermore, even a thin (<5 km) stiff mid-lithosphere layer delays breakup, demonstrating that depth distribution of weakening, rather than bulk strength alone, governs plate boundary formation.
本研究利用Fluidity开展二维上地幔伸展热-力学数值模拟，探讨不同橄榄石流变律（扩散蠕变、高温及低温-高温统一位错蠕变与屈服应力上限组合）对岩石圈尺度应变局域化的控制。文章创新性地提出了将局部黏度降低分解为力学弱化（应变率驱动）和热弱化（温度驱动）的诊断方法。结果表明：若无浅部屈服应力上限，变形……

t: 2-D thermo-mechanical finite-element simulations of incompressible Stokes flow (Fluidity) testing composite olivine rheologies, paired with finite-difference diagnostics partitioning local viscosity reduction into strain-rate (mechanical) and temperature (thermal) contributions.
采用Fluidity进行二维不可压缩Stokes热-力学有限元模拟，结合将局部黏度降低分解为应变率（力学）和温度（热）贡…

Synthetic 2-D upper-mantle extension experiments in a 1200 x 400 km mantle-only domain across 17 rheological combinations, initial plate ages of 10–100 Myr, and half-extension velocities of 0.2–5 cm/yr.
1200×400 km纯地幔域的二维伸展数值实验，涵盖17种流变组合、10–100 Myr板块年龄及0.2–5 cm/y…

Localization follows a two-stage narrowing-then-thinning trajectory. Including LT–HT dislocation creep lowers the yield-creep transition to ~800 K and halves localization time (10.5–11.8 Myr vs. 19.3–21.8 Myr for diffusion plus yield stress).
局域化遵循先变窄后减薄的两阶段路径；引入低温-高温位错蠕变将屈服-蠕变转换温度降至800 K，使局域化时间减半。
The model uses a mantle-only domain without crustal layering, neglects elasticity and shear heating, and imposes kinematic extension velocities rather than a self-consistent force balance.
采用无地壳的纯地幔构型，忽略了弹性和剪切生热，且采用运动学速度边界条件而非自洽力平衡驱动。

Evaluates a unified low-to-high-temperature dislocation creep law in lithospheric extension and introduces time-dependent diagnostics partitioning viscosity weakening into mechanical and thermal contributions.
首次在岩石圈伸展中评估低温-高温统一位错蠕变律，并提出定量分离力学弱化与热弱化的时变诊断框架。

kc: Introduced time-dependent weakening-partition diagnostics that separate local viscosity reduction into mechanical (strain-rate-driven) and thermal (temperature-driven) contributions.
Identified a universal two-stage pathway for extensional plate boundary formation: Stage 1 progressive lateral narrowing followed by Stage 2 rapid lithospheric thinning.

Demonstrated that low- to high-temperature dislocation creep accelerates strain localization by a factor of ~2 compared to diffusion creep plus yield stress by extending creep weakening down to 800 K.
Showed that a thin (<4–5 km) stiff layer in the mid-lithosphere acts as a mechanical bottleneck that severely delays localization, regardless of bulk plate weakness.
提出了时变弱化分解诊断方法，将局部黏度降低定量分解为力学（应变率驱动）和热（温度驱动）贡献。
揭示了伸展板块边界形成的普适两阶段路径：第一阶段变形带渐进横向变窄，第二阶段软流圈上涌驱动岩石圈快速减薄。
证明低温-高温位错蠕变可将蠕变弱化拓展至800 K，相比扩散蠕变加屈服应力模型使应变局域化加速约2倍。
发现岩石圈中部即使小于4-5公里的薄硬层也会作为力学瓶颈显著推迟局域化，表明弱化的深度分布比整体平均强度更关键。
me: 2-D incompressible Boussinesq Stokes thermo-mechanical finite-element modeling using Fluidity with dynamic unstructured mesh adaptivity (200 m to 50 km resolution).

Composite olivine rheology combining diffusion creep, high-temperature power-law or unified low-to-high-temperature (Peierls-bridging) dislocation creep, and constant or depth-dependent viscoplastic yield stress.

Post-processing diagnostics quantifying strain-rate amplification, deformed-zone width, plateness, tectonic force, and finite-difference partitioning of viscosity time derivatives into thermal and strain-rate fractions.
基于Fluidity有限元控制体积框架的二维不可压缩Boussinesq近似热-力学数值模拟，采用动态非结构化自适应网格（分辨率200米至50公里）。
包含扩散蠕变、高温幂律或低温-高温统一位错蠕变以及恒定/深度依赖黏塑性屈服应力的复合橄榄石流变学参数化。
定量计算应变率放大、变形带宽度、板块度、构造力以及将黏度时间导数分解为温度和应变率贡献的后处理诊断算法。

Parametric sweep across 17 rheological combinations (varying creep laws, yield stresses of 200 and 500 MPa, and thermal cutoffs for yielding at 900 K and 950 K) at reference plate age 50 Myr and half-extension rate 1 cm/yr.
Sensitivity experiments varying initial thermal plate age (10, 30, 50, 100 Myr) and imposed half-extension velocity (0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5 cm/yr), plus depth-dependent yield stress tests.
在1200 km宽、400 km深的纯地幔二维计算域中开展上地幔伸展数值实验，计算至40%总体伸展应变（约500 km伸展量）。
在50 Myr参考板块年龄和1 cm/yr半伸展速率下，对17种流变组合（不同蠕变律、200/500 MPa屈服应力及900/950 K屈服温度截断）进行对比实验。

Neglects elasticity and shear heating, using a viscoplastic yield-stress proxy that produces distributed flow rather than discrete brittle planar faults.
Extension is imposed kinematically via side boundary velocities rather than through a self-consistent far-field tectonic force balance.
采用简化的纯地幔模型，忽略了地壳分层、壳幔力学耦合以及晶粒尺寸演化或损伤等其他弱化机制。
忽略了弹性和剪切生热，使用黏塑性屈服应力近似代替脆性破裂，无法刻画离散断层几何形态。
通过侧边界速度运动学条件施加伸展，而非通过自洽的远场构造力平衡驱动。

tm.why: The paper investigates lithospheric-scale strain localization and plate boundary formation using 2-D thermo-mechanical geodynamic simulations of upper mantle extension with various olivine flow laws.

sum: Since 2021, the Reykjanes Peninsula in SW Iceland has experienced repeated basaltic fissure eruptions. This study presents new 3-D P-wave, S-wave, and Vp/Vs crustal models derived from 26,795 manual arrival-time picks of 1,147 local earthquakes recorded by 51 broadband stations between 2020 and 2024 using the FMTOMO package. Synthetic checkerboard and spike tests confirm robust recovery at 2–6 km depth. Key findings include fast shallow velocities (2–4 km) beneath high-temperature geothermal fields due to hydrothermal mineral alteration, an ENE-WSW low-velocity zone at 4–5 km depth aligned with the plate boundary, and a prominent low-Vp, low-Vs anomaly at 4–6 km depth beneath Svartsengi interpreted as the shallow magma domain feeding the 2023–2025 Sundhnúkur eruptions. A deeper (7–12 km) low-Vs, high-Vp/Vs anomaly beneath Fagradalsfjall likely reflects stalled melt, though synthetic tests novelly demonstrate that lower-crustal (>8 km) features cannot be robustly resolved by local earthquake tomography.
自2021年起冰岛雷克雅内斯半岛发生多次裂隙喷发。本研究利用2020–2024年间51个宽频带台站记录的1147次地方震共26,795个手动P、S波到时，采用FMTOMO反演了三维地壳Vp、Vs及Vp/Vs结构，并通过棋盘格和脉冲测试验证了2–6 km深度的可靠性。研究发现地热田浅部（2–4 km）……

t: Iterative non-linear 3-D traveltime tomography using FMTOMO, combining a Fast Marching Method eikonal solver with subspace velocity inversion and non-linear grid-search hypocentre relocation, deriving Vp/Vs by direct division of Vp and Vs models.
采用FMTOMO进行迭代非线性三维走时层析成像与震源重定位，通过Vp和Vs直接相除获取Vp/Vs。

26,795 manually refined P- and S-wave arrival picks (13,991 P, 12,804 S) from 1,147 local earthquakes recorded across 51 3-component broadband stations on the Reykjanes Peninsula between 2020 and 2024.
2020–2024年雷克雅内斯半岛51个宽频带台站记录的1147次地方震共26,795个手动P、S波到时。

Traveltime variance decreased by 71% (Vp) and 81% (Vs). Imaged a 4–6 km deep low-velocity magma domain beneath Svartsengi, fast shallow geothermal anomalies (2–4 km), and a 7–12 km deep low-Vs, high-Vp/Vs zone beneath Fagradalsfjall.
走时方差降低71%(Vp)和81%(Vs)；揭示Svartsengi下方4–6 km低速岩浆域及地热田浅部高速异常。
Models cannot reliably resolve structures below ~8 km depth due to the limited spatial distribution of deep earthquakes and strong trade-offs between velocity anomalies and hypocentre parameters.
受深部地震空间分布有限及震源-速度折衷影响，模型无法可靠解析8 km以下结构。

Provides new 3-D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models spanning 2020–2024 eruptions, imaging the Svartsengi magma reservoir and proving via synthetic tests that lower-crustal magma chambers are unresolved by local seismicity.
构建涵盖2020–2024喷发期的三维速度模型，成像Svartsengi岩浆域并证伪下地壳岩浆房的分辨率。

Imaged a distinct low-Vp and low-Vs zone at 4–6 km depth beneath Svartsengi, identifying the shallow magma domain supplying the 2023–2025 Sundhnúkur eruptions.
Identified an elongate ENE-WSW low-velocity zone at 4–5 km depth along the kinematic plate boundary and fast shallow anomalies (2–4 km) beneath geothermal fields.
Demonstrated via targeted synthetic spike tests that lower crustal anomalies (>8 km depth) are poorly constrained due to sparse deep seismicity and hypocentre-velocity trade-offs.
利用2020–2024年间1147次地方震的26,795个手动精修到时，构建了雷克雅内斯半岛中部的全新三维Vp、Vs和Vp/Vs模型。
在Svartsengi下方4–6 km深度处成像出明显的低Vp和低Vs区，确定了供给2023–2025年Sundhnúkur喷发的浅部岩浆储层。
识别出沿板块边界4–5 km深度的ENE-WSW向条带状低速区，以及地热田下方浅部（2–4 km）的高速异常。
通过针对性的合成脉冲测试证明，受限于深部地震稀疏分布及震源-速度折衷效应，8 km以下的下地壳异常无法得到可靠约束。

Initial hypocentre relocation using NonLinLoc and quasi-1-D traveltime inversion to derive an optimal 1-D starting model.
Iterative non-linear 3-D traveltime tomography and joint hypocentre relocation using FMTOMO (Fast Marching Method eikonal solver and subspace inversion).
Comprehensive resolution analysis using synthetic checkerboard tests (2x2x1 km and 4x4x2 km) and targeted synthetic spike tests with fixed and free hypocentres.
使用QuakeMigrate进行自动震相拾取，随后在2–16 Hz滤波的三分量地震图上进行手动精修并赋予不确定度（0.01–0.2 s）。
利用NonLinLoc进行初始震源重定位，并通过准一维走时反演构建最优一维初始速度模型。
采用FMTOMO软件包（快速行进法程函方程求解器与子空间反演）进行迭代非线性三维走时层析成像与震源联合重定位。
利用合成棋盘格测试（2x2x1 km和4x4x2 km）以及固定和自由震源的针对性合成脉冲测试开展全面的分辨率分析。

Filtered dataset of 1,147 local earthquakes yielding 26,795 manual arrival-time picks (13,991 P-picks and 12,804 S-picks), including deep long-period (DLP) events at ~10 km depth.
Synthetic starting model sensitivity tests (including RISE refraction model and random perturbations) and targeted anomaly spike recovery experiments.
2020至2024年间布设在雷克雅内斯半岛的51个三分量宽频带地震仪的波形记录。
筛选出的1147次地方震数据集，包含26,795个手动拾取到时（13,991个P波和12,804个S波），其中包括~10 km深处的深部常周期（DLP）事件。
一维初始模型敏感性测试（包括RISE折射模型及随机扰动测试）以及针对特定异常体的合成脉冲恢复实验。
li: Lack of earthquakes and crossing rays in the uppermost 2 km prevents reliable interpretation of near-surface structure.
Structures below ~8 km depth cannot be robustly resolved in size, shape, or amplitude due to spatially limited deep seismicity and hypocentre-velocity trade-offs.
Anomalies near the edges of the model volume (such as beneath Krýsuvík and the western extent of Svartsengi) lack full spatial and depth constraints.
The tomographic inversion assumes an isotropic medium, neglecting potential upper-crustal seismic anisotropy caused by aligned fractures and fissures.
最浅部2 km内缺乏地震事件和交叉射线，无法对近地表结构进行可靠解释。
由于深部地震空间分布有限以及震源位置与速度结构之间的强烈折衷，~8 km以下结构的尺寸、形状和幅值无法被可靠解析。
