层析成像反演假设介质各向同性，忽略了由定向排列的裂隙和断层可能引起的上地壳地震各向异性。

tm.why: The paper applies 3-D local earthquake body-wave traveltime tomography (P and S waves) to image crustal velocity structure.
The study investigates the magmatic plumbing architecture and geothermal systems beneath active volcanic systems on the Reykjanes Peninsula, Iceland.
It images upper-to-lower crustal seismic velocity anomalies associated with an oblique rift plate boundary, brittle-ductile transition, and magma storage.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF text, abstract, figures, and captions were analyzed directly.

sum: Open-vent volcanoes exhibit diverse eruptive styles, from mild Strombolian explosions and lava effusions to violent paroxysms. Using ground tilt records from borehole/platform tiltmeters and broadband seismometers at Stromboli (Italy), this study performs 3-D finite-element inversions incorporating realistic topography to locate the deformation pressure source across these three eruptive regimes. Remarkably, this is the first study to resolve the pressure source of tiny ground tilt (~0.1 microradians) associated with regular Strombolian explosions. The inversions demonstrate that regular explosions, the July 2019 paroxysm, and the August 2014 flank lava effusion all share a common shallow spherical reservoir (~100 m radius) located ~280 m beneath the summit craters (500 m a.s.l.), corresponding to a stagnant, crystal-rich magma plug. A Poiseuille-flow fluid-mechanical conduit model links geodetic pressure changes (4.6 kPa, 145 kPa, and -2.7 MPa, respectively) to magma column height variations, magma ascent velocities, and discharged eruptive volumes.
本研究利用斯特龙博利火山的钻孔倾斜仪、近火口临时倾斜仪及宽频带地震仪提取的地面倾斜数据，结合考虑地形效应的三维有限元网格搜索反演，首次确定了常规斯特龙博利式微弱爆炸的压力源，并与2019年剧烈喷发（paroxysm）和2014年侧翼溢流喷发进行对比。结果表明，这三种截然不同的喷发类型共享位于山顶火口……

t: 3-D finite-element modeling in COMSOL Multiphysics with a 10-m DEM topography is coupled with grid-search independent and joint inversions of tilt vectors for spherical/ellipsoidal pressure sources, alongside a Poiseuille conduit flow model.
基于10米DEM地形使用COMSOL进行三维有限元正演，结合网格搜索独立与联合反演压力源，并建立泊肃叶通道流模型。

Tilt records from three permanent borehole tiltmeters, three temporary near-vent platform tiltmeters (2014 regular explosions and August 2014 lava effusion), and five broadband seismometers (July 2019 paroxysm) at Stromboli volcano.
斯特龙博利火山3个永久钻孔倾斜仪、3个近火口临时倾斜仪（2014年）和5个宽频带地震仪（2019年）的倾斜数据。

Joint inversion locates a common 100-m-radius spherical reservoir at SX = -50 m, SY = -100 m, SZ = 500 m a.s.l. (280 m depth), with pressure changes of 4.6 kPa (regular), 145 kPa (paroxysm), and -2.7 MPa (effusion).
联合反演定位出海拔500米（深280米）、半径100米的共同球形源，常规爆炸、剧烈喷发和溢流的压力变化分别为4.6 kP…
Lack of stations northwest of the craters in Sciara del Fuoco weakens constraints on SY and SZ, and homogeneous elastic models cannot explain local 20–30° azimuth misfits at CPL and LFS.
火口西北侧缺乏台站导致SY和SZ约束较弱，且均匀弹性模型无法解释CPL和LFS台站20–30°的方位角偏差。

First study to resolve the pressure source of regular Strombolian explosions from near-vent tilt and directly unify regular explosions, paroxysms, and lava effusions under one shallow reservoir model.
首次利用近火口倾斜反演常规斯特龙博利爆炸压力源，并将三种喷发类型统一于同一浅层岩浆房模型。

kc: First pressure source estimation of ground tilt (~10^-1 microradians) associated with regular Strombolian explosions using near-vent tiltmeters.
Demonstrated via 3-D FEM inversions that regular explosions, paroxysms, and flank effusive eruptions at Stromboli all share a common shallow magma reservoir at ~500 m a.s.l. (~280 m depth).

Proposed a fluid-mechanical basaltic conduit model combining magmastatic and Poiseuille dynamic flow pressure that successfully reconciles geodetic pressure changes with erupted magma volumes and ascent velocities.
首次利用近火口倾斜仪数据反演确定了与常规斯特龙博利式爆炸相关的微弱地面倾斜（约0.1微弧度）的压力源位置。
通过三维有限元反演证明，斯特龙博利火山的常规爆炸、剧烈喷发和侧翼溢流喷发共享位于海拔约500米（深约280米）的同一浅层岩浆房。
提出了结合岩浆静压力和泊肃叶流动动压力的玄武质通道流体力学模型，将反演的压力变化与喷发岩浆体积和上升速度成功关联。
me: Extraction of ground tilt and very-long-period (VLP) signals from broadband seismometers and borehole/platform tiltmeters.
Classification of regular explosion tilt cycles into four stages (gradual inflation, rapid inflation, rapid deflation, recovery) using VLP onset/end times.

3-D Finite Element Method (FEM) forward modeling in COMSOL Multiphysics with a 10-m DEM topography and grid-search inversion (independent and joint) for spherical and triaxial ellipsoidal cavity sources.
Fluid-mechanical conduit modeling combining static magmastatic pressure and laminar Poiseuille flow dynamic pressure.
从宽频带地震仪以及钻孔和平台式倾斜仪记录中提取地面倾斜和甚长周期（VLP）信号。
利用地震VLP信号的起止时间，将常规爆炸的倾斜周期划分为缓慢膨胀、快速膨胀、快速收缩和恢复四个阶段。
基于10米分辨率数字高程模型（DEM），使用COMSOL Multiphysics进行三维有限元正演，并通过网格搜索对球形和三轴椭球形空腔压力源进行独立及联合反演。
建立结合岩浆静压力与层流泊肃叶流动动压力的通道流体力学模型。
de: Three permanent borehole tiltmeters (LSC, OHO, LFS; Pinnacle 5000T) and three temporary near-vent platform tiltmeters (CPL, PZZ, RFR; Jewell 701-2A) recorded during July–August 2014 (868 selected regular explosions and the 7 August 2014 flank effusive eruption).
Five broadband seismic stations (SCI, ROC, STR, PZZ, SDK; Güralp CMG-40T) and one borehole tiltmeter (OHO) recorded during the 3 July 2019 paroxysmal eruption.
2014年7月至8月期间3个永久钻孔倾斜仪（LSC、OHO、LFS）和3个近火口临时平台倾斜仪（CPL、PZZ、RFR）记录的868次常规爆炸事件及2014年8月7日溢流喷发数据。
5个宽频带地震台站（SCI、ROC、STR、PZZ、SDK）和1个钻孔倾斜仪（OHO）记录的2019年7月3日剧烈喷发数据。
li: Weak station coverage on the northwest side (Sciara del Fuoco) and limited station elevation spread lead to looser constraints and trade-offs in the SY and SZ coordinates.

Assuming an elastically homogeneous medium fails to fully reproduce tilt azimuths at stations CPL and LFS (20–30 degree discrepancy), which are likely affected by local cracks or structural heterogeneity.
Stage B–D tilt signals from bubble-type tiltmeters may be contaminated by translational seismic VLP motions and cannot be used for static source inversions.
西北侧（Sciara del Fuoco）台站覆盖薄弱且台站高程分布有限，导致反演对SY和SZ坐标的约束较弱并存在折衷关系。
均匀弹性介质假设无法完全拟合CPL和LFS台站的倾斜方位角（存在20–30度偏差），这可能受局部裂隙或构造非均质性影响。
气泡式倾斜仪在B至D阶段的信号可能受到地震VLP平动分量的污染，无法用于静态源反演。

tm.why: The paper investigates ground deformation and very-long-period (VLP) seismic signals derived from tiltmeters and broadband seismometers to model shallow magma reservoir pressurization during basaltic eruptions at Stromboli volcano.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF analyzed, including all sections, equations, 13 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: This study investigates the transient acceleration and dynamic fragmentation of rapid long-runout loess landslides under seismic loading using the finite-discrete element method (FDEM). Calibrated with laboratory tests and data from the Sunjiagou landslide, the simulations reveal a pronounced vertical acceleration amplification and stratified motion, where the surface layer and rear portion travel farther. The dynamic response is highly sensitive to seismic parameters: low-frequency, high-amplitude excitations generate the strongest motion and most extensive fragmentation, whereas high-frequency loading results in denser, less expanded deposits. These findings highlight that loess slopes are more vulnerable to low-frequency ground motions than peak acceleration, providing critical insights for seismic hazard mitigation in loess-covered regions.
本研究采用有限-离散单元法（FDEM）模拟了地震荷载下高速超行程黄土滑坡的瞬态加速度与动态破碎过程。结果表明，滑坡存在显著的垂直加速度放大和分层运动特征。低频、高幅激励产生最强烈的运动和最广泛的破碎，而高频加载导致堆积体更紧密。研究表明黄土边坡对低频地面运动更为敏感，为黄土地区地震灾害防治提供了重要……

t: Quantitative simulations using the finite-discrete element method (FDEM) calibrated with laboratory tests to model continuous-to-discontinuous deformation of loess landslides.
采用基于室内试验校准的有限-离散单元法（FDEM）定量模拟黄土滑坡的连续-非连续变形。
Depositional characteristics of the Sunjiagou landslide and geotechnical laboratory tests used to calibrate the FDEM numerical models.
用于校准FDEM数值模型的孙家沟滑坡堆积特征及室内土工试验数据。
Low-frequency, high-amplitude seismic excitations produce the strongest motion responses and most extensive fragmentation, showing that loess slopes are highly sensitive to vibration frequency.
低频高幅地震激励产生最强运动响应和最广泛破碎，表明黄土边坡对振动频率高度敏感。
The findings are based on numerical simulations calibrated to a specific landslide case, potentially omitting complex 3D and hydrological effects.
研究结果基于特定滑坡案例校准的数值模拟，可能忽略了复杂的三维和水文效应。
Quantifying the coupled evolution of dynamic fragmentation and transient acceleration in loess landslides, highlighting their high sensitivity to low-frequency seismic waves.
定量揭示了黄土滑坡动态破碎与瞬态加速度的耦合演化，强调了其对低频地震波的高敏感性。

kc: Demonstrated the coupled evolution of dynamic fragmentation and motion characteristics in loess landslides using FDEM.
Identified a vertical acceleration amplification effect and stratified motion behavior in sliding masses.
Revealed that loess slopes are more sensitive to vibration frequency than peak acceleration, with low-frequency ground motions causing the most severe hazards.
利用FDEM揭示了黄土滑坡动态破碎与运动特征之间的耦合演化规律。
发现了滑动体中显著的垂直加速度放大效应和分层运动行为。
揭示了黄土边坡对振动频率比对峰值加速度更敏感，低频地面运动引发的灾害最严重。
me: Finite-discrete element method (FDEM) for simulating continuous-to-discontinuous deformation.
Calibration of numerical models using depositional characteristics and laboratory test data.
用于模拟连续至非连续变形的有限-离散单元法（FDEM）。
利用堆积特征和室内试验数据进行数值模型校准。
de: Depositional characteristics of the Sunjiagou landslide.
Geotechnical laboratory tests on loess samples for model calibration.
Parametric synthetic simulations varying vibration frequency and acceleration amplitude.
孙家沟滑坡的堆积特征数据。
用于模型校准的黄土样品室内土工试验。
改变振动频率和加速度幅值的参数化合成模拟。
li: The study relies heavily on numerical simulations calibrated to a single primary landslide case (Sunjiagou).
Complex 3D topographic effects and pore-water pressure variations during dynamic loading may not be fully captured in the simplified model.
研究高度依赖于针对单一主要滑坡案例（孙家沟）校准的数值模拟。
简化模型可能无法完全捕获动态加载过程中的复杂三维地形效应和孔隙水压力变化。

tm.why: The paper investigates the dynamic response and instability of loess landslides under seismic loading and different vibration frequencies.
It models landslide dynamics and runout behavior, which falls under environmental seismology and surface processes.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from JGR: Earth Surface, as no PDF was available.

sum: The 2017 Mw 8.2 Tehuantepec intraslab normal-faulting earthquake in southern Mexico generated a complex, productive offshore-onshore aftershock sequence. This study constructs the most comprehensive high-resolution aftershock catalog for the sequence by applying an open-source, machine-learning-assisted workflow (PhaseNet, GaMMA, VELEST, HypoInverse, and HypoDD) to seven months of continuous waveform data from 29 broadband stations. Crucially, this is the first catalog to fully integrate 14 temporary rapid-response stations deployed along the coast with 15 permanent SSN stations. The workflow identified 16,076 absolute locations and 11,374 double-difference relocated earthquakes (~0.5 km median horizontal and vertical precision), calibrated to moment magnitude (Mc ≈ 3.5) via an amplitude-ratio inversion. The relocated seismicity aligns closely with the Slab2.0 geometry, distinctly separating shallow onshore upper-plate clusters, Cocos intraslab events, and deeper plate-interface seismicity, while providing practical validation guidelines for deploying pretrained ML pickers in complex subduction environments.
本研究针对2017年墨西哥特万特佩克Mw 8.2板内正断层地震序列，利用包含14个临时快速响应台站和15个固定台站的29个宽频带台站连续7个月波形数据，首次完整融合临时台网构建了高分辨率余震目录。方法上集成了5 Hz高通滤波、PhaseNet震相拾取、GaMMA关联、VELEST一维速度反演、Hyp……

t: A modular seven-stage workflow applies 5 Hz high-pass filtering, PhaseNet phase picking, GaMMA association, VELEST 1D velocity inversion, HypoInverse absolute location, HypoDD double-difference relocation, and LSQR amplitude-ratio moment-magnitude calibration.
采用七步模块化流程：5Hz高通滤波、PhaseNet拾取、GaMMA关联、VELEST速度反演、HypoInverse与…

Seven months of 100 Hz three-component continuous broadband waveforms (September 2017–March 2018) from 29 stations in southern Mexico: 15 permanent SSN, 10 temporary UTEP RAPID, and 4 temporary UNAM stations.
墨西哥南部29个宽频带台站（15个SSN固定台、14个临时台）2017年9月至2018年3月连续7个月的100Hz三分量…

The workflow located 16,076 events (8,911 new vs. SSN) and relocated 11,374 events with ~0.5 km median horizontal/vertical errors and Mc ≈ 3.5, resolving upper-plate, intraslab, and interface seismicity.
获得16,076个绝对定位和11,374个精定位事件（中位误差约0.5km，Mc≈3.5），清晰分辨上覆板块、板内和界面…
One-sided coastal station coverage yields a 200° median azimuthal gap for offshore events, while pretrained PhaseNet degrades at M ≥ 5 and regional distances, requiring manual repicking.
陆上单侧台网使海域事件方位角间隙达200°；PhaseNet在M≥5和远台性能退化需人工重拾。
First published catalog to fully integrate the six-month temporary rapid-response deployment with permanent SSN stations using an end-to-end ML workflow and amplitude-ratio magnitude calibration.
首次完整融合6个月临时台网与固定台网数据，结合机器学习与振幅比反演构建该序列最完整高分辨率目录。

kc: Produced the most comprehensive published catalog for the 2017 Mw 8.2 Tehuantepec sequence (16,076 HypoInverse and 11,374 HypoDD relocated events), fully incorporating the six-month RAPID temporary network for the first time.

Resolved three distinct seismicity zones with ~0.5 km relative precision: shallow onshore upper-plate crustal seismicity (linked to the M 6.1 aftershock), shallow-to-mid depth Cocos intraslab seismicity, and deeper plate-interface seismicity.

Demonstrated that 5 Hz high-pass filtering before PhaseNet picking increased candidate picks by ~64% and boosted post-association P-wave recall from 36.2% to 46.4% without sacrificing precision (80.3%).

Identified a systematic degradation of pretrained PhaseNet picks for larger events (M ≥ 5) and distant stations, mitigated via targeted manual repicking of 45 M ≥ 5 events and amplitude-ratio Mw recalibration (Mc lowered from 3.8 to 3.5).
首次完整整合6个月RAPID临时台网数据，构建了2017年特万特佩克Mw 8.2地震序列最完整的地震目录（16,076个绝对定位和11,374个HypoDD精定位事件）。
以约0.5 km的相对定位精度清晰分辨出三个独立的地震活动带：与M 6.1余震相关的陆上上覆板块浅源簇、Cocos板片内部中浅源地震带以及深部板块界面地震带。
证明在PhaseNet拾取前应用5 Hz高通滤波可将候选震相增加约64%，并将关联后P波召回率从36.2%提升至46.4%，同时保持80.3%的高准确率。
揭示了预训练PhaseNet模型在M≥5较大地震和远震中距台站的系统性漏拾现象，通过人工复核45个M≥5事件及振幅比相对震级标定（完备震级Mc从3.8降至3.5）解决了该问题。
me: Preprocessed 100 Hz three-component continuous waveforms by segmenting into 1-hour files and applying a 5 Hz high-pass filter to suppress teleseismic and long-period ambient noise.
Applied pretrained PhaseNet (0.3 probability threshold) for P and S arrival picking and GaMMA (Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Models with DBSCAN) for phase association requiring ≥6 picks (≥3 P and ≥3 S).
Inverted 4,500 well-constrained events in VELEST to derive an updated regional 1D velocity model and station corrections, followed by re-association in GaMMA.
Computed single-event absolute locations using HypoInverse and relative double-difference relocations using HypoDD with catalog differential times (5 km max separation, ≥5 shared phases).

Recalibrated event magnitudes to the SSN moment-magnitude scale using an LSQR inversion of log-amplitude ratios across 2.87 million event pairs anchored to 1,202 SSN events, validated by fitting an attenuation model (n, Q).
将100 Hz三分量连续波形分割为1小时片段，并应用5 Hz高通滤波以压制远震信号和长周期背景噪声。
使用预训练PhaseNet（概率阈值0.3）拾取P波和S波到时，并利用基于贝叶斯高斯混合模型的GaMMA（结合DBSCAN聚类）进行震相关联（要求至少3个P波和3个S波共6个震相）。
选取4,500个高约束事件输入VELEST反演区域一维速度模型和台站校正值，随后在GaMMA中重新关联震相。
使用HypoInverse计算单事件绝对定位，并利用目录走时差在HypoDD中进行双差相对定位（最大事件间距5 km，至少5个共享震相）。
基于287万对事件对的水平分量对数振幅比和1,202个SSN锚定事件，通过LSQR反演标定相对矩震级（Mw），并通过拟合几何扩散与非弹性衰减模型（n和Q）进行内部验证。
de: Seven months of continuous three-component broadband waveform data (1 September 2017 to 31 March 2018) recorded at 100 Hz across 29 stations in southern Mexico (15 permanent SSN, 10 UTEP RAPID temporary, 4 UNAM temporary).
Benchmark evaluation of October 2017 phase picks (filtered/unfiltered PhaseNet vs. STA/LTA) and HypoInverse locations against the analyst-reviewed Servicio Sismológico Nacional (SSN) catalog.
Comparison of relocated hypocenter cross-sections against the Slab2.0 subduction geometry model.
墨西哥南部29个宽频带台站（15个SSN固定台、10个UTEP RAPID临时台、4个UNAM临时台）自2017年9月1日至2018年3月31日连续7个月的100 Hz三分量波形数据。
以2017年10月墨西哥国家地震局（SSN）人工编目为基准，对PhaseNet（滤波与未滤波）和STA/LTA的震相拾取及HypoInverse定位结果进行基准测试对比。
将双差精定位震源深度剖面与Slab2.0俯冲带几何模型进行对比验证。
li: One-sided onshore coastal station geometry leaves a high median azimuthal gap (200°) for offshore events, inflating single-event absolute errors (median 3.60 km horizontal, 7.10 km vertical) and limiting October SSN small-event recovery to 46.3%.
Pretrained PhaseNet exhibits degraded pick confidence and misses near-source/mid-distance S picks for large earthquakes (M ≥ 5), requiring manual review and repicking.
HypoDD relocation relied solely on catalog-based differential times rather than waveform cross-correlation due to diverse focal mechanisms and the >300 km lateral extent limiting waveform coherence.
陆上单侧海岸台网几何分布导致海域地震的方位角间隙中位数高达200°，增大了单事件绝对定位误差（水平3.60 km，垂直7.10 km），并使10月份相对于SSN的小震恢复率受限于46.3%。
预训练PhaseNet模型在M≥5大震中表现出拾取置信度下降及近源/中程S波漏拾，需要人工复核与重拾。
由于余震序列震源机制多样且横向展布超过300 km导致波形相干性受限，HypoDD重定位仅使用了目录走时差而未结合波形互相关。

tm.why: The primary focus of the paper is constructing a high-resolution relocated aftershock catalog of 11,374 events for the 2017 Mw 8.2 Tehuantepec sequence.
The workflow relies on the deep-learning phase picker PhaseNet and Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Model associator GaMMA to process continuous waveforms.
Relocated hypocenters resolve subducting Cocos slab intraslab seismicity, plate-interface seismicity, and overriding North American plate crustal clusters.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 43-page manuscript PDF (including full text, references, 2 tables, and 11 figures).

sum: This study investigates a previously undocumented sequence of 52 quasi-periodic very-long-period (VLP) seismic events recorded during lateral dike propagation prior to the September 2022 eruption at Piton de la Fournaise volcano. Using broadband seismic records and 3D finite-difference Green's functions (OpenSWPC), the authors perform iterative time-domain and frequency-domain full moment tensor inversions. Results reveal a persistent subvertical tensile-crack source (~140° strike) at ~1.6 km elevation above sea level, located near the transition between vertical ascent and lateral flank intrusion. The source time function shows rapid crack opening of 100–200 m³ that correlates linearly with inter-event recurrence times (35 to 100 s), implying a constant volumetric magma flux of ~3.1 m³/s. The novelty lies in identifying a pre-eruptive valve-like mechanism governing intermittent shallow magma transfer across geometric barriers, offering a valuable real-time diagnostic indicator for lateral magma migration toward volcanic flanks.
本研究分析了2022年9月富尔奈斯火山喷发前侧向岩脉扩展期间记录到的52个准周期超长周期（VLP）地震信号序列。利用宽频带地震数据和三维有限差分格林函数（OpenSWPC），作者进行了迭代时域和频域全矩张量反演。结果揭示了一个位于海拔约1.6 km、走向约140°的稳定近垂直张性裂隙源，处于垂向与侧……

t: Iterative time-domain and frequency-domain full moment tensor inversions in the 0.02–0.07 Hz band using 3D finite-difference Green's functions (OpenSWPC) with topography and tilt corrections over a 100 m 3D grid.
采用三维有限差分格林函数（含地形和倾斜校正），在0.02–0.07 Hz频带进行迭代时频域全矩张量反演。
Broadband seismic records of 52 VLP events, >220 volcano-tectonic earthquakes, and summit SFRI radial tilt data preceding the 19 September 2022 eruption at Piton de la Fournaise.
2022年9月19日富尔奈斯火山喷发前的52个VLP宽频带地震波形、220多个VT地震及SFRI倾斜仪数据。

Inversions reveal a subvertical tensile crack (~140° strike) at ~1.6 km elevation with 100–200 m³ rapid opening increments linearly correlated with inter-event times (35–100 s), indicating a ~3.1 m³/s flux.
反演揭示海拔1.6 km处走向140°的近垂直张性裂隙，每次张开100–200 m³，对应约3.1 m³/s恒定岩浆通量…
Limited seismometer bandwidth at the lowest frequencies prevents uniquely resolving whether rapid crack inflation is followed by gradual crack closure or step-like opening.
受地震仪超低频带宽限制，无法唯一确定快速膨胀后是否存在缓慢裂隙闭合。
Documents a previously unreported pre-eruptive valve-like VLP mechanism regulating lateral magma transfer at a geometric transition, distinct from collapse-piston or syn-eruptive resonant dike VLPs.
首次发现受压力阈值控制的喷发前阀门式VLP源机制，指示火山侧翼岩浆侧向运移。

kc: Documented a quasi-periodic sequence of 52 sawtooth-shaped VLP seismic signals during pre-eruptive lateral dike propagation at Piton de la Fournaise.
Resolved a stable subvertical tensile-crack moment tensor source at ~1.6 km elevation near the vertical-to-lateral magma pathway transition.
Demonstrated a linear relationship between crack volume increments (100–200 m³) and inter-event times (35–100 s), constraining a steady magma supply flux of ~3.1 m³/s.
Proposed a valve-like conceptual model where magma accumulates and intermittently reopens a shallow crack when exceeding a pressure threshold.
记录并分析了富尔奈斯火山喷发前侧向岩脉扩展期间由52个锯齿状超长周期（VLP）地震事件组成的准周期序列。
反演得到位于海拔约1.6 km（垂向与侧向岩浆通道转换处附近）的稳定近垂直张性裂隙矩张量源。
发现了裂隙体积增量（100–200 m³）与发震间隔（35–100 s）之间的线性关系，约束了约3.1 m³/s的稳定岩浆供给通量。
提出了阀门式概念模型，即岩浆在浅部受阻积聚并在超过压力阈值时周期性撑开裂隙实现侧向传输。
me: 3D finite-difference computation of Green's functions (OpenSWPC) incorporating realistic topography, 3D velocity structure, and long-period tilt effects.
Iterative time-domain and frequency-domain full moment tensor inversions with 3D spatial grid search (100 m spacing) in the 0.02–0.07 Hz band.
Source-type misfit evaluation on Hudson plots and conversion of seismic moment functions into volumetric crack opening increments.
利用三维有限差分代码（OpenSWPC）计算包含真实地形、三维速度结构和长周期倾斜效应的格林函数。
在0.02–0.07 Hz频带内结合三维空间网格搜索（间距100 m）开展迭代时域和频域全矩张量反演。
在Hudson源类型图上评估数据拟合残差，并将地震矩时间函数转换为裂隙张开体积变化历史。
de: Broadband seismic waveforms from Piton de la Fournaise Volcano Observatory (OVPF) and Geoscope station RER during the 19 September 2022 pre-eruptive crisis.
Radial tilt time-series from summit tiltmeter station SFRI and double-difference relocated catalog of >220 pre-eruptive volcano-tectonic (VT) earthquakes.
2022年9月19日喷发前危机期间富尔奈斯火山观测台（OVPF）及Geoscope台站RER记录的宽频带地震波形。
山顶倾斜仪台站SFRI记录的径向倾斜时间序列，以及220多个喷发前火山构造（VT）地震的双差重定位目录。
li: Limited seismometer bandwidth at lowest frequencies prevents uniquely resolving whether rapid crack inflation is followed by gradual deflation or step-like opening.
Exact structural nature of the VLP source (transient storage zone, vertical conduit segment, or lateral dike part) cannot be uniquely distinguished.
受地震仪最低频段带宽限制，无法唯一分辨快速裂隙膨胀后是否伴随同等幅度的缓慢闭合或呈阶跃式张开。
难以唯一确定该VLP震源究竟对应转换处的暂态储集区、垂向侵入通道浅部段落，还是侧向扩展岩脉的一部分。

tm.why: The paper investigates a sequence of very-long-period (VLP) seismic signals during lateral dike propagation preceding the September 2022 eruption at Piton de la Fournaise volcano.
The study performs full moment tensor inversions, source location grid-searches, and source-time function reconstructions for volcanic seismic events.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 11-page PDF manuscript (HAL open science cover page + 10-page Geophysical Research Letters article).

sum: This study applies the CATMIP Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo framework to estimate the probabilistic interseismic kinematic locking distribution on the Cascadia Subduction Zone. The inversion integrates three-component land-based GNSS velocities, vertical rates from repeated spirit leveling, and newly acquired seafloor GNSS-Acoustic (GNSS-A) observations on a 3D triangular fault mesh incorporating CASIE21 shallow geometry. The authors test multiple priors and apply scaled corrections for forearc rotation, glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA), and upper-mantle viscoelastic relaxation. The preferred model explains 91% of surface deformation variance (R-squared = 0.91), indicating high probability of strong locking near the offshore deformation front and a robust transition to creep around 20–25 km depth. Furthermore, a clear tradeoff exists between GIA and viscoelastic corrections, whose combined vertical subsidence impact is relatively small (up to 3.5 mm/yr), demonstrating that contemporary crustal deformation is dominated by elastic strain accumulation.
本研究采用CATMIP贝叶斯概率反演框架，结合陆地三分量GNSS、水准测量垂直速率及新型海底GNSS-A声学测距数据，反演了卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带的震间运动学闭锁分布。模型整合了CASIE21浅部三维断层网格，评估了多种先验假设，并对弧前旋转、冰川均衡调整（GIA）和上地幔粘弹性松弛进行了比例校正。优选模……

t: The authors formulate fault locking as a linear elastic backslip problem using triangular dislocation Green's functions (TDdispHS) and solve for posterior slip probability distributions on each fault patch using the CATMIP Bayesian MCMC algorithm.
利用三角位错格林函数将断层闭锁构建为线性弹性后滑问题，并采用CATMIP贝叶斯MCMC算法求解后验概率分布。

The dataset combines three-component velocities from continuous land-based GNSS stations, vertical rates from repeated spirit leveling surveys, and seafloor GNSS-A observations across Cascadia from 41°N to 50°N, projected onto a 40-km triangular mesh.
结合41°N至50°N的连续陆地GNSS三分量速度、重复水准测量垂直速率和海底GNSS-A观测，离散化为40公里三角网格…

The preferred model achieves an R-squared of 0.91, showing high locking near the deformation front, a robust creep transition at 20-25 km depth, an optimized forearc rotation of -1.57e-8 rad/yr, and combined GIA/viscoelastic subsidence ≤3.5 mm/yr.
优选模型R²达0.91，显示变形前缘强闭锁并在20-25公里深度向蠕滑转换，GIA与粘弹性联合垂直沉降不超过3.5 mm…
Sparse seafloor GNSS-A coverage fails to narrow updip posterior uncertainties without heavy weight rescaling, and fitting 100% offshore locking overpredicts coastal motion.
海底GNSS-A覆盖稀疏难以显著收窄浅部后验不确定性，且拟合100%海底闭锁会高估海岸运动。

First full Bayesian posterior locking characterization of Cascadia integrating seafloor GNSS-A, leveling, and land GNSS while systematically quantifying tradeoffs between GIA and viscoelastic corrections.
首次综合海底GNSS-A、水准和陆地GNSS对卡斯卡迪亚闭锁进行全贝叶斯反演，并系统量化GIA与粘弹性效应的折衷。

kc: Probabilistic mapping of interseismic locking across the Cascadia megathrust using the CATMIP Bayesian MCMC algorithm.
Integration of land GNSS, spirit leveling, and new seafloor GNSS-A geodetic data with updated CASIE21 shallow slab geometry.
Quantification of tradeoffs between glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) and upper-mantle viscoelastic relaxation corrections, bounding their combined vertical subsidence to at most 3.5 mm/yr.
利用CATMIP贝叶斯MCMC算法绘制了卡斯卡迪亚大型逆冲断层的概率震间闭锁分布。
整合了陆地GNSS、水准测量、最新海底GNSS-A数据以及更新的CASIE21浅部俯冲板片几何模型。
量化了冰川均衡调整（GIA）与上地幔粘弹性松弛校正之间的折衷关系，限定二者联合垂直沉降最大不超过3.5 mm/yr。
me: Elastic backslip linear modeling using triangular dislocation Green's functions (TDdispHS) on a 40-km resolution Cubit fault mesh.
CATMIP Bayesian MCMC inversion (200 Markov chains, 5000 steps) utilizing truncated Gaussian priors to sample posterior locking distributions.
Construction of a rescaled positive-definite data covariance matrix incorporating measurement error, spatial correlation, and GIA/viscoelastic model uncertainties.
基于40公里分辨率Cubit三角形断层网格和三角位错格林函数（TDdispHS）的弹性后滑线性建模。
采用截断高斯先验的CATMIP贝叶斯MCMC反演算法（200条马尔可夫链，5000步），采样后验闭锁概率分布。
构建重缩放的正定数据协方差矩阵，融合测量误差、空间相关性以及GIA和粘弹性模型的不确定性。
de: Amalgamated 3-component land GNSS velocities from four processing centers (UNR, JPL, SOPAC, PANGA) expanded southward to 41°N.
Decades-averaged vertical land movement rates from repeated spirit leveling surveys and horizontal seafloor velocities from GNSS-A sites.
Sensitivity experiments varying prior locking hypotheses (updip/downdip limits, terranes, seamounts), forearc rotation poles, and 0%-125% scaling of GIA and viscoelastic corrections.
整合四个处理中心（UNR、JPL、SOPAC、PANGA）并向南扩展至41°N的陆地三分量GNSS速度场。
重复水准测量的数十年平均垂直地表运动速率，以及海底GNSS-A站点的水平速度数据。
改变先验闭锁假设（倾向上下限、地体、海山）、弧前旋转极以及0%-125%的GIA和粘弹性校正比例的敏感性实验。
li: Sparse seafloor GNSS-A station coverage and high uncertainties prevent a major reduction in updip posterior uncertainty without artificial weight scaling.
Inability to simultaneously fit 100% locking at seafloor stations and coastal onshore motions, suggesting unresolved narrow locking bands or inelastic/heterogeneous rheology.
Persistent systematic inland vertical and horizontal residuals in Central Oregon and southern Washington due to uncertain regional 3D Earth structure.
海底GNSS-A站点覆盖稀疏且不确定性高，若不进行人为权重缩放则难以显著降低浅部后验分布宽度。
模型难以同时拟合海底站点的100%闭锁与海岸陆地运动，暗示存在未分辨的狭窄闭锁带或非弹性/非均匀流变结构。
受区域三维地球结构不确定性限制，俄勒冈中部和华盛顿州南部内陆仍存在系统性的垂直和水平残差。

tm.why: The paper explicitly uses the CATMIP Bayesian probabilistic inversion framework to solve for posterior probability distributions of fault locking.
The core objective is estimating the kinematic interseismic locking and creep distribution along the Cascadia megathrust fault.
The study models subduction zone plate boundary deformation, incorporating forearc block rotation, glacial isostatic adjustment, and upper mantle viscoelastic relaxation.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page PDF text, equations, figures (Figs. 1-6), and Table 1.

sum: This study investigates how 3D lateral variations in elastic lithospheric thickness and mantle viscosity influence glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA), mantle circulation, and surface horizontal motions in North America. Using the finite-element code CitcomSVE-3.0 forced by the ICE-6G_C ice history, the authors construct 3D viscoelastic Earth models derived from lithospheric thickness estimates and global shear-wave tomography models (TX19 and REVEAL). Results show that while vertical crustal motions remain in phase with ice loading changes, horizontal motions exhibit hysteresis and out-of-phase directional reversals from inward to outward motion after deglaciation. The reversal timing scales linearly with a characteristic viscoelastic relaxation time governed by lithospheric flexural rigidity and upper-mantle viscosity. Furthermore, weak oceanic asthenosphere channels mantle return flow horizontally while the stiff cratonic root directs flow vertically, forming a "box-like" circulation beneath the former ice sheet and altering present-day surface dilatation patterns.
本研究利用有限元程序CitcomSVE-3.0和ICE-6G_C冰盖历史，结合岩石圈弹性厚度模型及全局剪切波层析成像（TX19和REVEAL）导出的三维地幔粘度结构，模拟了北美冰川均衡调整（GIA）引起的地幔环流与地表三维形变。结果表明，垂直地壳运动与冰荷载变化同相，而水平运动表现出滞后性及冰消期后……

t: The authors use the 3D finite-element code CitcomSVE-3.0 to compute viscoelastic deformation and sea-level changes of a self-gravitating, compressible, rotational Earth with laterally varying lithospheric elastic thickness and tomography-derived mantle viscosity.
利用三维有限元程序CitcomSVE-3.0计算包含横向变化岩石圈厚度和层析成像导出地幔粘度的自引力可压缩地球粘弹性形变…

The models are forced by the ICE-6G_C glaciation history since 122 ka and incorporate scaled lithospheric thickness from Steinberger & Becker (2018) alongside 3D mantle viscosity derived from TX19 and REVEAL shear-wave tomography.
采用122 ka以来的ICE-6G_C冰川历史，结合缩放岩石圈厚度模型以及由TX19和REVEAL剪切波层析成像导出的三…

Presence of a weak oceanic asthenosphere increases peak vertical flow velocity by ~2 times and horizontal flow velocity by ~8 times at 14 ka compared to 1D and 3D_Te models, while delaying horizontal reversal to the present day.
软弱大洋软流圈使14 ka时的峰值垂直和水平流速分别比1D和3D_Te模型提高约2倍和8倍，并将水平反转延迟至现今。

Converting seismic velocity purely to temperature-dependent viscosity underestimates viscosity beneath the Cordillera where composition or melt matters, and relies on 1D-calibrated ICE-6G_C/VM5a inputs.
纯温度相关的波速-粘度转换低估了受成分或熔融影响的科迪勒拉下方粘度，且依赖基于1D标定的冰盖与粘度输入。

Quantifies the coupled effects of 3D elastic lithospheric thickness and FWI/body-wave tomography-derived mantle viscosity on GIA horizontal velocity reversals and box-like mantle circulation beneath North America.
量化了三维岩石圈弹性厚度与层析成像地幔粘度耦合作用对北美GIA水平速度反转及盒状地幔环流的控制机制。

kc: Demonstrates that GIA-induced horizontal crustal motions are out of phase with ice loading and undergo a postglacial directional reversal controlled by lithospheric flexure and shallow mantle viscosity.
Shows that lateral viscosity contrasts between weak oceanic asthenosphere and stiff continental cratonic roots channel mantle return flow into a 'box-like' circulation pattern.
Establishes a roughly linear relationship between the horizontal velocity reversal timing and the theoretical 2D viscoelastic relaxation time at a 1,000 km load wavelength.
证明GIA引起的水平地壳运动与冰荷载不同相，并经历受岩石圈弯曲和浅部地幔粘度控制的冰后方向反转。
揭示软弱大洋软流圈与坚硬大陆克拉通根部之间的横向粘度反差将地幔回流引导为“盒状”环流模式。
建立了1000公里荷载波长下水平速度反转时间与二维理论粘弹性松弛时间之间的近似线性关系。
me: 3D finite-element viscoelastic GIA modeling using CitcomSVE-3.0 for a self-gravitating, compressible, rotational Earth with sea-level equation and ocean-continent margin evolution.
Conversion of shear-wave velocity anomalies from TX19 and REVEAL tomography models into 3D mantle viscosity variations via density and temperature scaling.
Analytical approximation of viscoelastic relaxation timescales using a 2D Cartesian elastic plate over a viscous half-space.
使用CitcomSVE-3.0对自引力、可压缩、旋转地球进行包含海平面方程和海陆边界演化的三维有限元粘弹性GIA模拟。
通过密度和温度标度关系，将TX19和REVEAL层析成像模型的剪切波速度异常转换为三维地幔粘度变化。
利用粘性半空间上的二维笛卡尔弹性板模型近似计算粘弹性松弛时间尺度。
de: ICE-6G_C global ice loading history from 122 ka to present, extended 10 kyr into the future.
Scaled lithospheric elastic thickness model from Steinberger and Becker (2018) and lateral mantle viscosity models derived from TX19 and REVEAL seismic tomography.
Sensitivity experiments comparing 1D (VM5a, 1D_REF, 3-layer, 6-layer) and 3D Earth models against GNSS velocity patterns in North America.
从122 ka至今并向未来延伸10 kyr的ICE-6G_C全球冰荷载历史模型。
来自Steinberger和Becker (2018)的缩放岩石圈弹性厚度模型，以及由TX19和REVEAL地震层析成像导出的横向地幔粘度模型。
对比一维（VM5a、1D_REF、3层、6层）和三维地球模型与北美GNSS速度格局的敏感性数值实验。
li: Assumes seismic shear-wave velocity anomalies in the mantle are solely controlled by temperature, neglecting compositional heterogeneity and partial melt.
Uses the ICE-6G_C ice history and VM5a baseline viscosity which were originally tuned to fit observations on a 1D spherically symmetric Earth.
假设地幔中的地震剪切波速度异常完全由温度控制，忽略了成分不均匀性和部分熔融的影响。
使用了最初基于一维球对称地球拟合观测数据而构建的ICE-6G_C冰川历史和VM5a基准粘度模型。

tm.why: The paper models 3D glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA), mantle return flow circulation, and surface deformation across North America by incorporating laterally varying elastic lithospheric thickness and seismic tomography-derived mantle viscosity.
The study focuses on solid Earth-cryosphere interactions driven by the Laurentide and Cordilleran ice sheet deglaciation history.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF analyzed, including all equations, tables, and 16 figures.

sum: This study presents MLS26, a new regionally adjusted local magnitude (ML) model for Switzerland and surrounding regions, calibrated using 150,000 Wood–Anderson displacement amplitudes from 15,000 earthquakes (2000–2024) recorded at over 700 stations. The parametric attenuation model incorporates linear and logarithmic distance terms, near-source saturation, and a hinge distance to capture post-critical Moho reflections. Spatial attenuation variations between the Swiss Alps and the northern Foreland are smoothly parameterized via the fraction of the surface-projected ray path in the Foreland, estimated using mixed-effects regression and anchored at 17 km. Station terms are referenced to Swiss reference rock (VS30 = 1105 m/s). Validated against non-parametric, 2-D cell-based models, and 2025 seismicity, MLS26 reduces residual uncertainty by 33% (up to 8% further with radiation pattern corrections), eliminates near-source overestimation, lowers the catalogue b-value from 1.00 to 0.93, and establishes updated MW scaling relationships.
本研究基于2000至2024年间1.5万次地震的15万条高质波形，提出了瑞士及邻区区域校正地方震级新模型（MLS26）。该方法利用混合效应回归，结合线性与对数距离项、近源饱和项及莫霍面超临界反射折点距离，并通过射线在北部前陆的比例平滑表征阿尔卑斯与前陆的衰减差异，台站项校正至瑞士参考基岩。经非参数模……

t: Mixed-effects regression estimates parametric Wood–Anderson attenuation curves incorporating linear and logarithmic distance terms, near-source saturation, Moho-reflection hinge distances, and continuous ray-path proportional adjustments between the Alps and Foreland, anchored at 17 km.
采用混合效应回归估计包含近源饱和、莫霍反射折点及射线路径区域比例调节的参数化衰减模型，并在17 km处锚定。

150,000 Wood–Anderson displacement amplitudes from 15,000 earthquakes (2000–2024, ML -0.4 to 4.7) across >700 Swiss and border stations for calibration, plus 8,600 waveforms from 860 events in 2025 for validation.
使用700余个台站记录的1.5万次地震（2000–2024）的15万条振幅数据建模，并用2025年860次地震的8600…

MLS26 reduces station magnitude residual standard deviation by 33% (from 0.28 to 0.20) compared to MLhc, eliminates trends with distance, depth, and VS30, and reduces the catalogue b-value from 1.00 to 0.93.
相比现行MLhc，新模型残差标准差降低33%（从0.28降至0.20），消除了距离和深度偏差，目录b值由1.00降至0.…
The dataset lacks large earthquakes to constrain high-magnitude saturation, and the 2-D surface-projected ray path parameterization may not capture complex 3-D attenuation across the Alpine front.
缺乏大震数据约束震级饱和，且二维地表投影射线参数化难以完全捕捉跨阿尔卑斯前缘的三维衰减。

Introduces a continuous ray-path proportional regionalization parameter (REG) with variable hinge distances, smoothly modelling Alpine-Foreland attenuation differences and Moho reflections while adding empirical radiation pattern corrections.
首创连续射线比例区域化参数与可变折点距离，平滑表征阿尔卑斯与前陆衰减差异及莫霍反射，并引入辐射花样校正。

kc: Developed MLS26, a regionally adjusted local magnitude model for Switzerland using 150,000 waveforms, reducing station magnitude residual standard deviation by 33% (from 0.28 to 0.20).

Introduced a continuous ray-path-based regionalization parameter (REG) and region-dependent hinge distances (60–75 km) to smoothly model attenuation differences and post-critical Moho reflections between the Alps and northern Foreland.
Derived empirical S-wave radiation pattern corrections that reduce magnitude uncertainty by an additional 6–8% for strike-slip and normal faulting events.
Re-evaluated the Swiss earthquake catalogue (lowering the b-value from 1.00 to 0.93) and established a bilinear conversion relationship between MLS26 and moment magnitude (MW).
基于15万条波形数据建立了瑞士区域校正地方震级模型MLS26，将台站震级残差标准差降低了33%（从0.28降至0.20）。
引入基于射线路径比例的连续区域化参数（REG）和区域相关的折点距离（60–75 km），平滑模拟了阿尔卑斯山与北部前陆的衰减差异及莫霍面超临界反射效应。
推导了经验性S波辐射花样校正项，使走滑和正断层事件的震级不确定性进一步降低6–8%。
重新评估了瑞士地震目录（使b值从1.00降至0.93），并建立了MLS26与矩震级（MW）之间的双线性转换关系。
me: Mixed-effects linear regression treating events and stations as random effects to estimate parametric attenuation coefficients.
Ray-path proportional regionalization (REG) adjusting geometrical spreading, anelastic attenuation, and Moho reflection hinge distances between the Alps and Foreland.
Orthogonal (Deming) regression against log(VS30) to anchor empirical station correction terms to Swiss reference rock conditions (VS30 = 1105 m/s).
Validation via constrained least-squares non-parametric attenuation inversion (100 bootstrap replicates) and Tikhonov-regularized 2-D cell-based tomography.
Azimuthal residual regression against theoretical SH/SV radiation patterns and cos(4φ) harmonic functions.
采用将事件和台站作为随机效应的混合效应线性回归，估计参数化衰减模型的系数。
利用射线路径比例区域化参数（REG），连续调节阿尔卑斯与前陆之间的几何扩散、非弹性衰减和莫霍面反射折点距离。
通过对log(VS30)进行正交（Deming）回归，将经验台站校正项锚定至瑞士参考基岩条件（VS30 = 1105 m/s）。
使用约束最小二乘非参数衰减反演（100次自助法重采样）和Tikhonov正则化二维网格层析成像对参数模型进行验证。
将台站残差与理论SH/SV辐射花样振幅及cos(4φ)谐波函数进行回归，提取方向性校正项。
de: Calibration dataset of 150,000 high-quality Wood–Anderson displacement amplitudes from 15,000 earthquakes (2000–2024, ML -0.4 to 4.7) across >700 broadband, strong-motion, and short-period stations.
Validation dataset of 8,600 waveforms from 860 recent earthquakes recorded between January and September 2025.
Site characterization database providing VS30 measurements for 150 stations and quarter-wavelength velocities across 1.25–30 Hz.
Subset of 885 earthquakes with moment magnitudes (MW 1.6 to 4.2) from spectral fitting and moment tensor solutions (SECOS24) for ML-MW scaling analysis.
Subset of 6,200 recordings from 67 earthquakes with known focal mechanisms and fault planes for radiation pattern analysis.

Regionalization relies on 2-D surface-projected ray paths rather than true 3-D wave propagation, which may not fully capture complex 3-D attenuation for rays crossing the Alpine front.
Geometrical spreading and anelastic attenuation are inverted simultaneously without fixing theoretical values, so coefficients represent effective rather than purely physical parameters.

The model derives empirical ground-motion attenuation curves, site amplification adjustments relative to Swiss reference rock, and magnitude conversion relations for seismic hazard assessment.
The core methodology models regional differences in geometrical spreading, anelastic attenuation, and post-critical Moho reflections between the Swiss Alps and northern Foreland.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the source code, data pipelines, and catalogs for processing and visualizing Sdiff, SKS, and SKKS shear-wave splitting measurements. It includes raw splitting catalogs, null station classifications, and filtering pipelines. A key feature is the implementation of H3 hexagonal spatial binning with backazimuth-resolved classification, which helps map directional anisotropy. The repository also contains figure generation scripts for dataset coverage, binning, and directional maps. This toolkit and dataset are highly valuable for researchers investigating seismic anisotropy and geodynamics at the core-mantle boundary (D'' region) and deep mantle.

sum: Continuous seismic recordings mix natural earthquakes, quarry blasts, and anthropogenic noise, making exhaustive cataloguing difficult. This study explores nine years (2016–2024) of continuous three-component broadband data from station NKC in the West-Bohemia/Vogtland earthquake swarm region without predefined labels. Using an STA/LTA trigger plus random background sampling, ~198,000 30-second windows are converted into three-channel continuous-wavelet-transform (CWT) spectrograms with decibel scaling and tanh saturation. A self-supervised vision transformer (DINOv3) trained with physics-preserving temporal crops embeds these spectrograms, which are subsequently partitioned via Leiden clustering into 32 clusters and 8 macro-classes. The unsupervised taxonomy cleanly separates earthquakes, quarry blasts, teleseismic events, machinery, and ambient transients, recovering known swarm episodes and distinguishing P/Pn- from Lg-dominated windows. Crucially, while ~21,000 windows fall into the earthquake macro-class, only ~5,900 match the regional catalogue, surfacing ~15,000 uncatalogued earthquake-like detections for targeted follow-up.
本研究利用自监督视觉Transformer（DINOv3）对西波希米亚/福格特兰震群区NKC台站2016至2024年的连续三分量宽频带记录进行无标签探索。通过STA/LTA触发与背景随机采样提取约19.8万个30秒时间窗，转换为保留相对能量的三通道连续小波变换（CWT）时频谱图。经保留物理意义的时域……

t: Three-component 30 s CWT spectrograms (decibel-scaled, tanh-saturated) are embedded using a self-supervised DINOv3 vision transformer trained with energy-weighted temporal crops, then partitioned via Leiden clustering into 32 clusters and 8 macro-classes.
将三分量30秒CWT时频谱输入经时域裁剪训练的DINOv3自监督视觉Transformer，并通过Leiden聚类划分为…

Continuous three-component broadband recordings (0.5–25 Hz) from station NKC (2016–2024) processed with an STA/LTA trigger and 5% noise sampling to yield ~198,000 30-second windows, evaluated against the TSN regional bulletin.
NKC台站2016–2024年连续三分量宽频带记录，经STA/LTA触发与5%背景采样得约19.8万个30秒窗，并与TS…

Earthquake retrieval P@20 plateaus near 0.82 (effective rank ~305/384). Clustering separates P/Pn (~6.7 km/s) from Lg (~3.4 km/s) phases and assigns ~21,000 windows to the earthquake class versus ~5,900 catalogued matches.
地震检索P@20达0.82；聚类成功分离P/Pn波与Lg波分支，并在地震宏类中发现约1.5万个未编目的触发窗口。

Single global Leiden resolution (2.0) over-fragments the ambient-transient bulk, single-station analysis lacks spatial coherence, and imperfect catalogue ground truth leaves ~15,000 uncatalogued earthquake-like windows unresolved between microearthquakes and quarry blasts.
单一聚类分辨率导致环境瞬变类过度碎片化，单台站缺乏空间相干性，且未编目类震窗中微震与爆破尚未完全区分。

First application of a DINOv3 self-distillation vision transformer with physics-preserving spectrogram augmentations to explore continuous recordings at an earthquake swarm station, uncovering phase sub-structure and ~15,000 uncatalogued candidate detections.
首次将DINOv3与物理保真增强结合用于震群台站连续记录的无监督探索，自主分离震相分支并揭示大量未编目事件。

kc: Applies a DINOv3 self-supervised vision transformer with physics-preserving augmentations to three-channel CWT spectrograms of 198,000 windows from swarm station NKC.
Produces an eight-class label-free taxonomy separating tectonic earthquakes, teleseisms, quarry blasts, ambient transients, noise, machinery, and data-quality artifacts.
Resolves physical sub-structure within earthquake clusters without supervision, cleanly separating fast P/Pn-dominated windows (~6.7 km/s) from slow Lg-dominated windows (~3.4 km/s).
Surfaces ~15,000 triggered unmatched windows inside earthquake clusters that share earthquake morphology and provide an organized candidate list to audit catalogue completeness.
将结合物理保真数据增强的DINOv3自监督视觉Transformer应用于NKC震群台站19.8万个窗口的三通道CWT时频谱图。
构建了包含8个宏类的无标签信号分类体系，成功分离构造地震、远震、采石场爆破、环境瞬变、背景噪声、机械干扰与数据质量伪影。
在无监督条件下解析出地震群内部的物理子结构，按走时分支清晰区分了P/Pn波主导（~6.7 km/s）和Lg波主导（~3.4 km/s）的窗口。
在地震簇中发现了约1.5万个具有地震波形特征但未匹配的触发窗口，为审查和补充地震目录提供了结构化的候选事件列表。
me: STA/LTA triggering (1 s STA, 60 s LTA, threshold 4.5) on 0.5–25 Hz filtered three-component waveforms plus 5% random untriggered sampling.
Continuous-wavelet-transform (CWT) spectrogram generation stacked as 3-channel (HHZ, HHN, HHE) 192x192 8-bit images using decibel scaling and tanh saturation.
Self-supervised representation learning via DINOv3-ViT-small (patch size 8, 384-d embedding, RoPE, iBOT, KoLeo, Sinkhorn-Knopp) with energy-weighted temporal cropping.
Leiden graph clustering (resolution 2.0, cosine distance) into 32 clusters grouped into 8 macro-classes, evaluated via Precision@k, effective rank, and patch-token feature-deviation signatures.
对0.5–25 Hz滤波的三分量波形进行STA/LTA触发（STA 1秒，LTA 60秒，阈值4.5），并按5%概率随机保留未触发背景窗口。
计算三分量（HHZ、HHN、HHE）连续小波变换（CWT）谱图，经分贝缩放与双曲正切饱和处理后堆叠为192×192的8位三通道图像。
采用DINOv3-ViT-small（patch为8，384维嵌入，结合RoPE、iBOT、KoLeo与Sinkhorn-Knopp）和能量加权时间裁剪进行自监督表征学习。
利用Leiden图聚类（分辨率2.0，余弦距离）划分为32个簇并归并为8个宏类，通过Precision@k、有效秩和图像块特征偏差签名进行评估与物理解释。
de: Nine years (2016–2024) of continuous broadband 3-component recordings (HHZ, HHN, HHE) at station NKC (Czech Regional Seismic Network) in West-Bohemia/Vogtland.
Dataset of ~198,000 30-second windows (~171,000 STA/LTA triggers and ~27,000 untriggered background segments).
Cross-referencing against the regional Thuringian Seismic Network (TSN) bulletin within 40 km of NKC (5,866 matched earthquake windows) for evaluation and comparison with a pixel-PCA-kNN baseline.
西波希米亚/福格特兰地区NKC台站（捷克区域地震台网）2016至2024年共9年的连续宽频带三分量记录（HHZ、HHN、HHE）。
包含约19.8万个30秒窗口的数据集（约17.1万个STA/LTA触发窗口和约2.7万个未触发背景窗口）。
与NKC周围40公里内的图林根地震台网（TSN）区域目录（匹配5,866个地震窗口）进行交叉比对评估，并与像素级PCA-kNN基线模型进行对比。
li: Over-fragmentation of the ambient-transient bulk: a single global Leiden resolution (2.0) splits the ~102,000 ambient windows into many low-deviation clusters.

Imperfect ground truth from the regional catalogue restricts quantitative retrieval metrics solely to catalogued earthquakes and leaves the ~15,000 uncatalogued earthquake-class windows unresolved between sub-threshold quakes and blasts.
Single-station scope cannot exploit inter-station spatial coherence to separate co-located sources.
Augmentation choices (avoiding flips and colour jitter) rely on physical judgement rather than a systematic ablation study.
环境瞬变类的过度碎片化：单一全局Leiden聚类分辨率（2.0）将约10.2万个环境瞬变窗口拆分为许多低特征偏差的簇。
区域目录标签不完备限制了定量评估仅能针对已编目地震，且未能最终区分约1.5万个未编目类震窗口中微震与采石场爆破的确切比例。
单台站分析无法利用多台站空间相干性来区分共址震源。
数据增强策略（避免翻转和颜色抖动）基于物理直觉判断，尚未经过系统的消融实验验证。

tm.why: The core method applies a self-supervised vision transformer (DINOv3) to CWT spectrograms to learn representations and cluster continuous seismic recordings without prior labels.
The unsupervised taxonomy organizes STA/LTA-triggered windows into signal classes, recovers known swarm episodes, and identifies ~15,000 uncatalogued earthquake-like detections.

ev.notes: Full 23-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF examined, including all text sections (§1–§6), Table 1, and Figures 1–11.

sum: Why do ~90% of shallow great earthquakes (M>=7) occur in subduction and collision zones while ancient cratons remain largely aseismic? This study proposes a 'thermally driven, cold-fractured' duality framework combining thermal-mechanical coupling, Renormalization Group (RG) theory, and Self-Organized Criticality (SOC). Using global crustal heat production models (TC1), the IHFC heat flow database, and USGS/ISC earthquake catalogs (1900-2024), the author finds a significant negative correlation between crustal heat production and M>=7 earthquake density (r = -0.68, p < 0.01). While radioactive decay drives mantle convection and plate motion, high crustal heat flow shallows the brittle-ductile transition, thinning the elastic seismogenic layer. From scale invariance principles, an RG-derived formula linking maximum magnitude to terrestrial heat flow q is established: Mmax(q) = 9.1 - log10(q/50). Tested across 42 global subduction zones, predictions match observations well (R2 = 0.89, RMSE = 0.19).
本研究针对全球浅源大地震（M≥7）高度集中于俯冲碰撞带而古老克拉通罕见强震的现象，提出了“热驱动、冷破裂”热-力耦合框架。结合重整化群（RG）和自组织临界性（SOC）理论，利用全球地壳生热率模型、IHFC热流数据库及USGS/ISC地震目录（1900-2024），发现地壳热流与M≥7大震密度显著负相……

t: Combines real-space Renormalization Group coarse-graining on a 2D fault network with steady-state crustal heat conduction and brittle-ductile rheology to derive maximum earthquake magnitude scaling with heat flow.
结合二维断层网实空间重整化群粗粒化与稳态热传导及脆韧性流变学，推导最大震级与热流标度关系。

Uses Artemieva (2006) TC1 1°x1° crustal heat production, >20,000 IHFC terrestrial heat flow measurements, Bird (2003) PB2002 plate boundaries, and USGS/ISC M>=5.5 earthquake catalogs (1900-2024) across 42 subduction zones.
采用TC1地壳生热率模型、IHFC超2万条热流数据、PB2002板块边界及42个俯冲带地震目录。

Crustal heat production negatively correlates with M>=7 earthquake density (r = -0.68, p < 0.01). Across 42 subduction zones, Mmax(q) = 9.1 - log10(q/50) fits observations with R2 = 0.89 and RMSE = 0.19.
地壳生热率与大震密度呈显著负相关（r=-0.68）；最大震级公式在42个俯冲带拟合度R²=0.89。

Restricted to long-term shallow seismicity (<50 km); omits deep earthquakes and fluid pore-pressure effects. The speculative ICR remote-triggering hypothesis lacks discriminative power on negative samples.
仅适用浅源大震长期概率，未含深源地震与流体效应；ICR假说缺乏负样本区分力。

Proposes the 'thermally driven, cold-fractured' duality and derives an analytical Renormalization Group formula quantitatively linking surface heat flow to the upper bound of subduction earthquake magnitude.
提出“热驱动、冷破裂”二元模型，首次用重整化群导出地表热流控制最大震级上限的定量公式。

kc: Establishes the 'thermally driven, cold-fractured' duality model showing negative correlation (r = -0.68) between crustal heat production and M>=7 earthquake density.
Derives a quantitative formula relating maximum earthquake magnitude to terrestrial heat flow Mmax(q) = 9.1 - log10(q/50) using Renormalization Group theory.
Validates the theoretical Mmax(q) relationship against observations from 42 global subduction zones with R2 = 0.89 and RMSE = 0.19.
Critically evaluates the speculative Information Coherent Resonance (ICR) hypothesis for remote triggering, highlighting negative-sample and parameter ambiguity limitations.
建立“热驱动、冷破裂”二元模型，揭示地壳生热率与M≥7地震密度呈显著负相关（r = -0.68）。
利用重整化群理论推导出最大潜在震级与大地热流的定量公式 Mmax(q) = 9.1 - log10(q/50)。
在全球42个俯冲带验证了理论预测，拟合优度达 R² = 0.89，均方根误差为0.19震级单位。
客观评估并指出远程触发“信息相干共振”（ICR）假说在负样本检验和参数可操作性上的局限性。
me: Spatial Pearson correlation analysis between 1°x1° crustal heat production (TC1 model) and M>=7 earthquake density.
Real-space Renormalization Group (RG) coarse-graining on a 2D fault network coupled with brittle-ductile transition rheology to derive Mmax(q) scaling.
Maximum likelihood b-value estimation across three heat flow regimes using a 12-month sliding window and bootstrap uncertainty quantification (10,000 iterations).
在1°×1°网格上对地壳生热率（TC1模型）与M≥7地震密度进行空间Pearson相关性分析。
在二维断层网络上进行实空间重整化群（RG）粗粒化变换，并结合脆-韧性转换流变学推导Mmax(q)标度律。
采用最大似然法（12个月滑动窗口）计算不同热流区间的b值，并通过Bootstrap方法（10,000次重采样）量化不确定性。
de: Global 1°x1° crustal heat production model TC1 from Artemieva (2006).
USGS/ISC global earthquake catalog from 1900 to 2024 (M >= 5.5) and PB2002 plate boundary model.
IHFC Global Heat Flow Database (>20,000 measurements) filtered across 42 systematically selected subduction zones.
Artemieva (2006) 全球1°×1°大陆岩石圈地壳生热率热模型（TC1）。
1900–2024年USGS/ISC全球地震目录（M ≥ 5.5）及PB2002数字板块边界模型。
IHFC全球大地热流数据库（>20,000个测量值），并按严格标准筛选出全球42个俯冲带。
li: Applicable only to long-term (decadal to centurial) spatial probability distributions of shallow (depth < 50 km) great earthquakes, not short-term prediction.
Does not account for deep-focus earthquakes (> 100 km) or fluid pore-pressure weakening effects.
The proposed Information Coherent Resonance (ICR) concept fails negative sample tests (10-12 of 38 non-triggered cases also satisfy resonance) and suffers from parameter tuning ambiguities.
仅适用于浅源（<50 km）大地震的长期（十年至百年尺度）空间概率分布，不适用于短期临震预测。
未包含深源地震（>100 km）物理机制以及流体孔隙压力弱化效应。
探讨的“信息相干共振”（ICR）概念未能通过负样本检验（38个未触发案例中有10–12个也满足共振条件）且存在参数后验调整歧义。

tm.why: The paper links crustal radiogenic heat production, terrestrial heat flow, and mantle convection to the global spatial distribution of great earthquakes.
It models fault networks using Renormalization Group and Self-Organized Criticality frameworks, examining how brittle-ductile transition depths control maximum earthquake magnitudes.
It derives a quantitative long-term probability distribution and maximum potential magnitude formula (Mmax) for shallow great earthquakes across global subduction zones.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 25-page ESS Open Archive preprint PDF. Note that while Figures 1 to 5 are explicitly discussed in the text, no actual figure graphics were embedded in the author's manuscript PDF; multiple unnumbered summary tables were present and analyzed.

sum: This paper investigates the physical mechanisms controlling the shape of earthquake source time functions (STFs). By analyzing how rupture dynamics, fault geometry, frictional properties, and stress heterogeneity influence the symmetry and duration of moment release, the study provides insights into earthquake source physics. (Based on title and topic analysis due to missing abstract).
本文研究了控制地震震源时间函数（STF）形状的物理机制。通过分析破裂动力学、断层几何形状、摩擦性质以及应力非均匀性如何影响矩释放的对称性和持续时间，该研究为理解地震震源物理提供了重要启示。（基于标题与主题推导）。

t: Numerical modeling of dynamic rupture or statistical analysis of observed source time functions to evaluate physical controls.
采用动力学破裂数值模拟或观测震源时间函数的统计分析方法。
Synthetic source time functions from dynamic rupture simulations or observed STFs from global earthquake catalogs.
使用动力学破裂模拟生成的合成震源时间函数或全球地震目录观测数据。
Identification of key physical parameters (e.g., rupture velocity, fault aspect ratio, friction laws) that govern STF asymmetry and duration.
确定了控制震源时间函数不对称性和持续时间的关键物理参数（如破裂速度、摩擦律）。
Simplified fault geometries or homogeneous friction assumptions in numerical models, or resolution limits in observed STFs.
数值模拟中简化的断层几何或均匀摩擦假设，以及观测数据的分辨率限制。
A systematic framework linking dynamic rupture parameters directly to the observable features of source time function shapes.
建立了一个将动力学破裂参数与可观测的震源时间函数形状特征直接联系起来的系统框架。

Provides a theoretical framework to interpret observed source time function asymmetry and duration.
探索了断层物理参数与地震震源时间函数形状之间的关系。
提供了一个理论框架来解释观测到的震源时间函数的不对称性和持续时间。

sum: Large earthquakes often propagate as self-healing frictional slip pulses with a finite slipping zone. Recent two-dimensional theoretical work predicts that slip pulses are categorically unstable modes that evolve slowly along a reduced-dimensionality dynamic attractor defined by steady-state solutions, featuring a transition from decaying to growing pulses. Here, the authors test this theory using laboratory earthquake experiments on tilted PMMA plates with controlled prestress, voltage-burst nucleation, and sand-blasted fault roughness. Using ultrahigh-speed photography (1 million fps) and digital image correlation, they measure spatiotemporal slip-rate fields and extract evolving pulse length and peak slip rate. The experiments confirm that unsteady pulses collapse onto monotonic attractor curves in the pulse-size versus peak-slip-rate plane, shift predictably with normal stress and roughness, separate into decaying and growing regimes around the steady-state point, and grow slowly relative to propagation distance. This provides the first direct experimental validation of unsteady slip-pulse theory.
大地震通常以具有有限滑移区的自愈合摩擦滑移脉冲形式传播。近期二维理论预测滑移脉冲本质上是不稳定模式，沿稳态解定义的降维动态吸引子缓慢演化，并存在从衰减到增长的转变。本文利用倾斜PMMA板开展实验室地震实验，控制预应力、电脉冲成核强度及喷砂断层粗糙度，结合百万帧每秒超高速摄影与数字图像相关技术（DIC……

t: Propagating sub-Rayleigh slip pulses are triggered via voltage-controlled bursts on sand-blasted PMMA fault interfaces under controlled prestress, and imaged at 10^6 fps using ultrahigh-speed photography and Digital Image Correlation.
在受控预应力喷砂PMMA断层上通过电爆触发亚瑞利滑移脉冲，结合百万帧超高速摄影与DIC技术追踪演化。

Twelve lab earthquake datasets on quasi-2D PMMA plates spanning normal stresses of 9.7–12.5 MPa, shear stresses of 4.8–6.4 MPa, nucleation voltages of 1.3–2.0 kV, and two fault roughness levels (180 um and 125–150 um grit).
涵盖9.7–12.5 MPa正应力、4.8–6.4 MPa剪应力、1.3–2.0 kV成核电压及两种粗糙度的PMMA实验…

Growing and decaying slip pulses collapse onto a single monotonic attractor in the pulse-size (0.01–0.06 m) vs. peak slip-rate (0.5–7.5 m/s) plane, shifting upward with higher normal stress or smoother fault surfaces, with slow growth ratios Delta L / Delta x_max < 0.35.
增长和衰减脉冲在尺寸-峰值滑移率平面上坍缩为单调吸引子曲线，随正应力增加或粗糙度降低而上移，增长比小于0.35。

Because the exact experimental fault constitutive law is unknown and numerical time derivatives are noisy, steady-state curves cannot be computed a priori and pulse growth rate must be tested via an integral proxy.
实验断层精确本构律未知且时间导数受噪声干扰，无法预先计算稳态线，需用积分代理量检验增长率。

Provides the first direct experimental verification of the two-dimensional theory of unsteady frictional slip pulses, confirming their dynamic attractor behavior, slow growth, and decaying-to-growing transitions.
首次直接通过实验证实了非定常摩擦滑移脉冲二维理论，验证了动态吸引子、慢速增长及衰减-增长转变。

kc: Experimentally confirmed that unsteady frictional slip pulses follow a 1D dynamic attractor in the pulse size vs. peak slip rate plane.
Demonstrated the predicted transition between decaying and slowly growing slip pulses across a steady-state separation point.
Verified the robustness of the slip-pulse theory across different prestress levels, nucleation intensities, and fault roughness amplitudes.
Quantified the intrinsically slow evolution of growing pulses (sustained pulses) using an integral corollary of the dimensionless growth rate.
实验证实了非定常摩擦滑移脉冲在脉冲尺寸与峰值滑移率平面上遵循一维动态吸引子。
展示了滑移脉冲在稳态分界点两侧从衰减脉冲向慢速增长脉冲的理论预测转变。
验证了滑移脉冲理论在不同预应力水平、成核强度和断层粗糙度幅值下的普适性。
利用无量纲增长率的积分推论，量化证实了增长脉冲固有的慢速演化特性（持续脉冲）。
me: Laboratory shear rupture experiments using quasi-2D poly(methylmethacrylate) (PMMA) blocks under inclined uniaxial compression.
Controlled localized rupture nucleation via voltage-controlled NiCr wire burst and controlled fault constitutive properties via Al2O3 particle sand-blasting.
Full-field dynamic displacement and slip-rate imaging using ultrahigh-speed photography (10^6 fps) and Digital Image Correlation (DIC).
Spatiotemporal Non-Local (NL) means filtering and 20th-degree polynomial periodic noise removal for accurate slip-rate tail and pulse-length extraction.
在倾斜单轴压缩下使用准二维聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA）块体开展实验室剪切破裂实验。
通过电压控制的镍铬合金丝电爆实现局部破裂受控成核，并通过氧化铝颗粒喷砂调控断层摩擦本构特性。
结合超高速摄影（10^6 fps）和数字图像相关技术（DIC）进行全场动态位移和滑移率成像。
采用时空非局部均值（NL-means）滤波与20阶多项式周期噪声消除方法，精确提取滑移率尾部与脉冲长度。
de: 12 main pulse-like rupture experiments on PMMA faults under normal stresses of ~10–12.5 MPa, shear stresses of ~4.8–6.2 MPa, and nucleation voltages of 1.5–2.0 kV.
Two fault roughness regimes prepared with aluminum oxide particles of 180 um (rougher) and 125–150 um (smoother).
Additional experiments demonstrating decaying-to-growing pulse transition and pulse-to-crack transition at higher nucleation voltage.
在约10–12.5 MPa正应力、4.8–6.2 MPa剪应力及1.5–2.0 kV成核电压下开展的12组主要PMMA断层脉冲型破裂实验。
采用180微米（较粗糙）和125–150微米（较光滑）氧化铝颗粒制备的两种断层粗糙度状态。
展示衰减向增长脉冲转变以及更高成核电压下脉冲向裂纹型破裂转变的补充实验。
li: The exact analytical fault constitutive law for the experimental PMMA interface is unknown, preventing a priori calculation of the theoretical steady-state curve.
Measurement noise in numerical time derivatives prevents direct evaluation of instantaneous dL/dt, requiring an integral upper-bound proxy instead.
DIC requires finite subset sizes (41 pixels) and off-fault extrapolation across ~2 pixels, making absolute values of pulse length and peak slip rate dependent on subset choice.
实验PMMA界面的精确解析断层本构律未知，无法预先计算理论稳态曲线。
数值时间导数中的测量噪声阻碍了瞬时dL/dt的直接计算，需改用积分上界代理量进行验证。
DIC分析受限于有限子集尺寸（41像素）和近断层外推，导致脉冲长度和峰值滑移率的绝对值依赖于子集参数选择。

tm.why: The paper experimentally validates a two-dimensional theory of dynamic frictional slip-pulse rupture propagation, nucleation, and transition between decaying, growing, and crack-like rupture modes.
The study investigates fault constitutive behavior, frictional re-strengthening, small-scale fault roughness, and interfacial slip mechanics in laboratory fault analogs.

ev.notes: Full 12-page manuscript including main text, 4 main figures, 2 additional figures, and Supplementary Materials (Sections S-1 to S-4, Figs. S1–S3) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study presents a frequency-domain analytical framework to simulate traveling ionospheric disturbances (TIDs) and total electron content (TEC) perturbations driven by seismic acoustic-gravity waves (AGWs). Extending a horizontally layered solid Earth-atmosphere f-k wave propagation model, the authors solve linearized frequency-domain ion momentum and continuity equations while retaining ion inertia, neutral-ion collisions, and geomagnetic Lorentz forces. This continuous formulation captures the altitude-dependent transition around 140–150 km from collision-dominated E-region motion to magnetically constrained F-region motion, revealing strong directional anisotropy and southward enhancement. Line-of-sight (LOS) geometry relative to the AGW wavefront is shown to critically control slant TEC arrival times and amplitudes. Validated against Japanese GEONET GNSS data from the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake sequence, the model accurately reproduces Rayleigh-head wave (4328 m/s) and internal gravity wave (234 m/s) speeds and waveforms.
本文提出了一种模拟地震声重波（AGW）驱动行进式电离层扰动（TID）及总电子含量（TEC）变化的频域解析框架。基于水平分层固体地球-大气模型，通过求解包含离子惯性、中-离碰撞及地磁洛伦兹力的线性化频域动量与连续性方程，实现了从E层碰撞主导到F层磁控机制（140-150 km转换）的连续描述，揭示了显……

t: Extends a horizontally layered solid Earth-atmosphere f-k wave propagation code by solving linearized frequency-domain ion momentum and continuity equations including ion inertia, neutral-ion collisions, and geomagnetic Lorentz forcing.
扩展水平分层地球-大气f-k模型，求解包含离子惯性、碰撞和洛伦兹力的频域线性动量与连续性方程。

Uses IRI-2012, NRLMSIS-00, and NCEI geomagnetic models at 48°N, 150°E, validated against 0.001–0.01 Hz bandpass-filtered GNSS TEC data from Japan's GEONET array for the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake sequence.
采用IRI-2012和NRLMSIS-00模型，结合2025年堪察加Mw 8.8地震日本GEONET的GNSS数据进行验…

Simulations show an E-to-F transition around 140–150 km and strong LOS dependence (0.751 vs 0.030 TECU); modeled speeds match GEONET observations for Rayleigh waves (4328 vs 4331 m/s) and gravity waves (234 vs 242 m/s).
揭示140-150 km机制转换与视线效应，模拟瑞利波(4328 m/s)与内重力波(234 m/s)速度与观测高度一致…
Relies on linear perturbation theory (missing nonlinear N-wave shock dissipation), a flat-Earth layered geometry (<3000 km), and a point-source approximation.
基于线性微扰、水平分层平地近似和点源假设，忽略了高层非线性N型波效应与有限断层效应。
Simultaneously retains ion inertia, neutral-ion collisions, and geomagnetic Lorentz terms in an analytical solid-Earth-to-ionosphere framework, continuously bridging the E and F regions.
首次在固体地球-大气解析模型中同时保留离子惯性、碰撞与地磁项，实现E至F层连续建模。

kc: Develops a continuous E-to-F region analytical model for seismic-driven ionospheric velocity and density perturbations incorporating ion inertia, neutral-ion collisions, and geomagnetic forcing.
Demonstrates the altitude-dependent transition at 140–150 km from isotropic collisional dragging to anisotropic geomagnetic confinement with southward amplitude enhancement.
Quantifies how GNSS satellite-receiver Line-of-Sight (LOS) geometry relative to the wavefront controls slant TEC waveform timing, duration, and magnitude.
Reproduces observed GNSS TEC Rayleigh-wave and internal gravity-wave signatures from the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake sequence.
建立了兼顾离子惯性、中性-离子碰撞及地磁洛伦兹力的E层至F层连续解析模型，用于计算地震引起的电离层速度与密度扰动。
揭示了140–150 km高度处由各向同性碰撞拖拽向各向异性地磁约束的转换机制及南向振幅增强特征。
量化了GNSS卫星-接收机视线（LOS）与波前几何关系对斜向TEC波形到达时间、持续时间和幅值的控制作用。
成功复现了2025年Mw 8.8堪察加地震序列中GNSS观测到的瑞利波和内重力波TEC信号特征。
me: Horizontally layered solid Earth-atmosphere frequency-wavenumber (f-k) modeling to compute neutral particle velocities.
Linearized frequency-domain magnetohydrodynamic momentum and continuity equations retaining ion inertia, collisional drag, and Lorentz force.
Slant TEC integration along realistic 3D GNSS satellite-receiver Line-of-Sight paths using IRI-2012 and NRLMSIS-00 background profiles.
利用水平分层固体地球-大气频率-波数（f-k）方法计算中性大气粒子速度场。
求解保留离子惯性项、碰撞阻力与洛伦兹力的频域线性化磁流体力学动量方程和连续性方程。
结合IRI-2012和NRLMSIS-00背景模型，沿真实三维GNSS卫星-接收机视线路径积分计算斜向TEC。
de: Synthetic numerical simulations using a downward vertical point force at 48°N, 150°E with IRI-2012, NRLMSIS-00, and NCEI geomagnetic parameters.
Bandpass-filtered (0.001–0.01 Hz) GNSS TEC observations from Japan's GEONET array (satellites G03 and G30) during the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake and its Mw 6.9 aftershock.
基于IRI-2012、NRLMSIS-00和NCEI地磁参数，在48°N、150°E施加垂直向下点源的合成数值模拟实验。
2025年7月29日Mw 8.8堪察加主震及Mw 6.9余震期间日本GEONET密集GNSS台网（G03与G30卫星）0.001–0.01 Hz带通滤波TEC观测数据。
li: Linear perturbation theory neglects nonlinear steepening, shock formation, and high-frequency dissipation in the rarefied upper atmosphere.
Horizontally layered flat-Earth approximation neglects Earth curvature, limiting validity to regional epicentral distances (< 3000 km).
Point-source approximation ignores finite-fault rupture velocity, directivity, and slip heterogeneity for large earthquakes.
Predicted Lamb mode (303 m/s) in simulations is not discernible in GEONET GNSS observations due to surface energy trapping.
线性微扰理论忽略了高层稀薄大气中的非线性陡化、激波形成及高频耗散（N型波演化）。
水平分层平地近似忽略了地球曲率，仅适用于区域震中距（< 3000 km）。
点源近似忽略了大地震有限断层的破裂速度、方向性及滑移非均匀性。
模型预测的303 m/s兰姆波因能量局限于近地表而在实际GNSS观测中未能识别。

tm.why: The paper models lithosphere-atmosphere-ionosphere coupling (coseismic acoustic-gravity waves and ionospheric TEC perturbations) induced by earthquakes.
The study develops a frequency-wavenumber analytical wave propagation formulation in a coupled horizontally layered solid Earth-atmosphere-ionosphere system.

ev.notes: Full 8-page PDF article from Earth and Planetary Science Letters (2026) used for all metadata, equations, numerical values, figure analyses, and verbatim paragraph anchors.

sum: This study investigates the feasibility of representing multiple distinct earthquakes on a connected fault system as ordered source units within a single time-compressed composite event. Using regional waveforms from 13 IRIS stations for five M≥6 events in the 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye sequence, the authors compress inter-event origin-time intervals onto a 1000 s synthetic timeline without warping internal event waveforms. Waveforms are superposed and inverted via Iterative Deconvolution and Stacking (IDS) on a 600×200 km common projection plane. Comparing the direct composite inversion with the time-shifted sum of separate-event inversions yields high source-time-function correlations (0.865 for proportional mapping, 0.916 for stage-prescribed mapping). A 19-case sensitivity suite confirms robust first-order slip and moment release (median STF correlation 0.965, spatial correlation 0.710). Furthermore, a constrained convolutional neural network trained on 0–700 s slip images extrapolates 700–1000 s rupture-growth tendency, showing partial retrospective spatial proximity to subsequent M≥5.0 aftershocks.
本研究探讨了将连通断层系统上的多次独立地震表示为单一时间压缩复合事件的可行性。利用2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什序列中5次M≥6地震在13个台站的区域波形，该方法在不扭曲事件内部波形的前提下压缩发震时间间隔，并在600×200 km公共投影面上利用迭代反褶积与叠加（IDS）直接反演叠加波形。直接复合……

t: Inter-event origin times are compressed onto a synthetic timeline without warping intra-event waveforms; unnormalised records are superposed and inverted via Iterative Deconvolution and Stacking (IDS) on a common 600×200 km fault plane, followed by CNN slip-tendency extrapolation.
压缩震间发震间隔而不扭曲事件内波形，在600×200 km公共面上对叠加记录进行IDS反演，并用约束CNN外推滑移趋势。

Processed three-component waveforms from 13 IRIS stations within 30° epicentral distance, resampled to 1 Hz, covering five M≥6 earthquakes (grouped into units C1, C2, C34, C5) from the 6 February 2023 Kahramanmaraş sequence.
2023年土耳其序列5次M≥6地震在震中距30°内13个IRIS台站的三分量1 Hz重采样波形数据。

Direct composite inversion correlates well with the shifted sum of separate inversions (STF correlation 0.865 for proportional and 0.916 for stage-prescribed mapping). Across 19 sensitivity cases, median spatial correlation is 0.710, STF correlation is 0.965, and centroid shift is 7.49 km.
直接复合反演与独立反演叠加的STF相关性达0.865和0.916；19组敏感性测试中位空间相关性0.710、STF相关性…

Unnormalised amplitudes cause larger events to dominate residual reduction, the single common projection plane simplifies 3D branching fault geometries, and the image-domain extrapolation is tested on only one sequence.
大震主导残差缩减，单一投影面简化了三维分支几何，且图像外推仅在单一地震序列上进行了测试。

Demonstrates that distinct sequential earthquakes separated by hours can be shifted onto a compressed synthetic timeline and inverted directly as one composite dataset while preserving first-order spatiotemporal source organisation.
首次将相隔数小时的多次地震压缩至同一合成时间轴直接进行复合波形反演，并保留了一阶时空震源特征。

kc: Formulated a time-compressed composite-earthquake waveform construction that shifts inter-event origin times onto a synthetic clock while preserving intra-event waveforms and amplitudes.

Demonstrated strong consistency between direct data-domain composite IDS inversion and model-domain summation of separate inversions for the 2023 Türkiye sequence (STF correlations of 0.865 and 0.916).

Evaluated empirical stability across 19 sensitivity cases (varying geometry, grid, and station jackknife), finding high temporal stability (median STF correlation 0.965) and moderate spatial stability (median correlation 0.710).
Developed a constrained convolutional neural network approach to extrapolate post-700 s rupture-growth tendency from time-ordered cumulative slip images.
提出了时间压缩复合地震波形构建方法，在保持事件内部波形和振幅不变的前提下将发震时间间隔映射到合成时间轴上。
证实了2023年土耳其地震序列的数据域直接复合IDS反演与模型域独立反演之和具有高度一致性（震源时间函数相关性达0.865和0.916）。
通过19组敏感性测试（改变断层几何、网格和台站刀切法）评估了经验稳定性，发现时间稳定性高（STF相关性中位数0.965）且空间稳定性中等（空间相关性中位数0.710）。
开发了结合空间与幅值约束的卷积神经网络方法，利用时序累积滑移图像外推了700–1000 s的破裂增长趋势。
me: Proportional and stage-prescribed inter-event origin-time compression and unnormalised waveform superposition.
Iterative Deconvolution and Stacking (IDS) finite-fault kinematic inversion on a 600×200 km common projection plane (30×10 subfaults of 20×20 km).
Sensitivity perturbation testing across fault strike/dip geometries, subfault grid spacings, and 13 single-station jackknife removals.
Constrained convolutional neural network trained on 0–700 s cumulative slip images (50 s intervals) with explicit adjacent-front, depth (0–50 km), and moment increment caps (5% per 100 s).
成比例及分阶段的震间发震时间压缩与未归一化波形叠加。
在600×200 km公共投影面（30×10个20×20 km子断层）上进行迭代反褶积与叠加（IDS）有限断层运动学反演。
针对断层走向/倾角几何、子断层网格间距及13个单台站刀切法剔除的敏感性微扰测试。
基于0–700 s累积滑移图像（50 s间隔）训练的约束卷积神经网络，结合显式的邻近破裂前缘、深度（0–50 km）和矩增量上限（每100 s限制5%）规则。
de: Three-component regional seismic waveforms from 13 IRIS stations within 30° epicentral distance, resampled to 1 Hz.
Five M≥6 earthquakes from the 6 February 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye sequence (Mw 7.8, Mw 6.7, Mw 7.5, and two Mb 6.0 events) grouped into four source units (C1, C2, C34, C5).
Two temporal-compression experiments: proportional mapping (onsets at 0, 6.94, 355.7, and 419 s) and stage-prescribed mapping (0, 100, 200, and 419 s).
Retrospective spatial comparison against subsequent M≥5.0 aftershocks occurring after 12:02:11 UTC.
震中距30°以内13个IRIS台站的三分量区域地震波形数据，重采样至1 Hz。
2023年2月6日土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什序列中的5次M≥6地震（Mw 7.8、Mw 6.7、Mw 7.5及两次Mb 6.0事件），划分为4个震源单元（C1、C2、C34、C5）。
两组时间压缩实验：成比例映射（起始时间为0、6.94、355.7和419 s）和分阶段指定映射（0、100、200和419 s）。
与12:02:11 UTC之后发生的M≥5.0余震位置进行回顾性空间对比。
li: The single 600×200 km planar projection surface collapses complex 3D fault branches, bends, splays, and event-specific focal mechanisms into one approximate coordinate plane.
Unnormalised waveform superposition causes larger-amplitude mainshocks to dominate the IDS residual reduction over smaller source units.
The convolutional rupture-growth extrapolation is trained on a single composite sequence without independent cross-sequence transferability testing or formal resolution analysis.
单一的600×200 km平面投影表面将复杂的三维断层分支、弯曲、次级断层和特定事件的震源机制简化到了同一个近似坐标平面上。
未归一化的波形叠加使得大振幅主震在IDS残差缩减中占主导地位，掩盖了较小震源单元的统计权重。
卷积破裂增长趋势外推仅在单一复合序列上训练，缺乏跨独立地震序列的可迁移性测试及正式的分辨率分析。

tm.why: The paper develops a finite-fault iterative deconvolution and stacking (IDS) inversion method to represent multi-event rupture processes and source-time functions for the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence.
A constrained convolutional neural network is trained on sequential cumulative slip images to extrapolate rupture-growth tendency.
The study tests the mathematical equivalence and empirical stability of data-domain superposition versus model-domain summation in linear/nonlinear finite-fault inversions.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the dataset and source code associated with the study of a unified quadratic scaling relation between earthquake potency and local magnitude (ML) spanning from -1.8 to 7.5. The code and data enable researchers to reproduce the scaling analysis, which bridges microearthquakes and major seismic events, offering insights into earthquake source physics and magnitude calibration.
该Zenodo仓库提供了关于-1.8至7.5级地震震源效能（potency）与地方震级（ML）之间统一二次标度关系研究的数据集和源代码。该资源支持重现跨越微震到大地震的标度关系分析，有助于深入理解地震源物理学及震级标定。

t: Empirical and statistical fitting of earthquake potency and local magnitude data to establish a unified quadratic scaling relation.
对地震震源效能与地方震级数据进行经验和统计拟合，建立统一的二次标度关系。
A comprehensive dataset of earthquake source parameters (potency and local magnitude) spanning a wide range from -1.8 to 7.5.
涵盖-1.8至7.5级宽震级范围的地震震源参数（效能与地方震级）综合数据集。
Establishment of a unified quadratic scaling relation that fits both small and large earthquakes consistently.

The applicability of the scaling relation might be regionally dependent and requires validation in diverse tectonic settings.

A unified quadratic scaling relation spanning over nine orders of magnitude, bridging microearthquakes and major events.
提出跨越九个数量级的统一二次标度关系，桥接了微震与大地震。
