sum: This study conducts a geotechnical and seismic hazard characterization of an industrial development site in Ain Sokhna, Egypt, using 18 profiles (~3.15 km) of P-wave Shallow Seismic Refraction Tomography (SSRT) and S-wave Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW), calibrated with wireline logs from Suez Well-3. The inversions resolve three layers: unconsolidated wadi sediments (Vp 400–1100 m/s, Vs 130–550 m/s), semi-consolidated sediments (Vp 1200–2000 m/s, Vs 545–1100 m/s), and sandstone bedrock (Vp 2200–3500 m/s, Vs 1200–1800 m/s). Dynamic elastic moduli (G up to 7.91 GPa, E up to 18.6 GPa) and geotechnical indices (stress ratio, concentration index, N-value, bearing capacity, settlement) were mapped. Time-averaged shear-wave velocity (Vs30) ranges from 763.4 to 1261.6 m/s, placing the entire area in NEHRP Site Class B. Novelty lies in integrating SSRT and MASW to reveal localized fault-controlled low-velocity anomalies in the bedrock that require site-specific foundation considerations.
本研究针对埃及艾因苏赫纳工业开发区，采集了18条测线（约3.15公里）的P波浅层地震折射层析成像（SSRT）与S波多道面波分析（MASW）数据，并结合Suez Well-3测井资料进行标定。反演揭示了三层结构：未固结河谷沉积物、半固结沉积物及砂岩基岩。研究计算并绘制了动态弹性模量（剪切模量达7.91……

t: P-wave velocity models were inverted from first-arrival travel times via ray-tracing least-squares tomography, while S-wave velocity profiles were obtained by Gauss-Newton inversion of fundamental-mode MASW dispersion curves constrained by P-wave models.
利用射线追踪最小二乘法反演P波初至走时，并以P波模型约束高斯-牛顿法反演MASW基阶频散曲线获取S波速度。

Eighteen active-source P-wave and S-wave seismic profiles (~3.15 km total length) acquired with 12/24-channel seismographs and a 15-kg sledgehammer in Ain Sokhna, integrated with wireline logs from Suez Well-3.
在艾因苏赫纳采集的18条P波和S波主动源地震剖面（总长约3.15公里）及Suez Well-3钻孔测井数据。
Three layers were resolved with Vp of 400–3500 m/s and Vs of 130–1896 m/s; bedrock shear modulus reaches 7.91 GPa, and Vs30 spans 763.4–1261.6 m/s, placing all 18 profiles in NEHRP Site Class B.
划分出三层结构（Vp 400–3500 m/s，Vs 130–1896 m/s），基岩剪切模量达7.91 GPa，Vs3…
Inversion results depend on assumed initial Vp/Vs ratios (1.65–1.90), and seismically derived bearing capacity and settlement are preliminary dynamic indicators that cannot replace static load tests.
反演受初始Vp/Vs比值假设影响，地震导出的承载力和沉降量仅为初步动态指标，不能替代静载试验。

Previous Ain Sokhna studies relied only on P-wave refraction; this study integrates S-wave refraction and MASW dispersion profiles to derive comprehensive dynamic elastic moduli, geotechnical indices, and Vs30.
克服前人仅用P波折射的局限，首次在该区结合S波与MASW全面评估动态弹性模量、岩土工程指标与Vs30。

kc: Integrated 18 P-wave SSRT and S-wave MASW profiles (~3.15 km total) with borehole logs in Ain Sokhna, Egypt.
Delineated three geoseismic units and mapped fault-related low-velocity anomalies in the sandstone bedrock.
Derived spatially continuous 2D and quasi-3D maps of dynamic elastic moduli, geotechnical indices, and Vs30 (763.4–1261.6 m/s, NEHRP Class B).
在埃及艾因苏赫纳地区联合采集并解释了18条P波SSRT和S波MASW剖面（总长约3.15公里）及钻孔测井数据。
划分了三个地震地质单元，并刻画了砂岩基岩中与断层相关的局部低速异常带。
生成了动态弹性模量、岩土工程指标及Vs30（763.4–1261.6 m/s，NEHRP B类场地）的二维和准三维连续分布图。
me: P-wave first-arrival travel-time tomography using least-squares inversion and ray-tracing forward modeling with L2 regularization.
Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) using phase-shift dispersion extraction and Gauss-Newton inversion constrained by P-wave models.
Empirical derivation of density (Gardner's relation calibrated with well logs), dynamic elastic moduli, geotechnical competence indices, and Vs30.
基于最小二乘反演、射线追踪正演及L2正则化的P波初至走时层析成像。
采用相移法提取频散曲线、并以P波模型约束高斯-牛顿反演的多道面波分析（MASW）。
利用测井标定的Gardner公式及经验关系计算密度、动态弹性模量、岩土工程指标和Vs30。
de: 18 active-source seismic profiles (28 spreads, 120 m and 240 m lengths, 5 m or 10 m geophone spacing) totaling ~3.15 km using a 15 kg sledgehammer source.
10 Hz vertical geophones with steel plate strikes for P-waves; 10 Hz horizontal geophones with wooden plank strikes for S-waves/MASW.
Wireline logging data (GR, SP, resistivity, neutron, lithology) from the adjacent Suez Well-3 down to 35 m depth.
使用15公斤大锤震源采集的18条主动源地震剖面（28个排列，长120米和240米），总长约3.15公里。
P波使用10 Hz垂直检波器配合敲击钢板；S波/MASW使用10 Hz水平检波器配合水平敲击木板。
邻近Suez Well-3钻孔35米深度内的测井数据（自然伽马、自然电位、电阻率、中子及岩性剖面）。
li: MASW inversion results are influenced by assumed initial Vp/Vs ratios (1.65–1.90) and resolution-depth trade-offs (~40 m max depth).
Seismically derived ultimate bearing capacity and settlement are preliminary dynamic indicators and cannot replace static load testing or boreholes.
MASW反演结果受初始假设Vp/Vs比值（1.65–1.90）以及分辨率与最大探测深度（约40米）折衷的影响。
由地震波导出的极限承载力和沉降量仅为初步动态指标，不能替代钻孔取芯和静载试验。

tm.why: The paper utilizes integrated P-wave shallow seismic refraction tomography (SSRT) and S-wave multichannel analysis of surface waves (MASW) to image the shallow subsurface.
The study calculates Vs30 and elastic/geotechnical parameters across 18 profiles to assign NEHRP site classes and assess seismic hazard and foundation competence.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all equations, 7 tables, and 10 figures.

sum: This paper introduces a novel petrophysical modeling framework and a Preisach-based approach to describe the nonlinear, hysteretic relationship between acoustic P- and S-wave velocities and effective rock pressure during loading and unloading. Instead of relying on a single microscopic mechanism, the petrophysical model utilizes an effective extensive state variable representing cumulative microstructural evolution (e.g., microcracks, grain contacts). Linearized joint inversion of laboratory-measured velocities is used to estimate model parameters and reconstruct an acoustically weighted effective descriptor. Concurrently, the Preisach theory represents compliant features as hysteretic units (hysterons) with distributed opening/closing pressures. By combining these approaches, the authors define two diagnostic quantities—Ratio of Hysteron Jumps and Cumulative Hysteron Jumps—to quantify hysteretic contributions. Both models accurately reproduce observed velocity-pressure hysteresis, providing complementary macroscopic and microscopic insights into rock microstructural evolution.
本文提出了一种新型物理模型和基于Preisach理论的方法，用于描述加载和卸载过程中纵横波速度与有效压力之间的非线性滞后关系。该物理模型引入了一个表征微观结构演化（如微裂隙、颗粒接触）累积效应的等效状态变量，并通过对实验室测量的声波速度进行线性化联合反演来估计参数。同时，利用Preisach理论将微……

t: Linearized joint inversion of laboratory-measured acoustic velocities combined with Preisach hysteretic modeling using distributed opening and closing pressures.
结合实验室测量声速的线性化联合反演，以及使用分布开关压力的Preisach滞后建模。
Laboratory-measured acoustic P- and S-wave velocities under varying effective pressures during loading and unloading phases.
在加载和卸载阶段，不同有效压力下实验室测量的声波纵波和横波速度。
Accurate reproduction of velocity-pressure hysteresis and reconstruction of the Preisach density function and diagnostic hysteron jump parameters.
高精度重现了速度-压力滞后效应，并重构了Preisach密度函数及诊断性滞后跳跃参数。
The reconstructed Preisach density function is non-unique, and the effective state variable does not prescribe a single unique microscopic mechanism.
重构的Preisach密度函数具有非唯一性，且等效状态变量未指定单一的微观机制。
Combining macroscopic petrophysical state-variable modeling with microscopic Preisach hysteresis theory to define new diagnostic quantities for rock microstructural evolution.
将宏观物理状态变量模型与微观Preisach滞后理论相结合，定义了评估岩石微观结构演化的新诊断量。

kc: Developed a unified petrophysical model using an effective extensive state variable to describe irreversible velocity-pressure hysteresis.
Applied the Preisach theory of hysteresis to represent compliant microstructural features as hysteretic units (hysterons).
Introduced two new diagnostic quantities (Ratio of Hysteron Jumps and Cumulative Hysteron Jumps) to quantify hysteretic switching contributions.
开发了一个使用等效广延状态变量的统一物理模型，用以描述不可逆的波速-压力滞后行为。
应用Preisach滞后理论，将柔性微观结构特征表示为具有分布开关压力的滞后单元（hysterons）。
引入了两个新的诊断量（滞后单元跳跃比例和累积滞后单元跳跃），以定量评估滞后切换的贡献。
me: Linearized joint inversion of laboratory-measured acoustic P- and S-wave velocities.
Preisach hysteretic modeling using distributed opening and closing pressures.
State-variable petrophysical modeling distinguishing between open and closed microstructural states.
对实验室测量的纵波和横波声速进行线性化联合反演。
使用分布开启和关闭压力的Preisach滞后建模。
区分开放和关闭微观结构状态的状态变量物理建模。
de: Laboratory-measured acoustic compressional (P) and shear (S) wave velocities under cyclic loading and unloading pressure phases.
在循环加载和卸载压力阶段下，实验室测量的声波纵波（P）和横波（S）速度。

tm.why: The paper utilizes linearized joint inversion to estimate petrophysical model parameters from laboratory-measured acoustic velocities.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is strictly based on the detailed abstract and metadata from GJI and Semantic Scholar.

sum: Along the Cascadia Subduction Zone, megathrust earthquakes cause meter-scale coseismic subsidence, abruptly raising relative sea level. This study models how coseismic subsidence magnitude (0.5–2.0 m) and timing (2030–2100) interact with eustatic sea level rise (SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5) and offshore wave climate across 32 rocky coast sites in Cascadia. Using linear wave theory and an exponential post-breaking decay function, the authors show that although deeper water reduces overall wave breaking, it shifts breaking of larger waves landward, reducing energy dissipation and amplifying annual cliff-base wave power up to a million-fold on subhorizontal platforms (<1°), while steep platforms (>5°) see muted changes. High-emissions sea level rise shifts the window of maximum amplification earlier in the century and enables partial post-earthquake wave power recovery as water deepens further. This reveals a critical coupling between solid-Earth geohazards and climate change governing decadal coastal erosion.
卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带巨型逆冲地震会产生米级同震沉降，导致相对海平面骤升。本文利用线性波浪理论与能量衰减模型，模拟了卡斯卡迪亚32个基岩海岸站点在2020至2100年间不同气候排放情景（SSP2-4.5和SSP5-8.5）、同震沉降幅度（0.5–2.0米）及发震时间下的近岸波浪动力学。结果表明，同震沉降虽……

t: Linear wave theory models shallow-water wave transformation and depth-limited breaking (gamma=0.78) across 5m bathymetric profiles, estimating annual cliff-base wave power via an exponential post-breaking decay function across 1600 earthquake-climate realizations.
利用线性波浪理论模拟5米水深剖面上的浅水波变与破波，并通过指数衰减函数计算1600组情景下的崖底年波浪功率。

Simulations use 32 Cascadia rocky coast bathymetric profiles (1/3 arc-second interpolated to 5m), IPCC AR6 sea level curves, tide gauge vertical land motion rates, hourly tides, and 1-degree wave forecasts from 2020 to 2100.
整合卡斯卡迪亚32个站点5米分辨率水深剖面、IPCC AR6海平面预测、验潮站垂直形变率、潮汐及2020–2100年逐小…

Coseismic subsidence reduces breaking wave counts by up to 53.4% by 2100 but shifts breaking landward up to 555 m, amplifying annual cliff wave power up to 10^6-fold on subhorizontal platforms (<1 deg), correlating negatively with slope (rho <= -0.91).
同震沉降使破波向陆迁移达555米，近水平平台（<1°）崖底波浪功率放大达百万倍，且与坡度呈强负相关（rho <= -0.…

The model neglects shoaling dissipation prior to breaking, wave setup, reflection, refraction, and dynamic morphological changes such as cliff failure or shoreline retreat over the 80-year simulation.
忽略了破波前浅化耗散、波浪增水、折射反射以及80年模拟期内海崖崩塌后退等动态地形变化。

First demonstration of how episodic megathrust coseismic subsidence couples with climate-driven sea level rise trajectories to govern transient versus sustained decadal coastal wave hazard amplification.
首次揭示了俯冲带同震沉降与气候海平面上升轨迹耦合对海岸波浪灾害瞬态放大与震后恢复的控制机制。

kc: Quantifies the coupled effects of megathrust coseismic subsidence and century-scale climate-driven sea level rise on cliff-base ocean wave power across 32 Cascadia sites.
Demonstrates that shore platform slope strongly regulates wave power amplification (Spearman's rho <= -0.91), with up to 10^6 amplification on subhorizontal platforms (<1 deg).
Reveals that emissions trajectories control the timing and persistence of earthquake-driven wave hazards, with rapid late-century sea level rise under SSP5-8.5 promoting partial hazard recovery.
量化了卡斯卡迪亚32个站点巨型逆冲地震同震沉降与百年尺度气候海平面上升对崖底海浪功率的耦合影响。
证明岸滩平台坡度强烈控制波浪功率放大倍数（Spearman's rho <= -0.91），近水平平台（<1°）放大可达百万倍。
揭示了碳排放轨迹决定地震波浪灾害的峰值时间与持续性，SSP5-8.5情景下本世纪末快速海平面上升可促使震后波浪能部分恢复。
me: Linear shallow-water wave theory with a depth-dependent breaking criterion (gamma = 0.78) applied to 5-m interpolated bathymetric swath profiles.
Wave classification into breaking, broken, and unbroken cliff-incident categories combined with an exponential post-breaking attenuation decay model for cliff-base wave power.

Parameter space exploration of 1600 hourly simulations (2020–2100) varying subsidence magnitudes (0.5, 1.0, 2.0 m), decadal earthquake years, and IPCC AR6 sea level projections (SSP2-4.5, SSP5-8.5) corrected for interseismic vertical land motion.
基于5米分辨率插值水深条带剖面，应用线性浅水波理论和深度依赖破波准则（gamma = 0.78）模拟波浪传播。
将入射波分类为破波、已破波和未破波，并结合破波后指数衰减函数计算崖底波浪功率。
开展2020至2100年逐小时参数空间模拟（共1600次），组合不同沉降幅度（0.5、1.0、2.0米）、十年间隔发震时间及扣除震间垂直形变后的IPCC AR6海平面预测（SSP2-4.5、SSP5-8.5）。
de: 1/3 arc-second NOAA Coastal Relief Model bathymetric DEMs extracted as 0.5 km wide swath profiles at 32 rocky coast sites from northern California to British Columbia.
Hourly 1-degree offshore deep-water wave forecasts (RisesAM-OceanWaves) and NOAA harmonic tidal predictions.
IPCC AR6 50th percentile regional sea level projections and local tide-gauge-derived interseismic vertical land motion rates.
从北加州至不列颠哥伦比亚省32个基岩海岸站点提取的1/3角秒NOAA海岸地形模型（CRM）0.5公里宽水深剖面。
逐小时1度分辨率近海深水波浪预测数据（RisesAM-OceanWaves）及NOAA潮汐调和分析预测水位。
IPCC AR6第50百分位区域海平面上升预测数据以及由验潮站推导的震间垂直陆地运动速率。
li: Neglects wave energy dissipation during shoaling prior to breaking, as well as shallow-water wave setup, reflection, and refraction.
Assumes a static cross-shore morphological profile (apart from vertical tectonic shifts) over the 80-year simulation and does not dynamically model cliff retreat or failure.
忽略了波浪浅化阶段破波前的能量耗散，以及浅水波浪增水、反射和折射过程。
假设80年模拟期内海岸横剖面形态除垂直构造升降外保持静态，未动态模拟海崖后退或崩塌。

sum: The 15 January 2022 Hunga volcano eruption generated a catastrophic tsunami, yet its primary triggering mechanism remained unclear due to sparse near-field instrumentation. By integrating regional seismic and hydro-acoustic (T wave) records from 14 SW Pacific stations (up to 2600 km away) with oceanographic, atmospheric, satellite, and eyewitness observations, this study reconstructs the 11-hour eruption timeline. The authors distinguish two T-wave types: weaker, directional signals from submarine eruption-fed mass flows, and powerful, omnidirectional signals from shallow ring-fault slip during caldera collapse. Backtracking travel times reveals that the largest local tsunami (18–40 m run-up) was triggered at ~05:28 UTC by the first of several stepwise caldera subsidence events, occurring ~1 hour after the main atmospheric explosions and coinciding with eruption plume foundering. This novel identification of caldera-collapse T waves highlights an unpredictable tsunami hazard and demonstrates the utility of hydro-acoustic monitoring for volcanic tsunami early warning.
2022年1月15日洪阿火山喷发引发了灾难性海啸。本研究结合西南太平洋14个地震台站（最远2600公里）的地震与水声（T波）记录，以及海洋、大气、卫星和目击者数据，重建了喷发过程。研究区分了两类T波：由海底喷发重力流产生的较弱定向信号，以及破火山口塌陷期间浅层环状断层滑动产生的强全向信号。走时反推表……

t: The authors bandpass-filtered seismic records (1–10 Hz) across 14 SW Pacific stations, generated rolling-window spectrograms, and back-projected T-wave arrival times using a 1.49 km/s SOFAR velocity to locate and time submarine volcano-tsunamigenic events.
对14个西南太平洋台站进行1-10 Hz带通滤波和时频分析，利用1.49 km/s水声速度回溯T波走时以定位海底火山事件…

Data comprise seismic waveforms from 14 SW Pacific sensors (750–2600 km distant), Nuku'alofa tide gauge and meteorological records, telecom failure logs, satellite plume/lightning series, GEBCO bathymetry, and Tongan eyewitness interviews.
结合距火山750-2600公里的14个地震台波形、潮位与气象记录、通信中断日志、卫星闪电数据及目击者访谈。

The first and largest stepwise caldera subsidence began at 05:28 UTC (~5 min peak energy duration), generating omnidirectional T waves up to 2600 km away and triggering the peak tsunami with >18 to 40 m run-ups.
首次最大规模破火山口塌陷始于05:28 UTC，产生远达2600公里的全向T波，并引发爬高18至40米的巨型海啸。

Because T waves are high-frequency (>2 Hz), their amplitudes can deceptively estimate long-period tsunami excitation, and bathymetric obstructions or signal overlaps complicate travel-time interpretations.
T波属高频信号（>2 Hz），难以直接估计长周期海啸激发特征，且海底地形障碍与信号重叠导致走时延迟。

Identifies submarine caldera collapse as a previously unrecognized T-wave source intermediate between a landslide and earthquake, proving delayed subsidence—not explosions—caused Hunga's worst tsunami.
首次识别出介于滑坡和地震之间的破火山口塌陷T波源，证实延迟塌陷而非爆炸引发了最具破坏性的海啸。

kc: Demonstrates that the largest local tsunami (18–40 m run-up) during the 2022 Hunga eruption was caused by sudden submarine caldera subsidence at ~05:28 UTC, ~1 hour after the major explosions.
Distinguishes two types of hydro-acoustic T waves: directional, pulsing signals (5–10 Hz) from submarine mass flows, and strong, omnidirectional signals (1–10 Hz) from caldera ring-fault collapse.
Links rapid submarine caldera subsidence and vent rearrangement directly to the sudden foundering of the >53 km high eruption plume.
证明2022年洪阿火山喷发期间最大的局地海啸（爬高18-40米）是由约05:28 UTC的突发海底破火山口塌陷引起的，滞后于主要爆炸约1小时。
区分了两种水声T波：来自海底重力流的定向脉动信号（5-10 Hz），以及来自破火山口环状断层塌陷的强全向信号（1-10 Hz）。
将快速的海底破火山口塌陷和喷口重组与超过53公里高的喷发柱突然坍塌直接联系起来。
me: Bandpass filtering (0.1–10 Hz and 1–10 Hz) and Fast-Fourier Transform spectrogram analysis of vertical-component seismic records across 14 SW Pacific stations.
Backtracking and travel-time analysis of SOFAR-channel T waves assuming an average hydro-acoustic velocity of 1.49 km/s, paired with 1D bathymetric path profiling.
Wavelet decomposition (48-min period) of tide gauge records and multiproxy correlation with satellite plume heights, lightning rates, barometric/temperature data, and eyewitness timestamps.
对西南太平洋14个台站的垂直分量地震记录进行带通滤波（0.1–10 Hz和1–10 Hz）及快速傅里叶变换时频谱分析。
假设平均水声速度为1.49 km/s，对SOFAR通道T波进行走时回溯分析，并结合一维海底地形剖面评估传播延迟。
对潮位计记录进行小波分解（48分钟周期），并与卫星喷发柱高度、闪电率、气压/气温数据及目击者时间戳进行多指标对比。
de: Vertical-component seismic waveform data from station MSVF (757 km away) and 13 other regional SW Pacific seismic stations at distances of 750 to 2600 km.
Nuku'alofa Harbor tide gauge and weather station data, plus Kanokupolu telecommunications tower failure logs (05:45:24 UTC).
Dual-satellite umbrella cloud height retrievals, ground-based volcanic lightning records, security camera videos, and 3 months of field eyewitness interviews in Tonga.
距离757公里的MSVF台站及西南太平洋其他13个区域地震台站（距离750至2600公里）的垂直分量地震波形数据。
努库阿洛法港潮位计和气象站数据，以及卡诺库波卢通信塔中断日志（05:45:24 UTC）。
双卫星伞状云高度反演、地基火山闪电记录、监控视频以及在汤加进行的为期3个月的现场目击者访谈。
li: T waves are intrinsically high-frequency (>2 Hz), so their amplitudes can provide deceptive estimates of the long-period characteristics of tsunami excitation.
Bathymetric obstacles, continental shelves, and signal overlap from successive events cause complex T-wave travel-time delays (up to 37 min) and obscure onset picking.
T波本质上是高频信号（>2 Hz），其振幅可能会对海啸激发的长周期特征提供具有误导性的估计。
海底地形障碍、大陆架以及连续事件的信号重叠会导致复杂的T波走时延迟（高达37分钟）并掩盖初至时间。

tm.why: The paper analyzes seismic and hydro-acoustic (T-wave) signals from the 2022 Hunga submarine volcanic eruption to determine the timing of eruption-fed density currents and caldera collapse.
The study focuses on the generation mechanisms, arrival timing, and early warning potential for catastrophic volcanic tsunamis with run-ups of 18 to 40 m.

sum: Interactions between carbonates and silicates are crucial for deep Earth processes, yet high-pressure compounds incorporating both tetrahedral carbonate and octahedral silicate units had remained experimentally unobserved. This study reports the synthesis of calcium silicate-diorthocarbonate (CaSiC2O7) at 122(2) GPa and 2800(200) K in a laser-heated diamond anvil cell from a CaSiO3, CaCO3, and FeO starting assemblage. Using synchrotron single-crystal X-ray diffraction and ab initio density functional theory calculations, the authors determine an orthorhombic structure (Cmcm) built from vertex-sharing SiO6 octahedra and CO4 tetrahedra forming [C2O7]6- dimers. Phonon and elastic tensor calculations confirm dynamical and mechanical stability up to megabar pressures, yielding a zero-pressure bulk modulus K0 = 151.2(9) GPa. At 122 GPa, CaSiC2O7 exhibits notably lower density (5.198 g/cm3), shear modulus (188 GPa), and seismic wave velocities (Vp = 12.45 km/s, Vs = 6.01 km/s) than major lower-mantle minerals, offering a new mineralogical mechanism for LLVP seismic anomalies.
本研究利用激光加热金刚石压腔在122 GPa和2800 K下由CaSiO3、CaCO3和FeO合成了高硅酸二原碳酸钙（CaSiC2O7）。结合同步辐射单晶X射线衍射与第一性原理计算，解析出其由共顶点的SiO6八面体与CO4四面体（形成[C2O7]6-二聚体）构成的Cmcm正交晶系框架结构。计算证实了……

t: Laser-heated diamond anvil cell synthesis at 122 GPa and 2800 K combined with synchrotron multigrain single-crystal X-ray diffraction and ab initio DFT calculations for structure, phonon dispersion, equation of state, and elasticity.
结合122 GPa和2800 K激光加热金刚石压腔合成、同步辐射单晶X射线衍射与第一性原理计算。

Natural CaSiO3 wollastonite powder containing ~5 vol% CaCO3 sandwiching 57Fe-enriched Fe0.945O, compressed to 122(2) GPa, laser-heated at 2800(200) K, and probed by XRD down to 34 GPa alongside DFT simulations (0–160 GPa).
含5 vol% CaCO3的天然硅灰石与Fe0.945O在122 GPa下加热，并结合34-122 GPa衍射与DFT计…

CaSiC2O7 crystallizes in orthorhombic Cmcm (a=4.4750 Å, b=6.4691 Å, c=9.013 Å at 122 GPa), with K0=151.2(9) GPa, and 122 GPa properties Vp=12.45 km/s, Vs=6.01 km/s, ρ=5.198 g/cm3, K=555 GPa, and G=188 GPa.
确定Cmcm正交结构，K0=151.2 GPa；122 GPa下Vp=12.45 km/s，Vs=6.01 km/s，密…

Carbon contamination from diamond anvils prevents quantitative mass balance, and non-equilibrium multi-phase coexistence in the laser-heated DAC precludes direct experimental verification of thermodynamic stability.
金刚石压砧碳污染阻碍质量平衡分析，且非平衡态限制了热力学稳定性的直接实验评估。
First experimental observation of a silicate-carbonate built from CO4 tetrahedra and SiO6 octahedra, and first discovery of an sp3-dicarbonate hosting [C2O7]6- dimers.
首次实验合成由CO4四面体和SiO6八面体构建的硅酸盐-碳酸盐及含[C2O7]6-的sp3二聚体。

kc: First experimental synthesis of a high-pressure silicate-carbonate containing both tetrahedral carbon (CO4) and octahedral silicon (SiO6) at megabar pressures (122 GPa, 2800 K).
Crystal structure determination of CaSiC2O7 via in situ synchrotron multigrain single-crystal X-ray diffraction, revealing sp3-hybridized [C2O7]6- diorthocarbonate dimers.
Ab initio determination of the equation of state (K0 = 151.2 GPa) and full elastic constants confirming mechanical and dynamical stability from 1 bar to 122 GPa.

Demonstration that CaSiC2O7 has lower density and seismic wave velocities (Vp = 12.45 km/s, Vs = 6.01 km/s at 122 GPa) than surrounding pyrolitic mantle minerals, linking deep carbon-silicate reactions to LLVPs.
首次在百万巴压力（122 GPa，2800 K）下实验合成出同时含有四配位碳（CO4）和六配位硅（SiO6）的高压硅酸盐-碳酸盐。
利用原位同步辐射多晶粒单晶X射线衍射测定了CaSiC2O7晶体结构，揭示了sp3杂化的[C2O7]6-二原碳酸根二聚体。
通过第一性原理计算获得了状态方程（K0 = 151.2 GPa）和弹性常数，证实了其在1 bar至122 GPa下的力学与动力学稳定性。
证明CaSiC2O7在122 GPa下具有比周围地幔矿物更低的密度和地震波速（Vp = 12.45 km/s，Vs = 6.01 km/s），将深部碳-硅反应与LLVPs联系起来。
me: High-pressure high-temperature synthesis using a double-sided laser-heated BX90 diamond anvil cell (DAC) up to 122(2) GPa and 2800(200) K.
In situ synchrotron-based single-crystal X-ray diffraction on polycrystalline samples with multigrain domain auto-finding (DAFi) and structure refinement in Jana2006.
Ab initio density functional theory (DFT) calculations using VASP with PBE-GGA potentials, PHONOPY for harmonic phonon dispersion, and stress-strain method for elastic tensors.
使用双面激光加热BX90金刚石压腔（DAC）在122(2) GPa和2800(200) K下进行高温高压合成。
对多晶样品进行原位同步辐射单晶X射线衍射，结合多晶粒域自动搜索（DAFi）与Jana2006结构精修。
使用VASP（PBE-GGA泛函）进行第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合PHONOPY计算声子谱及应力-应变法计算弹性张量。
de: Laser-heated DAC experiment on a natural CaSiO3 wollastonite powder (~5 vol% CaCO3) sandwiching 57Fe-enriched Fe0.945O at ESRF beamlines ID18 and ID15B.
Stepwise decompression XRD measurements from 122 GPa down to 34 GPa.
First-principles variable-cell structural relaxations from 1 bar to 160 GPa and 0 K elastic constant computations at 1 bar and 122 GPa.
在ESRF的ID18和ID15B光束线对夹有富57Fe的Fe0.945O的天然硅灰石CaSiO3粉末（含约5 vol% CaCO3）进行激光加热DAC实验。
从122 GPa逐步卸压至34 GPa的原位X射线衍射测量。
1 bar至160 GPa的第一性原理变胞结构弛豫，以及0 K下1 bar和122 GPa的弹性常数计算。
li: Potential carbon contamination from diamond anvils during laser heating prevents a quantitative carbon mass balance.
The sample chamber remained in a non-equilibrium multi-phase state, precluding direct experimental assessment of thermodynamic stability.
Elastic constants and acoustic velocities were calculated at 0 K without zero-point motion or high-temperature anharmonic effects.
激光加热过程中金刚石压砧潜在的碳污染阻碍了定量的碳质量平衡分析。
样品腔处于非平衡多相共存状态，无法直接通过实验评估其热力学稳定性。
弹性常数和声波速度是在0 K下计算的，未计入零点振动或高温非谐效应。

tm.why: The paper synthesizes a high-pressure silicate-carbonate phase (CaSiC2O7) under lowermost mantle conditions and evaluates its acoustic wave velocities, density, and potential contribution to large low-velocity provinces (LLVPs) near the core-mantle boundary.

ev.notes: Full 8-page Nature Communications PDF analyzed, including main text, methods, 4 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study utilizes data from two dense seismic arrays (114 geophones and 17 accelerometers) deployed in the Eel River basin, Northern California, following the 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino Triple Junction earthquake. By analyzing aftershock ground motions up to Mw 5.3, the authors perform empirical, distance-normalized peak ground velocity (PGV) analysis and single-station horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) measurements. They identify persistent localized amplification along basin edges and narrow river corridors, and deamplification across a fluvial terrace. Dominant resonance peaks at 3–6.5 Hz suggest amplification from thin (<100 m) surficial sediments, while secondary phases indicate deeper crustal or slab-related conversions. The study highlights the critical role of local sedimentary structure and topography in controlling ground motion variability, demonstrating the value of dense temporary deployments for urban seismic hazard assessment.
本研究利用2024年门多西诺三联点Mw 7.0地震后在加州埃尔河盆地部署的密集阵列（114个检波器和17台强震仪），分析了高达Mw 5.3的余震地面运动。通过经验距离归一化峰值地面速度（PGV）和单台动静比（HVSR）分析，发现盆地边缘和河流通道存在持续的局部放大，而河流阶地则表现出减幅。3–6.5……

t: Empirical distance-normalized peak ground velocity (PGV) analysis and single-station horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (HVSR) to characterize ground motion amplification and resonance.
采用经验距离归一化峰值地面速度（PGV）分析和单台动静比（HVSR）方法表征地面运动放大与共振。
Seismic waveforms of aftershocks (up to Mw 5.3) recorded by 114 three-component geophones and 17 accelerometers deployed for over 30 days in the Eel River basin.
由部署在埃尔河盆地30多天的114个三分量检波器和17台强震仪记录的余震（最大Mw 5.3）波形数据。
Persistent localized amplification along basin edges and river corridors, deamplification on fluvial terraces, and dominant resonance peaks between 3 and 6.5 Hz from thin surficial sediments.
盆地边缘和河流通道存在持续局部放大，河流阶地减幅，浅层沉积引起3-6.5 Hz的共振峰。
Short deployment duration (over 30 days) and localized spatial coverage (~300 km2) limiting long-term hazard characterization.

First high-density seismic array deployment in the Eel River basin capturing fine-scale spatial ground motion variability following a major MTJ earthquake.
首次在埃尔河盆地部署高密度地震阵列，捕获了大震后细粒度的空间地面运动变异性。

Mapped fine-scale spatial variability of ground motion, identifying localized amplification at basin edges/river corridors and deamplification at fluvial terraces.
Characterized shallow sedimentary resonance (3–6.5 Hz) and identified deeper crustal/slab-related phase conversions.
捕获了2024年门多西诺三联点Mw 7.0地震后埃尔河盆地的高密度余震地面运动数据。

sum: This study presents new LA-ICP-MS U-Pb zircon ages and geochemical/isotopic data from the Ediacaran Saghro and Ouarzazate Groups in the Sirwa massif, Morocco. The Saghro Group mafic rocks exhibit calc-alkaline, within-plate signatures indicating deposition in a back-arc basin with limited crustal input. In contrast, the younger Ouarzazate Group felsic-intermediate rocks show post-collisional, high-K calc-alkaline to shoshonitic characteristics with significant crustal reworking. These findings support a geodynamic model transitioning from early Ediacaran back-arc extension to late Ediacaran post-collisional crustal collapse, driven by lithospheric delamination or slab break-off, which triggered widespread crustal melting and the emplacement of a Silicic Large Igneous Province.
本研究利用LA-ICP-MS U-Pb定年和地球化学数据，探讨了摩洛哥Sirwa地块埃迪卡拉纪岩石的成因。结果表明，早期Saghro群基性岩形成于弧后盆地，地壳输入有限；晚期Ouarzazate群则记录了碰撞后的地壳塌陷与重熔。这证实了从弧后拉张向岩石圈拆沉/板块断离驱动的碰撞后塌陷的动力学演化，并……

t: LA-ICP-MS U-Pb zircon geochronology combined with whole-rock geochemistry and Nd isotope analysis to constrain rock ages and petrogenesis.
结合LA-ICP-MS U-Pb锆石定年、全岩地球化学和Nd同位素分析来约束岩石年龄和成因。
U-Pb ages from two magmatic rocks, detrital zircon data from the Saghro Group, and geochemical/isotopic datasets from the Sirwa massif.
包含两个岩浆岩样品的U-Pb年龄、碎屑锆石数据及地球化学与同位素数据集。
U-Pb ages of 575 and 564 Ma; Saghro Group Nd isotopes (+3.2 to +4.6) indicate pristine mantle source, while Ouarzazate Group (-0.8 to +1.1) shows crustal reworking.
获得575和564 Ma年龄；Saghro群指示新生幔源，Ouarzazate群指示地壳重熔。
The geodynamic model relies on geochemical proxies and lacks direct physical/geophysical constraints on lithospheric delamination.
动力学模型依赖地球化学指标，缺乏对岩石圈拆沉的直接地球物理约束。
Provides new age constraints and supports a transitional back-arc to post-collisional delamination model for the Ediacaran evolution of the Central Anti-Atlas.
提供了新的年龄约束，并支持了中反阿特拉斯埃迪卡拉纪从弧后向碰撞后拆沉演化的模型。

Identified a back-arc basin setting for the early Ediacaran Saghro Group with limited crustal input.

sum: Recent studies claimed decadal-scale structural variations in Earth's lowermost mantle and rapid fluid anomalies in the outer core based on SKS and ScS differential travel times from earthquake pairs. This paper re-evaluates the two primary earthquake pairs (AI-0009 in the Aleutians and KT-9718 in Kermadec) using moving-window cross-correlation (MWCC), global depth-phase measurements, 3D spectral-element waveform modeling (SPECFEM3D_GLOBE), and co-located sensor comparisons. The authors demonstrate that AI-0009 suffers from poor source repeatability even in direct P-waves, and that ~0.1 s shifts at station IU.SDV are replicated between co-located sensors (00 and 10) during the same event due to instrument instability. Furthermore, the ~1.0 s SKS shifts in KT-9718 are largely explained by a ~5.2 km focal depth difference and unmodeled 3D mantle heterogeneity, compounded by poor station timing in 1997. This work establishes rigorous diagnostic standards before attributing subtle waveform shifts to deep-Earth temporal dynamics.
近期研究基于地震对的SKS和ScS走时差，提出了地幔底部十年尺度结构变化及外核快速流动的观点。本文利用滑动窗互相关（MWCC）、深度震相分析、三维谱元法模拟（SPECFEM3D_GLOBE）及同址传感器对比，重新评估了两组核心地震对（AI-0009和KT-9718）。结果表明，AI-0009在直达P……

t: The authors apply moving-window cross-correlation (MWCC) to capture cycle-to-cycle time shifts, estimate source-depth differences via teleseismic sSdiff-Sdiff phases, simulate 3D waveforms using SPECFEM3D_GLOBE with S40RTS, and compare co-located GSN sensors.
采用滑动窗互相关测量逐周期时移，利用sSdiff-Sdiff估算震源深度差，结合SPECFEM3D_GLOBE模拟与同址…

Three-component broadband GSN waveforms from two earthquake pairs: Aleutian pair AI-0009 (2000 and 2009) and Kermadec pair KT-9718 (1997 and 2018), alongside co-located primary ('00') and secondary ('10') sensor recordings.
阿留申（AI-0009）和克马德克（KT-9718）两组地震对的全球宽频带三分量波形，以及同址00和10传感器记录。

KT-9718 has a 5.21 ± 1.35 km depth difference (mean δt(sSdiff-Sdiff) = 2.20 ± 0.57 s), predicting ~0.6 s of the ~1.0 s SKS shift. At IU.SDV, co-located sensors exhibit ~0.1 s shifts identical to reported lowermost-mantle signals.

Global tomographic models like degree-40 S40RTS are laterally smoothed and cannot resolve small-scale mantle heterogeneity, making it difficult to separate spatial complexity from true temporal variations.

sum: Near-surface petrophysical characterization is often hindered by high heterogeneity and parameter trade-offs. Traditional petrophysical joint inversion (PJI) combines P-wave seismic refraction tomography (SRT) and electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) using Wyllie's time-average equation, which frequently overestimates porosity in unconsolidated or clay-rich shallow sediments. This paper introduces a novel PJI framework that integrates SH-wave SRT, ERT, and optionally time-domain induced polarization (TDIP) data by adopting Castagna's shear-wave relation, Archie's law, and the dynamic Stern layer model. Because SH-waves propagate through the solid matrix and are largely insensitive to pore fluids, they directly constrain the rock volumetric fraction. Tested on a four-layer synthetic model and two field sites in central Italy (Lake Fogliano coastal aquifer and Sterpeto earth dam), the SH-wave PJI yields realistic porosity values (reducing shallow overestimations from >0.80 to ~0.70) and superior physical consistency, even allowing reliable characterization without costly IP surveys.
本研究提出了一种新的岩石物理联合反演（PJI）框架，将SH波地震折射层析成像（SRT）与电阻率层析成像（ERT）及时间域激发极化（TDIP）数据相结合。该方法用针对S波速度的Castagna关系式取代了基于P波速度和Wyllie方程的传统方法。由于SH波对孔隙流体不敏感，能直接约束岩石骨架体积分数。……

t: Jointly inverts SH-wave traveltimes, apparent resistivities, and chargeabilities for water, air, and rock fractions using Castagna's relation and DSLM, solved via LSQR with logarithmic constraints and dual-parameter smoothness regularization.
基于Castagna关系式与DSLM模型，采用LSQR算法、对数约束和双参数平滑正则化联合反演SH波走时与电法数据。

Evaluated on a noisy 4-layer synthetic model and two central Italy field datasets (Lake Fogliano coastal aquifer and Sterpeto clayey earth dam) using 48-channel ERT, TDIP, and sledgehammer P/SH-wave refraction surveys.
在含噪四层合成模型及意大利中部海岸含水层与土坝两个48道ERT/TDIP与P/SH波折射数据集上进行了测试。

SH-wave PJI recovers maximum porosity closer to ground truth (0.74 vs 0.86 in synthetic; ~0.7 vs >0.8-0.9 at Site 1) and lowers Site 2 RMSRE from 14.35% (P-wave) to 5.93% while preserving unit volume sum.
SH波PJI显著改善孔隙度精度（合成算例0.74对比P波0.86），并将工区2的拟合误差从14.35%降至5.93%。

SH-wave surveys require double-shot opposite-polarity acquisition, manual picking without statistical repeatability analysis, and tuning two separate regularization parameters (lambda_1 and lambda_2).
SH波采集需双向激发，走时误差采用统一赋权，且需调节两个独立的正则化参数。
First direct incorporation of SH-wave first-arrival travel-time tomography and Castagna's relation into a petrophysical joint inversion framework with electrical and IP data.
首次将SH波初至走时层析成像与Castagna关系直接嵌入电震岩石物理联合反演框架中。

kc: Develops the first petrophysical joint inversion (PJI) framework directly integrating SH-wave first-arrival travel-time tomography with ERT and TDIP data.
Replaces Wyllie's P-wave equation with Castagna's shear-wave relation, decoupling solid matrix estimation from pore-fluid saturation effects.
Introduces a dual-coefficient regularization matrix (lambda_1 and lambda_2) to independently control smoothness of electrical-coupled parameters and rock fraction.
Demonstrates on synthetic and two field sites in Italy that SH-wave PJI eliminates extreme porosity overestimations (>0.80) and remains robust even without TDIP data.
开发了首个将SH波初至走时层析成像与ERT及TDIP数据直接结合的岩石物理联合反演（PJI）框架。
用Castagna横波关系式取代Wyllie纵波方程，将固体骨架估计与孔隙流体饱和度效应解耦。
引入双系数正则化矩阵（λ1和λ2），分别独立控制电性耦合参数与岩石体积分数的平滑度。
通过合成算例和意大利两个野外工区证明，SH波PJI消除了孔隙度严重高估（>0.80），且在无TDIP数据时依然稳健。
me: Petrophysical coupling via Castagna's equation (linking SH-wave velocity to rock fraction), Archie's law, and the Dynamic Stern Layer Model (DSLM) for surface conduction.
Logarithmic parameter transformation of volumetric fractions (water, air, rock, and normalized chargeability) to enforce [0, 1] box constraints.
Iterative Gauss-Newton/LSQR minimization of an objective function combining data misfit, block-diagonal first-order roughness with two regularization weights, and volume conservation.
利用Castagna方程（关联SH波速度与岩石体积分数）、Archie定律和动态Stern层模型（DSLM）建立岩石物理耦合。
对水、空气、岩石体积分数及归一化极化率进行对数变换，以强制满足[0, 1]物理边界约束。
采用LSQR算法迭代最小化包含数据拟合差、双权重一阶粗糙度平滑项及体积守恒约束的目标函数。
de: Synthetic 4-layer model with 48 sensors at 2 m spacing (dipole-dipole ERT/TDIP and 1-shot-per-2-geophones P/SH SRT) contaminated with Gaussian noise.
Field Site 1 (Lake Fogliano, central Italy): 48-sensor ERT, TDIP, P-wave and SH-wave SRT profile (2 m spacing) across a sandy/silty coastal aquifer with observation well logs.
Field Site 2 (Sterpeto earth dam, central Italy): 118 m profile along the crest of a clayey embankment dam using ERT (3 m spacing) and P/SH-wave SRT (2 m spacing) without IP data.

The core contribution is a novel petrophysical joint inversion algorithm incorporating logarithmic parameter transformations, volume conservation constraints, and dual-parameter smoothness regularization.
The method is specifically designed for and applied to near-surface hydrogeophysical and environmental engineering problems, including a coastal aquifer and an earthen dam.

sum: This paper presents a theoretical framework proposing that the peridotite solidus (~1300°C dry) anchors the steady operating point of plate tectonics. By combining thermodynamics and mass conservation with global average asthenospheric thickness (~100 km) and mantle heat flow (~0.07 W/m²), the author derives a baseline exact solution of ~230 Myr (statistical mean of ~250 Myr) for Earth's asthenospheric circulation. This characteristic timescale acts as a statistical attractor, where deviations are corrected by negative feedback. The analytical model successfully explains plate-size limits, supercontinent breakup timescales (200–300 Myr), ridge migration, and predicts return velocities and effective asthenospheric thicknesses for individual plates.
本文提出了一个理论框架，认为橄榄岩固相线（干固相线约1300°C）锚定了板块构造的稳定运行点。结合热力学和质量守恒定律，利用全球平均软流圈厚度（约100 km）和地幔热流（约0.07 W/m²），推导出地球软流圈循环的基准精确解约为2.3亿年（统计平均约2.5亿年）。该特征时间尺度是一个统计吸引子，……

t: Analytical modeling of asthenospheric flow based on thermodynamics and mass conservation.
基于热力学和质量守恒定律的软流圈流动解析建模。
Theoretical calculations using global average asthenospheric thickness and mantle heat flow parameters.
使用全球平均软流圈厚度和地幔热流等观测参数进行理论计算。
Derivation of a ~250 Myr characteristic timescale for asthenospheric circulation and analytical formulae for plate return velocity.

The analytical model simplifies complex 3D mantle convection and heterogeneous plate geometries.
解析模型简化了复杂的3D地幔对流和不均匀的板块几何结构。
Positioning the peridotite solidus as the invariant thermodynamic pacemaker and attractor of plate tectonics.
首次将橄榄岩固相线作为板块构造的温控锚点和时间步调器。

sum: This paper proposes an alternative geodynamic model for the origin of the Hawaiian-Emperor chain, challenging the classical deep mantle plume hypothesis. Instead of a deep plume, the author suggests a high-viscosity asthenospheric body beneath the Pacific plate that migrates slower (~0.8–1.0 cm/a) than the surrounding asthenosphere (~2.5–4.0 cm/a). This migration lag hinders heat dissipation, leading to local heat retention and accumulation over 45–55 Ma, eventually triggering melting and volcanism. By analyzing published data on asthenospheric flow, hotspot kinematics, seismic tomography, heat flow, and helium isotopes, the paper argues that the thermal budget (82.7 GW total, with only 16.6% excess heat) is inconsistent with a deep plume. The model predicts a cone-shaped low-velocity anomaly and depth-rotating SKS fast axes, offering a unified framework for intraplate volcanism.
本文为夏威夷-帝王火山链的起源提出了一种新的地球动力学模型，挑战了传统的深部地幔柱假说。作者提出太平洋板块下方存在一个高粘度软流圈物质体，其运移速度（0.8-1.0 cm/a）远慢于周围软流圈（2.5-4.0 cm/a）。这种“运移滞后”阻碍了热量散失，导致局部热量积聚并达到约200°C的温升平衡，……

t: Analytical geodynamic modeling comparing asthenospheric flow kinematics with thermal budget calculations and published geophysical observations.
将软流圈流动运动学与热预算计算及已发表的地球物理观测进行对比的解析地球动力学建模。
Synthesized literature data including seismic tomography, surface heat flow, helium isotopes, and hotspot kinematics.
综合了包括地震层析成像、地表热流、氦同位素和热点运动学在内的文献数据。
Proposes a slow-migrating (~0.1 v_L) asthenospheric body retaining heat for 45-55 Ma, explaining the 82.7 GW thermal budget with only 16.6% excess heat.
提出一个慢速运移的软流圈物质体，蓄热45-55百万年，解释了仅含16.6%超额热的82.7 GW热预算。
The model is conceptual and analytical; detailed numerical modeling of the geodynamics is not performed.
该模型属于概念和解析性质，未进行详细的地球动力学数值模拟。
Replaces the deep mantle plume hypothesis with an asthenospheric migration lag model causing passive heat retention.
用软流圈运移滞后导致的被动蓄热模型取代了传统的深部地幔柱假说。

kc: Proposes a novel 'migration lag' heat retention model to explain the Hawaiian thermal anomaly without invoking a deep mantle plume.
Quantifies the thermal budget of the Hawaiian hotspot, showing that the excess heat (16.6%) is too low to support a deep-seated plume.
Provides testable predictions, including a cone-shaped low-velocity anomaly and depth-rotating SKS fast axes.
提出了一种创新的“运移滞后”蓄热模型，在不引入深部地幔柱的情况下解释了夏威夷热异常。

Thermal budget and heat retention modeling based on conduction and magmatic heat transport.
Comparative analysis of published seismic tomography, helium isotopes, and surface heat flow data.
软流圈流动的运动学与质量守恒分析。
基于传导和岩浆热输运的热预算与蓄热建模。
对已发表的地震层析成像、氦同位素和地表热流数据进行对比分析。

Calculated thermal budget parameters (69 GW conductive and 13.7 GW magmatic heat).
