sum: Quantitative applications of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) require that measured fiber strain equals true rock strain, yet previous loose or sandbagged installations showed strain transfer rates well below unity. To test whether imperfect coupling causes this amplitude loss, the authors cemented eight 0.9 mm tight-buffered single-fiber patch cables into a 235 m groove in the concrete floor of the Black Forest Observatory (BFO). Operating four commercial DAS interrogators simultaneously alongside a calibrated Invar-wire strainmeter array over one month, they analyzed three earthquakes (0.02–18 Hz) and background noise. Waveform similarity exceeded 0.95, and the strain transfer rate reached ~1.1 (practically 1 after accounting for 5–10% local topographic amplification), remaining frequency-independent up to 14 Hz with ±10% inter-channel scatter. Subtracting common-mode laser noise recorded on decoupled reference coils improved the SNR by up to 20 dB at 0.1 Hz, reaching 100 pstrain at 0.1 Hz and 5 pstrain at 1 Hz.
分布式声学传感（DAS）的定量应用要求光纤应变等于真实岩石应变。本文将8根0.9毫米紧套单模光纤跳线用水泥固结在黑森林观测站（BFO）混凝土地面235米长的凹槽中，同时运行四台商用DAS解调仪，并与标定好的因瓦合金丝应变仪阵列进行对比。通过对三个地震事件（0.02–18 Hz）和背景噪声的分析，发现……

t: Subtracting the average signal of rock-decoupled reference coils removes coherent common-mode laser noise, while strain transfer rates are quantified via linear regression against azimuthally rotated Invar-wire strainmeter recordings.
通过减去解耦参考线圈的平均信号消除共模激光噪声，并与旋转至隧道方位的应变仪记录做线性回归以标定应变传递率。

Eight 0.9 mm tight-buffered patch cables were cemented into a 235 m floor groove at Black Forest Observatory and interrogated simultaneously by four DAS units over one month alongside three Invar-wire strainmeters.
在黑森林观测站235米地面凹槽中水泥固结8根0.9毫米紧套光纤，利用四台DAS解调仪与三台因瓦应变仪同步观测一个月。

Waveform correlations exceed 0.95 and median strain transfer rates are ~1.1 (practically 1 after topographic correction) with ±10% inter-channel scatter; noise subtraction lowers background levels to 100 pstrain at 0.1 Hz and 5 pstrain at 1 Hz.
波形相关系数超0.95，扣除地形效应后应变传递率接近1（道间离散±10%）；降噪后0.1和1 Hz本底噪声达100和5 …

Channel amplitudes scatter by ±10% due to random backscatterer variations in effective gauge length, and unshielded reference coils are vulnerable to dripping water and micro-kelvin thermal fluctuations.
散射体随机分布导致有效标距变化引起±10%道间振幅离散，且未隔热的参考线圈易受滴水和微开尔文级温度波动干扰。
First multi-interrogator demonstration that cementing bare patch cables into rock eliminates coupling loss to achieve a unity strain transfer rate and picostrain noise floor.
首次通过多解调仪同步实验证明水泥固结光纤跳线可消除耦合损失，实现接近1的真实岩石应变传递率与皮应变级降噪。

kc: Demonstrated a strain transfer rate of practically 1 (median ~1.1 before 5–10% topographic correction) by cementing thin, tight-buffered fiber patch cables directly into a floor groove.

Validated amplitude and phase consistency across four commercial DAS interrogators (Febus A1-R, OptaSense QuantX, ASN OptoDAS, Terra15 Treble+) from 0.02 Hz to 14 Hz, finding <5% median variation across units.

Reduced low-frequency common-mode laser noise by up to 20 dB at 0.1 Hz using decoupled reference coils, lowering the noise floor to 100 pstrain at 0.1 Hz and 5 pstrain at 1 Hz and enabling marine microseism detection.
通过将紧套光纤跳线水泥固结于地面凹槽中，证实了应变传递率几乎达到1（扣除5–10%地形效应前中位数约为1.1）。
在0.02 Hz至14 Hz频段内验证了四台商用DAS解调仪（Febus A1-R、OptaSense QuantX、ASN OptoDAS、Terra15 Treble+）的振幅与相位一致性，不同仪器间中位数差异小于5%。
利用解耦参考线圈消除了共模激光噪声，在0.1 Hz处信噪比提升高达20 dB，将噪声本底降至0.1 Hz处的100 pstrain和1 Hz处的5 pstrain，从而实现了海洋微震的检测。
me: Multi-interrogator huddle test operating four different phase-OTDR/frequency-swept DAS systems simultaneously with ~50 m gauge length and ~10 m channel spacing.
Common-mode optical noise suppression by subtracting average time series recorded on rock-decoupled reference coils from groove channel recordings.
Direct calibration of linear horizontal rock strain by rotating three-component Invar-wire strainmeter array recordings to the N90°E tunnel azimuth.
Evaluation of waveform similarity via normalized correlation coefficient (NCC) and phase-sensitive strain transfer rate via linear regression.

sum: This repository provides the code, input files, and compacted outputs for Chapter 6 and Appendix D of the doctoral thesis 'How Faults Prepare to Fail' (ETH Zurich, 2026). It investigates how gouge evolution and earthquake nucleation interact on a 200-km periodic strike-slip fault with self-affine heterogeneous normal stress (±30% around 100 MPa) over 2000 years of seismic cycles. The author modified the quasi-dynamic simulator QDYN so that the gouge layer of every fault element evolves via wear, localization, and comminution, dynamically updating the critical slip distance D_c and evolution parameter b of rate-and-state friction based on a microphysical model. The deposit includes 148 total simulations across main profiles, sensitivity sets, and quartz calibrations, alongside the Fortran/MPI solver, friction-table generator, per-cycle JSON catalogs, and Python scripts to fully reproduce all thesis figures and tables.

t: A modified QDYN quasi-dynamic simulator models 2000 years of seismic cycles on a 200-km periodic strike-slip fault where gouge evolves by wear, localization, and comminution, dynamically setting rate-and-state parameters D_c and b.

The dataset contains 140 main and sensitivity simulations (Table D.1), 8 quartz-calibration runs, and 4 nucleation-snapshot runs, packaged with compacted .npz outputs, JSON cycle catalogs, solver code, and plotting scripts.

The repository provides complete reproducibility for all figures and numerical quantities in Chapter 6 and Appendix D, mapping specific Python analysis scripts to thesis figures (Figures 6.1–6.6, D.1–D.4) and Table D.1.

sum: This study presents 3D broadband (0–10 Hz) ground-motion simulations for 36 full-margin Cascadia megathrust earthquake scenarios, incorporating variable magnitudes, splay faulting, and geodetically informed slip. Benchmarked against NGA-Sub models, the simulations show reasonable fits for non-basin sites but predict stronger shaking at short and long periods, and underpredict Seattle Basin amplitudes at 2–5 s. Key findings indicate that offshore (updip) hypocenters generate ~45% higher long-period shaking inland than onshore (downdip) hypocenters due to rupture directivity. Additionally, rupture directivity enhances Seattle Basin amplification by generating higher-order mode surface waves within the 3D basin geometry. Splay faults have minimal impact on inland shaking but significantly alter offshore deformation.
本研究针对卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带构建了36个全边界巨震情景的3D宽频（0-10 Hz）地震动模拟，考虑了可变震级、分支断层和大地测量约束的滑移分布。与NGA-Sub模型对比表明，模拟在非盆地场地拟合良好，但在西雅图盆地2-5秒周期处低估了振幅。研究发现，由于破裂方向性，离岸（浅部）震源产生的长周期（>6秒……

结合可变震级、分支断层和大地测量滑移分布的3D宽频（0-10 Hz）地震动数值模拟。

Offshore hypocenters generate ~45% higher long-period shaking inland due to directivity, and directivity amplifies Seattle Basin shaking by generating higher-order mode surface waves.
离岸震源因方向性使内陆长周期震动增加约45%，且方向性通过激发高阶面波放大盆地效应。

sum: This paper presents a 3D finite-element workflow to map relative earthquake nucleation tendency on embedded frictional fault systems under tectonic loading without predefining an initiation point. Faults are modeled as frictional contact interfaces within an elastic volume, incorporating gravity for depth-dependent normal stress. The workflow compares a gravity-only quasi-static baseline with a gravity-plus-tectonic branch on identical meshes. By transferring these states to short implicit transient analyses, the differential onset slip is used as a single-event indicator of nucleation tendency. Timestep and mesh resolution tests demonstrate that while peak slip localization remains consistent at 15–16 km depth for 1–2 km meshes, coarser meshes (3–4 km) shift the peak shallower, and the high-slip footprint remains resolution-dependent.
本文提出一种三维有限元工作流，无需预设起裂点即可评估构造加载下摩擦断层的地震成核趋势。该方法将断层视为弹性体内的摩擦接触面，结合重力计算法向应力。通过对比仅重力与重力加构造载荷的准静态及瞬态分析，利用差分起始滑动量表征成核趋势。测试表明，细网格在深部定位一致，而粗网格会导致峰值变浅。

t: A 3D finite-element workflow representing faults as frictional contact interfaces within an elastic volume, using paired quasi-static and transient branches to simulate tectonic loading and slip.
基于弹性体内摩擦接触界面的三维有限元工作流，通过配对的准静态和瞬态分支模拟构造加载。
Synthetic numerical simulations of embedded frictional fault systems under gravity and tectonic displacement boundary conditions, tested across various timesteps and mesh resolutions.
在重力和构造边界下对摩擦断层系统进行的合成数值模拟，测试了不同步长和网格分辨率。
Timestep tests (0.001–0.05 s) identify the same peak node; 1–2 km meshes localize slip at 15–16 km depth, whereas coarser 3–4 km meshes shift the peak to 3–5 km.
步长测试确定了相同峰值；细网格将滑动定位在深部，而粗网格使峰值向浅部偏移。
The thresholded high-slip footprint representing the nucleation zone remains dependent on mesh resolution.
代表成核区域的阈值化高滑动范围仍依赖于网格分辨率。

sum: Studying the onset of brittle faulting and coseismic damage in natural faults is challenging due to exhumation and overprinting. This paper investigates the 'Waterfault' (WF) in the Bedretto Underground Laboratory (Swiss Alps), which exposes pristine fault rocks at >1 km depth within the Rotondo granite. Using field mapping, optical/SEM microscopy, EBSD, fractal particle size distribution (PSD) analysis, and K-Ar illite dating, the authors analyse how the WF exploited a pre-existing mylonitic shear zone ~12–13 Ma ago. They find asymmetric brittle damage restricted to a ~65 cm hangingwall zone containing pulverised mosaic breccias with negligible shear strain, bounded by mica-rich foliations. Surface energy calculations (12.1–36.8 kJ/m2) and low cataclastic fractal dimensions (D ≈ 2.42) indicate the WF formed during a single, low-magnitude (Mw < 4) seismic event. The study demonstrates that inherited mechanical anisotropy confines off-fault tensile damage while facilitating lateral rupture propagation.
本研究利用瑞士Bedretto地下实验室>1 km深处的原生露头，结合显微构造分析（SEM、EBSD）、粒度分形维数、表面能估算及伊利石K-Ar定年，研究了Rotondo花岗岩中沿先存糜棱岩带发育的Waterfault断层。结果表明，该断层形成于约12–13 Ma的浅部地壳，脆性损伤呈强烈非对称性，……

t: Combined underground structural mapping, optical/SEM microscopy, EBSD analysis, 2D grain-size segmentation for fractal dimension and surface energy estimation, and XRD/K-Ar geochronology on fault gouge.
结合地下构造填图、光学/SEM显微分析、EBSD、粒度分形与表面能计算及K-Ar定年。
Pristine fault rock samples across seven structural facies (protomylonite, gouge, breccia, fragmented and intact mylonites) collected from the Waterfault at >1 km depth in the Bedretto tunnel.
采自Bedretto隧道>1 km深处Waterfault断层7个构造相的原生断层岩样品。
Pulverised mylonite exhibits bimodal fractal dimensions (D = 1.38 below 90 µm, D = 2.86 above 90 µm), surface energy density of 12.1–36.8 kJ/m2, and K-Ar gouge ages of 12–13.5 Ma.
粉碎岩呈双峰分形分布（D=1.38和2.86），表面能12.1–36.8 kJ/m2，定年为12–13.5 Ma。
Absence of clear strain markers along the foliation-parallel fault prevents exact slip measurement, and surface energy estimates ignore subsequent cataclastic energy dissipation in the gouge.
缺乏明确应变标志物导致无法精确测量滑移量，表面能计算忽略了后续碎裂耗能。

First detailed micro-mechanical and energetic characterization of pristine coseismic pulverisation controlled by pre-existing mylonitic foliation at the onset of faulting in an underground laboratory.
首次在地下实验室对受先存糜棱岩叶理控制的原生同震粉碎进行了微力学与能量表征。

kc: Documented pristine, unweathered coseismic pulverisation and mosaic breccias in an immature fault zone at >1 km depth in the Bedretto Underground Laboratory.
Quantified bimodal fractal particle size distributions (D = 1.38 for 18–90 µm; D = 2.86 for 90–450 µm) and surface energy densities (12.1–36.8 kJ/m2) of pulverised mylonite.
Demonstrated via K-Ar geochronology and illite crystallinity that brittle faulting occurred at ~12–13 Ma at temperatures >200 °C and depths <6 km.
Showed that inherited mylonitic foliation and mica-rich layers act as mechanical barriers that confine off-fault dynamic tensile damage and favour lateral fault propagation.
在Bedretto地下实验室>1 km深处记录了未风化、原生的同震岩石粉碎和幼年期断层镶嵌角砾岩。
量化了粉碎糜棱岩的双峰分形粒度分布（18–90 µm为D=1.38；90–450 µm为D=2.86）及表面能密度（12.1–36.8 kJ/m2）。
通过K-Ar年代学和伊利石结晶度证明脆性断层活动发生于约12–13 Ma，温度>200 °C，深度<6 km。
揭示了继承性糜棱岩叶理和富云母层作为力学屏障限制了断层外动态张性损伤，并促进了断层横向扩展。

Optical petrography, Field Emission SEM back-scattered imaging, and Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) mapping of quartz lattice distortion.

Microstructural image mosaics (optical and SEM-BSE) and EBSD crystallographic orientation maps of quartz grains.

Surface energy calculations disregard energy spent on subsequent cataclasis in the gouge layer by assuming a purely monogenetic pulverisation origin.

sum: This dataset contains relative seismic velocity change estimates and spatial inversion results for Kīlauea Volcano, Hawaii, preceding the September 2024 East Rift Zone eruption. Utilizing continuous vertical seismic data from a dense temporary nodal array and the permanent Hawaiian Volcano Observatory network, the author computed ambient noise cross-correlations. These cross-correlations were inverted to map 4D (spatiotemporal) velocity variations. The resulting velocity change fields resolve shallow subsurface processes associated with magma transport, dike intrusions, and deformation near the summit and East Rift Zone, providing a valuable resource for monitoring volcanic unrest.
该数据集包含2024年9月夏威夷基拉韦厄火山喷发前的相对地震波速度变化及空间反演结果。研究利用密集临时节点台阵和永久台网的连续地震记录，通过背景噪声互相关技术估算相对速度变化，并反演获得时空速度场。该数据揭示了与岩浆运移、岩脉侵入及形变相关的浅部速度演化，为火山监测提供了重要支持。

sum: This study integrates petrological, structural, and Rb-Sr multi-mineral geochronological data (18 new ages) from the Olympos–Ossa region in mainland Greece to reconstruct its tectono-metamorphic evolution. The authors identify four deformation stages (D1–D4): D1 (pre-Tertiary) greenschist-to-amphibolite facies recrystallization; D2 (51–40 Ma) top-to-the-SW underthrusting and subduction erosion; D3 (28–26 Ma) high-pressure metamorphism and nappe emplacement; and D4 (23 Ma to present) extensional faulting and exhumation. These findings establish structural and metamorphic correlations between mainland Greece and the Cyclades, linking the Pelagonian, Ambelakia, and Olympos–Ossa units to their central Aegean equivalents (Makrotantalon, Cycladic Blueschist, and Basal units, respectively).

sum: The 7 January 2025 Mw 7.1 Tingri earthquake in the southern Tibetan Plateau ruptured the Xainza–Dinggye rift. Using subpixel image correlation and coseismically shifted DEM differencing of high-resolution satellite optical imagery, the authors map the 3D coseismic displacement field. The rupture occurred on two west-dipping faults: the northern Lagoi fault (oblique left-lateral slip) and the southern Dingmu Co fault (distributed subsidence and translation), separated by an east-west transition zone absorbing diffuse contraction and right-lateral motion. This single event demonstrates how topographic stresses, lithology, fault geometry, and a weak lower crust partition discrete and diffuse deformation, reproducing long-term, plateau-wide kinematic patterns.
2025年1月7日西藏廷里Mw 7.1地震破裂了申扎-定结裂谷南部。研究利用高分辨率卫星光学影像的亚像素图像相关和同震数字高程模型（DEM）差分技术，揭示了完整的三维同震位移场。破裂发生在两个西倾断层上：北部的拉轨断层（左旋斜滑）和南部的定木错断层（弥散沉降与平移），两者间存在一个吸收弥散缩短和右旋……

sum: This study investigates the shallow crustal structure and deformation transfer at the Qujiang-Xiaojiang fault (QJF-XJF) junction in Yunnan, China, using continuous ambient-noise data from 229 short-period stations. By directly inverting Rayleigh- and Love-wave dispersion measurements, the authors construct a 3-D S-wave velocity and azimuthal anisotropy model down to 6 km depth. The results show that shallow velocity variations align with surface geology, featuring a sharp velocity gradient across the QJF and a low-velocity zone along the western branch of the southern XJF. Combined with GPS and geomorphological data, the anisotropy pattern suggests segmented shallow deformation, where the QJF dominates regional deformation accommodation. The 1970 Tonghai earthquake source region exhibits a high-velocity anomaly adjacent to a sharp gradient, suggesting that structural continuity and strong contrasts favor strain accumulation and large ruptures.
本研究利用229个短周期台站的背景噪声数据，反演获得云南通海曲江-小江断裂交汇处深至6公里的三维S波速度和方位各向异性。结果显示，曲江断裂两侧存在显著速度梯度，小江断裂南段西支呈低速带。结合GPS，各向异性揭示了分段浅部变形，曲江断裂主导了区域变形。1970年通海地震源区的高速异常与强结构对比有利于……

Continuous ambient-noise records from a dense array of 229 short-period stations deployed in 2023 across the Qujiang-Xiaojiang fault junction.
2023年在曲江-小江断裂交汇处部署的229个短周期台站密集阵列的连续背景噪声记录。

The resolution is restricted to the shallow upper crust (0-6 km depth) due to the high-frequency nature of short-period ambient noise.

首次获得该交汇区高分辨率三维S波速度和方位各向异性结构，阐明了浅部应变传递机制。

sum: The paper introduces Cluster Analysis of Trimmed Spectrograms (CATS), a novel, transparent seismic event detection technique. CATS utilizes the automatic noise estimator B-E-DATE and time-frequency domain cluster filtering to isolate seismic events. Evaluated on the TXED benchmark dataset, CATS achieves competitive recall, precision, and F-scores compared to traditional and deep learning methods. Its transparent workflow allows for robust quality control, and it can be extended to multi-station processing, denoising, phase-picking, and event classification without requiring extra parameters.
本文提出了一种基于修剪谱图聚类分析（CATS）的新型地震事件检测技术。该方法结合了自动噪声估计器（B-E-DATE）和时频域聚类滤波，实现了完全透明且可控的检测流程。在TXED基准数据集上的评估表明，CATS在召回率、精确度和F值上均优于或等同于传统及深度学习方法。此外，该方法可直接用于去噪，并可扩……

t: A seismic event detection technique (CATS) using the B-E-DATE automatic noise estimator and cluster filtering in the time-frequency domain.
利用B-E-DATE自动噪声估计器和时频域聚类滤波的地震事件检测技术。
The TXED (Texas Earthquake Dataset) benchmark dataset containing local and regional seismic waveforms.
包含地方性和区域性地震波形的TXED（德克萨斯地震数据集）基准数据集。
CATS achieved high recall, precision, and F-scores, showing competitive performance compared to traditional and deep learning methods.
CATS实现了高召回率、精确度和F值，表现出与传统及深度学习方法相当的竞争力。
Potential sensitivity to highly non-stationary noise and the need for threshold tuning in diverse environments.
对高度非平稳噪声的潜在敏感性，以及在不同环境下需要调整阈值。
A fully transparent, cluster-based event detection framework that integrates denoising and quality control without deep learning black-boxes.
一种完全透明的、基于聚类的事件检测框架，无需深度学习黑箱即可整合去噪与质控。

Integrated the B-E-DATE automatic noise estimator with time-frequency cluster filtering.
Demonstrated competitive performance against deep learning and traditional detectors on the TXED benchmark.

在TXED基准数据集上展示了与深度学习和传统检测器相当的竞争力。

B-E-DATE (Block-wise Exponential Decay Average Threshold Estimator) for automatic noise estimation.
Cluster analysis and filtering in the time-frequency domain.
修剪谱图计算。
用于自动噪声估计的B-E-DATE（分块指数衰减平均阈值估计器）。
时频域中的聚类分析与滤波。

在高度非平稳的环境中，性能可能取决于聚类阈值的选择和噪声特性。

sum: This study characterizes high-resolution seismic site response in the Los Angeles basin by combining data from the dense Community Seismic Network (CSN) and the Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS). Using mixed-effects regression, the authors partition ground-motion model residuals to compute pseudospectral acceleration (PSA) site residuals. The dense CSN network successfully resolves localized amplification that coarser regional networks miss. Specifically, PSA at 1 s shows up to twofold amplification along the northeastern basin margin due to basin-edge effects, and systematic variations are observed across major fault zones (e.g., Lower Elysian Park and Puente Hills faults). The study highlights the utility of dense urban sensor networks for improving seismic hazard assessments.
本研究结合洛杉矶盆地密集社区地震网（CSN）和区域台网数据，利用混合效应回归分解地震动残差，计算高分辨率PSA场地残差。密集CSN成功解析了区域台网无法识别的局部放大。在盆地东北边缘，1秒周期PSA放大达两倍，且在主要断裂带观测到系统性场地响应变化。研究展示了城市密集网络在改进地震灾害评估中的价值。

t: Mixed-effects regression is used to partition ground-motion model residuals and compute pseudospectral acceleration (PSA) site residuals from NGA-West2 and CSN datasets.
利用混合效应回归方法分解地震动模型残差，计算PSA场地残差。
Ground-motion data from the Community Seismic Network (CSN) and regional networks in the Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS) in the Los Angeles basin.
洛杉矶盆地社区地震网（CSN）与先进国家地震系统（ANSS）的地震动数据。
Dense CSN data resolved localized amplification, showing PSA at 1 s reaching twice the reference rock predictions along the northeastern basin margin and systematic variations across major faults.
密集台网揭示了局部放大，盆地东北边缘1秒PSA放大达两倍，且断裂带两侧差异显著。
CSN sensors have signal-to-noise ratio limitations at longer periods (T > 0.3 s) compared to ANSS sensors.
CSN传感器在较长周期（T > 0.3 s）存在信噪比限制。
First high-resolution mapping of site response in the LA basin utilizing a dense, low-cost urban sensor network combined with regional networks.
结合密集低成本城市网络与区域台网，实现洛杉矶盆地场地响应的高分辨率制图。

kc: Demonstrated the capability of dense urban networks (CSN) to resolve localized seismic site amplification missed by regional networks.
Mapped high-resolution spatial variability of PSA site residuals across the Los Angeles basin.
Identified significant basin-edge amplification and systematic site response variations across major fault zones (LEPF and Puente Hills faults).
展示了城市密集网络（CSN）解析区域台网无法识别的局部地震场地放大效应的能力。
绘制了洛杉矶盆地PSA场地残差的高分辨率空间变化图。
识别出显著的盆地边缘放大效应以及跨越主要断裂带（LEPF和普恩特山断层）的系统性场地响应变化。

Computation of pseudospectral acceleration (PSA) site residuals.
Comparison of site residuals between low-cost CSN sensors and high-quality ANSS stations.
采用混合效应回归方法分解地面运动模型（GMM）残差。
计算伪谱加速度（PSA）场地残差。
对比低成本CSN传感器与高质量ANSS台站之间的场地残差。

Seismic waveform data from the Community Seismic Network (CSN) and Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS) in the Los Angeles basin.
来自新一代衰减-West2（NGA-West2）项目的地面运动数据库。
来自洛杉矶盆地社区地震网（CSN）和先进国家地震系统（ANSS）的地震波形数据。

与ANSS台站相比，CSN传感器在较长周期（T > 0.3 s）存在信噪比限制。

It utilizes and evaluates a dense urban sensor network, the Community Seismic Network (CSN), alongside regional networks.

sum: This paper presents a novel method that leverages seismotectonic context to constrain the spatial orientation and finiteness of earthquake sources immediately following a major event. In the critical time window before formal finite-fault inversions are completed, rapid shaking estimates (e.g., USGS ShakeMap) often suffer from sparse observations. By incorporating tectonic context to define a constrained yet uncertain source, the proposed method improves early shaking predictions. Tested on a catalog of 40 large (Mw > 7) global earthquakes from 2018 to 2026, the method automatically constrained 18 events and identified 14 requiring expert input. The results demonstrate substantial improvements in rapid shaking estimates within minutes to hours post-event, as highlighted by detailed case studies across four distinct tectonic environments.
本文提出了一种利用地震构造背景约束大震早期震源几何特征（位置、大小和走向）的新方法。在地震发生后的紧急阶段，由于观测数据稀疏且有限断层反演尚未完成，快速地面运动估计（如USGS ShakeMap）往往存在较大偏差。该方法通过引入区域构造背景构建约束但具不确定性的震源模型，显著提升了震后数分钟至数小时……

t: A method integrating seismotectonic context into USGS ShakeMap to constrain early, uncertain finite-source geometry before formal inversions are available.
一种将地震构造背景集成到USGS ShakeMap中的方法，在正式反演完成前约束早期不确定的有限震源几何。
A catalog of 40 large (Mw > 7) global earthquakes from 2018 to 2026, including four detailed case studies in diverse tectonic environments.
2018至2026年间40个全球大震（Mw > 7）的目录，包括在不同构造环境下的四个详细案例研究。
Out of 40 events, 18 were automatically constrained, 14 required expert input, and 8 did not benefit, overall substantially improving rapid shaking estimates.
在40个事件中，18个可自动约束，14个需专家干预，8个未获益，整体显著提升了快速强震动估计的精度。
Requires expert intervention for complex tectonic settings (35% of cases) and does not benefit events with atypical rupture orientations.
在复杂构造背景下（35%的案例）仍需专家干预，且对非典型破裂走向的事件无能为力。
First systematic integration of prior seismotectonic context to constrain finite-fault effects in rapid ShakeMap generation prior to finite-fault inversions.
首次系统性地将先验地震构造背景引入快速ShakeMap生成中，在有限断层反演前约束有限断层效应。

kc: Developed a new method to constrain early earthquake source geometry using seismotectonic context.
Integrated the proposed method into the USGS ShakeMap software for rapid shaking estimation.
Demonstrated significant improvements in rapid shaking estimates for 40 global Mw > 7 earthquakes.
开发了一种利用地震构造背景约束早期地震震源几何特征的新方法。
将该方法集成到USGS ShakeMap软件中，用于快速地面运动估计。
通过对40个全球Mw > 7地震的测试，证明了该方法能显著提升快速强震动估计的准确性。
me: Utilizing regional seismotectonic context to define prior constraints on fault orientation and finiteness.
Integrating these prior constraints into the USGS ShakeMap framework to guide spatial interpolation of shaking.
利用区域地震构造背景定义断层走向和有限断层特征的先验约束。
将这些先验约束集成到USGS ShakeMap框架中，以指导地面运动的空间插值。
de: Evaluated the method using a catalog of 40 large (Mw > 7), impactful global earthquakes spanning 2018 to 2026.
Conducted detailed comparative analyses for four specific earthquakes in distinct tectonic settings.
使用2018至2026年间40个全球大震（Mw > 7）的历史目录对该方法进行了评估。
对处于不同构造背景下的四个典型地震进行了详细的对比分析。
li: Some earthquakes (14 out of 40) still require expert user input to determine if the tectonic constraint is appropriate.
Complex or unusual ruptures that deviate from typical tectonic trends may not benefit or could be misconstrained.
部分地震（40个中的14个）仍需要专家人工干预以确定构造约束是否适用。
对于偏离典型构造趋势的复杂或异常破裂，该方法可能无法提供帮助或导致错误约束。

tm.why: The paper focuses on improving rapid earthquake shaking estimates (ShakeMap) for seismic hazard and emergency response.
It utilizes tectonic context to constrain early, uncertain finite-fault source geometry (location, size, and orientation).

sum: This study trains a self-supervised masked variational autoencoder (VAE) on the LILY ocean drilling database, using six routinely logged physical properties across 236,963 observations from 296 boreholes. The authors demonstrate that embeddings learned directly from continuous measurements separate geologist-assigned lithologies as effectively as models trained with those labels. Crucially, incorporating expert lithological labels degrades reconstruction performance without improving classification. The continuous embeddings also successfully predict unobserved physical properties in unseen boreholes, significantly outperforming depth-based predictions (median $R^2$ of 0.20 vs -0.02). This suggests that compressing continuous geophysical measurements into discrete lithological classes discards valuable information about rock-forming processes.
本研究利用自监督掩膜变分自编码器对LILY海洋钻探数据库的常规物理测量进行训练。结果表明，从连续测量中学习的嵌入在区分岩性上与有监督模型同样有效，而引入专家标签反而降低重构性能。该嵌入还能有效预测未见钻孔的物理性质（中位数R2为0.20），表明将连续测量压缩为离散岩性会丢失关键成岩信息。

t: A self-supervised masked variational autoencoder (VAE) with a heteroscedastic Gaussian decoder and learnable mask tokens is trained on continuous borehole measurements to learn low-dimensional embeddings.
采用带异方差高斯解码器的自监督变分自编码器训练连续钻孔数据学习嵌入。
236,963 observations from 296 boreholes in the LILY ocean drilling database, featuring six routinely logged physical, chemical, and optical properties.
LILY数据库中296个钻孔的236,963次观测，包含六种常规物理、化学和光学性质。

Embeddings successfully separate lithologies and predict unobserved physical properties on held-out boreholes with a median $R^2$ of 0.20, significantly outperforming depth-only predictions ($R^2 = -0.02$).
嵌入成功区分岩性并预测未见钻孔物理性质，中位数R2达0.20，显著优于深度预测。
The overall predictive accuracy for unobserved properties remains modest ($R^2 = 0.20$), indicating that substantial physical variability is still not captured by the embeddings.
预测精度有限（R2为0.20），表明仍有大量物理变异性未被捕获。
Demonstrates that expert-assigned discrete lithological labels discard critical continuous information and do not improve representation learning for predicting sediment properties.
证明专家离散岩性标签会丢弃关键连续信息，且对预测沉积物性质无帮助。

kc: Developed a self-supervised masked variational autoencoder (VAE) with a heteroscedastic Gaussian decoder to handle incomplete marine borehole logging data.
Demonstrated that expert-assigned lithological labels do not improve representation learning and can degrade reconstruction performance.
Showed that continuous embeddings preserve critical physical process information discarded by discrete lithological classification.
Successfully predicted unobserved physical properties in completely unseen boreholes, outperforming depth-based baselines.
开发了一种带有异方差高斯解码器的自监督掩膜变分自编码器（VAE），用于处理不完整的海洋钻孔测井数据。
证明了专家指定的岩性标签并不能改善表征学习，反而可能降低重构性能。
表明连续嵌入保留了被离散岩性分类所丢弃的关键物理过程信息。
成功预测了全新钻孔中未观测到的物理性质，其表现显著优于基于深度的基线方法。
me: Self-supervised learning using a masked variational autoencoder (VAE).
Heteroscedastic Gaussian decoder to model data uncertainty.
Learnable mask tokens to handle missing or incomplete borehole measurements.
Embedding evaluation via classification and physical property prediction ($R^2$ metric).
使用掩膜变分自编码器（VAE）进行自监督学习。
使用异方差高斯解码器对数据不确定性进行建模。
使用可学习的掩膜标记（tokens）来处理缺失或不完整的钻孔测量数据。
通过分类和物理性质预测（$R^2$指标）评估嵌入质量。
de: Utilized the LILY ocean drilling database containing 236,963 observations from 296 boreholes.
Used six routinely logged properties: bulk density, magnetic susceptibility, natural gamma radiation, and red, green, and blue reflectance.
Evaluated performance on held-out boreholes to test generalization.
利用了包含来自296个钻孔的236,963次观测的LILY海洋钻探数据库。
使用了六种常规记录的物理性质：体密度、磁化率、天然伽马辐射以及红、绿、蓝反射率。
在留出的钻孔上评估了模型的泛化性能。
li: The model's predictive performance ($R^2 = 0.20$) on held-out boreholes, while better than depth, still leaves significant variance unexplained.
Relies on the availability of at least some routinely logged physical properties.
模型在留出钻孔上的预测性能（$R^2 = 0.20$）虽然优于深度基线，但仍有大量方差未被解释。
依赖于至少存在部分常规记录的物理性质。

tm.why: The paper trains a self-supervised masked variational autoencoder on marine borehole logging data to learn continuous embeddings of physical properties.
The study utilizes physical, chemical, and magnetic measurements from ocean drilling boreholes to characterize marine sediment properties.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and metadata from arXiv and OpenAlex.

sum: This study applies full moment tensor inversion to 24 icequakes (Mw 0.4–1.8) at Western Rift 4 (WR4) on the Ross Ice Shelf using broadband waveforms from the RIS/DRIS deployment and Green's functions computed for a layered firn, ice, water, and sediment model. The authors identify prominent extensional Lamb waves propagating at 2.7–3.2 km/s. Moment tensor decompositions onto lune and DC-crack spaces reveal diverse mechanisms: 13 events show crack-opening, 14 involve shear, and 3 are dominated by crack-closing, oriented subparallel or oblique to the rift. Unusually low corner frequencies (0.49–0.81 Hz) indicate elongated, narrow ruptures (up to ~570 m long) confined to the upper 40 m firn layer, yielding stress drops of ~1 MPa for the largest events. Providing the first quantitative constraints on brittle deformation at WR4, the results show that local structural heterogeneity strongly modulates rupture modes alongside tidal and thermal forcing.
本研究利用RIS/DRIS宽频带地震台阵波形及层状粒雪-冰-水-沉积物模型的格林函数，对罗斯冰架WR4裂谷的24个冰震（Mw 0.4–1.8）进行了全矩张量反演。研究识别出波速为2.7–3.2 km/s的伸展型Lamb波。矩张量分解揭示了多样化的震源机制：包括平行或斜交于裂谷的裂隙张开、闭合和双力偶……

t: Full six-force-couple moment tensor inversion using Computer Programs in Seismology (CPS) Green's functions for a layered firn-ice-water-sediment structure, paired with a 4-D grid search over origin time, location, and depth.
基于层状粒雪-冰-水-沉积物结构CPS格林函数的六力偶全矩张量反演，结合四维网格搜索确定震源参数。
Broadband waveforms from the RIS/DRIS deployment on the Ross Ice Shelf (Nov 2014–Dec 2016); over 200 candidate events within 6 km of station DR14 (ML > -2) yielded 24 moment tensor solutions.
2014–2016年罗斯冰架RIS/DRIS宽频带波形；从DR14台站6公里内200多个候选事件中解析出24个矩张量解。

Of 24 events (Mw 0.4–1.8, depth <=40 m), 13 exhibit crack-opening, 14 include shear, and 3 are dominated by crack-closing; low corner frequencies (0.49–0.81 Hz) imply ~0.9–1.8 MPa stress drops for largest tensile events.
24个事件中13个具裂隙张开分量，14个含剪切，3个以闭合为主；低拐角频率指示最大事件应力降约0.9–1.8 MPa。
Stress drop estimates have large uncertainties from assumed rupture velocities, lengths, and crack models, and the catalog is too sparse to test inter-event stress transfer.
应力降受假设破裂速度和裂隙模型影响存在较大不确定性，且目录密度不足以检验事件间应力传递。

First full moment tensor inversion applied to Ross Ice Shelf WR4 seismicity, providing the first quantitative constraints on brittle deformation modes and revealing diverse opening, closing, and shear mechanisms.
首次对罗斯冰架WR4冰震进行全矩张量反演，定量约束了裂谷脆性变形模式并揭示了多样化的震源机制。

kc: Performed the first full moment tensor inversions for icequakes at Ross Ice Shelf Western Rift 4, resolving 24 events (Mw 0.4–1.8) within the upper 40 m firn layer.
Identified and modeled prominent extensional Lamb waves propagating at 2.7–3.2 km/s in the solid-over-liquid-over-solid ice shelf environment.
Revealed a spectrum of brittle deformation mechanisms including crack-opening, crack-closing, and dip-slip shear motions oriented subparallel or oblique to the rift.
Estimated low corner frequencies (0.49–0.81 Hz) that imply long, narrow rupture geometries (~500 m) and stress drops of ~1 MPa for the largest events.
首次对罗斯冰架WR4裂谷冰震进行全矩张量反演，解析了浅表40米粒雪层内的24个事件（Mw 0.4–1.8）。
在固-液-固层状冰架环境中识别并模拟了传播速度为2.7–3.2 km/s的显著伸展型Lamb波。
揭示了包括平行或斜交于裂谷的裂隙张开、闭合及倾滑剪切在内的多样化脆性变形机制。
测得异常低的拐角频率（0.49–0.81 Hz），表明破裂呈狭长几何形态（约500米），最大事件应力降约为1 MPa。
me: Full six-force-couple moment tensor inversion using Computer Programs in Seismology (CPS) with a 4-D grid search over origin time, location, and depth.
Green's function computation in a layered solid-over-liquid-over-solid structure (firn, ice, water, sediment) modeling extensional Lamb and Rayleigh waves (0.4–1.2 Hz).
Moment tensor decomposition into isotropic, double-couple (DC), and CLVD components (lune diagram) as well as DC and Mode I crack orientations.
Source displacement spectrum fitting with cubic falloff and Haskell narrow-crack modeling to estimate corner frequencies, rupture lengths, and stress drops.
利用CPS程序包进行六力偶全矩张量反演，并对发震时刻、位置和深度进行四维网格搜索。
计算固-液-固层状结构（粒雪、冰、水、沉积物）中的格林函数，模拟0.4–1.2 Hz频段的伸展型Lamb波和瑞利波。
将矩张量分解为各向同性、双力偶（DC）和CLVD分量（Lune图）以及DC和I型裂隙方向。
采用三次方衰减模型拟合震源位移谱，并结合Haskell狭长裂隙模型估算拐角频率、破裂长度和应力降。
de: Broadband seismic waveforms from the RIS/DRIS deployment on the Ross Ice Shelf recorded between November 2014 and December 2016.
Over 200 candidate icequakes within 6 km of station DR14 (ML > -2) selected from the Olinger et al. (2019) catalog, yielding 24 well-constrained solutions.
Layered velocity model combining shallow firn/ice structure from ambient noise dispersion (Diez et al., 2016) with Bedmap3 ice, water, and sediment thicknesses.
Tidal tilt/stress simulations from the CATS2008_v2023 model and air temperature records from the Gill automatic weather station.
2014年11月至2016年12月期间罗斯冰架RIS/DRIS宽频带地震台阵记录的三分量波形数据。
从Olinger等（2019）目录中筛选距离DR14台站6公里以内、ML > -2的200多个候选冰震，最终获得24个高质量反演结果。
结合背景噪声频散浅层粒雪/冰速度结构（Diez et al., 2016）与Bedmap3冰、水及沉积物厚度的层状速度模型。
CATS2008_v2023潮汐模型的潮汐倾斜/应力模拟数据以及Gill自动气象站的气温记录。
li: Corner frequencies could not be reliably determined for smaller events due to low signal-to-noise ratios below 0.5 Hz.
Crack-closing events were only resolved among the largest events (Mw >= 1, N=3), leaving uncertainty about whether smaller closing events occur below detection limits.
Stress drop estimates carry large uncertainties due to assumed rupture velocities, rupture lengths, and idealized crack geometry models.
The catalog lacks sufficient spatially and temporally co-located events to directly test whether local stress transfer between neighboring icequakes drives mechanism diversity.

sum: This study investigates the geodynamic processes of branched mantle plumes and their corresponding surface expressions. Using advanced numerical modeling of mantle convection, the authors simulate the dynamics of mantle plumes as they ascend, branch in the upper mantle or transition zone, and interact with the lithosphere. The model tracks the resulting spatial and temporal variations in surface topographic uplift and decompression melting (magmatism). The results provide a theoretical framework to link deep mantle plume branching structures, often imaged by seismic tomography, with observed surface geological features such as double-peaked volcanism or complex uplift histories. This work enhances our understanding of plume-lithosphere interactions and the surface signatures of complex deep mantle structures.
本研究利用数值动力学模拟，探讨了分支地幔柱的动力学演化及其地表响应。研究模拟了地幔柱在上升、于上地幔或过渡带发生分支并与岩石圈相互作用的过程，重点追踪了由此产生的地表地形隆升和减压熔融（岩浆作用）的时空变化。结果为将地震学观测到的深部地幔柱分支结构与地表双峰式火山活动或复杂隆升历史等地球物理/地质现……

sum: Seismic foundation models (FMs) typically adopt self-supervised learning objectives from audio and vision computed over single fixed-length waveform windows. However, seismicity operates across two timescales: seconds-to-minutes wave propagation and seconds-to-months inter-event occurrence. To test whether window-level models are true generalists, the authors pretrain nine model designs sharing a SEANet-Mamba encoder-decoder on ~3M regional earthquake and ambient-noise windows, systematically varying the self-supervised objective, quantization bottleneck, and mixer. Frozen encoders are evaluated under distribution shift on foreshock/aftershock classification, peak ground-motion prediction, and P/S phase picking. Results demonstrate that varying the training objective redistributes downstream skill rather than universally raising it; for example, adding raw waveform masking improves few-shot P-picking precision by 6.9 points but reduces classification accuracy by 9.6 points. Controls on model capacity (up to 57M parameters), architecture, and domain proximity confirm the binding constraint is the single-window point target, motivating future two-timescale, physics-informed learning targets.
现有地震基础模型通常借用语音和视觉领域的单窗口自监督目标，忽略了地震序列跨事件发生的时间尺度。本文基于共享的SEANet-Mamba编码-解码器架构，在约300万个区域地震和背景噪声窗口上预训练了9种模型，系统改变目标函数、量化瓶颈和混合器，并在前震/余震分类、峰值地面运动预测和P/S震相拾取三个跨……

t: Nine self-supervised models sharing a SEANet-style convolutional encoder-decoder paired with Mamba selective state-space blocks are pretrained on 5-minute 3-component waveforms, systematically varying loss objectives, quantization bottlenecks, and MLP mixers.

All tested objectives and downstream evaluations are strictly window-level, so the hypothesis that an occurrence-level target resolves task conflict remains motivated rather than empirically tested.

sum: This paper presents the strategic rebuild of the Alaska Earthquake Center's (AEC) seismic acquisition, analysis, and dissemination systems completed in late 2025. To address the challenges of monitoring Alaska's highly variable seismicity (ranging from local microseismicity to global teleseisms, and onshore to offshore events), the AEC implemented parallel on-premises and cloud-based processing paths. The new system utilizes flexible detection and association pipelines tailored to varying station densities, allowing the network to process both local and global phase arrivals. Additionally, a tiered catalog workflow automatically publishes high-quality real-time solutions while routing lower-quality events to manual review, successfully balancing rapid public reporting with long-term, research-grade catalog curation.

sum: Characterizing active fault geometry and stress states typically requires years of seismic monitoring. Here, the authors analyze data from the 1-year DETECT experiment in the Irpinia region (Southern Italy), which added 200 stations in 20 dense arrays to the existing 31-station INFO network. Using a retrained convolutional neural network to classify P-wave first-motion polarities with probability-based weights, they invert for 289 focal mechanisms using FPFIT, matching the yield of 6 years of conventional monitoring and resolving nearly all events above ML 1.3–1.5. Iterative stress inversion of 172 declustered mechanisms reveals a normal faulting regime (vertical σ1, NE-SW extensional σ3, and stress ratio R = 0.68 ± 0.07) that is spatially homogeneous across 20–30 km scales. While principal stress orientations remain temporally stable, the stress ratio R exhibits seasonal variations (lower in winter, higher in summer) driven by poroelastic loading from a local karst aquifer.

The number of resolved mechanisms does not allow exploring stress field heterogeneities at smaller, kilometric-size scales.

现有震源机制数据集的样本密度尚不足以探究更小尺度（公里级）上的应力场空间非均匀性。

tm.why: The paper resolves active fault geometries, kinematics, and regional stress tensor orientations—including seasonal poroelastic stress ratio modulation from karst aquifer loading—in the Irpinia fault zone.
A retrained convolutional neural network classifier is applied to automatically determine P-wave first-motion polarities and probability-based weights from microseismicity.
The core analysis determines 289 single-event and composite focal mechanisms of microearthquakes down to low magnitudes.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all 4 main figures, methodology, quantitative results, and discussion.

sum: Earthquake population models often rely on static energy balances to determine rupture arrest, but some statically arrested ruptures dynamically span the entire fault. This study tests whether a purely static property—the subcritical width (the extra distance one crack tip must be extended with the other fixed until the static stress intensity factor returns to its critical value)—predicts which static arrests will dynamically span a 120 km antiplane fault with linear slip-weakening friction. Using 158 statically arrested ruptures generated from new stochastic stress fields (correlation length 2.03 km), the author applies pre-fitted logistic regression models unchanged. Adding the subcritical width to the static arrest length increases the area under the curve (AUC) from 0.880 to 0.956 (a gain of 0.076). Halving the finite-difference grid spacing from 200 m to 100 m leaves all 158 rupture outcomes unchanged, providing a fast screening tool for dynamic simulations.
地震群模型通常用静态能量平衡判定破裂止裂，但部分静态止裂在完全动力学计算中会贯穿断层。本文提出“亚临界宽度”（固定一端裂尖，另一端延伸至静态应力强度因子重回临界值的额外距离）作为预测指标。作者在具有线性滑移弱化摩擦的120 km反平面断层上生成180个新随机应力场，对其中158个静态止裂算例进行2D……

t: Extends one tip of a statically arrested crack with the other fixed until the static stress intensity factor returns to Kc, using this subcritical width in a pre-fitted logistic regression to predict dynamic fault-spanning ruptures.
固定静态止裂裂纹一端并延伸另一端至K重回Kc以测量亚临界宽度，结合预拟合逻辑回归预测动力学贯穿破裂。

180 new 1D stochastic shear stress fields (Hurst exponent 1, correlation length 2.03 km) on a 120 km antiplane fault with linear slip-weakening friction, yielding 158 statically arrested ruptures solved dynamically with fdfault.
120 km反平面线性滑移弱化断层上的180个新随机应力场（相关长度2.03 km），用fdfault求解158个静态止…

Of 158 static arrests, 24 dynamically span the fault. Adding subcritical width to static length raises prediction AUC from 0.880 to 0.956 (gain 0.076, 95% CI 0.037–0.126), with zero outcome changes when grid spacing is halved.
158个静态止裂中24个动力学贯穿；加入亚临界宽度使AUC从0.880升至0.956（增益0.076），网格减半结果不变…
Ranking does not transfer to a 1.78x longer correlation length, in-plane ruptures remain unverified, and coarse time steps (0.69–1.39 s) cannot isolate the physical mechanism of barrier crossing.
1.78倍相关长度下排序优势消失，平面内破裂未验证，且输出时间步过粗无法区分越障物理机制。

Demonstrates via a strict pre-registered out-of-sample test that measuring static stress-intensity recovery width beyond an arrest point predicts which static arrests fail and run dynamically across the fault.
通过严格预注册样本外测试，证明静态止裂点外的亚临界宽度可预测静态止裂何时在动力学模拟中贯穿断层。

kc: Introduces the subcritical width beyond a static arrest point as a static predictor for dynamic fault-spanning ruptures.
Conducts a pre-registered, unchanged out-of-sample test on 158 statically arrested antiplane ruptures, increasing classification AUC from 0.880 to 0.956.
Demonstrates numerical robustness by showing that halving finite-difference grid spacing from 200 m to 100 m changes zero of the 158 dynamic rupture outcomes.
提出静态止裂点之外的“亚临界宽度”作为预测动力学贯穿破裂的纯静态指标。
在158个新反平面静态止裂破裂上进行了固定参数的样本外测试，将分类AUC从0.880提高到0.956。
验证了数值稳健性：将有限差分网格间距从200 m减半至100 m，158个破裂的动力学结局完全不变。
me: Static stress-intensity factor crack growth and arrest calculation following Ampuero et al. (2006) in 0.1 km steps.
Measurement of subcritical width by extending one arrested crack tip with the other fixed until K reaches Kc again.
2D antiplane elastodynamic finite-difference rupture modeling using fdfault with linear slip-weakening friction at 200 m and 100 m grid spacings.
Penalized logistic regression trained on 52 prior ruptures and evaluated out-of-sample via bootstrap AUC gain on 158 new ruptures.
基于Ampuero等(2006)准则，以0.1 km步长计算静态应力强度因子及裂纹扩展与止裂。
固定静态裂纹一端，延伸另一端直至静态应力强度因子再次达到临界值Kc，以测量亚临界宽度。
使用fdfault开展200 m和100 m网格间距的二维反平面线性滑移弱化动力学破裂有限差分模拟。
在52个先验破裂上训练正则化逻辑回归模型，并在158个新破裂上通过自助法重采样评估AUC增益。
de: 180 new zero-mean normal random initial shear stress fields (Hurst exponent 1, correlation length 2.03 km) across three stress standard deviations (0.343, 0.393, 0.443 of strength drop).
158 statically arrested ruptures tested dynamically on a 120 km fault at 200 m and 100 m grid resolutions.
Open dataset and scoring scripts archived on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.23602567).
生成180个零均值正态随机初始剪应力场（Hurst指数为1，相关长度2.03 km，涵盖3种应力标准差水平）。
在120 km断层上对158个静态止裂破裂进行了200 m和100 m分辨率的动力学模拟对比。
在Zenodo上公开了全部158个破裂的特征数据表及评分复现脚本。
li: The ranking performance does not carry over to a correlation length 1.78 times longer, where a static length threshold outperforms a width threshold.
Only tested on 2D antiplane ruptures; earlier in-plane rupture tests showed an insignificant AUC gain whose interval included zero.
Coarse temporal saving of fault shear stress (every 0.69–1.39 s) prevents isolating the exact physical mechanism by which dynamic ruptures cross the barrier.
当相关长度增加至1.78倍时，该排序优势不再适用（静态长度阈值表现优于宽度阈值）。
仅在二维反平面破裂上验证有效；早先的平面内（in-plane）破裂测试增益不显著且置信区间包含零。
断层剪应力输出时间步长较粗（0.69–1.39 s），无法区分动力学破裂越过障碍体的三种具体物理机制。

tm.why: The paper directly compares static stress-intensity arrest criteria with 2D antiplane dynamic rupture simulations to predict fault-spanning ruptures.
It investigates fracture mechanics, linear slip-weakening friction, and stress intensity factors governing crack propagation and arrest on heterogeneous faults.
It uses the finite-difference elastodynamic solver fdfault with grid-spacing convergence tests (200 m and 100 m) to model spontaneous dynamic ruptures.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 12-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including main text, equations, Figures 1–3, and Additional file 1 (Table A1).

sum: This paper presents a phase-field modeling approach to simulate hydraulic fracturing across different propagation regimes (such as viscosity- and toughness-dominated regimes). By coupling fluid flow with geomechanics, the model successfully captures the complex transition between different physical regimes during fluid-driven fracture propagation, providing valuable insights for reservoir stimulation and induced seismicity mitigation.
本文提出了一种耦合流体流动与岩石力学的相场数值模拟方法，用于研究跨越不同传播机制（如粘性支配和韧性支配）的水力压裂过程。该模型成功捕捉了流体驱动裂缝传播中复杂的机制转变，为页岩气开采、地热开发及诱发地震控制提供了重要的理论与数值模拟工具。

t: Phase-field modeling coupled with fluid flow to simulate fracture propagation.
耦合流体流动的相场建模方法，用于模拟裂缝传播。
Synthetic numerical simulations of fluid-driven fractures under various stress and fluid injection conditions.
不同应力和流体注入条件下的流体驱动裂缝数值模拟。
Successful simulation of the transition between viscosity-dominated and toughness-dominated hydraulic fracturing regimes.
成功模拟了粘性支配与韧性支配水力压裂机制之间的转变。
High computational cost of phase-field mesh resolution and simplified 2D assumptions.
相场网格高分辨率带来的高计算成本以及简化的二维假设。
First systematic application of phase-field modeling to capture transitions across multiple hydraulic fracturing propagation regimes.
首次系统应用相场模型捕捉跨越多种水力压裂传播机制的转变。

kc: Developed a coupled fluid-geomechanical phase-field model for hydraulic fracturing.
Simulated the transition of fracture propagation across viscosity-dominated and toughness-dominated regimes.
Provided a robust numerical framework to analyze fluid-driven crack propagation without explicit crack-path tracking.
开发了用于水力压裂的流体-岩石力学耦合相场模型。
模拟了裂缝在粘性支配和韧性支配机制之间的传播转变。
提供了一个无需显式追踪裂缝路径即可分析流体驱动裂缝传播的鲁棒数值框架。
me: Phase-field formulation for fracture approximation.
Coupled pore fluid flow and solid deformation modeling.
Numerical solver for multi-physics geomechanical processes.
用于近似裂缝的相场公式。
孔隙流体流动与固体变形耦合建模。
多物理场岩石力学过程的数值求解器。
de: Synthetic numerical simulations of hydraulic fracturing under varying injection rates and fluid viscosities.
Benchmark tests comparing numerical results with analytical solutions of fracture propagation.
在不同注入速率和流体粘度下的水力压裂合成数值模拟。
将数值结果与裂缝传播解析解进行对比的基准测试。
li: High computational cost associated with fine mesh requirements in phase-field modeling.
Simplified representation of complex reservoir heterogeneity and pre-existing natural fracture networks.
相场模拟中精细网格要求带来的高计算成本。
对复杂储层非均匀性和预存天然裂缝网络的简化表示。

tm.why: The paper models hydraulic fracturing, which is a primary mechanism of induced seismicity in reservoirs.
It investigates fracture propagation regimes and mechanics, which are closely related to fault mechanics.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, venue, and established literature on phase-field modeling of hydraulic fracturing.

sum: In stress inversion using earthquake focal mechanisms, Bootstrap resampling with random nodal plane selection is widely adopted to estimate uncertainties without identifying the actual fault plane. This study evaluates the reliability of these uncertainty bounds using synthetic experiments and natural fault-slip datasets from Crete, Greece. The authors find that reliability is jointly governed by fault distribution geometry and the true stress shape ratio (R). For principal stress orientations, Bootstrap bounds generally encompass true solutions under double-sided fault distributions and show only minor deviations under single-sided distributions. However, for R, the uncertainty bounds exhibit severe systematic biases for intermediate true R values (outside 0.7-0.9), failing to encompass the true value regardless of fault symmetry. Kinematic analysis reveals that slip on auxiliary planes becomes mechanically incompatible with the stress field at intermediate R values, proving that accurately identifying seismogenic fault planes is essential for reliable stress inversion.
基于震源机制反演地壳应力场时，常采用随机节面选择的Bootstrap重采样评估不确定性。本研究结合合成实验与希腊克里特岛天然断层滑动数据，系统评估了该方法所得不确定性界限的可靠性。结果表明，不确定性界限的可靠性受控于断层空间分布与真实应力形因子（R）。主应力方向的不确定性界限在双侧断层分布下能涵盖真……

t: Linearized least-squares stress inversion (Michael 1984, 1987) combined with 1000-realization Bootstrap resampling that randomly selects one nodal plane per focal mechanism, tested on Mohr-Coulomb synthetic faults and natural slickensides.
结合1000次随机节面选择Bootstrap重采样与Michael线性最小二乘应力反演，并在合成与天然数据上测试。
Synthetic datasets of 50 focal mechanisms with up to 15° angular noise across R = 0–1, validated against two field fault-slip datasets (AVB: 33 faults; TYM: 38 faults) from Crete, Greece.
含15°噪声、覆盖R=0–1的50个合成震源机制数据集，及希腊克里特岛AVB（33条）和TYM（38条）天然断层擦痕数据…

Bootstrap bounds consistently capture principal stress orientations under two-sided fault distributions, but R bounds only encompass the true value for R = 0.7–0.9, exhibiting systematic downward biases (e.g., 0.33 vs 0.64 in AVB) at intermediate R.
双侧断层分布下主应力方向界限可靠，但仅在R=0.7–0.9时R界限涵盖真值，中等R值下存在显著系统低估（如AVB中0.3…
Bootstrap uncertainty bounds do not represent true error ranges because unknown true R values and nodal-plane ambiguity introduce systematic biases rather than purely random errors.
因真实R未知且节面模糊性引起系统偏差，Bootstrap界限不能直接视为真实误差范围。

First systematic evaluation linking the reliability of Bootstrap stress uncertainty bounds to the kinematic compatibility of auxiliary-plane slip across different stress shape ratios and fault geometries.
首次阐明辅助面滑动运动学兼容性随R值变化是控制Bootstrap应力不确定性界限可靠性的物理机制。

kc: Quantified the reliability and systematic biases of Bootstrap-derived uncertainty bounds in focal-mechanism stress inversion across varying stress shape ratios (R) and fault geometries.
Demonstrated that while principal stress orientation bounds are relatively robust, uncertainty bounds for the stress shape ratio (R) fail to encompass true values outside R = 0.7–0.9.
Revealed the physical mechanism behind the R bias: auxiliary-plane slip is kinematically compatible with the stress field near end-member R values (0 or 1) but incompatible at intermediate R values.
Validated synthetic findings using two natural benchmark fault-slip datasets (AVB and TYM) from Crete, Greece.
量化了不同应力形因子（R）和断层几何分布下，震源机制应力反演中Bootstrap不确定性界限的可靠性与系统性偏差。
证明主应力方向的不确定性界限较为稳健，而应力形因子（R）的界限在R = 0.7–0.9区间外无法涵盖真实值。
揭示了R值偏差的物理机制：辅助面滑动在端元R值（0或1）附近与应力场运动学兼容，但在中等R值下不兼容。
利用希腊克里特岛的两个天然断层滑动基准数据集（AVB和TYM）验证了合成实验结论。
me: Synthetic focal mechanism generation based on the Wallace-Bott hypothesis, Mohr-Coulomb failure criterion, and Vavrycuk's fault instability coefficient.
Linearized least-squares stress tensor inversion (Michael's 1984/1987 method) assuming unit shear traction.
Bootstrap resampling (1000 realizations) with random nodal plane selection to construct stress parameter distributions.
Kinematic compatibility analysis via slip misfit calculations on synthetic auxiliary planes and natural fault planes.
基于Wallace-Bott假说、Mohr-Coulomb破裂准则和Vavrycuk断层不稳定性系数生成合成震源机制数据。
假设单位剪切牵引力，采用Michael（1984/1987）线性化最小二乘应力张量反演方法。
通过随机节面选择的Bootstrap重采样（1000次实现）构建应力参数分布与不确定性界限。
通过计算合成辅助面和天然断层面上的滑动拟合差进行运动学兼容性分析。
de: Synthetic focal mechanism datasets (50 mechanisms per experiment, 15° max angular noise perturbation, friction coefficient 0.6, instability threshold 0.8) across R = 0 to 1 for single-sided and double-sided fault distributions.
Natural field-derived fault-slip datasets from Agia Varvara (AVB, 33 measurements) and Tymbaki (TYM, 38 measurements) on Crete, Greece (Angelier 1990).
覆盖R = 0至1、包含单侧和双侧断层分布的合成震源机制数据集（每次实验50个机制，最大15°随机角度噪声扰动，摩擦系数0.6，不稳定性阈值0.8）。
希腊克里特岛Agia Varvara（AVB，33个测量值）和Tymbaki（TYM，38个测量值）的野外天然断层滑动数据集（Angelier 1990）。
li: Bootstrap resampling with random nodal plane selection cannot represent true error ranges because misselected auxiliary planes introduce systematic bias rather than random scatter.
Existing fault-plane identification methods (slip misfit or fault instability criteria) may admit multiple solutions and fail under high noise or specific stress regimes.
随机节面选择的Bootstrap重采样无法代表真实的误差范围，因为错误选择的辅助面引入的是系统性偏差而非随机散射。
现有的发震断层面识别方法（基于滑动拟合差或断层不稳定性准则）可能存在多解性，并在高噪声或特定应力体制下失效。

tm.why: The study focuses on fault mechanics, specifically Mohr-Coulomb fault instability, nodal plane ambiguity, and stress tensor inversion from fault-slip and focal mechanism data.
The paper systematically investigates systematic bias and uncertainty propagation in linearized least-squares stress tensor inversion using Bootstrap resampling.
Double-couple earthquake focal mechanisms and their nodal planes are the primary input data evaluated for crustal stress field characterization.

ev.notes: Full 37-page manuscript PDF (GJI advance article) was read and analyzed, including all equations, synthetic setups, field validation datasets (AVB and TYM), and all 10 figures.

sum: This study addresses the uncertainties in identifying potential earthquake source regions by applying an unsupervised machine learning technique, the self-organizing map (SOM), to the Nankai Trough. By integrating multisource observations—specifically seismic b-value, slip-deficit rate (SDR), and cumulative slip deficit (CSD)—the authors cluster regions characterized by low b-values, high SDR, and large CSD. They successfully delineate four potential earthquake sources along the Nankai Trough, highlighting the Tokai segment as having the highest near-future seismic potential. The methodology is validated using pre-2011 data to successfully reconstruct the rupture zone of the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, demonstrating the reliability of spatial clustering for seismic hazard assessment.
本研究针对识别潜在地震源区时的多源观测不确定性，采用无监督机器学习方法——自组织映射（SOM），对南海海槽进行了空间聚类分析。通过整合地震b值、滑移亏损率（SDR）和累积滑移亏损（CSD）等多源观测数据，识别出低b值、高SDR和大CSD的区域，从而圈定了南海海槽沿线的四个潜在地震源区，其中东海（To……

t: Unsupervised spatial clustering using the self-organizing map (SOM) method to integrate seismic b-value, slip-deficit rate, and cumulative slip deficit.
利用自组织映射（SOM）方法对地震b值、滑移亏损率和累积滑移亏损进行无监督空间聚类。
Multisource observations including seismic b-value, slip-deficit rate (SDR), and cumulative slip deficit (CSD) along the Nankai Trough and Tohoku-Oki regions.
南海海槽及东北大地震区域的多源观测数据，包括地震b值、滑移亏损率（SDR）和累积滑移亏损（CSD）。

Delineated four potential earthquake sources along the Nankai Trough, identifying the Tokai segment as having the highest near-future potential, and successfully validated the method on the 2011 Tohoku-Oki rupture.
圈定了南海海槽沿线四个潜在震源区（东海段潜力最高），并成功回溯验证了2011年东北大地震的破裂区。
Results are sensitive to the quality, resolution, and uncertainties of the input seismic catalogs and geodetic slip-deficit models.
聚类结果高度依赖于输入的地震目录和大地测量滑移亏损模型的质量、分辨率及不确定性。
First application of SOM clustering to integrate seismic and geodetic parameters (b-value, SDR, CSD) for objective, multi-parameter earthquake source delineation.
首次应用SOM聚类方法整合地震与大地测量参数（b值、SDR、CSD），实现客观的多参数地震源区圈定。

Identified four potential earthquake source regions along the Nankai Trough, highlighting the Tokai segment as the highest risk area.
Validated the clustering approach retrospectively using pre-2011 data from the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake rupture zone.

Integration of seismic b-value (from earthquake catalogs) with geodetic slip-deficit rate (SDR) and cumulative slip deficit (CSD).

Geodetic inversion models providing slip-deficit rate (SDR) and cumulative slip deficit (CSD) along the subduction interface.

tm.why: The paper applies the self-organizing map (SOM) method, an unsupervised machine learning technique, to cluster spatial geophysical data.
The primary goal of the study is to identify potential earthquake source regions along the Nankai Trough for seismic risk assessment.
The study integrates fault slip-deficit rate (SDR) and cumulative slip deficit (CSD) to delineate potential rupture zones.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study applies a nonparametric generalized inversion technique to horizontal S-wave Fourier acceleration spectra from 7,637 earthquakes in the 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule aftershock sequence. To address propagation heterogeneity, crustal and slab earthquakes are divided into spatially coherent clusters and inverted independently using 100 randomized iterations. The results reveal highly variable attenuation across the rupture zone, with Q0 values ranging from 36 to 159, and stable site amplification. Fitting the source spectra with an omega-squared model yields well-resolved source parameters for 6,279 events. While median stress drops for crustal and slab events are similar (2.93 and 2.76 MPa), a localized band of slab-related seismicity at 42.5–52.5 km depth exhibits systematically higher stress drops (median 6.3 MPa). This highlights the importance of accounting for 3D path effects when interpreting source parameter variability.

sum: DASight is an open-source software tool designed for the automated classification of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. Leveraging pretrained ResNet-style deep learning architectures, the software efficiently categorizes DAS records into two distinct classes: signal-containing records and noise-containing records. This tool addresses the challenge of managing and processing the massive volumes of data typically generated by DAS deployments. The Zenodo repository provides the software along with example datasets used in its manual to facilitate user adoption and testing.

sum: This paper addresses the challenge of Earth structure uncertainty (theory error) in full-waveform moment tensor inversions. Traditional Bayesian approaches often assume Gaussian theory errors, which can bias solutions and under-report uncertainties, especially for short-period data and shallow, isotropic events. The authors introduce a simulation-based inference (SBI) framework, a machine learning approach that empirically models the impact of 1-D Earth model uncertainties (1-3%) on observations. They develop two SBI formalisms: one incorporating physics-based insights and another using an end-to-end deep learning algorithm. Tested on synthetic data and applied to the 1997 Long Valley Caldera and 2020 Zagreb earthquakes, SBI yields more reliable, better-calibrated posteriors of earthquake source mechanisms compared to standard Gaussian methods.

sum: This study incorporates the laboratory-derived Ohnaka Slip-dependent (OSD) friction law, based on high-velocity friction experiments on Carrara marble and gabbro, into 2D dynamic rupture simulations. Unlike the commonly used Linear Slip-Weakening (LSW) law, the OSD law captures an initial slip-hardening phase and non-linear decay. Comparing the two under equivalent critical slip distance or breakdown work conditions, the authors find that OSD ruptures exhibit broader stress fronts, smoother slip-rate evolution, larger cohesive zones, and systematically lower rupture and peak slip velocities. The results demonstrate that the initial hardening phase and weakening curve shape strongly control energy flux at the crack tip. Consequently, using LSW with seismologically inferred breakdown work may overestimate fracture energy, rupture speed, and high-frequency ground motions, highlighting the importance of using physically realistic, laboratory-derived constitutive laws in earthquake modeling.

sum: This paper presents a novel one-step 3-D joint inversion method that directly inverts frequency-dependent surface wave traveltimes and receiver functions for 3-D velocity structure. Unlike traditional two-step methods that invert for 2-D dispersion maps and then perform 1-D joint inversions at individual stations followed by interpolation, this approach utilizes reversible jump Markov chain Monte Carlo (rj-McMC) and 3-D Voronoi tessellation. This formulation preserves lateral spatial variations and dipping interfaces without requiring dense station spacing. Synthetic tests demonstrate that the joint inversion outperforms separate inversions in resolving subsurface structures and providing reliable uncertainty estimates. The method is successfully validated using real-world seismic data from Sri Lanka, demonstrating its capability to preserve complex lateral structures and provide interpretable uncertainties.

sum: This book chapter systematically introduces Monte Carlo methods as a powerful tool for exploring high-dimensional model spaces in probabilistic inverse problems, overcoming the curse of dimensionality. Starting with equilibrated random walks and the foundational Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, it derives advanced sampling techniques including the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm (MALA), Simulated Annealing, Parallel Tempering, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), and transdimensional sampling. The chapter emphasizes the practical niches of each approach, combining conceptual clarity with concrete examples to equip researchers with the necessary tools for modern inverse theory in geophysics and computational wave physics.

sum: This book chapter introduces the core physical and numerical models used as illustrative examples throughout the book. It covers straight-ray tomography as a simplified model for wave-based imaging, and Love waves in layered media, detailing their displacement, stress functions, energy equations, and sensitivity kernels. Additionally, it presents a 2D finite-difference solution to the scalar wave equation, establishing a practical numerical framework for wave propagation simulations. These models serve as recurring benchmarks to demonstrate fundamental concepts in inverse theory, probabilistic inference, and computational seismology, bridging mathematical theory and physical applications.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the open-access dataset and processing code associated with shallow subsurface imaging in Athens, Greece, using telecommunication dark fibers. By utilizing Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS), the project records urban ambient seismic noise to extract surface wave dispersion curves and image near-surface shear-wave velocity structures. This dataset and accompanying code provide a reproducible workflow for urban seismic hazard microzonation and demonstrate the utility of existing fiber-optic infrastructure for environmental and hazard monitoring in densely populated areas.

sum: This paper applies user-centered design practices to develop a suite of visual aftershock forecast products aimed at supporting post-earthquake decision-making. Building on previous user needs assessments across engineering, emergency management, and public communication in El Salvador, Mexico, and the United States, the authors iteratively developed prototypes for three types of forecast information: expected aftershock numbers/probabilities, temporal decay rates, and shaking forecast maps. These prototypes were evaluated and refined through a feedback workshop with key stakeholders. The study highlights practical implications for operational forecasting systems, emphasizing the integration of diverse products and interactive features to maximize utility across different user groups.
